title: Merchandise Manager
description:
Store - DEN-BRIGHTON, COThe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards. This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.
  • Execute and maintain SISO (Store-In-Stock Optimization) routines to drive in-stock levels, replenishment accuracy, and sales readiness.
  • Oversee Planogram (POG) execution, ensuring merchandising sets are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards, including initial product placement and presentation to company expectations.
  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Type of Experience Required

  • 3+ years retail leadership experience

Work Environment

  • Ability to remain standing for long periods of time
  • Ability to move throughout the store
  • Regular bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and stretching
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise and fixtures, up to 25-50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve products.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including scanning items, stocking shelves, and operating POS equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent customer interactions.
  • Work hours include nights, weekends and early mornings

Applicants in the U.S. must satisfy federal, state, and local legal requirements of the job.

Total Base Pay Range for this Position:

$16.00 - $22.20This position may be eligible for overtime compensation in accordance with state and local laws.

Application Deadline: This position will remain open until

2026-12-12

Note: We encourage early applications as we may begin interviewing qualified candidates before the deadline.

title: Data Scientist
description:
The Data Scientist is a key member of the Pricing Strategy & Insights team, responsible for leveraging advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, and statistical methodologies to support pricing strategy, revenue optimization, and enterprise decision-making across VCA and Mars Veterinary Health. This role focuses on leveraging large, complex datasets to uncover patterns in pricing, utilization, and client behavior, and to design analytical models and optimization approaches that improve pricing decisions, revenue outcomes, and long‑term strategic planning.

Operating at the intersection of data science, pricing strategy, and business decision‑making, the Data Scientist translates analytical questions into robust statistical and machine‑learning models (e.g., price elasticity, demand forecasting, and segmentation) and translates model outputs into clear, actionable insights for pricing leaders and cross‑functional stakeholders. This role also supports a test‑and‑learn culture by applying experimental and measurement approaches (e.g., A/B testing) to quantify the impact of pricing actions and promotional strategies.

In addition to hands‑on model development, the Data Scientist is responsible for validating analytical approaches, documenting assumptions and limitations, and partnering with analysts and technical teams (e.g., data engineering) to enable scalable data pipelines and production‑ready model deployment into dashboards and decision tools. Reporting to the Director, Pricing Strategy & Insights, this role helps elevate the analytical maturity of the Pricing organization by introducing repeatable modeling techniques, best practices, and forward‑looking insights that strengthen how pricing decisions are evaluated, governed, and executed.

This role requires associates to work a hybrid schedule out of one of the MVH North America Hub Locations – Los Angeles, CA.

Essential Responsibility/Tasks:

  • Advanced Analytics & Modeling: Design, build, and maintain statistical and machine‑learning models to support pricing decisions, including price elasticity, demand forecasting, segmentation, and drivers of utilization and spend.
  • Pricing Optimization & Decision Support: Develop analytical approaches and (as appropriate) optimization methods that account for profitability and business constraints; translate model outputs into practical pricing recommendations and scenario implications for leaders.
  • Experimentation & Impact Measurement: Design and analyze statistical experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to evaluate pricing and promotional effectiveness; ensure results are clearly communicated and inform future pricing actions.
  • Data Engineering Partnership & Data Preparation: Prepare and transform large‑scale datasets using SQL and Python/R; partner with data engineering and analytics teams to ensure data quality, consistent definitions, and scalable pipelines.
  • Model Validation, Documentation & Governance Enablement: Validate models for accuracy and stability; document methodologies, assumptions, and limitations; support responsible use of analytics in governance and decision forums.
  • Deployment & Enablement: Support operationalization of models into dashboards, tools, and recurring decision processes (including monitoring and refresh); train/enable analyst partners on model interpretation and usage.
  • Other Related Duties as Assigned: Support ad hoc analyses, leadership requests, and cross‑functional initiatives related to pricing, promotions, or growth strategy.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Operations Research, or related field. Master’s degree or PhD in related field is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or statistical modeling
  • Experience in pricing, revenue optimization, demand forecasting, or commercial analytics is preferred.

*All degrees will be deemed “or equivalent combination of education and experience” unless absolutely required to do the job (i.e., DVM degree for Veterinarian, Law degree for Attorney, etc.).

PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Python (preferred libraries: scikit‑learn, XGBoost, pandas, NumPy, matplotlib)
  • SQL (large‑scale structured datasets)
  • Statistical modeling, machine learning, and optimization techniques
  • Data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau or equivalent) and executive presentations
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel (modelling and communication)

Additional Information: Compensation is negotiable based on education, experience, and other relevant credentials. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $107,656 - $161,485. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only.

If you are a current associate, you will need to apply through our internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on the Jobs Hub app or search for Browse Jobs.

Benefits: We offer competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision and paid vacation/sick days, 401(k), generous employee pet discounts and more!

The information in this position description indicates the general nature and level of work to be performed. It is not designed to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of associates assigned to this job. Management reserves the right to revise the job description or require that other tasks be performed when the circumstances of the job change (for example, emergencies, change in personnel, workload, or technical development)

title: Autorisert fagarbeider
company: Tønsberg kommune Avlastning og forebyggende tjenester
description:
Vil du bidra til en trygg og forutsigbar hverdag for en ungdom?

Tjenesten omfatter praktisk bistand og helsetjenester i hjemmet til en ungdom med funksjonsnedsettelser. Virksomhet avlastning og forebyggende tjenester har ansvar for tilbudet.
Bemanningen er to ansatte per tjenestemottaker på dagtid, kveldstid og i helgene, i tillegg til egne våkene nattevakter.
Kommunen ønsker å bygge et sterkt og stabilt lag rundt tjenestemottakeren, og søker deg som vil bidra til trygge, forutsigbare og gode tjenester.

Turnus og arbeidstid

Vi tilbyr en alternativ turnus som kombinerer komprimerte arbeidsperioder med sammenhengende friperioder.
Arbeidsperioder og friperioder fastsettes i en kalenderplan for ett år av gangen. Kalenderplanen viser den konkrete fordelingen av arbeid og fri. Det legges opp til langvakter.
Arbeidsstedet er ca. 15 minutter fra Tønsberg sentrum.

Du vil bli en del av et større lag

Tiltaket er et av sju tiltak i virksomhet Avlastning og forebyggende tjenester. Vi er opptatt av at barn og unge får gode, forsvarlige og likeverdige tjenester.
Virksomheten har seks døgnbemannede avlastningssentre som gir avlastningstjenester, barneboliger, psykisk helsetjeneste og aktivitetsgrupper til barn og unge 0-18 år.
Virksomheten er en av 13 virksomheter i sektor for mestring og helse i Tønsberg kommune.

Hovedarbeidsoppgaver

  • Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Daglig tjenesteyting og utøve helsehjelp i tråd med gjeldende krav og lovverk

  • Tilrettelegge for aktiviteter med tjenestemottaker

  • Målrettet miljøarbeid knyttet opp tjenestemottakers behov

  • Sikre brukermedvirkning

  • Dokumentasjon i Aidn (vårt journalsystem)

  • Medansvarlig for utarbeidelse av tiltaksplaner og evaluering

  • Legemiddelhåndtering

  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid og ta del i faglige beslutninger

  • Delta på kurs og opplæring som til enhver tid er prioritert i kompetanseplanen

Kvalifikasjonskrav

  • Autorisert helsepersonell, fortrinnsvis fagarbeider eller tilsvarende

  • Førerkort klasse B, tiltaket har egen tjenestebil

  • Digitale ferdigheter

  • Språkkrav for helsepersonell tilsvarende B2

  • Gyldig politiattest må fremvises ved oppstart

Det er ekstra fint for oss om du også har

  • Kjennskap til lovverk som regulerer tjenesten særlig HOL kap.9

  • Erfaring eller interesse for arbeid med læringsutfordringer/utfordrende atferd

  • Erfaring med epilepsi

Hvem ser vi etter?

  • Du må tåle hektiske dager med ulikt innhold.

  • Vi jobber med mennesker – noe som krever endringsvilje og fleksibilitet i måten å løse oppgavene på

  • Jobben krever at du har en høy grad av selvstendighet

  • Jobben krever godt samarbeide med nærpersoner og andre instanser

  • Du er en lagbygger med gode samarbeidsevner - som har et ønske om å bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Hva kan vi tilby deg?

  • Fast ansettelse

  • Lønn etter gjeldende tariffavtale

  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger

  • Varierte og spennende oppgaver

  • Faglig utvikling

  • Tilgang på bedriftshytter

  • Treningsavtaler

Søkerlister med opplysninger om navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bosted- eller arbeidskommune for hver søker er offentlig i hht Offentlighetsloven. Det kan gjøres unntak dersom søker anmoder om dette og grunngir dette i søknaden. Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge, vil søkeren varsles om dette.

Kommunen ber aldri om kontaktinformasjon eller kontoopplysninger i rekrutteringsfasen, verken over SMS, e-post eller i brev via Digipost

title: Fitness Specialist - Naples, FL
description:
FOX Rehabilitation is hiring a Fitness Specialist to lead group exercise and personal training for older adults at a Senior Living Community in Naples, Florida. This role is ideal for a personal trainer, exercise science graduate, or certified fitness professional passionate about healthy aging, fall prevention, and functional fitness for seniors.


About this role

This is a part-time position (approximately 5 hours per week) with a clear path to grow your caseload and hours. You will serve as the primary wellness professional embedded within a Senior Living Community, delivering evidence-based fitness programming to older adults through group classes, one-on-one personal training, and partner training sessions.

Current schedule:

Tuesday - Friday: 10:30 am - 11:00 am


What you'll do

Grow the wellness program

Drive engagement among residents to increase group class participation and build a 1:1 and partner training client base. Growth is fueled by your relationship-building efforts and reinforced by referrals from FOX's skilled therapy team as patients transition out of rehabilitation.

Collaborate with a therapy team

Work alongside FOX Physical and Occupational Therapists and Speech Language Pathologists at the Senior Living Community. Build trust with clinicians who refer patients to wellness, a direct pipeline that supports your schedule growth.

Educate and connect

Confidently communicate the benefits of wellness programming to residents, family members, and power-of-attorney contacts to increase participation and program awareness.

Expand your reach

Travel to patient residences for house call sessions and expand into additional communities as your territory grows.


Why Join FOX Rehabilitation?

FOX Rehabilitation is a clinician-operated practice rooted in meaningful relationships, evidence-based care, and a mission to abolish ageism. You’ll be supported by leaders who understand client and senior living community engagement, because they’ve lived it.


Why fitness specialists love working with FOX

  • Opportunities to practice in both in-home and senior living community settings
  • Potential telehealth / virtual care components that expand flexibility and access
  • Opportunity to autonomously drive growth of FOX Wellness and be the SLC’s “go to” for all things Wellness
  • A collaborative, interdisciplinary environment (PT, OT, SLP, Fitness Specialists)
  • Work within a community-based practice that supports independence, wellness, and longevity
  • A culture that invests in your growth and values provider-driven decision-making

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or Exercise Physiology; OR Certified Personal Trainer through a nationally accredited organization (ACSM, NSCA, NASM, ACE, ISSA preferred); OR prior fitness training experience with willingness to obtain CPT certification
  • Experience or strong interest in working with older adults in a proactive, wellness-focused setting
  • Comfortable presenting and educating residents and families on wellness program benefits
  • Ability to travel between Senior Living Communities and patient residences as needed
  • Current CPR certification
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; responsive to email, Teams, text, and phone
  • Basic computer skills for documentation and scheduling

Physical Requirements

The physical demands below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. The strength classification for this position is medium, defined as:

  • Exerting 25–50 lbs. of force occasionally (up to 1/3 of the time)
  • Exerting 10–25 lbs. of force frequently (up to 2/3 of the time)
  • Exerting up to 10 lbs. of force constantly

Additional physical requirements include:

  • Ability to perform CPR
  • Moderate to maximum assists with patient transfers and bed mobility
  • Able to reposition a bed-bound patient independently
  • Required to stoop, sit, bend, pull, climb, reach, kneel, crouch, and climb stairs
  • Stand for extended periods of time
  • Prolonged periods of intense physical exertion including running, lifting, and stretching
  • Perform repetitive movements of the upper extremities
  • Extensive walking throughout the shift
  • Fit to drive (required for House Calls setting)
  • Regularly required to talk and hear; specific vision abilities include close vision and ability to adjust focus
  • Frequently required to stand, walk, use hands to feel, and reach with hands and arms

title: Director, People AI Engineering & Innovation
description:
The Director, People AI Engineering & Innovation is Assurant’s hands-on AI technical and product leader for the People Organization. This leader establishes the People Organization’s technical AI strategy, architecture, platform roadmap, engineering standards and delivery framework while partnering with SLT sponsors, People Organization teams and the Execution COE to shape and evaluate demand. The Director determines the right solution path and turns prioritized opportunities into secure, production-grade AI products with measurable value. The Director brings deep experience from outside traditional HR and works directly in discovery, prototyping, design review, troubleshooting and delivery when needed. Safety, security, privacy, roles and access, infrastructure readiness, responsible AI and human controls are built into every stage with enterprise technology and control partners. The role establishes clear operating interfaces and decision rights across AI Innovation, Workday and People Technology, People Data and Analytics, ERIN/Unify Experience, the Execution COE, People functional teams and enterprise partners.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?


People AI Technical Strategy, Architecture & Delivery Framework


  • Establish and evolve the People Organization’s technical AI strategy and roadmap, translating priorities and emerging capabilities into a clear architecture, platform direction and sequenced capability roadmap.
  • Define reusable technical patterns, engineering standards, decision frameworks and delivery practices that move solutions securely from concept through production, stabilization and formal transfer.
  • Partner with SLT sponsors, People teams and the Execution COE to help teams understand what is technically possible, shape opportunities and determine when AI is the right solution versus Workday, automation, process simplification or another platform.
  • Maintain a clear point of view on architecture, platform choices, security, roles and access, responsible AI, production readiness and long-term supportability.

Hands-On AI Architecture, Engineering & Delivery


  • Serve as the technical and architecture authority for People AI solutions across approved platforms.
  • Participate directly in prototyping, architecture, workflow and integration design, technical reviews, evaluations and troubleshooting.
  • Lead approved solutions from discovery through design, build, validation, launch and a defined stabilization period.
  • Establish reusable patterns, grounded-solution approaches, evaluation methods, documentation and engineering standards.

Safety, Security, Access & Responsible AI


  • Build safety, security, privacy, identity, roles, permissions, least-privilege access and People-data protection into every stage of the lifecycle.
  • Partner at every stage with IT, Infrastructure, Information Security, Privacy, Legal and enterprise AI-governance teams.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, escalation, monitoring, auditability and controls for sensitive decisions and higher-risk use cases.
  • Retain approval authority over architecture, security, access, integrations, model changes and production readiness and pause changes that do not meet required standards.

Value Realization, Governance & Product Lifecycle


  • Define success measures for adoption, quality, capacity released, experience improvement, control effectiveness and sustained ROI.
  • After stabilization, complete a formal transfer to a named business or product owner who owns adoption, business priorities, backlog and value realization.
  • Retain technical governance over architecture, security, access, integrations, model or platform changes, evaluations, monitoring and production readiness.
  • Partner with the Execution COE and product owners on quarterly results readouts and recommendations to scale, improve, hold or retire solutions.

Operating Model, Decision Rights & Cross-Functional Partnership


  • Establish and maintain clear operating interfaces across AI Innovation, Workday and People Technology, Data and Analytics, ERIN/Unify Experience, the Execution COE, functional teams and enterprise partners.
  • Define and uphold decision rights, design authorities, service expectations, escalation paths, technical ownership and lifecycle accountabilities.
  • Partner with SLT sponsors and functional teams on business problems; partner with the Execution COE on education, show-and-tells, discovery, intake, prioritization and portfolio governance.
  • Partner with the Workday leader when solutions touch Workday data, processes, roles, integrations or transactions, preserving Workday as the authoritative system of record.
  • Contribute technical perspective, demonstrations and reusable examples that help leaders recognize opportunities, without sole accountability for generating organizational demand.

Talent & Team Leadership


  • Build a high-performing, hands-on AI product and engineering team by setting a clear talent standard and meaningful accountability for outcomes.
  • Develop talent through direct coaching, technical reviews, differentiated development, stretch assignments and clear expectations.
  • Build bench strength and succession capability and prepare team members for broader product, technical and leadership responsibility.
  • Evolve roles and hire capabilities where gaps exist, with emphasis on architecture, engineering, security, evaluation, responsible AI and production delivery.
  • Use external partners selectively while maintaining internal architecture authority, technical knowledge, accountability and ownership.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data science or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive technology, software, data or AI experience, including leadership of production and enterprise-grade solutions and teams.
  • 3+ years of deep hands-on experience designing and delivering AI products, agents, grounded solutions, workflows, integrations and enterprise applications in production.
  • Demonstrated technical depth in solution architecture, APIs, data flows, identity, roles and access, security, monitoring, evaluations and production readiness.
  • Experience developing technical AI strategies, architecture roadmaps, reusable patterns and engineering frameworks.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot, UnifyApps, Leena AI, Claude or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience embedding security, privacy, responsible AI, human oversight and auditability throughout a product lifecycle.
  • Strong product judgment and experience translating ambiguous business problems into practical solutions and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to personally prototype, inspect designs, review technical work, troubleshoot complex issues and lead alongside engineers.
  • Experience establishing decision rights and operating interfaces across business, product, platform, data, portfolio and control teams.
  • Demonstrated talent leadership, including differentiated development, bench building, succession planning, hiring and effective use of external partners.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, AI, data science or a related field.
  • Experience building AI products outside traditional HR or People Technology environments.
  • Experience with enterprise copilots, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration platforms and model evaluation.
  • Experience operating in highly regulated or data-sensitive environments.
  • Familiarity with People processes or People technology is helpful but not required.

title: Chief Engineer
description:
Chief Engineer

Our Culture:

We are a highly entrepreneurial company limited only by our imagination. Diversity and teamwork are major aspects of our culture. Success comes to those who continuously seek opportunities to learn and pass on new knowledge. We always strive to be better, never bored, and never complacent. Focus on ways to promote and engage in internal growth programs.

Continuously exemplify and live by our Culture.

  • Complete all required training
  • Adhere to all standard operating procedures and property specific brand standards

  • Inspect and maintain elevators

  • Repair furniture and structures

  • Direct and oversee the functionality and safety of the facility, including, but not limited to, physical buildings, mechanical equipment, electrical systems, heating/cooling systems, plumbing systems, life safety systems and grounds according to federal, state, and local regulations

  • Must be able to use/lift arms for up to 8 hours

  • Able to work in varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, rain, etc.

  • Must speak in a clear, understandable voice, hear at a basic level, and understand English

title: Production Area Manager
description:
JOB FUNCTION

We are seeking a motivated and ambitious Production Area Manager to join our production team and support the daily management of specific manufacturing departments. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop leadership skills and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced chemical manufacturing environment.

Working closely with experienced managers, the Junior Production Area Manager will contribute to ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production processes. The role involves supporting team coordination, monitoring production activities, helping to optimize workflows, and participating in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing productivity, quality, and cost efficiency.

The ideal candidate is eager to learn, demonstrates strong problem-solving and communication skills, and has an interest in manufacturing operations. A proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety and teamwork are essential for success in this role.

The objective of this position is to build the competencies required to progressively take on greater responsibilities while contributing to the delivery of high-quality products in a safe, efficient, and cost-effective manner.


MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Support the management of department, assisting in the coordination of daily operations and production schedules.
  • Monitor production activities and contribute to the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, and productivity targets.
  • Learn and apply OEM standards, technical specifications, and relevant industry requirements (IATF 16949, ISO 9001).
  • Support supervisors and operators in maintaining efficient workflows and resolving day-to-day operational issues.
  • Assist in monitoring key production KPIs (efficiency, scrap rates, cycle times) and participate in the implementation of improvement actions.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, contributing to Lean Manufacturing and problem-solving activities.
  • Promote and support compliance with workplace safety and environmental standards.
  • Collaborate with Logistics, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to ensure smooth production flows.
  • Support maintenance planning activities by coordinating with maintenance teams on preventive and corrective interventions.
  • Contribute to employee training and onboarding activities, helping to ensure adherence to operating procedures.
  • Prepare reports and communicate production updates to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Develop leadership and people management skills through coaching, mentoring, and hands-on experience in the production environment.

Requirements

  • Master or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Mechanical, or related fields.
  • 1-3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in a Team Leader, Shift Leader, Production Engineer, Production Supervisor, or similar role.
  • Experience within chemical manufacturing or other process industries is preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes, plant operations, maintenance practices, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Initial experience in coordinating production teams and supporting daily shop floor activities.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and regulatory requirements in an industrial environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to adapt in a dynamic production setting.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with ERP or production management systems is considered a plus.
  • Good command of English, both written and spoken.

The base salary range for this position is 50.000,00 eur to 55.000,00 eur per year.

title: Hospital Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Veterinary Client Service or Veterinary Technician professional to join our leadership team as Hospital Manager.
The role demands a leader with the interpersonal and organizational skills to continue achieving our goals of delivering excellent patient care and customer service to both our clients and referring veterinarians.

The successful candidate will have experience in Human Resource and personnel management, Marketing, and Business development. Your strong financial and operational acumen will be put to good use!

The Hospital Manager—under the guidance of the Regional Management team and in partnership with the Medical Director—performs a wide range of administrative activities related to the practice. This includes: mentoring the staff and overseeing the business operations and maintenance of the facility; ensuring the business growth and profitability of the practice; and supporting the hospital’s mission of delivering high quality patient care and exceptional client service.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially to a diverse range of audiences and settings.

• Professional comportment and appearance, with excellent interpersonal skills and a friendly, positive attitude.
• Respect for and willingness to work with clients and their pets.

title: PMO & Programs Manager
description:
The PMO & Programs Manager leads the execution discipline for main Procurement and applicable Supply Chain projects. You will be responsible for PMO methods, the Sourcing Strategy Management Office (SSMO), assigned program execution, PMO support for approved contract management improvement initiatives, continuous improvement and value realization. The role ensures initiatives are appropriately scoped, prioritized, executed, measured and embedded into sustainable operating routines.

This role is part of the global Operations Center of Excellence and is expected to work across Procurement spend categories and applicable Supply Chain or Operations initiatives where PMO methods, execution discipline or process improvement support is required.

  • Improve the PMO framework, including project intake, prioritization, governance rhythm, portfolio reporting, and supporting tools.

  • Lead change management and program enablement, including team member communications, training, adoption activities, and the development of process and program documentation.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in project/program management, continuous improvement, procurement operations, supply chain operations, or related fields within complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, Operations or a related field required; Master of Business Administration or advanced degree.

description:

Overview

We are seeking a hands-on, technically skilled professional to join our global team as an Associate Platform Reliability Engineer. This role is critical to ensuring the stability, reliability, and resilience of Jefferies’ front-to-back technology infrastructure, with a focus on post-trade processing, operations, and regulatory support.

  • Identify and eliminate manual support tasks through automation; develop tools for deployment, management, and service visibility.

title: Pathology Manager
description:
Pathology Manager

Glasgow Hospita] | Pathology | Permanent | Full time

At Nuffield Health the UKs largest healthcare charity, everything we give our patients, members and customers would not be possible without you. Leadership and team management

title: Repairs Surveyor
description:
About the role

Our Repairs and Maintenance teams play an important role in delivering our vision of providing great homes and great service. They offer vital support, ensuring that our homes are safe, warm, and dry, and where everything works; Places where our residents are proud to live.

We are looking for a Repairs Surveyor to join our team covering locations in Hertfordshire & Bedfordshire. This is a full time, permanent role offering agile working.

The overall purpose of the role is to carry out surveys and property inspections, oversee the delivery of subcontracted repairs and ensure repairs are highlighted and completed in accordance with Guinness standards and timeframes.

Working Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with 8-hour shifts scheduled between 8:00am and 8:00pm. Occasional Saturday working (8:00am to 12:00pm) on a rota basis, with no more than 1 in 4 weekends required.

What we are looking for

We are seeking someone with strong technical knowledge of building standards, experience in HHSRS assessments, and an understanding of responsive, voids and planned repairs. You will be confident managing contractors, working independently, delivering excellent customer service, and communicating clearly.

You will be able to demonstrate these essential skills:

  • Excellent level of knowledge of building construction standards, and legislation, and an ability to diagnose and specify remedies to building defects.
  • Experience of undertaking assessments in line with the Housing Health & Safety Rating System.
  • Understanding of responsive repairs, voids works, planned and cyclical repairs requirements.
  • Ability to be proactive and work on own initiative, with limited supervision.
  • Experience of managing contractors.
  • Excellent standards of customer care and the ability to deliver accurate and clear communications in writing, face to face or by telephone.
  • Good IT skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office, housing and property management systems.
  • Ability to plan, organise and prioritise a heavy workload, whilst working on a mobile basis, keeping excellent records.
  • Demonstrates the Guinness Behaviours.

Desirable skills:

  • A good understanding of the context of social housing.
  • Experience in working within a commercially aware environment.

Essential qualifications:

  • Educated to Level 4 (HNC in Surveying or Construction & Built Environment or equivalent) or higher.
  • Evidence of continuous professional development.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Level 4 VRQ Certificate in Managing Damp, Mould and Customer Care in Housing.
  • RICS (Building Surveying) or MCIOB membership.

title: Pomočnik direktorja – z možnostjo dolgoročnega nasledstva (m/ž)
description:
Naš naročnik je podjetje z dolgoletno tradicijo na področju razvoja in proizvodnje tehnološko naprednih rešitev. Odlikujejo ga lastno znanje, razvojna usmerjenost, visoki standardi kakovosti ter prisotnost na zahtevnih mednarodnih trgih.

V začetnem obdobju bo ključna naloga pomočnika direktorja povezovanje produktnega vodenja, prodaje, marketinga in razvoja (R&D) ter zagotavljanje njihovega usklajenega delovanja v smeri tržnih potreb, konkurenčnih produktov in poslovnih rezultatov. V tej vlogi bo spoznal poslovanje, ključne procese in ekipo ter postopoma prevzemal širše vodstvene odgovornosti z dolgoročno perspektivo prevzema vodenja družbe.

Opis delovnega mesta

  • Povezovanje in usklajevanje produktnega vodenja, prodaje, marketinga in razvoja (R&D),
  • Sodelovanje pri oblikovanju produktne strategije in poslovnih usmeritev,
  • Povezovanje potreb kupcev in mednarodnih trgov s produktnim razvojem,
  • Usklajevanje prodajnih, marketinških in razvojnih prioritet,
  • Vodenje ključnih projektov od ideje do lansiranja produktov,
  • Sodelovanje pri strateških in operativnih poslovnih odločitvah,
  • Postopno prevzemanje širših vodstvenih odgovornosti.

Pričakujemo

  • Univerzitetno ali magistrsko izobrazbo tehnične smeri, prednostno elektrotehnike,
  • Zaželena dodatna poslovna izobrazba oziroma znanja s področja managementa ali poslovodenja,
  • Izkušnje s produktnim vodenjem, prodajo ali poslovnim razvojem,
  • Dobro razumevanje razvoja kompleksnih tehničnih produktov in sodelovanja z R&D,
  • Izkušnje iz mednarodnega industrijskega oziroma tehnološkega B2B-okolja,
  • Izkušnje z vodenjem medfunkcijskih ekip in projektov,
  • Sposobnost povezovanja inženirskega razmišljanja s poslovnimi cilji, tržnimi potrebami in strateškim razvojem podjetja,
  • Strateško razmišljanje, samostojnost in razvite vodstvene sposobnosti,
  • Dobro znanje angleškega jezika.

Ponujamo

  • Pomembno in dolgoročno perspektivno vodstveno vlogo,
  • Neposredno vključevanje v ključne poslovne in strateške odločitve,
  • Strukturirano uvajalno obdobje in celovit vpogled v poslovanje podjetja,
  • Postopno prevzemanje odgovornosti z možnostjo dolgoročnega nasledstva in prevzema vodenja družbe.

title: Housing Assistant - Multiple Locations across City
description:
Housing Assistant (Homelessness Prevention & Housing Options Team (HP&HOT)
Multiple Locations across City

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850
Hours: 36 per week

The City of Edinburgh Council’s Homelessness Prevention and Housing Options Team is at the frontline for tackling and preventing homelessness in Edinburgh.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a full time HP&HOT Housing Assistant to support Homeless Housing Officers with the prevention and statutory duty requirements to households who are homeless or threatened with homelessness in Edinburgh.

All posts will be based in any of the following locations at any given time:

  • 249 High Street, Edinburgh
  • North West Office – 8 West Pilton Gardens, Edinburgh
  • North East Office – 101 Niddrie Mains Road, Edinburgh
  • South East Office – 40 Captains Road, Edinburgh
  • South West Office – 10 Westside Plaza, Edinburgh
  • Working from home

Please note that that at any point in your employment with the Council that you may be required to work in any location across Edinburgh and therefore the above locations may change at short notice.

The HP&HOT Housing Assistant will work in a statutory service supporting Housing Officers to provide advice and support to customers to prevent and resolve homelessness by helping them remain in their home or where this is not possible secure a home.

They will provide assistance with ongoing management of cases, ensuring that homeless applicants are accessing appropriate support, considering their full housing options and bidding appropriately to enable them to secure permanent accommodation.

The role will be administrative with ongoing customer contact, maintaining records and closing cases timeously. This will enable Housing Officers to focus on the provision of high quality and person-centred case work to assist households to resolve their homelessness.

The HP&HOT Housing Assistant will fulfil the Council’s duties by working to legislative and good practice requirements and in collaboration with many other statutory services and partner organisations.

Successful candidates require resilience and excellent organisational skills as they will be working within a busy service area with competing demands. They must be able to take ownership and responsibility for their tasks and have a proven track record of working within a challenging frontline service.

This post is subject to a Basic Disclosure check. Where an individual has spent a continuous period of 3 months or more out with the UK in the last 5 years, an Overseas Criminal Record Check will be required. You will be required to provide this check. An unconditional offer of employment and commencement in the post will be subject to the outcome of both these pre-employment checks being deemed satisfactory.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone feels valued and able to be their best. We particularly encourage applications from women for senior roles, as well as people from minority ethnic backgrounds, people with disabilities or neurodivergent people, care experienced people, carers and LGBT+ people across all levels of the organisation, all of whom are currently underrepresented. All applicants will be considered fairly based on skills and experience. Disabled and care-experienced applicants who meet the minimum job criteria will be guaranteed an interview.

Find out more about our commitment to equalities

As part of our goal to improve organisational culture and create a great place to work together for the people of Edinburgh, we want to make sure we're recruiting the best people. We’re interested not only in your skills and experience but also in your approach to work. Therefore, part of our interview process will be an assessment of how you would bring Our Behaviours of Respect, Integrity and Flexibility into your ways of working.

This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.

  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

title: Supply Planning Manager
description:
Seniority Level: Associate

#Ownership


Purpose:

Brewing the world’s most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive. Our portfolio of iconic brands includes global classics like Stella Artois, Budweiser, and Corona, and well-known favorites such as Camden Hells, Beck’s, and Leffe. We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy. We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work.

That’s Who We Are: Come and OWN IT.


The role:

As a Supply Planning Manager, you'll own the supply relationship with some of our most important customers, leading collaboration across Commercial, Logistics, and Supply functions to deliver outstanding service and business results. You'll use data, insights, and strong partnerships to drive performance, solve complex challenges, and identify opportunities to improve our end-to-end supply chain.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Act as the central point of contact between customers and BBG’s Commercial, Logistics, and Supply teams on all supply chain matters.
  • Lead collaborative planning, including short-term forecasting (current month plus next three months), promotional activities, seasonal events, and new product launches.
  • Monitor customer stock levels, coordinate range reviews and portfolio changes, and proactively communicate supply risks, constraints, and opportunities.
  • Use data, insights, and analysis to influence customer behaviours, improve processes, and enhance distribution centre-to-store service performance.
  • Own end-to-end supply relationships with assigned customers, positioning BBG as the supplier of choice.
  • Develop and deliver Joint Supply Plans (JSPs) to drive collaborative, mutually beneficial supply chain improvements.
  • Identify and implement supply chain efficiencies while maintaining service levels and supporting commercial objectives.
  • Lead joint value creation initiatives to deliver sustainable cost savings and operational improvements for BBG and customers.
  • Own and manage customer and BBG supply chain KPIs, ensuring accurate reporting, regular reviews, and achievement of targets.
  • Develop performance improvement plans and communicate risks, issues, and mitigation actions proactively to internal and external stakeholders.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment, embraces challenges, and delivers results through strong customer partnerships and collaboration.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for customer relationships, building trusted, long-term partnerships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Embraces change and continuous improvement, challenging the status quo to enhance processes, performance, and ways of working.
  • Demonstrates a customer-centric mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to create value and improve supply chain performance.
  • Uses data, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving to make informed decisions and deliver measurable results.
  • Demonstrates resilience, adaptability, and agility when navigating challenges, ambiguity, and changing priorities.
  • Builds strong relationships and effectively influences stakeholders across all functions and organisational levels to achieve shared objectives.
  • Leads by example, representing Budweiser Brewing Group professionally and consistently demonstrating its values.
  • Possesses strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, teamwork, and attention-to-detail skills, with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Has the ability to learn and use digital tools and systems (e.g., O9, ERP platforms, Power BI); experience in supply chain, logistics, demand planning, or customer operations, and a degree or equivalent professional experience, are advantageous.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 holidays per year + bank holidays & holiday trading options
  • Pension (up to 8% employer contribution) & income protection
  • Comprehensive health & wellbeing benefits (fully funded private medical insurance, dental insurance, gym discounts, Employee Assistance Programme)
  • 26 weeks paid parental leave for eligible primary caregivers
  • A beer allowance to enjoy our brands
  • 2 volunteer days a year to support your local community
  • Life assurance & charitable giving

Why build your career with us

We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.


UNIQUE CULTURE

We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company’s long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication.


BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES

We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.


GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. In an environment where commitment to excellence pays off, our people are able to deepen their impact and create a long-lasting legacy.#

Job Description:

If you are driven to keep roadways and bridges safe and effective, accelerate your career by being part of the team that keeps Maine moving! Join MaineDOT as a Transportation Worker for a rewarding career full of advancement opportunities, career development, competitive pay, generous paid time off, terrific benefits including a robust wellness program, and much more!


From road repair to culvert replacement in the summer to plowing in the winter, Transportation Workers are an essential part of the MaineDOT team getting Mainers from point A to point B safely. Transportation workers are on the front lines of roadwork, putting in long hours in all types of weather to make sure Mainers and their families are safe on our state’s roads, bridges, and highways.


A day in the life of a Transportation Worker changes with the seasons, meaning employees learn new skills and no two days are exactly the same. MaineDOT offers paid Commercial Driving License training and Snowfighter training, and over time, the more you learn, the more you earn with automatic promotional opportunities.


For this position candidates must meet the following experience criteria:

  • Must be 18 years of age, have a high school diploma or equivalent
  • Required to work at a higher class as necessary and in accordance with required licenses and/or certification

Licensing/Registration/Certification Requirements:

  • State-paid Medical examination that includes:
    • a drug test
    • Department’s Respirator fit test
  • Class C State of Maine license by first day of employment.
  • Shall obtain and retain a valid Class B State of Maine license during the initial six-month probationary period.
  • Ability to become a certified snow fighter within 12 months.
  • Ability to obtain flagger certification within a specified amount of time.

Under federal law, only U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, or H-2A, H-2B, or E-2 visa holders will be eligible for new or renewed CDLs.

Interested applicants need to apply online by clicking the "Apply for this Opening/Apply Now" button along with uploading a cover letter, current resume, and any applicable copies of post-secondary transcripts, licensing, registration and certifications.

We believe in supporting our workforce's health and wellbeing with a valuable total compensation package, including:

  • Work-Life Fit – Rest is essential. Take time for yourself using 13 paid holidays, and 3+ weeks of vacation leave annually. Vacation leave accrual increases with years of service, and overtime-exempt employees receive personal leave.

State employees are eligible for an extensive and highly competitive benefits package, covering many aspects of wellness. Learn about additional wellness benefits for State employees from the Office of Employee Health and Wellness.

title: Head Claims
description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed.

Role incumbent provides end-to-end operational and supervisory oversight of the Claims team, ensuring policy claims are assessed and settled promptly, fairly and consistently, while protecting the company from fraud, leakage and regulatory, legal, financial and reputational risk.

The role holder will drive and shape a customer-centred claims philosophy, strengthen governance and controls, and use data, technology and capable teams to deliver an efficient claims experience that reinforces trust in the company’s promise to policyholders and beneficiaries.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop and execute the claims strategy in alignment with the company’s business objectives, customer proposition, risk appetite and operational priorities.
  • Optimize service standards that promote fairness, consistency and sound judgement.
  • Timely collation of claims data analysis and presentation to the executive management (via the Chief Operations Officer) claims trends, emerging risks, material losses, service performance and required interventions, to aid executive decisions.
  • Proactively engage and maintain effective relationships with Underwriting, Actuarial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit, Sales, Customer Service, Technology and Product teams, to uphold seamless claims operations.
  • Oversee the end-to-end notification, registration, validation, investigation, assessment, approval, repudiation and settlement of claims across individual and group life portfolios.
  • Ensure claims are handled within approved turnaround times, policy terms, delegated authorities and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee complex, contentious, litigated and ex gratia claims, escalating material matters appropriately and documenting the rationale for decisions.
  • Ensure clear, timely and empathetic communication with claimants, beneficiaries, policyholders, intermediaries and corporate clients, particularly in sensitive situations (e.g. bereavement).
  • Maintain effective complaint resolution and escalation processes, conduct root cause analysis and translate insights into service improvements.
  • Uphold and own continuous improvement through claims process redesign, automation, workflow discipline and effective case management, to enhance customer experience and minimize risk exposure.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable NAICOM, regulations, regulatory guidelines, anti-money laundering requirements, data protection obligations and internal policies.
  • Maintain robust claims policies, standard operating procedures, decision records, quality assurance reviews and audit trails.
  • Uphold preventive and detective controls minimize claims leakage, fraud, error, duplicate payments and unauthorised settlements.
  • Actively coordinate claims investigations and coordinate with Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, law enforcement and external specialists, where required.
  • Ensure timely and accurate regulatory, statutory and management reporting (monthly/quarterly, etc), on outstanding claims, ageing, repudiations, complaints, recoveries and material exposures.
  • Promptly address audit, compliance and regulatory findings and ensure agreed remedial actions are sustained.
  • Sustain a high performing claims team with clear objectives, appropriate capacity, strong technical capability and disciplined performance management.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of first degree or equivalence (e.g. B.Sc.) in Insurance, Actuarial, or related courses
  • Must possess a recognized professional qualification/certification in Insurance (e.g. CIIN or CII) and minimum membership of Associate (ACIIN or ACII)

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive operational experience in life insurance administration, policy processing, or actuarial/claims management.
  • Minimum of five (5) years’ experience (post-professional qualification) in the technical department of an insurance institution.
  • Demonstrable experience overseeing complex and high value claims, claims governance, fraud risk, litigation, reserving interfaces and reinsurance recoveries.
  • Strong practical knowledge of the Nigerian life insurance market and the legal and regulatory environment governing claims administration.

Key Competencies:

  • Claims Expertise: Deep and practical knowledge of life claims assessment, policy interpretation, medical and financial evidence, investigation and settlement.
  • Regulatory and Risk Judgement: Applies sound judgement within legal, regulatory, ethical and risk parameters.
  • Customer Centricity: Balances compassionate service with disciplined policy and control requirements.
  • Commercial and Financial Acumen: Understands the impact of claims on profitability, reserves, capital, reinsurance and customer value.
  • Data-led Decision-Making: Converts claims data into actionable insight and measurable interventions.
  • Strategic Team Coordination: Sets direction, translates strategy into execution and drives sustainable change.
  • People Management: Builds capability, accountability and collaboration
  • Communication and Influence: Communicates complex and sensitive decisions clearly and credibly to diverse stakeholders.
  • Integrity and Courage: Makes fair, evidence-based decisions and constructively challenges inappropriate outcomes.
  • Operational Excellence: Establishes disciplined processes, effective controls and a continuous-improvement culture

Prudential is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equality of opportunity of benefits for all who apply and who perform work for our organisation irrespective of sex, race, age, ethnic origin, educational, social and cultural background, marital status, pregnancy and maternity, religion or belief, disability or part-time / fixed-term work, or any other status protected by applicable law. We encourage the same standards from our recruitment and third-party suppliers taking into account the context of grade, job and location. We also allow for reasonable adjustments to support people with individual physical or mental health requirements.

title: Clinical Program Manager
description:
Clinical Program Manager

Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Medford, Burlington, Lewiston, Little Rock and Springdale offices.

Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside within a commutable distance from our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Lewiston, Little Rock and Springdale offices or who are willing to relocate.


Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person-focused and economically sustainable health care system.

Who We Are Looking For:

Every day, Cambia’s dedicated team of Program Managers are living our mission to make health care easier and lives better. As a member of the Health Services Operations (HSO) Clinical Program Management team, our Health Care Services (HCS) Program Manager provides direction, oversight and organization to ensure overall success of one or more complex clinical programs (e.g. cost stewardship, specialty pharmacy, care management, etc.). The HCS Program Manager supports a HCS executive or directing program sponsor to ensure program deliverables are met while striving to improve care quality, enhance consumer experience, and reduce cost. Responsibilities include managing program initiatives from inception to sustainment and providing oversight related to program evaluation, development, processes and reporting during all phases of the program. Initiatives may involve managing internally developed programs or programs established through a vendor partnership. This role requires strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships across the organization (e.g, Health Care Services, Health Plan Operations, Data & Technology, and Finance) – all in service of creating a person-focused health care experience.


Are you ready to lead complex clinical programs that directly improve care quality and make health care easier for thousands of members? Do you thrive in collaborative environments where you can build relationships across diverse teams while driving innovative health care solutions? Then this role may be the perfect fit.


What You Bring to Cambia:

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Health Care Administration, or related field (Masters preferred)
  • 5+ years' experience with project and/or program management in healthcare, healthcare insurance operations or other large, complex industry.
  • Experience in clinical area preferred. May have equivalent combination of education and experience.

Skills and Attributes:


  • Ability to think analytically, effectively applying project management and financial techniques, and providing recommendations to management using critical thinking and sound judgment.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functionally with all levels of the organization for the purpose of driving solutions and resolving issues in a timely and effective manner.
  • Proficiency in effectively managing high-profile projects, identifying and mitigating risks, and reporting barriers to program deliverables.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyze complex data and situations, learn quickly and create options, recommendations and action plans.
  • Experience in independently defining, developing, managing and reporting on processes and metrics.
  • Ability to accomplish results through others by establishing relationships, effective controls and monitoring processes.
  • Ability to partner effectively with external partners/vendors.
  • Familiarity with health plan and clinical terminology, operations and trends.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills with all levels of the organization, including the ability to resolve complex issues, build consensus among groups of diverse stakeholders, manage strategic partner relationships, and effectively lead and engage internal teams in the fulfillment of roles and responsibilities.
  • Solid knowledge of program evaluation concepts and methodologies, with experience in program effectiveness analysis, measurement, and reporting.
  • Experience with AI tools and technologies to enhance productivity and decision-making in professional settings highly desired

What You Will Do at Cambia:


  • Works closely with project sponsor(s), cross-functional teams, and project managers to plan and develop scope, deliverables, required resources, work plan, budget, and timing for new initiatives.
  • Effectively manages internal/external stakeholder relationships, ensuring the focused pursuit of desired outcomes.
  • Manages program and project teams to identify risks and opportunities across multiple initiatives or workstreams to ensure program goals are reached.
  • Educates and trains the leadership, staff, business associates and other stakeholders regarding new program elements, process, and implementation.
  • Maintains a system for ongoing data/statistical reporting and program assessment. Develop and communicate program documents, project plans, etc.
  • Effectively collaborates with internal program leaders, senior management, and cross-functional managers/directors to develop program monitoring and assessment protocols for evaluation and improvement. Recommend program and process changes as appropriate.

Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose-driven, award-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100+ year history. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through.

  • Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed.

In exchange for helping members live healthy lives, we offer benefits that empower you to do the same. Just a few highlights include:

title: General Practice Channel Lead
description:
The General Practice Lead is responsible for driving the strategy, deployment, and growth of our General Practice (GP) veterinary locations. This role partners closely with hospital and field leadership, medical operations teams, and cross-functional Support Office departments to design and execute initiatives that make every day work easier for our associates; so our teams can focus on what matters most: delivering outstanding medical care and an excellent experience for every client and pet. This is a strategic, hands-on role for a veterinary industry leader who thrives on turning ideas into scalable programs across a multi-site practice network.

This role requires associates to work a hybrid schedule out of one of the MVH North America Hub Locations - Vancouver, WA | Santa Monica, CA .

Essential Responsibility/Tasks:

Strategy & Deployment

  • Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for General Practice locations, aligning clinic-level execution with company-wide goals.
  • Translate high-level strategy into clear, actionable deployment plans, timelines, and success metrics.
  • Partner with field and hospital leaders to roll out new programs, protocols, and tools consistently across all GP locations.
  • Monitor performance against KPIs and adjust plans based on data, field feedback, and business needs.

Growth Initiatives

  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities across the GP network, including new service lines, capacity optimization, and client retention strategies.
  • Build business cases for new initiatives, partnering with Finance and Field Operations to size impact and secure investment.
  • Support the integration and ramp-up of new or acquired General Practice locations.
  • Track industry trends and competitive dynamics in veterinary care to inform growth strategy.

Associate Experience

  • Generate and champion ideas that simplify the daily work of veterinarians, technicians, and support staff — reducing friction and administrative burden.
  • Gather feedback directly from clinic teams and turn it into practical process, tooling, or workflow improvements.
  • Partner with Learning & Development, P&O, and Medical Leadership to ensure initiatives are well-supported with training and change management.
  • Serve as a visible, trusted resource for GP teams navigating new initiatives.

Client & Patient Experience

  • Design and refine operational standards that elevate the client and patient experience at every touchpoint.
  • Use client feedback, satisfaction data, and hospital visits to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure initiatives balance operational efficiency with the compassionate, high-quality care clients and pets expect.
  • Redesign the way our Client Service associates work to elevate experience to bring client experience as our competitive advantage.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or DVM a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in veterinary practice operations, multi-site healthcare operations, or a related field, with a track record of leading strategic initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience deploying programs across multiple locations or a distributed team.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and drive them to completion.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels — from clinic associates to executive leadership.
  • Analytical mindset; comfortable using data to identify opportunities, measure impact, and make recommendations.
  • Deep understanding of, or strong interest in, veterinary medicine, general practice workflows, and the challenges facing clinical teams.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to hospitals up to 10% of time.
  • Openness to digital innovation, including the responsible use of AI and emerging technologies, to improve healthcare delivery, reduce administrative burden, and create a better experience for associates, clients, and patients.

*All degrees will be deemed “or equivalent combination of education and experience” unless absolutely required to do the job (i.e., DVM degree for Veterinarian, Law degree for Attorney, etc.).

PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Worked directly in or closely with veterinary hospitals and understand the day-to-day realities of general practice teams.
  • Energized by solving operational problems and turning them into scalable solutions.
  • Balanced big-picture strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get into the details.
  • Putting people — associates, clients, and pets — at the center of every decision.

title: Senior Manager, Regional Commercial Development
description:
Job Description

Are you interested in joining the LEGO® India Market business, and working closely with a dedicated team to build the LEGO® Brand by bringing best in class commercial acumen and tools and processes to the organisation.


Core Responsibilities


Customer & Channel Strategy


  • Develop LEGO India's long-term Customer and Channel strategy, defining the role of each channel and key customer in our growth journey.
  • Partner closely with Sales and Key Account teams to develop Joint Business Plans and strategic customer growth agendas.
  • Build & Drive the Commercial calendar for the BU in line with the Integrated Commercial PLAN (ICP).
  • Identify new channels, opportunities and ways of working that can unlock incremental growth.

Portfolio & Assortment

  • Partner with Marketing and Sales to translate consumer and channel insights into portfolio, assortment and channel decisions.
  • Define the right portfolio and proposition for different channels and customer segments.
  • Balance brand building, consumer relevance and commercial opportunity.

Commercial Performance & P&L

  • Partner with Finance and Sales to identify opportunities to improve trade investment, channel economics, mix and profitability.
  • Bring a strong commercial lens to business decisions and help the organisation make better choices about where to invest and where to simplify.
  • Work with the Finance partner to build & maintain CHANNEL level P&Ls to drive a health balance of Topline & Bottomline.
  • Build fact-based recommendations that connect growth with healthy P&L outcomes.

Strategic Projects & Business Leadership

  • Lead high-impact cross-functional commercial projects for the India business.
  • Act as a strategic sparring partner to the GM and India Leadership Team on growth, customers, channels and commercial priorities.
  • Bring together complex information and turn it into clear choices, recommendations and actions.
  • Represent India confidently with APAC and global stakeholders including but not limited to Regional commercial development forums.

Translating Global Commercial Development Agendas to India

  • Lead and drive global processes and planning by carrying out the Regional Market Group (MG) Integrated Commercial Plan (ICP), running the BU ICP, Customer Business Planning (CBP) process and the annual Customer Pulse.
  • Support optimization of trade investments in the BU via the implementation of customer segmentation model and Multi-Channel Pricing framework (partnering with Finance).
  • Develop and deploy the sales training capability agenda for the BU Sales Team.
  • Coordinate the implementation & excellence in Globally developed Sales tech, tools and processes

Play your part in our team succeeding!


As LEGO India continues to scale rapidly, we are looking for a strategic and commercially minded leader to shape our Customer and Channel strategy for India.

This role sits on the India Leadership Team and will be a close strategic partner to the General Manager, working across Sales, Marketing and Finance to translate our growth ambition into a clear commercial agenda.

The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. We are looking for someone who can see the bigger picture, challenge the status quo, connect the dots across functions and then work with teams to make things happen.


Do you have what it takes?

  • Minimum 10 years of commercial experience in FMCG, consumer durables, toys, or premium consumer brands, spanning at least two of Sales, Channel/Customer Strategy, Revenue Growth Management, Category Management, Commercial Finance, or Strategy/Consulting.
  • A proven track record of building and executing channel or customer strategies in India across modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce, general trade/distribution, and brand-owned or franchise retail.
  • Hands-on experience developing Joint Business Plans with key accounts and managing trade terms and trade investment.
  • Experience owning or strongly influencing P&L outcomes, including pricing, mix, margin, and channel economics.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional projects and presenting to senior leadership. Exposure to regional or global stakeholders is a strong plus.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including an understanding of how growth, trade spend, and portfolio choices flow through to the P&L.
  • The ability to turn consumer, shopper, and channel insights into portfolio and assortment decisions.
  • Structured problem-solving: synthesising complex data into clear choices, trade-offs, and recommendations.
  • A solid grasp of RGM levers such as price-pack architecture, promotions, trade terms, and mix management.
  • Advanced analytical skills with the judgement to know when "good enough" data supports a decision.
