title: Voorman/-vrouw Wijkservice
description:
Wat ga je doen?

Als Voorman/-vrouw Wijkservice sta je midden in het werk. Je stuurt een ploeg van ongeveer tien collega's aan en werkt zelf mee aan het groenonderhoud in Veenendaal. Je weet wat erbuiten moet gebeuren, verdeelt het werk en helpt collega's waar dat nodig is. Met jouw ervaring zorg je dat het werk goed en veilig wordt uitgevoerd. Het mooie aan deze functie? Je ziet iedere dag wat jullie samen bereiken. Een straat die er weer netjes bij ligt, groen dat goed wordt onderhouden en bewoners die tevreden zijn. Daar doe je het voor!

Je werkt niet alleen met je hoofd, maar ook met je handen. Of je nu een schoffel, snoeischaar of motorzaag gebruikt, je laat collega's zien hoe ze veilig en goed kunnen werken. Je helpt hen nieuwe vaardigheden te leren en zorgt dat iedereen zijn werk goed kan doen.

Naast het buitenwerk ben je er ook voor je collega's. Je luistert, geeft duidelijke aanwijzingen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat er van hem of haar wordt verwacht. Je houdt het werk overzichtelijk en zorgt voor een fijne sfeer waarin collega's elkaar helpen. Je hebt regelmatig contact met bewoners, andere afdelingen.Zo weet je wat er speelt en kun je samen met je ploeg zorgen voor een wijk waar bewoners prettig kunnen wonen.


Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het plannen, verdelen en afstemmen van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden.
  • Het begeleiden van collega's en het aanleren van nieuwe vaardigheden.
  • Het uitleggen en uitvoeren van werkzaamheden in de openbare ruimte.
  • Het verwerken van uren en meldingen en het snel en zorgvuldig afhandelen van meldingen van bewoners.
  • Het deelnemen aan overleggen.

Wie zoeken wij?


Je bent iemand die graag buiten werkt en weet hoe het werk in het groen moet worden aangepakt. Je vindt het leuk om collega's te helpen en kunt goed omgaan met mensen met verschillende achtergronden. Je geeft duidelijke aanwijzingen, blijft rustig als het druk is en werkt zelf net zo hard mee. Je ziet wat er moet gebeuren en pakt problemen aan. Daarbij denk je vooruit en zorg je dat het werk netjes, veilig en op tijd gebeurt. Je houdt rekening met bewoners en gaat prettig om met de mensen die je tijdens je werk tegenkomt. Je bent een betrokken collega op wie anderen kunnen rekenen. Je houdt van samenwerken, hebt plezier in je vak en vindt het belangrijk dat iedereen goed en veilig kan werken.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Een mbo diploma in groenvoorziening of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Een diploma VOL VCA.
  • Ervaring als voorman, hovenier of in vergelijkbaar werk.
  • Sortimentskennis en hoe je deze kennis in de praktijk gebruikt.


Wat bieden wij?

We heten je van harte welkom bij een informele organisatie met korte lijnen, betrokken collega’s en een goede werksfeer. We bieden jou:

  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor één jaar voor 36 uur per week, die bij goed functioneren wordt omgezet naar een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd.
  • Een salaris van maximaal €4.130,- (schaal 7, o.b.v. 36 uur per week per 1 januari 2027, cao Gemeenten)
  • Ruim vijf weken verlof met de mogelijkheid extra uren bij te kopen
  • Een Individueel Keuzebudget van 17,05%, wat je zelf kunt inzetten op een manier die bij jouw situatie past.


Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je hier.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je gaat werken bij team Wijkservice van gemeente Veenendaal. Het team bestaat uit ongeveer 35 collega's die dagelijks zorgen voor het onderhoud van het groen in de openbare ruimte, de begraafplaats en speelvoorzieningen. Ook handelt het team meldingen over de openbare ruimte af.

Daarnaast werken er bijna evenveel groenmedewerkers mee die vanuit IW4 bij de gemeente zijn geplaatst. Je komt terecht in een team met collega's die veel kennis hebben van hun vak en zich betrokken voelen bij de samenleving. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat de buitenruimte van Veenendaal er goed bij ligt.

Werkt Veenendaal voor jou?

Werken bij de derde grootste stad van de provincie Utrecht betekent samenwerken aan een stad die groeit en voortdurend in beweging is. We zijn een jonge en levendige gemeente en een organisatie met korte lijnen en een open sfeer. Iedereen is welkom en ieders talent telt. Je krijgt veel ruimte om mee te denken, initiatief te nemen en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Met ruim 600 collega’s zetten we ons elke dag in voor onze inwoners, ondernemers en de stad. Je krijgt vertrouwen én kansen om echt impact te maken. Want bij ons geldt: Veenendaal werkt voor jou!

Meer weten over hoe het is om te werken voor Veenendaal? Kijk op www.werkenvoorveenendaal.nl

Ben je enthousiast?

Lijkt het jou mooi om samen met je ploeg te zorgen voor een schoon en groen Veenendaal? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Solliciteer via het online sollicitatieformulier uiterlijk 30-11-2026. Na de sluitingsdatum ontvang je zo snel mogelijk bericht over het vervolg van de procedure.

Wil je meer weten?

Nieuwsgierig naar de functie of hoe het werk er in de praktijk uitziet? Voor inhoudelijke vragen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Erik, portefeuillemanager, via (0318) 538 538.

Wil je meer weten over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Janneke, teamleider Wijkservice, via 06 42 49 70 96. Kun je ons telefonisch niet bereiken? Stuur dan een WhatsApp bericht of mail naar werken@veenendaal.nl.


Voor nieuwe medewerkers is een geldige Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) nodig. Ook kan een referentiecheck onderdeel zijn van de procedure.

title: Financial Solutions Specialist - Burnaby Branch
description:

What this role is all about:

The Financial Solutions Specialist provides advanced, licensed investment advice and multi‑goal financial strategies aligned to members’ life events and evolving financial needs. Working in an unassigned member model, the Financial Solutions Specialist engages members through milestone‑driven interactions, proactive outreach, and referrals, ensuring advice remains timely, compliant, and appropriate. Through goal‑based advisory and collaborative partnerships, this sales‑driven role ensures a seamless, holistic member experience.

Through hybrid advice delivery and close collaboration with investment partners, credit partners, and branch advisory teams, the Financial Solutions Specialist plays a key role in strengthening member relationships, identifying when comprehensive financial planning is required, and ensuring a seamless, holistic member experience across the broader advice ecosystem.

What you’ll do:

Licensed Investment Advice & Mutual Fund Sales

  • Perform investment suitability reviews based on client information, following regulations and internal policies.
  • Provide tailored investment recommendations and execute mutual fund sales and other licensed investment products.
  • Develop and implement medium- and long-term investment strategies based on member risk tolerance, goals, and time horizon.
  • Educate members on portfolio diversification, market fundamentals, and retirement planning strategies.
  • Maintain strict adherence to regulatory, licensing, and documentation requirements, ensuring compliance at all times.

Expanded Multi-Goal Advisory Support

  • Deliver advanced planning conversations focused on retirement accumulation, education savings, multi-year investment objectives, and early-stage tax efficiency considerations.
  • Support financial milestones requiring judgment, technical expertise, and strategic insight.
  • Leverage CRM analytics to identify advisory opportunities, deepen member relationships, and proactively engage members.

Complex Lending & Credit Expertise

  • Manage escalated lending scenarios from branch teams and Financial Solutions Associates, including construction and renovation mortgages, rental/investment property financing, business-for-self income structures, and multi-product lending strategies.
  • Recommend lending structures that balance member needs with institutional risk appetite.
  • Collaborate with credit partners to resolve complex or escalated cases, ensuring timely and effective solutions.

Member Experience & Journey Support

  • Engage proactively through holistic advisory services to help members implement recommended strategies and achieve financial goals.
  • Utilize hybrid advisory channels—digital, virtual, and in-person—ensuring accessibility and convenience.
  • Document all suitability assessments, investment recommendations, and next steps accurately in CRM systems.
  • Promote digital literacy and encourage members to use digital tools for goal tracking and financial management.

Collaboration & Referral Partnership

  • Coordinate closely with appropriate teams for members requiring comprehensive financial planning.
  • Mentor Financial Solutions Associates and other branch team members, sharing product knowledge, regulatory guidance, and best practices.
  • Work collaboratively with wealth, credit, and risk teams to ensure a seamless and integrated member experience.
  • Actively participate in advisory practice development, continuous learning, and professional growth initiatives.

A little about your qualifications:

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • Mutual Fund License (IFIC/MFDA) required.
  • PFP, QAFP, or CFP designation preferred or willingness to pursue.
  • 4–6 years of advisory experience including investment and lending.
  • Strong understanding of registered products (RRSP, TFSA, RESP) and non-registered investment solutions.
  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and compliance standards in financial services.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and advisory and coaching skills.
  • Familiarity with complex lending scenarios, including mortgages, refinancing, and multi-product strategies.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and documentation of suitability and compliance requirements.

        Total Rewards:

        Our total rewards approach reflects Beem's values — celebrating success, investing in your growth, and supporting you at work and in life.

        • Compensation: Annual salary range of $67,700 - $73,000, with pay based on your skills and experience, and performance bonuses tied to shared goals
        • Health & Wellness: Extended health coverage (including mental health support), dental care, and disability coverage
        • Time Away: Vacation and personal days to rest, recharge, and manage life outside of work
        • Retirement & Financial Well-being: Generous RRSP contributions, in-house financial advice, and flexible options to add your own contributions
        • Beem Member Perks: Free banking accounts, special mortgage and lending rates, and preferred financial perks

          At Beem we are BOLD and Always Welcoming and our values are at the forefront of everything we do!

          • Build Together: You are a team player who thrives on collaboration, sparks ideas, and fosters inclusivity.
          • Own It: You are ready to take charge, drive change, and deliver outstanding results.
          • Lead with Agility: You are a dynamic, adaptable thinker who thrives on challenge and innovation.
          • Driven by Curiosity: You are eager to explore, learn, and shape the future.

          Ready to join?

          Visit us at to learn more about what it’s like to work for Beem Credit Union! We sincerely thank all applicants for their interest; however, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

          We at Beem Credit Union are committed to ensuring inclusive employment practices and an accessible business environment for our employees. We do not discriminate based on any protected attribute covered by the Human Rights Code and encourage all qualiﬁed candidates to apply. We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates. All applications are reviewed by a member of our team.

          Beem Credit Union serves communities across many traditional Territories and Treaty areas in British Columbia. We are grateful to live and work on this land and are committed to reconciliation, decolonization, and building strong, connected relationships.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
Do you relish the prospect of driving operational resilience, platform reliability, and global edge scale?

Do you thrive on leading complex technical programs at the intersection of software engineering, distributed systems, and production operations?

Join our Cloud Technology Group Strategy & Operations team

Our team drives the strategic, cross-organizational programs that safeguard platform availability, automate production operations, and scale our infrastructure globally. We partner closely with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), core product development and infrastructure teams to minimize operational toil, eliminate single points of failure, and raise the bar on platform resilience. Senior engineering leadership relies on our team to orchestrate high-visibility initiatives that keep Akamai's globally distributed platform fast, reliable, and secure.

Shape the success of projects

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will serve as the strategic bridge between SRE, product, and platform teams. You will drive cross-organizational initiatives that translate reliability and performance goals into measurable engineering roadmaps.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Partnering across SRE, Product, and Platform Engineering to establish unified reliability, performance, and platform health roadmaps
  • Driving core reliability programs, including Service Level Objectives (SLOs/SLIs), error budget governance, disaster recovery (DR) drills, and multi-region resilience testing
  • Championing platform performance and health initiatives, identifying architectural bottlenecks, systemic failure modes, and capacity constraints across critical services
  • Leading operational excellence and toil-reduction programs, automating operational workflows, modernizing observability, and instituting production readiness standards
  • Orchestrating cross-functional dependency management, unblocking complex initiatives and aligning engineering priorities between feature velocity and platform stability
  • Providing executive visibility into platform health metrics, reliability trends, and critical program milestones

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have relevant technical program management experience, partnering closely with SRE, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems teams
  • Be comfort navigating ambiguity, handling risks, and shifting gears as needed across rapidly evolving environments
  • Have deep familiarity with reliability and performance domains, including SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, observability (metrics, logs, traces), high-availability architectures, and chaos/resilience principles.
  • Have proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment, uniting product, architecture, and operations teams around shared platform health goals
  • Have good interpersonal and organizational skills with an ability to communicate effectively with all stakeholders
  • Have solid technical fluency, capable of engaging with principal engineers and architects on technical trade-offs, scaling limits, and failure domains
  • Have excellent communication and influence skills, fluent in English, with the ability to distill complex production health data for executive audiences
  • Have relevant experience or a Bachelor's or Master's diploma in Computer Science or its equivalent

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Head of Equity Research is responsible for managing, supervising, and monitoring the equity research activities and output of the team of Equity Fund Managers and Equity Analysts. He/she works with the team to initiate and update coverage of stocks in the equity universe, and form investment views, priorities and preferences of stocks to be the basis for construction of equity portfolios. He/she assists the Head of Investments &/or Deputy Head of Equity to apply research, valuation and documentation consistent with the team’s equity investment philosophy and procedures. He/she is also responsible for leading the Analyst Model Portfolio and its application to specified equity portfolios.

  • Lead and oversee the equity research function, including the work produced by Equity Analysts and Equity Portfolio Managers who have dual portfolio management and analyst responsibilities, ensuring compliance with all research, governance, and record-keeping requirements.

  • Work with the team to maintain and regularly update coverage of stocks within the equity universe, providing fair valuations and investment recommendations (Buy/Hold/Sell).

  • Maintain, enhance, and execute the team's equity investment philosophy, research framework, and investment processes. Drive the generation of alpha-producing investment ideas, challenge assumptions, and facilitate robust investment discussions.

title: Avdelingsleiar ved Nore Neset ungdomsskule
description:
Ved Nore Neset ungdomsskule er det ledig fast 100% stilling som avdelingsleiar frå 01.02.2027.

Har du lyst til å vere med å leie skulen vår? Vi søker deg som vil vere med å bidra til godt læringsmiljø og gode resultat i skulane i Bjørnafjorden kommune, der alle skal med. Vi kan tilby eit inspirerande og mangfaldig fagmiljø der vi jobbar målretta for å skape gode oppvekstvilkår for elevane våre. I Bjørnafjorden kommune er vi opptekne av å skapa trygge og gode skulemiljø som gir elevane gode føresetnader for læring, meistring og trivsel. Vi satsar også på å utvikla sterke rammer for lesing gjennom heile opplæringsløpet.

Arbeidsstad
Nore Neset ungdomsskule ligg vakkert til ved Liafjellet i Hagavik. Skuleåret 2026-2027 har skulen 464 elevar og om lag 65 tilsette. Vi held til i eit flott skulebygg frå 2014 og har eit topp moderne idrettsanlegg like ved. Du kan lesa meir om Nore Neset ungdomsskule på nettsida vår:

Arbeidsoppgåver
- Vere ein del av skulen sitt leiarteam saman med to andre avdelingsleiarar og rektor
- Pedagogisk leiing og delvis personalansvar
- Delta i ulike team
- Følge opp læringsarbeidet og elevane si faglege og sosiale utvikling
- Legge til rette for pedagogisk utviklingsarbeid og leie profesjonsfellesskap mot felles mål
- Dialog med elevar, tilsette og føresette
- Samarbeid med PPT, BUP m.fl.

Eigenskapar
Vi ser etter deg som:
- har god relasjonskompetanse, er trygg og inkluderande
- har gode samarbeidsevner
- likar å jobbe i ein organisasjon med høgt tempo og stort krav til fleksibilitet
- har god fagleg og digital kompetanse
- jobbar planmessig og strukturert
- har systemforståing for rammer, lover og forskrifter
- er samlande og likar å jobbe i team
- har ei positiv innstilling, og er løysing- og utviklingsorientert
Leiarutdanning og erfaring frå skuleleiing er ønskjeleg, men ikkje eit krav.
Aktuelle søkarar blir kalla inn til intervju.

Kvalifikasjonar
Godkjent relevant utdanning frå høgskule eller universitet og kompetanse for ungdomstrinnet.
Utanlandsk utdanning må vere godkjent av HK-dir. Det vil seie at du må kunne vise til både:
- «godkjenning av utenlandsk høyere utdanning»
- «godkjenning som lærer i skole eller styrer og pedagogisk leder i barnehage»
Det er ønskelig med leiarkompetanse som er relevant for stillinga.
God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne er ein føresetnad. Nynorsk er administrasjonsmålform i Bjørnafjorden kommune.
I tråd med opplæringslova stiller vi krav om tilfredsstillande politiattest av den som får tilbod om stillinga.

Vi tilbyr
- Fagleg og personleg utvikling i eit godt og inspirerande arbeidsmiljø
- Gunstig pensjonsordning, yrkesskade- og gruppelivsforsikring
- Løn etter gjeldande avtalar
- Vi arbeider for å få etablert heiltidskultur i kommunen

Bjørnafjorden kommune er ein arbeidsplass som verdset likestilling og mangfald, der alle tilsette forpliktar seg til prinsippet om likeverd og bidreg til å skapa eit inkluderande arbeidsmiljø. Vi ønskjer eit mangfald av søkjarar og oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, etnisk bakgrunn eller livssyn.

Etter utløpet av søknadsfristen vil det bli utarbeidd ei offentleg søkjarliste. Denne vil innehalda namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og dessutan bustad- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn dersom ein søkjar ber om det, men opplysningar kan likevel bli offentleggjort i samsvar med gjeldande regelverk. Dersom ei oppmoding om unntak ikkje blir teken til følgje, vil søkjaren bli varsla.

Vi vil aldri be søkjarar om å oppgi BANK-ID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen.

Job Description Summary:

The primary responsibility of the Behavioral Health Technician, Child Crisis is to provide care to individuals and families who receive services through Monarch’s Crisis & Urgent Care Services supporting children in a therapeutic environment.

What You'll Do:

• Provide care to individuals receiving services in a manner that ensures safety, client’s rights, confidentiality, comfort, dignity and a therapeutic environment.
• Carry out functions that contribute to the effectiveness and safety of the unit including crisis intervention, taking vital signs, observation of individuals receiving services.
• Demonstrate responsible for maintaining inventory supplies and make appropriate requisitions.
• Ensure an environment conducive to recovery consistent with SRMH/DD/SAS, Crisis & Urgent Care Services philosophy and best practice.
• Respect the rights of individuals receiving services to make choices within the available parameters and make every effort to follow the individuals receiving services crisis plan.
• Work with clients and families and other team members to ensure the crisis stabilization unit provides individuals receiving services with a safe and supportive environment consistent with recovery concepts and person-centered planning.
• Coordinate and/or implement skilled level activities involving the care, treatment, and training of individuals receiving services on the crisis unit.
• Ensure that the individuals receiving services maintain appropriate personal hygiene, perform activities of daily living and receive the proper nutrition.
• Assist with self-help skills as necessary and keep supervisor informed of the condition of individuals receiving services.
• Prepare written reports (vital signs, census reports, incident reports for example) as necessary.
• Utilize the treatment plan as developed by the nursing staff and/or the substance abuse specialist.
• Supervise individuals receiving services in the activities of daily living, encouraging individuals receiving services to display independence and responsibility for self.
• Enforce limits on individuals' behavior using established policies, procedures and rules.
• Secure and relay information used by professionals for the admission, discharge and transfer of individuals receiving services.
• Observe individuals receiving services for changes in physical and mental conditions, reporting those to professional staff.
• Monitor and document food intake during mealtime and snack time.
• Assist in group educational sessions and/or activities as assigned for individuals receiving services at the facility under supervision.
• Attend and actively participate in meetings and training as required. Maintain certification in all agency, state and federal training requirements.
• Demonstrate knowledge of and comply with all agency policies and procedures, as well as state and federal statutes and regulations related to specific program areas.
• Demonstrate knowledge of emergency procedures and assist in crisis situations.

Avdelingen har egen tilsynslege og tjenesteleder er tett på avdelingen i det daglige.

Vi satser på heltidskultur, men legger vekt på å skape et arbeidsmiljø som tar hensyn til individuelle behov og preferanser. Gjennom årsturnus gir vi deg også mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidstid i stor grad.

Velkommen som søker til en spennende jobb hos oss hvor vi legger vekt på kvalitet, kompetanse, mestring og trivsel. Sammen skaper vi et godt og helsefremmende arbeidsmiljø i splitter nye lokaler!

title: Coördinator Boa-team
description:
Breng jij structuur, duidelijkheid en beweging in een operationeel team? Heb je ervaring in het handhavingsdomein en weet je collega’s mee te krijgen, ook zonder hiërarchische bevoegdheden? Wil je bouwen aan een BOA-team dat planmatig werkt en verantwoordelijkheid neemt? Dan zoeken wij jou!

Voor het team Veiligheid zijn wij op zoek naar een Coördinator BOA-team voor 36 uur per week.

Wat ga je doen?
Barendrecht is een middelgrote gemeente met een warme sfeer. Binnen team Veiligheid werken we vanuit één gezamenlijke missie: zorgen voor een veilige en leefbare omgeving voor onze inwoners, ondernemers en bezoekers.

Als Coördinator BOA's ben je de drijvende kracht achter de dagelijkse organisatie en operationele sturing van ons BOA-team. Je brengt overzicht in de inzet, stelt heldere verwachtingen en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Ons team staat aan de vooravond van een doorontwikkeling. Je krijgt de ruimte om samen met de BOA’s, de senior BOA en de beleidsadviseur de werkwijze verder te professionaliseren.

Dit ga je doen
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een goede dagelijkse aansturing, een realistische planning en een resultaatgerichte uitvoering. Niet door alles zelf op te pakken, maar door de groep duidelijkheid, richting en vertrouwen te geven.

Je zorgt voor structuur en duidelijke werkafspraken
Je organiseert de dagelijkse werkverdeling, bewaakt aanwezigheid en gemaakte afspraken en spreekt collega’s aan als dat nodig is. Je geeft direct en respectvol feedback. Je bent duidelijk over verwachtingen en weet waar jouw rol ophoudt en die van de teammanager begint.

Je brengt regie in roosters en capaciteit
Je maakt een samenhangende inzetplanning waarin meldingen, wijkgericht werken, taakaccenten, reguliere controles en geplande acties allemaal een plek krijgen. Daarbij is de richtlijn dat op teamniveau ongeveer de helft van de inzet naar meldingen en de helft naar overige werkzaamheden gaat. Je maakt zichtbaar wat haalbaar is en stelt tijdig knelpunten aan de orde.

Je zorgt dat acties echt worden uitgevoerd
Elke maand staat een thema-actie centraal, met een BOA als verantwoordelijke. Daarnaast spelen specifieke overlastvraagstukken, zoals fatbikes of verkeersgedrag. Jij plant capaciteit, maakt afspraken over de uitvoering, volgt de voortgang en zorgt voor terugkoppeling. Zo verdwijnen acties niet tussen de dagelijkse meldingen.

Je ontwikkelt de werkwijze én het team
Je bouwt mee aan een professionele werkcultuur waarin medewerkers eigenaarschap nemen. Je verbetert werkprocessen, coacht medewerkers en zorgt voor een eenduidige manier van werken. Je loopt regelmatig mee buiten om te zien hoe het werk gaat en gerichte feedback te geven, maar je draait niet structureel mee als BOA in de straatbezetting.

Je verbindt uitvoering en beleid
Je werkt nauw samen met de beleidsadviseur Toezicht & Handhaving. Die bepaalt de inhoudelijke doelen en prioriteiten; jij vertaalt deze naar opdrachten, inzet en resultaten. Ook verzoeken van andere OOV-adviseurs komen via jou in de integrale planning terecht. Je houdt de teammanager op de hoogte van knelpunten en levert feitelijke input voor personele gesprekken. De formele personeelsverantwoordelijkheid ligt bij de teammanager.

Met wie werk je samen?
Je maakt deel uit van team Veiligheid: een betrokken team van professionals dat zich iedere dag inzet voor een veilig en leefbaar Barendrecht. Binnen het team werken onder andere beleidsadviseurs Openbare Orde en Veiligheid, juristen, vergunningverleners APV en Bijzondere Wetten en boa's.

Je werkt dagelijks samen met de BOA’s en de senior BOA, die collega’s vakinhoudelijk en praktisch ondersteunt. Met de beleidsadviseur Toezicht & Handhaving stem je prioriteiten af; daarnaast werk je samen met andere OOV-adviseurs en uitvoeringspartners, zoals de politie. Je valt hiërarchisch onder de teammanager Veiligheid. Je hebt functionele sturingsruimte, maar geen hiërarchische of formele personeelsverantwoordelijkheid.

Wat bieden wij?
  • Je krijgt een arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd, met uitzicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Je hebt flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om, waar de werkzaamheden dat toelaten, gedeeltelijk vanuit huis te werken;
  • Afhankelijk van ervaring word je ingeschaald tussen €3568,- en €5096,- bruto per maand bij een 36-urige werkweek; de functie is ingedeeld in schaal 9 volgens de CAO gemeenten.
  • Je ontvangt bovenop je maandsalaris een individueel keuzebudget (17.05% keuzebudget bovenop je bruto jaarsalaris, wat neerkomt op een bedrag tussen de €608,- en €868,- bruto per maand. Dit kun je in zetten voor aanschaf extra vakantiedagen, extra salaris of reiskostenuitruil.);
  • Je ontvangt een vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken;
  • Je neemt deel aan de ABP-pensioenregeling;
  • Je kunt gebruikmaken van een aantrekkelijke ouderschapsverlofregeling;
  • Je krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf professioneel te ontwikkelen.

Werken voor Barendrecht
Barendrecht is een prachtige gemeente met bijna 50.000 inwoners en een zeer actief verenigings- en ondernemersklimaat. We zitten in de regio precies tussen stad en groen. Barendrecht heeft een dorps karakter maar stadse kwaliteiten en voorzieningen zoals een theater, zwembad, en talloze (sport)verenigingen. Met verbindingen via tram, trein, fiets en auto ligt de wereld aan onze voeten. Met zo’n 350 collega’s zetten we ons dagelijks in voor thema’s als veiligheid, buitenruimte, zorg en welzijn, leefomgeving en bestuur. Is dat ook iets voor jou?

Waarom kiezen voor Barendrecht?
We bieden goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, maar wat onderscheidt ons van andere gemeenten? Als je het aan ons vraagt, dan staat de goede sfeer en mentaliteit op de werkvloer met stip op één. Als je door de werklocaties van onze gemeente loopt, dan wordt er hard gewerkt en gelachen. Het is informeel en er hangt een positieve energie. Mensen zoeken elkaar op. Niet alleen voor vergaderingen, maar bijvoorbeeld ook gezamenlijke lunch of een overleg tijdens een korte wandeling. Onze jaarlijkse zomer- en kerstborrel zijn een traditie aan het worden. Net als het verse fruit voor een gezondere snack tussendoor.

Daarnaast kun je in veel functies, natuurlijk altijd in overleg, jouw werktijd flexibel indelen of een deel van je uren thuiswerken. We snappen dat je een file liever vermijdt of bijvoorbeeld liever tussendoor gaat sporten in plaats van tijdens het spitsuur. Voor dat laatste hebben we overigens een unieke oplossing, onder ons gemeentehuis zit een sportschool waar je met korting kunt sporten.

Samenwerking met De BedrijfsvoeringsPartner
Met de gemeenten Albrandswaard en Ridderkerk werken we samen in De BedrijfsvoeringsPartner. Zij ondersteunen ons onder andere op het gebied van HRM, facilitair, en automatisering.

Jouw stempel drukken op Barendrecht?
In Barendrecht krijg je de ruimte om echt iets te doen. Om jouw ideeën om te zetten in actie en verschil te maken voor onze inwoners. We waarderen initiatief en samenwerking. Samen maken we Barendrecht elke dag een beetje mooier.

Wat vragen wij van je?

Gaan we samen bouwen aan een sterk BOA-team?
We zoeken een ervaren professional die de handhavingspraktijk kent en energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van mensen, werkprocessen en samenwerking. Je hebt natuurlijk gezag, durft keuzes te maken en kunt zowel duidelijk als prettig communiceren.
  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en relevante ervaring binnen het veiligheids- of handhavingsdomein.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met operationele coördinatie of functionele aansturing.
  • Je kent de gemeentelijke handhavingspraktijk, bij voorkeur domein I; ervaring bij de politie met operationele sturing kan ook goed aansluiten.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het opzetten van structuur, plannen van capaciteit en invoeren van werkprocessen.
  • Je spreekt medewerkers tijdig en consequent aan en weet ze mee te nemen in veranderingen.
  • Je kunt schakelen tussen praktijk, beleidsafstemming en een bestuurlijke omgeving.
  • Een (eerdere) BOA-bevoegdheid is een pré, geen vereiste.

Voldoe je niet aan ieder punt, maar denk je dat jouw kennis, ervaring en persoonlijkheid goed bij deze functie passen? Ook dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren.

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden
Als je kiest voor werken bij onze gemeente dan is dat niet voor niets. We bieden een mooi basissalaris en ook de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn uitstekend. Meer weten?

Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden

Ben jij onze nieuwe aanwinst?
Laat ons dan z.s.m. weten waarom jij onze nieuwe collega moet worden!

Voor deze vacature hanteren we geen sluitingsdatum. De vacature staat open tot het moment dat wij een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden.

Het aanvragen van een VOG is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Meer informatie
Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Linda de Ruiter via l.d.ruiter@barendrecht.nl of via 06-28517819.

Heb je vragen die betrekking hebben op de sollicitatieprocedure, dan kun je contact opnemen met Recruitment via recruitment@barendrecht.nl.

Let op: de vacature wordt gelijktijdig intern en extern uitgezet. Bij gebleken geschiktheid hebben interne kandidaten voorrang.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature is onnodig.

title: Associate Lab Operations Engineer
description:

Partner with the best

Do what you love

title: Total Rewards Systems Analyst
description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM


TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

The Total Rewards Systems Analyst supports the systems, data and operational processes used across Global Total Rewards. The role coordinates business-side configuration and testing with HR Technology, executes approved system-based compensation cycles, administers the Comp AI Tool and automated survey feeds, and maintains reliable reporting and data controls. The Analyst also supports benefits processes, carrier feeds and the Global Benefits Inventory with program owners and providers. The role translates approved business rules into tested system outcomes and resolves issues without independently changing policy or employee entitlements.


Key Responsibilities:


Workday Compensation & Benefits Administration

  • Coordinate and validate approved business-side configuration for compensation and benefits processes with HR Technology, following technical access and release controls. Programs and Benefits supply and approve their business rules.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, reconcile outputs and track defects for compensation and benefits changes. Obtain business-owner acceptance and HR Technology release approval before production.
  • Manage total rewards data governance in Workday — job codes, ranges, grades, comp plans, benefits configs, eligibility rules, carrier feed mappings.
  • Troubleshoot Workday comp and benefits module issues — coordinate with HR Tech for resolution.

Comp AI Tool Administration

  • Administer the Comp AI Tool — user access, data feeds, configuration, Workday integration.
  • Monitor data quality and integrity — market data, internal data, benchmarking outputs.
  • Manage automated survey submission feeds — ensure data flows, participation, and market data ingestion are accurate and timely.
  • Support user onboarding and training for Consultants, Analysts, and HRBPs.
  • Coordinate with vendor on enhancements, issues, and updates.

Benefits Systems Oversight

  • Support open enrollment system testing — plan configs, eligibility, enrollment workflows.
  • Audit carrier feed accuracy — identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Maintain Global Benefits Inventory data with Lockton and Global Benefits; Benefits validates plan content and local program rules.

Audits, Analytics & Reporting

  • Build and maintain total rewards dashboards — headcount costs, comp metrics, pay equity, benefits trends, vendor performance.
  • Perform data and system-control checks covering pay-range mapping, classification fields, benefits enrollment, carrier feeds and cycle outcomes. Escalate policy or legal interpretation issues to TR Compliance and the program owner.
  • Develop ad hoc analytics — scenario modeling, cost projections, retention risk, market trends.
  • Support external reporting — proxy, Form 5500, ACA 1094/1095-C, regulatory filings.
  • Ensure data reconciliation across all systems.

System Cycle Execution and Operational Controls

  • Run approved compensation system events, monitor processing, resolve tickets and reconcile final outputs before the authorized payroll handoff.
  • Maintain configuration documentation, test scripts, access records and recurring-system playbooks; support release, rollback and incident procedures.
  • Develop metric definitions, dashboards and scheduled reports with business owners, documenting validation, data access and refresh frequency.
  • Manage survey submission status through the Comp AI Tool and resolve feed exceptions. Refer material job-match and benchmark selection questions to Programs or Consultants.

Role Boundaries and Decision Rights

  • Does not own compensation philosophy, plan design, routine offer decisions or legal conclusions.
  • Programs owns business content and validation; Systems executes the approved workflow and reconciles results.
  • Benefits/Equity own their program vendor operations; Systems supports technical connections and data controls. Regulatory audits and remediation oversight are coordinated with TR Compliance.

Success Measures:

Targets and review cadence are agreed with the manager after assessing workload, program deadlines and baseline performance.

  • Accurate reconciliations and complete testing evidence.
  • On-time system processing and reporting.
  • Documented incident resolution and stable data feeds.
  • Accessible training and current process documentation.

Working Requirements:

Travel, regional working-hour overlap, accessibility requirements and any required language capabilities are confirmed for the position through the approved staffing process. Handle compensation, health, financial and participant data only through authorized systems and access controls.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in HRIS, IS, HR, Business, or related field.
  • 3–5 years HRIS/compensation systems or benefits systems administration.
  • Strong Workday HCM knowledge — comp and/or benefits module.
  • Experience with BenAdmin platforms (Empyrean, bswift, Benefitfocus, or similar).
  • Data audits, carrier feed management, system reconciliation experience.
  • Strong analytical skills — dashboards, audits, actionable insights.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or Excel-based dashboards.

Preferred:

  • Experience with real-time benchmarking platforms.
  • Retirement recordkeeper systems (Fidelity, Vanguard).
  • Manufacturing or multi-site environments.
  • M&A systems integration and data migration.

Competencies:

  • Systems Expertise: Understands how HRIS, comp, and benefits systems interconnect.
  • Data Integrity: Every data point, feed, and report accurate and reconciled.
  • Problem Solving: Diagnoses system issues quickly.
  • Partnership: Works with HR Tech, vendors, and all TR pillars.


Compensation and Benefits:

Applicants may be entitled to:

  • Mandatory Statutory Benefits according to the laws and legislation

  • Staff dormitory, Dining hall, Gym room, Company Shuttle, and other supportive facilities and services for those living on-site

  • Occupational health check-ups, Shuttle bus, Supplementary housing allowance (those not in dorms), Meal subsidy, etc.

  • Labor unions or other kinds of associations of interest, rich recreational activities such as company Annual Dinners, holiday gifts and greetings, team building, and various social activities.

  • Systematic training courses, Development projects, and Career paths

Export Statement:
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Specimen Processor
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Specimen Processor I to join our team in Brick, NJ.


Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 6:00pm – 2:30am, and rotating Saturdays as needed

Job Responsibilities:

  • Prepare laboratory specimens for analysis and testing
  • Unpack and route specimens to their respective staging areas
  • Accurately identify and label specimens
  • Pack and ship specimens to proper testing facilities
  • Meet department activity and production goals
  • Properly prepare and store excess specimen samples
  • Data entry of patient information in an accurate and timely manner
  • Resolve and document any problem specimens

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or GED or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1 year or more experience (lab, accessioning, production, manufacturing or warehouse environment)
  • 1 year or more of medical or production experience

Additional Job Standards:

  • Comfortable handling biological specimens
  • Ability to accurately identify specimens
  • Experience working in a team environment
  • Strong data entry and organizational skills
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Proficient in MS Office
  • Able to lift up to 40lbs.
  • Able to pass a standardized color blindness test

Are you organized, accountable, and have always gone the extra mile to make sure things are done right? Imagine the impact those skills can have in ensuring the accuracy of millions of healthcare tests, every month. If you share our passion for strengthening physician care, please apply for the Specimen Processor I position!

The Specimen Accessioner will be responsible for performing clinical specimen accessioning, sample sorting and data entry in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment according to established standard operating procedures.


**Pay Range: $17.75 - $20.00 per hour

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data


Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. For more detailed information, please click here.


If you're looking for a career that offers opportunities for growth, continual development, professional challenge and the chance to make a real difference, apply today!

Labcorp strives for inclusion and belonging in the workforce and does not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. We make employment decisions based on the needs of our business and the qualifications and merit of the individual. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), family or parental status, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, personal appearance, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic. title: Director - Tax
description:
Support Center - IrvingThe Director – Tax is a strategic leadership position responsible for the end-to-end management of all corporate tax compliance, including Corporate income tax (CIT), Sales and Use Tax (SUT) compliance, financial reporting, and audit defense. This role oversees the relationship with external compliance partners (KPMG), manages high-level financial forecasting for tax liabilities, and serves as the internal subject matter expert for all indirect tax matters. The Director ensures seamless coordination between Tax, Accounting, AP, Treasury, and Legal to maintain compliance and optimize cash flow.

Major Activities

SUT Compliance & Partner Management

  • External Coordination: Manage the SUT compliance lifecycle with KPMG, including the preparation of annual calendars for data exchange and return review deadlines.
  • Review & Sign-off: Provide final sign-off for returns in the KPMG Digital Gateway and review monthly SUT compliance workpapers.
  • Internal Filings: Conduct final reviews of internally filed returns, including signing returns and approving related funding requests.
  • Notice Management: Oversee daily notice management, delegating action items to the Supervisor - Indirect Tax and external compliance teams.
  • Exemption Certificates: Provide high-level review of pending B2B exemption certificates in the Tax Exempt Portal as needed.

Financial Planning & Tax Accounting

  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Prepare annual budgets for Tax and SUT P&L accounts; update monthly forecasts for actuals and upcoming period revisions.
  • Cash Management: Develop weekly cash tax forecasts for FP&A and Treasury to outline compliance payments for the fiscal year.
  • Accounting Close: Participate in monthly close meetings, providing variance explanations for SUT accounts and managing monthly journal entry status.
  • Professional Fees: Manage accruals and budget-to-actual analysis for SUT and Business License professional fees, reporting directly to the Vice President- Tax.
  • Audit Reserves: Review quarterly audit reserve workpapers and corresponding journal entries.

Audits, Defense & Consulting

  • Audit Defense: Lead jurisdictional SUT audits, including information gathering, participating in auditor calls, and signing off on closing workpapers.
  • Financial Audits: Prepare deliverables for EY’s quarterly and year-end financial statement audits, including process walk-throughs and inquiry responses.
  • Recovery & Reviews: Oversee use tax reviews and unclaimed property claims; collaborate with outside consultants to identify refund opportunities and mitigate exposure.
  • Specialized Audits: Prepare deliverables for the ABL Spain Bank Audit and Irving Rebate submissions.

Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting (ASC 740)

  • Provision Oversight: Review and confirm the reasonableness of the worldwide consolidated current and deferred tax expense, ending deferred tax balances, and income tax payable proofs.
  • Quarterly Reporting: Lead the quarterly tax close; manage full-year PBT forecasts for AETR calculations, review discrete items (UTB interest, rate changes), and provide final tax templates to Accounting for journal entry recording.
  • Technical Review: Validate all federal book-tax differences, state modifications, credits, valuation allowances, and uncertain tax positions (UTPs).
  • Disclosures & Controls: Review income tax footnotes and deferred scheduling analysis while ensuring strict compliance with SOX controls.
  • Reconciliations: Approve all payable, deferred, and UTB reconciliations within ARCS and review state tax receivable-payable analyses.

Domestic Transfer Pricing & Audit Management

  • Transfer Pricing: Compute final domestic transfer pricing adjustments at year-end and estimate periodic amounts for upcoming fiscal years.
  • Audit Leadership: Coordinate the IRS exam, review state audit impact scenarios, and lead audit settlement negotiations.
  • External Management: Manage relationships with internal and external auditors, providing data and lead explanations for management reporting.
  • International Correspondence: Compile and review information for certain specialized international audits, such as the Spain price audit.

CIT Compliance & Tactical Oversight

  • CIT Estimates & Extensions: Review and approve all federal and state estimated tax payments and extension requests.
  • CIT federal, state and international tax compliance oversight
  • Indirect & Franchise Tax: Oversee the quarterly Form 720 (Federal Excise Tax) filings, franchise tax budgets, and annual true-up reconciliations.
  • RTP Management: Oversee the accounting for federal and state Return-to-Provision (RTP) adjustments.

Strategic Operations & Leadership

  • Business Support: Review vendor contracts for appropriate tax language and act as the primary liaison with Legal for Annual Report compliance.
  • Project Leadership: Serve as the Tax lead for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) projects, providing tax impact analysis and sign-off from kick-off to go-live.
  • Governance: Review annual SAM Registrations for government sales and approve New Jersey UEZ Recertifications for specific store locations.
  • Legislative Oversight: Monitor new legislation to assess potential impacts on the business and provide training to the team on legislative or system changes.
  • Special Projects: Lead high-complexity initiatives including Due Diligence, Purchase Accounting, Debt Restructurings, Accounting Method Changes, and ERP (Oracle) implementations.
  • Team Development: Direct performance management activities, mentor team members, and foster a culture of continuous process improvement and technology adoption.

Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA and/or Master’s in Taxation (MST) required.
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive tax experience, with significant time in a leadership role within a large retail or multi-jurisdictional corporate environment.
  • Systems: Proficiency with KPMG Mercury, Docusign, Oracle, and Tax Exempt Portals.
  • SUT Expertise: Deep knowledge of Sales and Use Tax compliance, audit defense, and use tax recovery.
  • Accounting: Strong understanding of P&L variance analysis, journal entry management, and cash tax forecasting.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to manage external vendors and cross-functional internal relationships (AP, Legal, Treasury).
  • Technical Mastery:
  • Expert-level knowledge of ASC 740 and SOX compliance.
  • Proven experience in IRS Exam coordination.
  • Proficiency in ARCS, Oracle, and specialized tax provision/calendar software.

Applicants in the U.S. must satisfy federal, state, and local legal requirements of the job.

title: Client Service Representative
description:
VCA Lynnfield by the Lake Animal Hospital (Wakefield, MA)


Are you a compassionate, organized, and highly professional "people person" who loves animals? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where you can make a genuine difference in the lives of pets and their owners every single day?


If so, VCA Lynnfield by the Lake Animal Hospital wants you on our team! We are seeking a personable yet highly professional Client Service Representative (CSR) with veterinary experience to be the welcoming face of our hospital.


Why We Need You

As the first and last face our clients see, you set the tone for our entire practice. You aren't just answering phones—you are building and maintaining the trust and confidence of our veterinary community. As a CSR, you are the crucial pivot point around which our daily hospital operations spin.

In this vital role, your day-to-day will include:

  • Creating Outstanding First Impressions: Warmly greeting clients and their pets, answering busy phone lines with a smile, and guiding patients comfortably to their exam rooms.
  • Managing the Flow: Scheduling and confirming appointments efficiently to keep our veterinary team running smoothly.

What We Are Looking For

What We Offer You

We value our team members and believe in rewarding hard work. Eligible employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Competitive Pay: Starting at $18 per hour, with room for growth based on veterinary experience.

title: Client Service Representative (Night Shift)

At VCA Alameda East Veterinary Hospital, we believe exceptional patient care begins with exceptional client service. Every interaction matters, and our Client Service Representatives are often the first smile, reassuring voice, and lasting impression our clients experience.


We're looking for an energetic, compassionate, and customer-focused professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about helping both people and their pets. More importantly, we're looking for individuals who are excited to grow their career in the veterinary industry.

At Alameda East, we don't just hire Client Service Representatives—we invest in them. title: Scheduling Coordinator -  SITE BASED
description:
Job Description

Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables. applications and expertise. Agilent enables customers to gain the answers and insights they seek so they can do what they do best: improve the world around us.


Agilent is collaborating with leading biopharmaceuticals located in the UK and is hiring for the integral and dynamic role of Enterprise Scheduling Coordinator (ESC).


The main objectives of this position are to:


  • Represent Agilent Technologies delivering high levels of customer satisfaction in a dynamic, fast passed pharmaceutical site.
  • Effective planning, scheduling and hosting of engineers for onsite maintenance activities.
  • Manage and update scheduled services plan, ensuring successful completion of services and responding to breakdown repair requests.
  • Work in partnership with customer(s) internal & third-party vendors
  • Effectively manage contractual response times, minimizing rescheduling and delivering services within satisfactory timelines.
  • Build successful customer relationships, prioritizing customer requirements and keeping customer informed of any scheduling changes.

Responsibilities of the Enterprise Scheduling Coordinator are:

  • Service coordination; organizing service visits in accordance with site schedule along with management of associated standards / parts and IT requests etc. necessary for the successful completion of the service.
  • Vendor hosting – support as the dedicated point of contact for onsite services, managing permits and supporting service engineers during service visits.
  • Customer POC – first point of contact for the customer for any scheduling or operational queries.
  • Daily administrative duties such as quotation requests, raising purchase orders and reconciling costs. Track out of scope costs and report regularly to account manager.
  • Attend operational calls, customer meetings and managing a high volume of emails.
  • Customer asset management, ensuring inventories are accurate. Managing new instrument additions, removals, and any changes to the agreed inventory.
  • Monitoring performance metrics ensuring maintenance and repair requests are completed within the timeframe agreed with customer, with minimum disruption to onsite activities.
  • Work with scheduling applications such as SAP CRM System and SmartSheet.
  • Ability to work as a team player and demonstrate a passion for the role and customer satisfaction.
  • Schedule vendor inductions and comply with customer vendor management requirements, ensuring risk assessments, training records and relevant documentation is collated in advance of scheduled services
  • To management repair requests, minimizing instrument downtime.
  • Proactive monitoring of schedule adherence to planned preventative maintenance.
  • Management shipment and tracking of off-site instruments.
  • Data management – managing inventory, service metrics, schedule and costings to a high standard.
  • Collation of vendor service reports and upload onto customer CMMS software. Closure of associated work orders
  • Following customer gowning and PPE requirements while operating in clean room areas and laboratories.


Qualifications

Core Skills Requirements:

  • Third level qualification, science qualification advantageous.
  • Ability to be a key team player, take ownership and help your colleagues with a positive attitude.
  • Ability to manage sudden changes in priorities.
  • Proven ability to problem-solve and multi-task.
  • Planning, organizational, and time management skills. Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to handle customer and vendor requests via telephone, email, in-person.
  • Excellent communication skills – effective interpersonal and cross-functional collaboration skills to work effectively with team members, customers, and relevant stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently will limited managerial input.
  • Knowledge of planning and administrative tools is preferable – SAP/Smartsheet.

title: Team Leader
description:
About TaskUs: TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.


It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer: At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.




What does a Team Lead do? Think of yourself as someone who will provide mentorship, guidance, and career development to members of your team, so not everyone can qualify for this role. We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it’s time to imagine what it’s like being a Team Lead.


As a Team Lead, you will provide mentorship, guidance, and career development to members of your team. You will implement escalation channels by mutually agreed-upon procedures. You will lead a high-performing team through an exciting transition to build problem-solving, critical thinking, analytical and technical capabilities that will enable the department to develop deeper, more scalable solutions. You will establish team goals and work with direct reports on strategies for executing, measuring progress, and sharing results. You will also identify actionable insights, suggest recommendations, and influence team strategy through effective communication.

So, do you have what it takes to be a Team Lead?

2 years of prior experience in the BPO or call center industry

title: Principal Software Systems Engineer
description:
Powering the agentic revolution in travel. Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

We are seeking a Software Systems Engineer to join our global engineering team, where innovation knows no borders. This team designs and delivers resilient, high-throughput cloud services that power critical travel transactions across the globe. By building modern distributed systems, the team ensures our platform operates with exceptional performance, scalability and reliability. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Software Systems Engineer, you will serve as a technical anchor, guiding engineering teams through the design and delivery of cloud-native microservices. You will take ownership of architectural decisions, drive continuous engineering improvements and champion modern development practices across the software lifecycle. This role requires technical depth in distributed architectures, hands-on engineering rigor and collaborative leadership to solve complex challenges sustainably.


What you'll do

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for distributed backend microservices within an Agile/Lean monorepo environment
  • Design and implement high-performance service-to-service APIs, event-driven integrations and scalable data architectures
  • Own the full software development lifecycle from technical design through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and production diagnostics
  • Guide development teams in modern testing standards, observability, resilience patterns and failure handling to safeguard production stability
  • Introduce and evaluate AI-assisted engineering practices, using tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve code exploration, quality, testing and delivery speed
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align service boundaries, optimize infrastructure with Terraform and container orchestration, and ensure robust security standards

What you'll bring

Required qualifications

  • At least 6 years of hands-on Java backend development experience, including recent production experience with Java 17 or later
  • Deep expertise across the Java ecosystem, Spring Boot and the design of cloud-native microservices
  • Proven track record leading development teams or serving as a technical anchor in Agile/Lean delivery environments
  • Strong foundation in distributed systems, covering asynchronous messaging, service boundaries, consistency, failure handling and observability
  • Solid grasp of the end-to-end SDLC, including CI/CD automation, testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito and AssertJ, code reviews and production support
  • Practical experience applying AI tools effectively for code implementation, testing, debugging and documentation, along with evaluating their delivery impact
  • Excellent communication skills in English

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with Java 21
  • Domain experience in Order Management Systems (OMS) or travel/airline operations, including orders, PNRs, payments or booking servicing
  • Experience managing builds and dependencies with Maven and Bazel within a monorepo
  • Experience working with Google Cloud Platform, Google Cloud Spanner and distributed or NoSQL data stores
  • Practical experience with Google Cloud Pub/Sub, event-driven architectures and message-driven workflows
  • Hands-on experience developing or integrating APIs using gRPC, Protocol Buffers and REST/JSON
  • Familiarity with containerized cloud deployments on Kubernetes/GKE, infrastructure as code via Terraform, Envoy service-mesh concepts or OAuth 2.0/Okta security

Work arrangements

  • Hybrid working mode; 3 chosen days from the office in a week
  • Flexible working hours: Maintain your work-life balance by adjusting your working hours to your needs

Paid time off

  • Year-End-Break: enjoy additional fully paid days off during the last week of the year
  • Paid parental leave: Take up to 12 weeks off with pay after birth or adoption of a child. Sabre Global Paid Parental Leave runs concurrently with local leave policies.
  • Paid volunteer time: take up to 4 days annually to give your time to a charitable organization of your choice

Your money

  • My Benefit platform/Multisport card: enjoy the benefit cafeteria system and use popular sport card
  • Tax deduction: take the opportunity to claim deductible costs, reducing your income tax
  • Employee Capital Plans: profit from long-term saving scheme co-financed by Sabre and the State Treasury
  • Baby Bonus: benefit from one-time allowance on childbirth or adoption
  • Say Thanks program: collect points on recognition program and transfer them to wide variety of gifts and services

Health and wellness

  • Luxmed medical coverage: take care of yourself and your family with the extensive medical package with a broad range of additional services
  • Foreign travel insurance: feel safe going abroad with free Allianz insurance offered as part of our Lux Med package
  • Employee Assistance Program: find help in free, confidential program with a certified counselor
  • Mindfulness & meditation apps: take care of your mental and physical health
  • Life insurance: sign up for free, high coverage life insurance program

Career development

  • Professional development: access to e-learning platforms as well as join Sabre live learning sessions
  • Certification and tuition reimbursement
  • Our Communities: join one of our team member groups focused on sharing knowledge and best practices (Google Developers Group, Innovation Lab Community, Women in Technology, SOLVE!T and many more)

And more

title: Part Time Merchandise Manager
description:
Store - STROUDSBURG, PAThe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards. This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.
  • Execute and maintain SISO (Store-In-Stock Optimization) routines to drive in-stock levels, replenishment accuracy, and sales readiness.
  • Oversee Planogram (POG) execution, ensuring merchandising sets are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards, including initial product placement and presentation to company expectations.
  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Type of Experience Required

  • 3+ years retail leadership experience

Work Environment

  • Ability to remain standing for long periods of time
  • Ability to move throughout the store
  • Regular bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and stretching
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise and fixtures, up to 25-50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve products.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including scanning items, stocking shelves, and operating POS equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent customer interactions.
  • Work hours include nights, weekends and early mornings

title: Hospital Manager
description:
VCA Franklin Park Animal Hospital, located in Franklin Park, IL is seeking a highly experienced Veterinary Client Service professional to join our leadership team as Hospital Manager. The hospital offers general practice services including surgery and dentistry. The practice has been a part of VCA for many years and is well known in the community. The team is passionate about providing the best quality medicine and exceptional client experience.


The role demands a leader with the interpersonal and organizational skills to continue achieving our goals of delivering excellent patient care and customer service to both our clients and referring veterinarians.

The successful candidate will have experience in Human Resource and personnel management, Marketing, and Business development. Your strong financial and operational acumen will be put to good use!

The Hospital Manager—under the guidance of the Regional Management team and in partnership with the Medical Director—performs a wide range of administrative activities related to the practice. This includes: mentoring the staff and overseeing the business operations and maintenance of the facility; ensuring the business growth and profitability of the practice; and supporting the hospital’s mission of delivering high quality patient care and exceptional client service.


Skills and Qualifications
• 2 to 3 years of customer service and financial budget management experience.
• Knowledge of sales and marketing techniques.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially to a diverse range of audiences and settings.
• The ability to make decisions, delegate responsibility and achieve results with hospital team members.
• Professional comportment and appearance, with excellent interpersonal skills and a friendly, positive attitude.
• Respect for and willingness to work with clients and their pets.
• Must be able to handle multiple tasks and deal with an environment of changing priorities.

Job Responsibilities
• Direct and develop the veterinary, technical and administrative staff towards the goal of quality patient care and excellent client service; assist in the formulation of objectives and policies to ensure efficient and profitable hospital operations.
• Oversee the hiring, reviewing, disciplining and terminating of professional staff, in accordance with and with the approval of the Regional Management team.
• Review the P&L Report monthly and partner with the Hospital Medical Director to increase revenue and limit expenses; work with home office to prepare and submit the yearly budget (budget forecast, operating plan, cap-ex expenditures) and participate in the evaluation process with Regional Management team.
• Model an “owner” mentality in hospital by demonstrating a willingness to assist all employees in making the practice a success; invest the necessary amount of time to accomplish the required responsibilities and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital.
• Minimizing patient stress and discomfort; recommend referral to another VCA doctor or specialist when this is likely to significantly improve the prognosis.
• Maintain client/patient medical/surgical records and make certain all necessary logs are kept up-to-date through established protocols; assist colleagues in follow-up and future management of the patient.
• Supervise the administration and case review of client medical complaints.
• Positively represent the hospital and VCA in the professional community and to the general public.
