title: Clinical Assay Specialist (CLIA)
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a Clinical Assay Specialist (CLIA) to join our team at 100 Perimeter Park Drive, Morrisville, NC.

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm EST. Weekend work may be required.
  • Potential travel for cross-site support needs or external training needs.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide technical and scientific oversight for CLIA laboratory testing, ensuring compliance with regulatory and quality standards.
  • Serve as General Supervisor and Technical Supervisor designee as applicable for the CLIA lab, including oversight and execution of testing, training, competency assessments, and day-to-day support for high-complexity testing.
  • Lead assay transfers and validation activities to support clinical laboratory operations.
  • Establish, monitor, and improve quality control processes to ensure accurate and reliable test results.
  • Troubleshoot technical and operational issues, implement corrective actions, and ensure testing systems meet performance requirements.
  • Coordinate proficiency testing programs and support laboratory readiness for CAP, CLIA, NYSDOH, and other regulatory inspections.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams drive continuous improvement initiatives, workflow optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Execute development and validation studies for Companion Diagnostic (CDx) programs under the direction of project leads.
  • Provide direct technical support for CDx development activities, including sample processing, instrumentation, data generation, and troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to the preparation and review of SOPs, validation protocols, reports, and technical documentation.

Minimum Qualifications

U.S. Education Requirements:

The incumbent must qualify as a CLIA high complexity General Supervisor (42 CFR 493.1461) and must meet applicable CAP and New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH) Clinical Laboratory Evaluation Program (CLEP) personnel requirements for this role.

General Supervisor (high complexity) - must meet one of the following:

  • An earned bachelor’s degree in a chemical, biological, clinical or medical laboratory science, or medical technology, from an accredited institution AND at least 1 year of laboratory training or experience, or both, in high complexity testing; OR
  • An earned associate degree in a laboratory science or medical laboratory technology from an accredited institution (or equivalent education and training as defined in 42 CFR 493.1489(b)(3)) AND at least 2 years of laboratory training or experience, or both, in high complexity testing; OR
  • A doctor of medicine, doctor of osteopathy, or doctor of podiatric medicine licensed to practice medicine, osteopathy, or podiatry AND at least 1 year of laboratory training or experience, or both, in high complexity testing.

New York State (NYSDOH CLEP):

  • Meet all NYSDOH CLEP qualification requirements applicable to the General Supervisor, as determined by NYSDOH. New York requirements may be more stringent than federal CLIA, and final acceptance of an individual is subject to NYSDOH review.
  • For testing samples originating in New York, on-site supervision is always required whenever such testing is performed.

Work Experience Required:

  • 4 or more years’ experience with firsthand high complexity testing across one or more relevant platforms (e.g., IHC, PCR/qPCR, NGS, immunoassay) preferred.
  • 2 or more years’ experience supervising, training, or mentoring laboratory staff in a clinical setting preferred (to support supervisory growth of the role).

Work Experience Preferred

  • Direct experience establishing, activating, or accrediting a CLIA laboratory, or bringing a laboratory through CAP accreditation and/or New York State (NYSDOH CLEP) approval.
  • Experience transferring and validating laboratory-developed tests (LDTs) or companion diagnostic assays from an R&D or development environment into a CLIA/clinical laboratory.
  • Experience authoring and implementing SOPs, quality systems, and QC programs.
  • Hands-on experience across one or more of the laboratory's platforms: IHC, PCR/qPCR, NGS, and/or immunoassay (MSD-ECL).
  • Companion diagnostics (CDx) or IVD development experience, ideally supporting pharmaceutical clinical trials.
  • Familiarity operating in a regulated device or clinical-study environment (e.g., ISO 15189, IVDR, 21 CFR Part 11, GCP/ICH E6, ISO 20916).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current ASCP (or equivalent) certification; ASCP Specialist in Molecular Biology (SM/MB)

Additional Job Standards

  • Theoretical and practical knowledge of analytical instrumentation.
  • Knowledge of preclinical/clinical assays and companion diagnostics (CDx) development.
  • Strong working knowledge of CLIA, CAP, and relevant state regulations.
  • Proficiency with Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) and Microsoft Office.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills; ability to multitask and manage priorities in a demanding environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; skilled in time management, planning, and delivering presentations.
  • May work with potentially hazardous/biohazardous materials, clinical or laboratory environment with exposure to biohazard materials.
  • Must be able to see and distinguish colors.
  • Must have command of the English language, both oral and written.
  • Must be able to use hands to finger, handle, or touch objects, tools, or controls, including a keyboard, for up to 12 hours per day.
  • Must be able to stand, walk, and/or bend for up to 12 hours per day and perform repetitive tasks; occasionally lifting up to 40 lbs.
  • Mandatory use of personal protective equipment (lab coats, gloves, safety glasses) always in laboratory areas.

About Labcorp

At Labcorp, we are a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services that help doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers, and patients make clear and confident decisions.

Through our unparalleled diagnostics and drug development laboratory capabilities, our 70,000 employees combine innovative innovation, science and technology to solve some of today’s biggest health challenges, accelerate life-changing healthcare breakthroughs and impact lives around the world.

Here, you are empowered to own your career journey and create a personalized development plan with the support of your team.

title: Boliden Zinkgruvan söker en Dokumentationsansvarig
description:
Boliden Zinkgruvan bryter malm och producerar koncentrat av zink, koppar och bly. Metaller har en avgörande betydelse för ett modernt samhälle. Det gör oss till en viktig aktör i klimatomställningen. Boliden Zinkgruvan finns strax utanför Askersund, nära både natur och storstad. Vi är inte bara Sveriges äldsta och sydligaste gruva i bruk. Vi är en arbetsplats för 490 medarbetare med många olika yrkesroller. Vi erbjuder en bra arbetsmiljö med varierande uppgifter och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter, även internationellt.

Boliden Zinkgruvan söker nu en strukturerad dokumentationsansvarig som vill ta en nyckelroll i arbetet med att utveckla och säkerställa kvaliteten i vår anläggningsdokumentation. Tjänsten tillhör sektionen Projekt- och förändringsarbete inom Verksamhetsutveckling.

Vi söker dig som trivs med att skapa struktur, har ett tekniskt intresse och tycker om att samarbeta med människor i olika delar av organisationen. Du är kvalitetsmedveten, noggrann och har förmågan att se både detaljer och helhet.

Om rollen

Som dokumentationsansvarig ansvarar du för att säkerställa att verksamheten har tillgång till korrekt, uppdaterad och lättillgänglig anläggningsdokumentation. Du fungerar som ett viktigt stöd till projektledare, underhållsorganisation och driftverksamhet vid såväl förändringar som nyanskaffningar av utrustning.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med flera delar av verksamheten och ger stora möjligheter att påverka både arbetssätt och utvecklingen av våra system för dokumenthantering.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Ansvara för strukturering, administration och arkivering av anläggningsdokumentation.
  • Säkerställa att dokumentation är korrekt, aktuell och tillgänglig för verksamheten.
  • Kravställa vilken dokumentation som ska levereras vid projekt, investeringar och förändringar.
  • Granska ritningar, tekniska underlag och konstruktionsdokumentation tillsammans med verksamheten.
  • Säkerställa att dokumentationsleveranser följer gällande standarder, riktlinjer och dokumentationsstrukturer.
  • Stödja projektledare, drift- och underhållsorganisationen i dokumentationsfrågor.
  • Bidra vid framtagning och arkivering av teknisk dokumentation kopplad till CE-märkning.
  • Driva och utveckla arbetssätt, rutiner och systemstöd för dokumenthantering.
  • Samarbeta med både lokala och centrala IT-funktioner för att utveckla våra digitala lösningar.
  • Medverka i verksamhetsutvecklingens förbättrings- och förändringsarbete.

Kvalifikationer

  • Teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet inom teknik, konstruktion eller dokumentationshantering.
  • God teknisk förståelse för maskiners uppbyggnad samt drift- och underhållsprocesser.
  • Erfarenhet av ritningar, teknisk dokumentation eller konstruktionsunderlag.
  • God förmåga att kommunicera och samarbeta med olika funktioner och yrkesgrupper.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
  • God datorvana och erfarenhet av system såsom:
    • SAP

Senior Ratepayer Assistance Specialist

Maine Public Utilities Commission (MPUC)
Division: Consumer Assistance and Safety Division
Position Code: 1175
Location: Hallowell, Maine (Hybrid Work Schedule Available)
Vacancies: 1
Salary Range: $54,017.60– $75,732.80 annually
Opening Date: November 5, 2026
Closing Date: November 19, 2026


About the MPUC


The Maine Public Utilities Commission (MPUC) plays a crucial role in shaping Maine’s energy and utility landscape. Our mission is to ensure that all Mainers have access to safe and reliable utility services at just and reasonable rates, while promoting energy efficiency and reducing greenhouse gas emissions.


Our Consumer Assistance and Safety Division (CASD) is dedicated to protecting consumer rights, resolving utility-related disputes, and ensuring utility companies follow Maine laws and regulations. CASD handles complaints involving billing, service quality, disconnections, payment arrangements, and more. The Division also educates the public and monitors utility compliance across the state.

If you are passionate about serving your community and protecting consumers, we encourage you to apply!


Job Description


This is complex administrative work involving the analysis and investigation of inquiries and complaints from consumers regarding public utilities. Work includes investigations, negotiating resolutions with utility management and consumers, documenting findings of violations, and participating in reviewing rate and tariff filings and adjudicatory proceedings. This work involves significant time working on the telephone with the public. Work is performed under limited supervision.

Representative Tasks


  • Investigates, mediates, and resolves complaints to solve complex disputes concerning utility services.
  • Reviews and evaluates case reports to ensure compliance with laws, rules, and past practices.
  • Reads and explains applicable tariffs, laws, rules, policies, and procedures to other staff, consumers, and consumer representatives to ensure implementation and compliance with rules.
  • Compiles and writes statistical reports on complaints, inquiries, and investigations to provide information to management.
  • Recommends disposition of cases and findings of violations of rules to finalize actions.
  • Independently issues decisions on cases that are legally binding and that can result in a utility company providing credit to the customer, establishing payment arrangements, or finding other resolutions to the complaints.
  • Conducts informal hearings on complaints, on-site audits of utility credit and collection procedures, training programs with utility representatives, and special projects to provide information, resolve complaints, and ensure rules are followed.
  • Advise Consumer Assistance Specialists to assist them with the investigation and resolution of consumer complaints.
  • Participates in advocate and advisor teams conducting investigations and adjudicatory proceedings to evaluate and make recommendations on quality of customer services.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities


  • Knowledge of applicable laws, rules, regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Knowledge of resources and organizations where individuals can obtain assistance.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for network automation?

Do you want to help scale a global platform?

Join the Mapping SRE team

A Senior II Site Reliability Engineer is needed for the Routing Services team at Akamai. Responsibilities include managing routing infrastructure, enhancing production systems, resolving network problems, creating automation, and ensuring reliable network services. This position supports Akamai's distributed compute platform and focuses on maintaining and improving critical systems for optimal performance and reliability.

Partner with the best

You will work closely with SREs, network engineers and architects on infrastructure changes, incident resolution and improvements to routing services.

As a Senior II Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Operating, maintain and troubleshoot Linux-based routing infrastructure in production.
  • Investigating BGP routing issues, network connectivity problems and routing configuration failures.
  • Supporting routing software such as FRRouting (FRR), including configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting.
  • Developing and maintain automation for routing infrastructure, configuration management and operational tasks using tools such as Ansible
  • Supporting and deploying cloud-native, third party software utilizing an infrastructure as code paradigm
  • Participating in production incidents, perform root cause analysis and drive follow-up improvements.
  • Improving monitoring, alerting and observability for routing services.
  • Defining and maintain Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for supported services.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Demonstrate expertise in Site Reliability Engineering, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a comparable role centered on infrastructure.
  • Demonstrate expertise in Linux system administration and advanced troubleshooting abilities.
  • Demonstrate expertise in TCP/IP networking, routing protocols, and efficient network troubleshooting techniques.
  • Demonstrate expertise in BGP, routing policies, and foundational routing concepts.
  • Have experience with routing software such as FRRouting (FRR) or similar technologies.

title: Ajoneuvovarustelija
description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Vantaalle ajoneuvovarustelijoita.

Työ pitää sisällään ajoneuvojen lisälaitteisiin liittyviä asennuksia. Työhön kuuluu mm. johtojen vetoa, laitteiden pinta-asennuksia ja erilaisia kytkentöjä. Työhön sisältyy vain 12 voltin sähköjärjestelmiin liittyviä kytkentöjä, joten varsinaista sähköalan koulutusta ei edellytetä. Aiempi kokemus vastaavanlaisista töistä on luonnollisesti eduksi. Työ on melko toisteista ja siihen annetaan kattava perehdytys.

Työohjeet ovat suomeksi, joten vähintään hyvää suomen kielen taitoa tarvitaan työssä menestymiseen.

Työtä tehdään päivävuorossa ma-pe 40 h/ vko.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian ja haussa on pari vakituista työntekijää asiakkaallemme. Alkupalkka tehtävässä asettuu todennäköisesti välille 14-18 €/h, riippuen hakijan osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta.

Hakijoilta toivomme:

  • kokemusta vastaavanlaisista töistä
  • reipasta asennetta sekä
  • tiimityöskentelytaitoja.

Tarjoamme kaikille Apuvoiman työntekijöille aina:

  • laajennetun työterveyshuollon
  • luotettavan ja laadukkaan palkanmaksun
  • oman yhteyshenkilön työsuhdeasioidesi hoitoon.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, valitse seuraavista sinulle sopivin lähestymistapa:

  • Hae paikkaa linkin kautta .
  • Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: teemu.aalto@apuvoima.com.
  • Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä Teemuun soittamalla, viestillä tai WhatsAppilla numeroon 050 525 4627.
APUVOIMA ON REKRYTOINNIN AMMATTILAINEN
Yhdistämme osaavat tekijät ja työnantajat eri aloilla ympäri Suomen.
Tarjoamme monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin – olitpa sitten etsimässä seuraavaa askelta urallasi tai joustavaa työtä muun arjen rinnalle.
Meille on tärkeää, että työnteko on sujuvaa ja mutkatonta. Meillä arki toimii ja Apuvoima on lähellä silloin kun sitä tarvitset.

description:

Job Profile

Business Function:

Group Information Security and Privacy

Team:

IAM - Privileged Access Management Engineering

Job Title:

PAM Engineer

Reports to:

PAM Manager

Location:

Bengaluru, India



Job description summary

The PAM Engineer will be responsible for the implementation, engineering, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the enterprise Privileged Access Management platform. The role will provide hands-on expertise across CyberArk Vault, Central Policy Manager (CPM), Privileged Session Manager (PSM), Central Credential Provider (CCP), Credential Provider (CP), and Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA). The engineer will develop custom integrations, maintain platform currency through upgrades and patching, automate repetitive activities, and work closely with the PAM Operations team to deliver a secure, stable, and scalable PAM service.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, implement, configure, and maintain CyberArk PAM solutions across enterprise environments.

• Develop, test, deploy, and support custom CPM plugins for password management and reconciliation use cases.

• Develop, test, deploy, and support custom PSM connectors for secure privileged session access.

• Administer and support CyberArk Vault, CPM, PSM, CCP, CP, and PTA components.

• Plan and execute CyberArk platform upgrades, security patches, hotfixes, and lifecycle maintenance activities.

• Automate repetitive engineering and operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or equivalent technologies.

• Build and support integrations between CyberArk and applications, servers, databases, network devices, cloud services, and DevOps platforms.

• Troubleshoot complex platform, connector, authentication, password rotation, and privileged session issues.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable remediation for recurring incidents and platform defects.

• Partner with the PAM Operations team on onboarding, incident resolution, service improvements, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness.

• Coordinate technical changes with application, infrastructure, security, and change-management stakeholders.

• Maintain engineering standards, configuration records, technical documentation, and support runbooks.

• Contribute to platform resilience, disaster recovery testing, capacity planning, monitoring, and security compliance activities.

About You

• Hands-on engineer with strong ownership, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to problem solving.

• Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with engineering, operations, application, infrastructure, and security teams.

• Comfortable coordinating multiple technical activities and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Committed to continuous learning, service improvement, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

You and Our Values

You exemplify our core values in the following ways:

Ambitious - Improve PAM capabilities through practical engineering and automation.

Curious - Continuously learn, investigate, and challenge existing approaches.

Empathetic - Listen to stakeholder needs and support teams constructively.

Courageous - Take ownership of complex technical issues and decisions.

Nimble - Adapt effectively to changing priorities, technologies, and risks.


Experience and Expertise Needed

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 5 to 10 years of hands-on experience in PAM implementation, engineering, and platform support within enterprise environments.

• Strong implementation and administration experience with CyberArk Vault, CPM, PSM, CCP, CP, and PTA.

• Proven experience developing custom CPM plugins and PSM connectors.

• Experience with CyberArk platform upgrades, patching, migrations, hardening, health checks, and lifecycle management.

• Strong automation and scripting skills using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or equivalent technologies.

• Experience integrating PAM with Windows, Linux/Unix, databases, network devices, applications, cloud platforms, and DevOps toolchains.

• Good understanding of privileged account lifecycle management, authentication, password rotation, session isolation, secrets retrieval, and threat analytics.

• Experience supporting complex incidents, performing root cause analysis, and coordinating technical remediation with PAM Operations.

• Good understanding of IAM, cybersecurity principles, enterprise change management, and security control requirements.

• Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and cross-team coordination skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and deliver engineering activities through to completion.

• CyberArk certification such as CDE, Sentry, or equivalent is preferred.

• Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP and integration with ServiceNow or CI/CD platforms is an advantage.

title: Cost Coordinator
description:
As a Cost Coordinator, you will use data, analytics, and business intelligence tools to improve cost visibility, support strategic decision-making, and increase profitability across the organization. You will help transform complex data into applicable insights that help increase products, operations, and our performance. You will report to Cost Risk Manager.


Key Responsibilities


  • You will maintain cost data within Oracle ERP, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and reliability across raw materials, packaging, and manufacturing cost structures.
  • You will develop Power BI dashboards that provide visibility into costs, manufacturing expenses, profitability, pricing changes, and important business indicators.
  • You will analyze manufacturing cost performance, identify trends and variances, and provide recommendations that support operational decisions.
  • You will create cost simulations and financial models to evaluate the impact of changes in raw material prices, packaging costs, manufacturing expenses, and exchange rates.
  • You will consolidate and analyze data from multiple sources to produce Indicators, profitability metrics, and business insights that support projects.
  • You will partner with other teams to evaluate product costs, new product developments, optimization projects, and specification changes.
  • You will identify market trends, supply risks, and cost-saving opportunities through the analysis of raw material and packaging purchases.
  • You will help establish standards of data quality, governance, and reporting consistency across cost and profitability analyses.
  • You will translate complex datasets into executive-level recommendations that influence profitability and performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Accounting, Data Science, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in manufacturing or industrial cost analysis.
  • Experience in Business Intelligence and profitability analysis.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards and automated reporting solutions.
  • Experience with data modeling, financial analysis, and performance analytics.
  • Technical skills:
  • Power BI
  • Excel (can perform complex functions)
  • Cost Analysis / Manufacturing Costing
  • Data Modeling & Analytics

title: Libraries Adviser - Multiple Locations across City
description:
Libraries Advisor
Multiple Locations across City

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850 (pro-rata for part-time)
Hours: 14.08hrs per week, 52 weeks

We are recruiting Library Advisor staff to join our library teams in a number of library locations across the city.

Posts are shift working and include Saturdays and evenings.

Our libraries are at the heart of their communities. Members of staff work with their community to help create a thriving place to live and to help reduce poverty and inequality. We support users to develop their digital skills, and we help them get the information and advice they need. Our staff encourage babies and children to develop their language and reading ability through programmes like Bookbug and Read, Write Count. We help those of all ages in the community who struggle with loneliness by providing them with a place to meet and connect. We provide a full range of books and other resources to help everyone to live, learn and work.

Young people are regular users of libraries and can range from structured activity to simply meeting up with friends. It is vital that our staff have a broad understanding of the issues faced by young people and that individually or as part of the team, you are willing to engage with and support young people and maintain a positive, safe and trusted environment. Any youth engagement experience will be welcomed.

To be a successful member of our team you must be able to show that you can deliver excellent customer service and that you can understand the needs of different parts of the community.

If you could be an effective team player in a service that puts customers first, please apply. If you are invited to interview, we will ask you your preferred hours and discuss with you the permanent and temporary positions. Whilst we recruit to teams in individual libraries, staff are expected to work in any library across the city.

The City of Edinburgh Council is committed to recruiting people who will deliver high quality public services to our diverse communities within the city of Edinburgh. The preferred candidate will be required to join the PVG Scheme or undergo a PVG Scheme update check. You will be required to provide this check. An unconditional offer of employment and commencement in the post will be subject to the outcome of both these pre-employment checks being deemed satisfactory.

We're committed to creating a workplace culture where all our people feel valued, included and able to be their best at work, and we recognise the benefits that a diverse workforce with different values, beliefs, experience, and backgrounds brings to us as an organisation.

As part of our goal to improve our organisational culture and create a great place to work together for the people of Edinburgh, we want to make sure that we’re bringing the best people into our roles, not just in their skills and experience but also in their approach to work.

To help achieve this, we’re changing the way we interview and assess candidates by moving from a competency-based interview approach to a behavioural and technical (skills for the job) based approach. This new way of interviewing will allow us to assess how you think and how you would bring Our Behaviours of Respect, Integrity and Flexibility into your ways of working.

title: Global Pricing Manager, Aerospace
description:
PPG's Aerospace Business is looking for a Global Pricing Manager to join our team! As the Global Pricing Manager, Aerospace, you will lead the development and execution of pricing strategies across the Aerospace Coatings and Sealants business. You will be accountable for driving profitable, sustainable growth through pricing science, governance, and commercial enablement in a complex and technically differentiated market. As the Global Pricing Manager, you will serve as a strategic business partner to Sales, Product Management, Finance, Commercial Excellence, and Leadership, ensuring pricing decisions are data‑driven, market‑informed, risk‑aware, and aligned with business objectives across multiple segments.



As the Global Pricing Manager, you will be an individual contributor reporting to the Global Commercial Segment Director - Aerospace Business. This is an onsite position with a flex-Friday option and can be based out of the following locations in the U.S.: Atlanta, GA or Los Angeles, CA. We are also open to candidates in the following European locations: Shildon, England; Gonfreville, France; Toulouse, France; Wroclaw, Poland; or Hamburg, Germany.



Key Responsibilities

  • Develop & execute the global pricing strategy, pricing structures and architecture across product lines, channels, and market segments
  • Champion a value‑based selling that reflects technical performance, lifecycle value, and risk mitigation
  • Lead global pricing initiatives, recommend pricing responses to changing market conditions and cost dynamics (e.g., tariffs, cost shifts, competitive moves) with agility and discipline
  • Optimize discount structures, rebate programs, and commercial terms
  • Establish and lead pricing governance, including approval workflows, escalation protocols, and compliance
  • Set up and lead pricing review boards and governance forums
  • Communicate pricing rationale and changes clearly to field sales, ensuring alignment and confidence
  • Support strategic deal structures, customer negotiations, and margin management
  • Train sales teams in value-based pricing and negotiation principles
  • Develop and deploy pricing models including elasticity analysis, price waterfall, segmentation, and optimization frameworks
  • Develop and enhance digital tools to improve data visibility, integrity, and streamline pricing workflow
  • Leverage and innovate around AI-driven pricing models, partnered with BI, including predictive analytics, customer segmentation, and dynamic pricing algorithms
  • Implement pricing systems (Price FX) and tools to automate and scale execution
  • Measure and report on pricing performance, margin trends, and ROI
  • Collaborate with the cross‑functional team (Product Management, Commercial, Finance, Procurement, Operations, Supply Chain and Legal teams)



Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business related field required, MBA preferred.
  • 8+ years' experience in a pricing, strategy, finance or commercial leadership role.
  • Proven success in a global or multi-regional B2B manufacturing and / or growth focused innovative sectors.
  • Experience with QAD, Oracle, pricing software and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Price FX).
  • Strong analytical capabilities and data-driven decision making
  • Experience balancing global consistency with regional market needs.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Only U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, and political asylees or refugees are eligible to apply.



The base salary range for this position is $130,000 to $150,000, with a possibility of an annual bonus up to 10% of base salary. title: Strategisch Adviseur
description:
Aantal uur: 32-36 uur per week
Salaris: tussen €5.369,- en de €7.253,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur (schaal 12)
Contract: 1 jaar met uitzicht op vast dienstverband
Reageren vóór: 30 november

"Sterk In verbinding, Helder in communicatie. Kracht in de uitvoering.”

Draag bij aan de toekomst van onze gemeente. Als Strategisch Adviseur help je bestuur en organisatie koers te bepalen op vraagstukken die Zuidplas vandaag én morgen sterker maken. Werk mee en maak het verschil!

Maak het verschil bij Zuidplas!
Werken bij gemeente Zuidplas betekent werken in een omgeving waar vertrouwen, flexibiliteit en ruimte centraal staan. In onze groeiende gemeente, met dorpen als Moerkapelle, Moordrecht, Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel en Zevenhuizen én het nieuwe Cortelande, werk je aan vraagstukken die er echt toe doen. Hier denk je groots en doe je het samen.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, initiatief te nemen en jouw ideeën tot leven te brengen.
Samen met betrokken collega’s werk je open, verbindend en met energie aan meerdere opgaven tegelijk. Dat vraagt om lef, eigenaarschap en de wil om te blijven groeien. Want hier maak jij het verschil – elke dag opnieuw.

Groots denken, samen doen! Maak er jouw werk van.

Het cluster Bestuur & Communicatie bestaat naast strategisch adviseurs uit bestuursadviseurs, communicatieadviseurs, een directiesecretaris, een adviseur Kabinetszaken, een organisatieadviseur, bestuurssecretaresses en clustersecretaresses. Het team Strategisch Advies bestaat uit drie strategisch adviseurs, die breed inzetbaar zijn en elkaar kunnen vervangen in geval van afwezigheid.

Op dit moment zijn we op zoek naar twee nieuwe collega’s voor het team Strategisch Advies.

Over de rol
Als strategisch adviseur lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van Zuidplas. Je signaleert maatschappelijke, politieke, economische en bestuurlijke ontwikkelingen en onderzoekt wat deze betekenen voor de gemeente. Als strategisch adviseur leg je de verbinding tussen visies en ambities voor de lange(re) termijn naar acties en doelstellingen op de korte(re) termijn. Je helpt bij het definiëren van nieuwe opgaven, het in beeld brengen van kansen en risico’s, en het prioriteren of faseren van projecten en werkzaamheden.

Je draagt bij aan het verhogen van het strategisch vermogen van de gemeentelijke organisatie. Je adviseert college, directie en managers over integrale keuzes en geeft richting aan de ontwikkeling van beleid over meerdere domeinen heen. Dat doe je op het snijvlak van politiek, strategie en interbestuurlijke samenwerking, waarbij je complexe maatschappelijke vraagstukken vertaalt naar een strategische koers die gemeente Zuidplas verder brengt.

Dit ga je doen
  • Je adviseert het college, de directie en managers over beleidsrichting, prioritering, risico’s en scenario’s. Je verbindt doelstellingen op de korte termijn met ambities op de lange termijn;
  • Je analyseert en interpreteert beleid vanuit Rijk, provincie en regio’s. Op basis daarvan maak je een vertaalslag naar het beleid van de gemeente;
  • Je oefent invloed uit op (beleid van) hogere overheden en bestuurlijke partners, in de vorm van lobbywerkzaamheden. Zelfstandig vanuit de gemeente Zuidplas en/of waar nodig onder de ‘lobbyvlag’ van partners (zoals de Regio Midden-Holland);
  • Je vertegenwoordigt de gemeente Zuidplas op strategisch niveau in belangrijke regionale, provinciale en landelijke netwerken. Als strategisch adviseur neem je het voortouw bij het opstellen van gespreksagenda’s, in samenwerking met andere belanghebbenden en/of betrokkenen binnen de organisatie;
  • Je doet aan proactief netwerken en draagt zorg voor relatiebeheer met bestuurlijke partners en/of belangrijke ketenpartners, waaronder de Regio Midden-Holland, de provincie Zuid-Holland en de Vereniging Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG);
  • Je vertaalt publicaties van relevante instituten (Zoals het CBS, PBL en SCP) en relevante data naar de gemeente Zuidplas en past deze toe in je advisering binnen opgaven, projecten en beleidsvelden;
  • Je adviseert opgavemanagers bij het formuleren van opgaven en het prioriteren daarbinnen (op basis van kennis, relaties, data en/of beschikbare middelen);
  • Je definieert (koppel)kansen en zet deze uit bij de verantwoordelijke (vak)collega’s. Dit kunnen beleidsinhoudelijke kansen zijn, maar ook kansen op het verwerven van middelen (zowel budget als capaciteit);
  • Waar nodig fungeer je tijdelijk als kwartiermaker voor vraagstukken die nog niet zijn belegd binnen de organisatie. Hierbij gaat het om vraagstukken met een hoge mate van bestuurlijke gevoeligheid, grote consequenties voor de gemeentelijke organisatie en een hoge mate van complexiteit.

Dit breng je mee
  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde relevante hbo-opleiding of wo-opleiding;
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring als strategisch adviseur, bestuursadviseur, directieadviseur en/of senior beleidsadviseur, binnen de overheid of publieke sector;

title: Specialist za strateško upravljanje kadrov (m/ž)
description:
Vrhunske inovacije, ki jih snujemo v skupini ETI, so ključni elementi svetovnega razvoja v zelen jutri. Postani del zgodbe o varni prihodnosti tudi ti.

ETI d.o.o., vodilno podjetje v izdelavi kvalitetnih in celovitih rešitev za zaščito električnih instalacij, vabi v svojo sredino timsko naravnano, zavzeto in ambiciozno osebo, željno novih izzivov in novih znanj.

Naredite korak naprej in sprejmite to odlično zaposlitveno priložnosti in se zaposlite v TOVARNI LETA 2021 in SUPERFINALISTU v izboru NAJBOLJŠEGA ZAPOSLOVALCA 2023.

Opis delovnega mesta

V naš tim vabimo sodelavca/-ko, ki bo kot SPECIALIST ZA STRATEŠKO UPRAVLJANJE KADROV prvenstveno opravljal/a naslednje naloge:

  • sodelovanje pri oblikovanju in izvajanju kadrovske strategije koncerna ter strateškem načrtovanju kadrovskih potreb v skladu s poslovnimi cilji,
  • načrtovanje in koordiniranje pridobivanja ključnih in strokovno zahtevnejših kadrov,
  • sodelovanje pri načrtovanju in izvajanju organizacijskih sprememb ter oblikovanju organizacijske strukture in sistemizacije delovnih mest,
  • strokovno sodelovanje pri urejanju zahtevnejših delovnih razmerij v slovenskih družbah koncerna,
  • sodelovanje pri razvoju organizacijske kulture, krepitvi vrednot,
  • sodelovanje pri izvajanju strateških kadrovskih projektov na ravni koncerna,
  • spremljanje in analiziranje ključnih kadrovskih kazalnikov ter oblikovanje predlogov ukrepov za izboljšanje kadrovske in organizacijske učinkovitosti,
  • samostojno izvajanje drugih zahtevnejših strokovnih nalog s področja upravljanja kadrov v skladu s pooblastili.

Pričakujemo

K sodelovanju vabimo odgovornega, samostojnega in sodelovalnega strokovnjaka/-injo, ki ima:

  • najmanj VI/2 stopnjo izobrazbe s področja kadrovskega menedžmenta, organizacijskih ved, psihologije, ekonomije, prava ali druge ustrezne smeri,
  • najmanj 5 let ustreznih delovnih izkušenj na kadrovskem področju, od tega vsaj 2 leti pri zahtevnejših strokovnih ali razvojnih kadrovskih nalogah,
  • razvite sposobnosti strateškega in sistemskega razmišljanja ter analitičnega pristopa k reševanju izzivov,
  • dobro poznavanje delovnopravne zakonodaje,
  • samostojnost, proaktivnost, odgovornost in usmerjenost k iskanju rešitev ter izboljšavam,
  • dobre komunikacijske in sodelovalne sposobnosti ter občutek za delo z ljudmi,
  • dobro znanje angleškega jezika.

Ponujamo

  • delo v razvojno usmerjenem mednarodnem okolju;
  • željam in ambicijam naših sodelavcev vedno prisluhnemo in v skupnem dogovoru oblikujemo njihovo razvojno pot znotraj podjetja in celotnega mednarodnega koncerna;
  • stimulativno nagrajevanje;
  • ker je življenje več kot služba, ne pozabljamo na ravnotežje med poslovnim in zasebnim življenjem;
  • nudimo uporabo počitniških kapacitet, možnost rekreacije v prostem času, možnost preventivnih zdravstvenih pregledov, organiziramo športne aktivnosti, omogočamo zdravo in uravnoteženo prehrano v lastni menzi;
  • vsem zaposlenim nudimo dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje in zavarovanje za hiter dostop do specialistov.

title: Lab Supervisor – Blood Bank
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Laboratory Supervisor to join our team at Rome Hospital in Rome, NY.


Work Schedule: 7:00am – 3:30pm with weekend rotation.


Job Responsibilities

· Supervise the day to day operations of the Blood Bank department

· Ensure laboratory tests are accurately performed and results are reported in a timely manner

· Directly supervise, train, and mentor laboratory personnel of the department

· Monitor daily workflow in the lab and schedule adequate assay coverage

· Responsible for ensuring all shifts in the department are properly staffed

· Research and resolve any production errors while escalating when necessary

· Engage in continuous process and service level improvements

· Ensure all equipment is being properly maintained through Quality Control

· Prepare and maintain Quality Assurance records and documents

· Evaluate new process improvements and make appropriate recommendations

· Meet regularly with direct reports to provide coaching and feedback for their development

· Perform bench work as needed and maintain proficiency/competency in technical operations

· Ensure all work is in accordance with state and Federal regulations

· Responsible for administering and managing policies and procedures

· Process and maintain payroll and personnel files

· Perform administrative duties as needed

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a Chemical or Biological science, Clinical Laboratory Science or Medical Technology
  • 4 or more of clinical laboratory testing experience
  • New York state Laboratory Supervisor license eligible

Preferred Qualifications

  • 6 months or more of supervising or leading a team
  • ASCP or AMT certification

Additional Job Standards

  • In lieu of education requirements listed above, non-traditional degrees with applicable science credits that meet CLIA standards may meet education requirements
  • Understanding of laboratory operations as well as policies and procedures
  • Experience working in a high volume laboratory environment
  • Strong working knowledge of CLIA, CAP and relevant state regulations
  • Ability to work independently and within a team environment
  • Proficient with computers; Familiarity with laboratory information systems
  • High level of attention to detail along with strong communication and organizational skills
  • Comfortability making decisions in a changing environment
  • Ability to handle the physical requirements of the position
  • Able to pass a standardized color blindness test
  • Flexibility to work overtime or other shifts depending on business needs
  • At Labcorp we have a passion for helping people live happy and healthy lives. Every day we provide vital information that helps our clients and patients understand their health. If you are passionate about helping people and have a drive for service, then Labcorp could be a great next career step! Join us and discover a path filled with opportunities for growth, continuous learning, professional challenges, and the chance to truly make a difference. Apply today!

title: Part Time Merchandise Manager
description:
Store - GREELEY, COThe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards. This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.
  • Execute and maintain SISO (Store-In-Stock Optimization) routines to drive in-stock levels, replenishment accuracy, and sales readiness.
  • Oversee Planogram (POG) execution, ensuring merchandising sets are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards, including initial product placement and presentation to company expectations.
  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Type of Experience Required

  • 3+ years retail leadership experience

Work Environment

  • Ability to remain standing for long periods of time
  • Ability to move throughout the store
  • Regular bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and stretching
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise and fixtures, up to 25-50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve products.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including scanning items, stocking shelves, and operating POS equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent customer interactions.
  • Work hours include nights, weekends and early mornings

Applicants in the U.S. must satisfy federal, state, and local legal requirements of the job.

$16.00 - $22.20This position may be eligible for overtime compensation in accordance with state and local laws.

title: Libraries Adviser - Multiple Locations across City
description:
Libraries Advisor
Multiple Locations across City

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850 (pro-rata for part-time)
Hours: 5.75hrs per week (Saturday Only), 52 weeks per year

We are recruiting Library Advisor staff to join our library teams in a number of library locations across the city.

Posts are Saturday only.

Our libraries are at the heart of their communities. Members of staff work with their community to help create a thriving place to live and to help reduce poverty and inequality. We support users to develop their digital skills, and we help them get the information and advice they need. Our staff encourage babies and children to develop their language and reading ability through programmes like Bookbug and Read, Write Count. We help those of all ages in the community who struggle with loneliness by providing them with a place to meet and connect. We provide a full range of books and other resources to help everyone to live, learn and work.

Young people are regular users of libraries and can range from structured activity to simply meeting up with friends. It is vital that our staff have a broad understanding of the issues faced by young people and that individually or as part of the team, you are willing to engage with and support young people and maintain a positive, safe and trusted environment. Any youth engagement experience will be welcomed.

To be a successful member of our team you must be able to show that you can deliver excellent customer service and that you can understand the needs of different parts of the community.

If you could be an effective team player in a service that puts customers first, please apply. If you are invited to interview, we will ask you your preferred hours and discuss with you the permanent and temporary positions. Whilst we recruit to teams in individual libraries, staff are expected to work in any library across the city.

title: Team Manager – Network Site Infrastructure
description:
Vi søker deg som ønsker å være med på å drifte og videreutvikle nettverkene og lokasjonene som driftes av KONGSBERG IT. Teamet har ansvar for KONGSBERGs nettverksinfrastruktur både nasjonalt og internasjonalt, og består av medarbeidere i Norge og Spania.

Som Team Manager er din viktigste oppgave å utvikle menneskene i teamet. Vi ser etter en faglig sterk leder som evner å utfordre og veilede medarbeiderne slik at de tar gode beslutninger og fortsetter å utvikle seg, både faglig og personlig. Rollen krever interesse for teknologi, softwareutvikling og utviklingsmetodikk, samt et ønske om å skape gode rammer for samarbeid og kompetanseutvikling. Teamet består av både erfarne og yngre medarbeidere, med et felles engasjement for faget og en sterk samarbeidskultur.

KONGSBERG har mange krevende leveranser som er avhengige av robuste og sikre nettverksløsninger. Nettverket skal legge til rette for effektiv utvikling og drift, uten at det går på bekostning av sikkerheten. I KONGSBERG IT får du derfor arbeide med spennende prosjekter og komplekse problemstillinger i et miljø som kontinuerlig forbedrer og videreutvikler sine løsninger.

Arbeidsoppgaver og ansvarsområder

  • Lede og utvikle medarbeidere og team
  • Ansvar for fagområdet nettverk, inkludert prosesser, metodikk og verktøy
  • Sikre stabil drift, support og videreutvikling av nettverksinfrastrukturen
  • Sikre leveranser knyttet til site-infrastruktur, etableringer og prosjekter
  • Drive forbedringsarbeid, feilretting og implementering av ny funksjonalitet
  • Representere avdelingen i relevante ledelses- og fagfora
  • Samarbeide med og støtte øvrige IT-miljøer og forretningsområder

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • Relevant erfaring og god forståelse for IT-drift og teknologiske løsninger
  • Ledererfaring, gjerne fra tekniske fagmiljøer
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter en engasjert og målrettet leder som motiveres av å utvikle medarbeidere og bygge sterke team. Du har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner, skaper tillit i organisasjonen og bygger gode relasjoner. Som person er du selvstendig, ansvarsbevisst og beslutningsdyktig, samtidig som du evner å involvere og samarbeide med andre der det er naturlig. Du arbeider strukturert og løsningsorientert, med fokus på å skape gode resultater. I tillegg er du fleksibel og omgjengelig, og trives med samarbeid på tvers av fagområder og teknologier.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss får du muligheten til å arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom mennesker og teknologi. Du blir en del av et inkluderende, sammensveiset og uformelt arbeidsmiljø med høy faglig kompetanse og en kultur der vi bygger hverandre opp og lykkes sammen. Vi tilbyr gode karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter, konkurransedyktige pensjons- og forsikringsordninger samt attraktive velferdstilbud. Som ansatt får du blant annet tilgang til eget treningssenter, innovasjonslab for ansatte, hytteutleie og flere andre gode velferdsordninger. I tillegg tilbyr vi et gunstig aksjeprogram og bonusordning.

Arbeidssted: Kongsberg og Asker i kombinasjon med hjemmekontor

Om oss:

KONGSBERG IT er en global IT-organisasjon i Kongsberg Gruppen med om lag 300 medarbeidere spredt rundt i hele verden. Vi har ansvar for å drifte, vedlikeholde og videreutvikle fellestjenester og forretningsapplikasjoner for hele Kongsberg Gruppen. Konsernet har en solid ordrereserve og er posisjonert for videre vekst i årene som kommer.
Du kan lese mer om KONGSBERG IT her: https://www.kongsberg.com/no/careers/kongsberg-it/

description:

Contour Software has grown from a dozen people to over 2,000 staff across 3 cities, in less than 14 years.

The Division:

Jonas Club Software helps clubs thrive by focusing on the creation of exceptional experiences. These experiences are delivered through industry leading services, integrated applications, innovative technology, and long-term partnerships with the clubs.

The Position
We are looking to hire a SQA Automation Analyst having hands-on experience and expertise both in manual and automation testing, to help ensure high quality and timely delivery of releases.

The successful hire will be located and work out of the Contour Software Karachi office, working as part of the resource-center team, as an extension of the division-based R&D department.


Required Qualifications & Skills

  • University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, and/or related discipline.

  • Hands-on in using Playwright for browser automation and familiarity with other testing frameworks.

title: Merchandise Manager
description:
Store - PITT-WM PENN HWY, PAThe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards. This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.
  • Execute and maintain SISO (Store-In-Stock Optimization) routines to drive in-stock levels, replenishment accuracy, and sales readiness.
  • Oversee Planogram (POG) execution, ensuring merchandising sets are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards, including initial product placement and presentation to company expectations.
  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Type of Experience Required

  • 3+ years retail leadership experience

Work Environment

  • Ability to remain standing for long periods of time
  • Ability to move throughout the store
  • Regular bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and stretching
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise and fixtures, up to 25-50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve products.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including scanning items, stocking shelves, and operating POS equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent customer interactions.
  • Work hours include nights, weekends and early mornings

title: Civieltechnisch Projectleider Infrastructuur en Gebiedsontwikkeling
description:
Civieltechnisch Projectleider Infrastructuur en Gebiedsontwikkeling
HBO/WO | € 4.520 - € 6.422 | Schaal 11 | Jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband | 36 uur

Wil je werken aan civieltechnische projecten die ertoe doen en impact maken op de buitenruimte van een gemeente die voor uitdagende veranderingen staat? Dan is dit jouw kans! Het Ingenieursbureau van de gemeente Haarlemmermeer is op zoek naar een gedreven en verbindende projectleider die hierin een voortrekkersrol wil spelen.

Als civieltechnisch projectleider kun jij het verschil maken en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de voorbereiding en realisatie van nieuwe infrastructuur en gebiedsontwikkeling. Je werkt aan projecten die het verschil maken, zoals de grootschalige gebiedsontwikkeling in Lisserbroek, de Weg om de Zuid, de herinrichting van het centrum van Hoofddorp en de uitbreiding van de infrastructuur ten behoeve van hoogwaardig openbaar vervoer. Op basis van jouw ervaring, expertise en interesse kijken wij samen met jou welke uitdagingen het beste bij jou passen.

Je hebt als projectleider in Haarlemmermeer veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt dus niet te horen hóé je het moet doen, maar waar we naartoe willen. Aan jou de taak om dat te vertalen naar je werk en samen met je team mooie stappen te zetten. Daarnaast geven wij je de ruimte voor ondernemerschap en voor je persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Bij ons gaan werkplezier, een goede sfeer en topprestaties hand in hand.

Spreekt dit je aan? Lees verder en solliciteer!

Werken als civieltechnisch projectleider bij gemeente Haarlemmermeer betekent…
  • Dat je als projectleider eindverantwoordelijk bent voor ontwikkelingen in de Haarlemmermeer. Je stuurt integrale ontwerpteams aan en begeleidt de voorbereiding, aanbesteding en uitvoeringsfase van civieltechnische projecten in de grond-, weg- en waterbouw van de openbare buitenruimte, onder andere bij grootschalige gebiedsontwikkelingen.
  • Dat je een echte teamspeler bent en begrijpt dat samenwerking de sleutel is tot de beste resultaten. Je geeft leiding aan multidisciplinaire projectteams en bent verantwoordelijk voor de samenwerking met externe ingenieursbureaus. Verschillende disciplines en expertises zorgen samen voor mooie en breed gedragen resultaten.
  • Dat je de spin in het web bent bij de afstemming tussen ontwerpers (onder andere landschap, stedenbouw, verkeer en civiel), werkvoorbereider(s), directievoerder(s), toezichthouder(s), adviseurs, interne opdrachtgevers en interne en externe stakeholders (onder andere aannemers, projectontwikkelaars en andere overheden).
  • Dat je meerdere projecten in verschillende fases tegelijkertijd leidt. Dit vraagt van jou dat je afstand kunt nemen van de inhoud en sturing geeft aan het proces en de organisatie van je projecten.
  • Dat je als projectleider oog hebt voor kennisontwikkeling, nieuwe innovaties en wensen uit participatietrajecten, en weet hoe je deze kunt inpassen in jouw civiele projecten.

Werkzaamheden
  • Functioneel en inhoudelijk aansturen van projectteamleden.
  • Afstemmen met diverse interne en externe stakeholders.
  • Bewaken van de voortgang en kwaliteit van je projecten.
  • Het laten toetsen van ontwerpen, bestekken en contractstukken op juistheid, volledigheid en uitvoerbaarheid.
  • Coördineren van technische advisering met financiële consequenties voor de opdrachtgever.
  • Het laten opstellen van programma's van eisen, plannen van aanpak, ramingen en risicoanalyses.
  • Opstellen en afstemmen van interne offertes met onze opdrachtgevers.
  • Rapporteren aan de opdrachtgever over de voortgang, het meer- en minderwerk en afwijkingen op de GROTIK-aspecten.
  • Zorgdragen voor een correcte overdracht van het project na uitvoering aan het cluster Beheer en Onderhoud.

Dit bieden wij
  • Een warm welkom, goede begeleiding en grote collegiale betrokkenheid.
  • Een salaris tussen de € 4.520,- en € 6.422,- bruto per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek.
  • Betreft functieschaal 11, inschaling afhankelijk van ervaring, kennis en kunde.
  • Een individueel keuzebudget van 17,05% van je bruto maandsalaris dat je kunt laten uitbetalen of waarmee je bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen kunt kopen.
  • Een goed pakket met secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een ABP-pensioenregeling.
  • Gemeente Haarlemmermeer biedt je ruimte om je werk en privé optimaal te combineren. Met flexibele werklocaties en oplossingen werk je net zo eenvoudig vanaf kantoor, huis of projectlocatie. Dit ondersteunen wij met een laptop en telefoon.
  • Professionele groei met onze leerportaal Bouw aan Jezelf, loopbaancoaching en Het Goede Gesprek.
  • Persoonlijke vitaliteit dankzij het MEERVitaal-programma en uiteenlopende activiteiten, zoals de maand van de vitaliteit, ondersteuning bij mantelzorg, workshops en veel meer.
  • Jonge Ambtenaren: een netwerk met en voor alle nieuwe collega’s (jong én oud).
  • We stimuleren reizen met het openbaar vervoer en de (elektrische) fiets. Reis je met het OV? Dan vergoeden we dit volledig.
    Kom je met de fiets, dan krijg je € 0,25 per kilometer. Gebruik je je eigen auto of motor, dan kun je € 0,25 per kilometer uitruilen via het IKB (bruto-netto).
    Houd er rekening mee dat de parkeergelegenheid voor eigen rekening is en afhankelijk van locatie beperkt beschikbaar.

Waar ga je werken?
Het Ingenieursbureau helpt civiel- en bouwtechnische projecten te realiseren. Zo zorgen wij voor een leefbare openbare buitenruimte. Hiervoor leveren we veel verschillende producten en werken we samen met alle clusters in het fysiek domein. We doen dit met veel passie, technische kennis en humor. Als je nu naar buiten kijkt, zie je overal om je heen de projecten waar het Ingenieursbureau aan heeft gewerkt. Denk aan parken, bruggen, wegen, stoepen, fietspaden, scholen en nog veel meer. Alle inwoners, bedrijven en bezoekers van de Haarlemmermeer maken dagelijks gebruik van onze aangelegde projecten.

Het Ingenieursbureau bestaat uit zo'n 70 collega's, inclusief een flexibele schil van inhuur. Samen voeren we in diverse projectteams de werkzaamheden uit.

Ontmoet meer collega’s. Samen zijn we meer.

Maak het verschil
Bij gemeente Haarlemmermeer zet jij je dagelijks in voor ruim 160.000 inwoners. Met jouw expertise, ambitie en energie kun je dus écht het verschil maken. Dat doe je samen met meer dan 1.400 collega’s. Bij Haarlemmermeer vind je stedelijke dynamiek én een dorps karakter. Daartussen vind je prachtige natuur, rijke historie en landbouwgrond. Dat betekent dat je in je werk in aanraking komt met allerlei onderwerpen, belangen en uitdagingen. De komende jaren blijft Haarlemmermeer sterk groeien naar 200.000 inwoners en ook onze maatschappij staat niet stil. Er is dus genoeg te doen waarbij we jouw kennis, daadkracht en visie goed kunnen gebruiken. Kom jij met ons in beweging en daag je ons uit met jouw frisse blik?

Dit zoeken we in jou
Je bent een doel- en oplossingsgerichte organisator die op zakelijke en subtiele wijze zijn projectomgeving (be)stuurt. Je schakelt soepel tussen de verschillende niveaus. Daarnaast ben je creatief, slim, enthousiast en inspirerend. Je communiceert makkelijk en duidelijk. Je zoekt snel persoonlijk contact en bent de verbindende factor. Je kunt mensen voor je winnen. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk in diverse overlegsituaties. Je bent uiteraard integer en bent een voorbeeld als het gaat om handelen naar onze kernwaarden: professioneel, waarderend en samen.

Je spreekt zowel de taal van de ontwerpers, ontwikkelaars, aannemers, inwoners als van je collega's. Je ziet mogelijkheden in plaats van belemmeringen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, contract, de realisatie en de nazorgfase van civiele projecten en de overdracht aan het cluster Beheer & Onderhoud. Je hebt duurzaamheid hoog in het vaandel staan en bent steeds op zoek naar innovaties.

Naast de eerder genoemde competenties vinden wij het volgende belangrijk:
  • Je hebt een afgeronde civieltechnische hbo- of wo-opleiding of aantoonbare ervaring op hbo-/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt minimaal 6 jaar ervaring als civieltechnisch projectleider.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met één of meerdere van de volgende typen projecten: nieuwe infrastructuur, gebiedsontwikkeling, kunstwerken of openbare verlichting/VRI.
  • Je hebt goede kennis van de UAV, UAV-GC en RAW-systematiek of een andere vorm van contractmanagement.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met projectmatig werken binnen het werkgebied waarop je solliciteert en met het aansturen van integrale projectteams.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met risicomanagement.
  • Je bent omgevingsbewust en handelt tactvol in relatie tot inwoners en het bestuur.
  • Je bent gewend om adviserend de samenwerking met het managementteam te zoeken.
  • Je hebt affiniteit met het inhoudelijk inwerken van medewerkers en het borgen van kennis.

Herken jij je hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je
Upload direct je motivatie – waarin je aangeeft wat jou inspireert in deze functie – en je cv via het sollicitatieformulier. De vacature blijft beschikbaar totdat een geschikte kandidaat gevonden is.

Meer weten over deze vacature?
Neem contact op met Sten Camps, Teammanager-IB-Team B, via 06-48331148 of sten.camps@haarlemmermeer.nl.

Voor meer informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je contact opnemen met Rolf van de Haar, Corporate Recruiter, via 023-5676273 of recruitment@haarlemmermeer.nl

Procedure
  • Deze vacature staat open totdat we de juiste collega hebben gevonden. Wacht dus niet met solliciteren tot de sluitingsdatum en schrijf ons nu je motivatie. Wij gaan dan graag met je in gesprek.
  • We reageren binnen 5 werkdagen op je reactie.

Wat verder goed is om te weten
  • Voor indiensttreding vragen wij een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG). Afhankelijk van de functie gaat het om een VOG of een VOG-P. Gemeente Haarlemmermeer bepaalt welke verklaring van toepassing is.
  • Lees hier meer over de CAO Gemeenten 2025-2027.
  • Lees hier meer over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden, opleidingsmogelijkheden, werktijden, verlof en meer.
  • Overige openstaande vacatures in het fysieke domein.

NB. Ongevraagde acquisitie door bemiddelingsbureaus stellen we niet op prijs en kan leiden tot uitsluiting bij onze andere wervingsacties. Ook het ongevraagd sturen van cv’s door bureaus aan onze medewerkers zien we als acquisitie. Deze cv’s nemen wij niet in behandeling

title: Sommerstudent 2027
description:
Hvert år tar Norconsult Norge AS imot godt over 100 studenter til sommerjobb. Som sommerstudent hos oss vil du jobbe med spennende oppgaver, fortrinnsvis i faktiske oppdrag for eksterne kunder, hvor målet er at du får brukt teorien du har lært i praksis.


Vi utlyser sommerjobb i vår avdeling for Dam og Vassdrag, ved vårt kontor i Kristiansand. Primært søker vi etter 3. og 4. års studenter.


Vi har Norges største fagmiljø knyttet til dammer- og vassdragsanlegg. Avdelingen består av over 80 medarbeidere som til daglig utfører rådgivertjenester innen betong- og fyllingsdammer, hydrologi og hydraulikk samt flomsikring. Våre kunder er i hovedsak kraftselskaper, kommuner, entreprenører og leverandører.


Dine arbeidsoppgaver kan blant annet bestå av:

  • Deltagelse på byggeplassoppfølging
  • Prosjektering og modellering i 3D
  • Beregninger og dimensjonering
  • Deltakelse på befaring av vassdragsanlegg



For oss er det viktig at du:

  • Fortrinnsvis er masterstudent på 3. eller 4. året, med relevante fagvalg (konstruksjon, geoteknikk eller vassdragsteknikk)
  • Er omgjengelig og bidrar til vårt gode sosiale miljø
  • Er engasjert og nysgjerrig
  • Er strukturert og pliktoppfyllende
  • Har gode fremstillingsevner på norsk, både skriftlig og muntlig



Som sommerstudent hos oss får du:

  • En sommerjobb hvor du vil få delta aktivt i prosjektarbeid, prosjektering og prosjektgjennomføring
  • Sterk bedriftskultur preget av uformelle kommunikasjonslinjer
  • Fadderordning, sosiale og faglige arrangementer, bedriftsidrettslag m.m.
  • Sommerstudentdag i Oslo for hele landet
  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og ansettelsesbetingelser


Innsendelse av søknad: CV, vitnemål og attester sendes via vårt elektroniske søknadsskjema på våre internettsider. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at det kun er de elektroniske søknadene som vil bli behandlet. Det anbefales å søke tidlig da søknader vil bli behandlet fortløpende.



Norconsult

Norconsult er et ledende nordisk rådgiverselskap. Vi kombinerer ingeniørfag med arkitektur og digital kompetanse, på tvers av små og store prosjekter i privat og offentlig sektor, innen infrastruktur, energi og industri, bygg, eiendom og arkitektur. Gjennom nyskaping og innovasjon, og med formålet «Hver dag forbedrer vi hverdagen», søker vi stadig etter mer bærekraftige, effektive og samfunnsnyttige løsninger. Med hovedkontor i Sandvika i Norge og om lag 7200 medarbeidere fordelt på over 140 kontorer i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Island, Polen og Finland, kombinerer vi tverrfaglig kompetanse med lokal tilstedeværelse.


For Norconsult er det en grunnleggende forutsetning at alle mennesker er likeverdige. Målet er at våre medarbeidere skal ha de samme mulighetene til å nå sitt fulle potensial uavhengig av hvem de er eller hvordan de identifiserer seg. Et bredere spekter av perspektiver hjelper oss å forstå alle deler av samfunnet, utfordrer oss i våre oppdrag og fører til en høyere grad av innovasjon. Vi ønsker derfor medarbeidere med ulik bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen.


Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. title: Director of Admissions
description:
Director of Admissions | Raleigh Oaks Behavioral Health | Garner, North Carolina

About the Job:

PURPOSE STATEMENT:

The Intake Director is responsible for managing all the different aspects of the patient assessment, referral, and admission process. Responsibilities include the development, direction, operations, financial management, and human resource development of the Admissions Department. Communicates with all other facility staff members to have a smooth admission outcome. Leads a team of professionals from multiple departments in developing and nurturing professional relationships with payers, physicians and other clinicians in acute care hospitals, community mental health centers and other organizations. Oversees and ensures implementation of updates/projects to improve quality outcomes and maintain revenue-generating strategies.

Roles and Responsibilities:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides oversight to the admission function. Provides clinical evaluations of prospective patients determining patients' appropriateness for the program and coordinates the psychiatric assessment process with the medical staff.
  • Provides additional oversight for the Call Center Team including call management, processing admission requests, verifying insurance and preauthorization needs, managing referrals, and ensuring overall compliance with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and quality standards for patient intake and admissions.
  • Identifies and prioritizes issues of importance, including those priority issues as set by leadership. Collaborates with department leaders and corporate leaders, as needed.
  • Communicates instructions, expectations and timelines clearly and concisely.
  • Leads a team of highly engaged members through hiring, orienting, performance assessment and management, motivating, training, scheduling, and coaching to meet department goals and ensure effective and efficient department operation.
  • Maintains productivity levels that are aligned with patient census, curtailing unnecessary overtime and/or excessive staff work hours.
  • Manages staff scheduling and maintains an updated plan for contingency staffing.
  • Maintains accountability expectations for self and staff in all areas of job performance.
  • Engages staff in quality and safety basics to ensure sustained, measurable compliance.
  • Identifies staff educational needs and ensures they are addressed with education programs that are attended by staff.
  • Holds staff accountable for non-compliance and patient safety concerns, as well as attendance, following policies, behavior, and adherence to code of conduct.
  • Identifies and implements proactive data-based census development strategies. Reports data related to the referral and admission process.
  • Continually assesses processes and workflows involved with pre-admission performance and maintains an intake continuous improvement plan for the department.
  • Establishes results-producing relationships with the referral community including physicians, social workers, state officials, and payers.
  • Educates team members and referral sources about company services as related to industry changes, specific clinical programs and capabilities, clinical outcomes, and appropriate patient referrals/admissions.
  • Manages the finances of the department, prepares and monitors budgets and spending to ensure department operates within allocated funds.
  • Ensures that appropriate and accurate billing information is available for all admissions and coordinates with Business Office.
  • Prepares for any surveys related to regulatory agencies (TJC, Medicare, etc.).
  • Maintains all documentation in accordance with regulatory and accrediting standards.
  • Works with Department Heads and Medical Staff to assure admissions services are effectively integrated into hospital operations.
  • Determines and implements admissions best-practices, promotes the hospital, and maintains a satisfied patient base.
  • May be required to provide onsite coverage for other programs when needed, develops, and executes new programs according to market needs and may provide training, case consultation and Administrator On Call coverage during and after program hours as needed.
  • Performs Leadership Rounds as assigned to include observation and immediate identification of environment of care, safety, and infection control concerns, as well as real time education of new facility processes.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Registered Nurse or Master’s Degree from an accredited college or university in social work, counseling, psychology, mental health, or a related clinical field required.
  • Two or more years' healthcare admissions experience required. Behavioral health field preferred.
  • Working knowledge of psychiatric diagnosis, of the Addiction & Recovery field and experience in clinical interviewing, patient assessment, treatment planning, communicating with external review organizations or comparable entities.

LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:

  • RN License or LCSW, LMHC or LPC, or other behavioral health license as required by the state for this position.
  • CPR and de-escalation and restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
  • First aid may be required based on state or facility requirements.

WORK LOCATION:

This position is onsite at the facility and is not a remote position.

SUPERVISORY REQUIREMENTS:

One or more years proven supervisory/management experience required, preferably in Admissions.

description:
If asked to describe the culture at Metropolitan Family Services, we could do that in one word. COMMUNITY! Both our internal culture as well as through the services we provide, community is at the heart of all we do.
