MFS is currently looking to fill a new full-time role, Crisis Responder! Within our Crisis Prevention Response Unit (CPRU) team!

The pay for this position will fall in the range of $27.18 per hour . Where candidates fall in this range will be based on skill and experience level. This is an hourly position that will require you to clock in / out.

Shift & Availability Requirement

This position requires employees to be comfortable riding trains and working on train platforms as part of their regular job duties.

Candidates must have open availability for BOTH shifts below and be able to work the full shift based on operational needs:

  • Shift 1: 11:30 AM – 7:30 PM
  • Shift 2: 7:00 PM – 3:00 AM

You must be available to work either shift as needed. If you are unable to work either of these shifts, you will not be considered for employment.

This requirement will remain in place after hire and will not change. If you are hired and later become unavailable to work either shift, it will result in termination of employment.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Respond rapidly to crisis situations to de-escalate.
  • Mediate disputes to prevent escalation into violence during large gatherings, civil unrest, and mass shootings.
  • Mediate conflicts, de-escalate tense situations, and build trust with diverse individuals and groups including at-risk youth and gang members.
  • Maintain situational awareness while working in confined, fast-paced environments with continuous public activity.
  • Work collaboratively with local businesses, residents, and organizations to promote safety.
  • Coordinate with public safety personnel, emergency responders, and community partners to ensure appropriate interventions.
  • Identify and monitor potential conflicts and individuals/groups at elevated risk of violence.
  • Connect community members to supportive services such as mental health care, housing, employment, or social services.
  • Provide follow-up after crises to support healing and reduce the likelihood of retaliation or recurrence.
  • Participate in team meetings, case reviews, and debriefings to share insights and improve practice.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, interventions, and referrals while respecting confidentiality.
  • Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent education, required.
  • 1+ years of relative experience including (but not limited to): crisis intervention, verbal de-escalation, clinical work in a mental health setting, required.
  • Experience in community outreach, violence prevention, youth development, social services, crisis intervention, or restorative justice programs.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Training or certification in mediation, de-escalation, or crisis response, preferred.
  • Bilingual or multilingual abilities, particularly in Spanish or other languages common in the community, preferred.
  • Lived experience with challenges related to violence, justice system involvement, or trauma, with the ability to serve as a positive role model.
  • Knowledge of local resources such as housing, employment, mental health, and social services.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Satisfactorily pass all screenings and criminal background checks.
  • No pending criminal cases or prior convictions for sexual assault, child abuse or domestic violence

This position requires employees to be comfortable riding trains and working on train platforms as part of their regular job duties. Candidates must have open availability for either of the following shifts and be able to work the full shift based on operational needs:

  • Shift 1: 11:30am – 7:30 PM
  • Shift 2: 7:00 PM – 3:00 AM

Open availability for BOTH of these shifts and the ability to ride trains and work on train platforms are required. IF YOU ARE UNABLE TO WORK BOTH SHIFT TIMES, YOU WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR THE ROLE.

    • Strong conflict mediation and negotiation skills.
    • Basic data entry and documentation skills.
    • Understanding of community violence dynamics and factors contributing to conflict in urban environments.
    • Awareness of local community resources, social services, and support networks.
    • Familiarity with public safety systems, restorative justice approaches, and community engagement best practices.
    • Effective verbal and nonverbal communication, including active listening and empathy.
    • Ability to respond calmly and strategically in high-stress or crisis situations.
    • Relationship-building and trust development with diverse populations.
    • Documentation and basic reporting skills to accurately record incidents and interventions.
    • Problem-solving, situational assessment, and decision-making in dynamic environments.
    • Remain composed and professional in volatile or high-pressure situations.
    • Work independently and as part of a team while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
    • Maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive information.
    • Willingness to work flexible on-call schedules, including evenings, overnight and weekends.

The employee is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing and viewing a computer terminal.

Job Description:

Adviseur re-integratie & verzuim

Venlo & Roermond

Als Adviseur Re-integratie en Verzuim lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan het terugdringen van verzuim en het vergroten van de inzetbaarheid van UPS’ers. Je adviseert leidinggevenden en managers rondom verzuimdossiers en begeleidt casemanagers om de kwaliteit en effectiviteit van re-integratie trajecten te waarborgen.

Dit ga je doen

Als adviseur re-integratie en verzuim focus je je op een duurzame inzetbaarheid van alle UPS medewerkers. Je ontwikkelt strategieën en actieplannen om UPS’ers zo goed mogelijk te begeleiden, maar houdt hierbij ook bedrijfsbelangen in de gaten. Samen met casemanagers, medewerkers en andere stakeholder werk je aan effectieve re-integratieplannen en re-integratieprocessen. Daarbij volg je de richtlijnen volgens de Wet verbetering poortwachter en deel je kennis met casemanager over eventuele ontwikkelingen rondom deze wetgeving. Tevens ondersteun je medewerkers en casemanagers op het gebied van vitaliteit & verzuim gerelateerde onderwerpen en initieer en stimuleer je initiatieven om verzuim te voorkomen. Je identificeert trends en valkuilen om nieuwe adviezen om de duurzame inzetbaarheid van medewerkers te verhogen. Werken bij UPS betekent hard werken. Je hebt een volle agenda, maar je haalt veel energie uit het dagelijkse contact met kandidaten en je collega’s.

Dit breng je mee

  • Je hebt een hbo- of wo-studie afgerond in de richting van Human Resource Management.
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar HR-werkervaring of werkervaring een vergelijkbare rol als bijvoorbeeld casemanager.
  • Je hebt kennis van persoonlijke ontwikkeling, arbeidsrecht en de Wet verbetering poortwachter.
  • Je hebt kennis van MS Office en HR/salaris software.
  • Je hebt zakelijk inzicht, bent integer, nauwkeurig en een echte teamspeler.
  • Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands én Engels.

En dit pakket krijg je van ons

  • Een goed startsalaris tussen € 3200 - € 4500;
  • 29 vakantiedagen o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding, bedrijfspensioenregeling, collectieve zorgverzekering, telefoon/laptop (indien nodig), fietsplan en korting op je sportschoolabonnement;
  • Mogelijkheid om enkele dagen thuis te werken in overleg;
  • Professionele trainingen die je helpen nóg beter te worden in je vak;
  • Goede doorgroeimogelijkheden. Dankzij onze ‘promote-from-within’-cultuur vind je altijd nieuwe, uitdagende kansen op verschillende functieniveaus.

Over UPS
Natuurlijk heb je onze bruine bestelbussen weleens zien rijden, maar wist je ook dat UPS een toonaangevende leverancier is van gespecialiseerde transport- en logistieke diensten (UPS Supply Chain Solutions)? Sinds de oprichting in 1907 zijn we uitgegroeid tot een miljardenbedrijf en actief in meer dan 200 landen en gebieden wereldwijd. Wat dit voor jou betekent? Mogelijkheden waarvan je nooit had durven dromen. Ontdek hoe Future You zich bij UPS kan ontwikkelen!

Bij UPS behandelen we mensen eerlijk. We werven, selecteren, trainen, promoveren en compenseren op basis van verdienste, ervaring en andere werk gerelateerde criteria. We discrimineren niet op basis van leeftijd, afkomst, religie, (psychologisch) geslacht, beperking of seksuele geaardheid.

title: Full-Time Client Service Representative
description:
VCA Durant Road Animal Hospital & Pet Resort – Raleigh, NC

At VCA Durant Road Animal Hospital & Pet Resort, we believe exceptional pet care starts with exceptional people. We are looking for a friendly, energetic, and compassionate Client Service Representative (CSR) who enjoys building relationships with clients, loves animals, and thrives in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Our CSRs are often the first and last impression clients have of our hospital. They play a vital role in creating a welcoming experience while helping our medical team and Pet Resort operate efficiently every day.

Why Join Our Team?

We are an AAHA-accredited small animal hospital located in North Raleigh with two veterinarians and a full-service Pet Resort offering boarding, daycare, grooming, and spa services for our canine and feline guests.

At Durant Road, teamwork is one of our greatest strengths. We are looking for someone who will be cross-trained throughout the hospital, giving you the opportunity to learn and grow beyond the front desk. In addition to client service responsibilities, you'll gain experience supporting our medical team and Pet Resort, creating a dynamic work environment where you can branch out and learn new skills and become an essential part of our hospital.

What You'll Do

As a Client Service Representative, you will:

  • Welcome clients and their pets with warmth and professionalism.

  • Answer multi-line phones and provide outstanding customer service.

  • Schedule and confirm medical appointments, surgeries, boarding reservations, grooming appointments, and daycare visits.

  • Escort clients and pets to exam rooms after obtaining an accurate weight.

  • Process payments and confidently discuss estimates, invoices, and payment options.

  • Educate clients on hospital services offered, our wellness program, preventive care, our online pharmacy for prescriptions, and products available for purchase.

  • Manage medical records, digital correspondence, prescription requests, and client communications.

  • Make outbound follow-up calls and assist with client retention and new client outreach.

  • Coordinate the check-in and check-out process for boarding, daycare, and grooming guests.

  • Help maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming hospital environment, both inside and outside the facility.

  • Work collaboratively with our veterinary team and Pet Resort staff to provide exceptional care and customer service.

Schedule

Our hospital hours are:

  • Monday - Friday: 7:30 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Saturday: 7:30 AM – 2:00 PM

  • Sunday: Pet Resort boarding pick-up only from 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM (handled by our Pet Resort team)

We are seeking a full-time team member who enjoys a 4-day workweek (7:30 AM – 6:00 PM) with a rotating Saturday schedule, providing an excellent work-life balance.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Friendly, positive, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

  • Passionate about animals and their care.

  • Organized with strong attention to detail.

  • Comfortable multitasking in a busy environment.

  • A dependable team player with excellent communication skills.

  • Willing to learn and grow through cross-training opportunities.

Customer service, veterinary, animal care, boarding, or pet resort experience is preferred, but we are happy to train the right candidate who brings a great attitude and a willingness to learn.

Compensation

Starting pay begins at $16.00/hour and is based on experience.

VCA Total Rewards Benefits

We offer competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid parental leave

  • 401(k)

  • Free mental health resources and wellness subscriptions (Headspace and Lyra)

  • Referral bonuses

  • Infertility benefits

  • Employer-paid life, long- and short-term disability insurance

  • Generous hospital discounts and product discounts

  • Career development programs

  • Veterinary Technician education tuition support and scholarships

  • A supportive, collaborative team culture

  • Growth & leadership opportunities

  • Access to veterinary educational platforms

title: retail PT merchandise Manager
description:
Store - Bangor, METhe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards. This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.
  • Execute and maintain SISO (Store-In-Stock Optimization) routines to drive in-stock levels, replenishment accuracy, and sales readiness.
  • Oversee Planogram (POG) execution, ensuring merchandising sets are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards, including initial product placement and presentation to company expectations.
  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Type of Experience Required

  • 3+ years retail leadership experience

Work Environment

  • Ability to remain standing for long periods of time
  • Ability to move throughout the store
  • Regular bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and stretching
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise and fixtures, up to 25-50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve products.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including scanning items, stocking shelves, and operating POS equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent customer interactions.
  • Work hours include nights, weekends and early mornings

Applicants in the U.S. must satisfy federal, state, and local legal requirements of the job.

Total Base Pay Range for this Position:

$16.00 - $22.20This position may be eligible for overtime compensation in accordance with state and local laws.

title: Account Strategist
description:
What You'll Do:

As an Account Strategist at Criteo, you will play a key role in driving measurable growth and strategic success for our top advertisers and agency partners.
You’ll own the end-to-end relationship for a portfolio of clients — from performance optimization to long-term strategic planning — while collaborating closely with Account Executives, cross-functional experts, and your Team Manager.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with consultative partnership skills anda passion for delivering client impact in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


• Manage a portfolio of advertisers and agency partners, ensuring campaign success, retention, and long-term growth.
• Develop and execute strategic business plans in partnership with Agency managers to drive incremental budgets, upsell new solutions, and strengthen account health.
• Serve as a trusted consultant to clients on digital strategy, advising on how to leverage Criteo’s technology and products to achieve business goals.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Data Analysis, Product, Technical Solutions, Ad Ops, and Marketing to deliver scalable growth and operational excellence.
• Analyze performance data and KPIs to identify actionable insights and customized optimization strategies at the account level.
• Proactively identify opportunities for account expansion, performance improvement, and adoption of new Criteo products or features.
• Support the development and rollout of best practices and new processes to enhance Criteo’s service and operational efficiency.
• Create tailored proposals and deliver impactful presentations to clients during regular business reviews.
• Contribute to internal initiatives that strengthen account management excellence, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams.
• Act as the voice of your clients internally, providing feedback that influences product innovation and service enhancement

Who You Are:

• 4 to 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Media Planning, or Performance Marketing within the AdTech or Digital Media industry.
• Experience with Commerce or Brand verticals, or within agencies, is highly preferred.
• Proven success in managing complex client portfolios and delivering measurable business results through data-driven strategy and consultative partnership.
• Strong understanding of digital advertising operations, campaign optimization, and sales strategy, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
• Highly collaborative, proactive, and solution-oriented — you thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace challenges, and take ownership to drive impact.
• Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently with both agency partners and clients at all levels.
• Analytical and detail-oriented, comfortable working with performance metrics and using data to tell a compelling story.
• Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to share knowledge, support peers, and contribute to collective success.
• BA/BS university degree
• Native in Korean, Business English

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!​

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.
📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.
💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.
🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.
💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

title: Client Development Coordinator, Energy
description:
ABOUT BAKER BOTTS

Baker Botts is a leading international law firm recognized for its deep understanding of the industries it serves, particularly the energy and technology industries. With offices across major global markets, the firm delivers sophisticated legal services while cultivating a collaborative, inclusive culture where both attorneys and professional staff contribute to client success and organizational excellence.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an energy sector-focused, outgoing and engaged business development and legal marketing professional who thrives in a team environment and is committed to helping others be successful to fill the role of Coordinator of our Energy practices. The primary focus of this role will be to support energy-related marketing and strategic planning initiatives that promote market share expansion and increased revenue of the firm’s distinctive and leading energy practices across Global Projects, Corporate, Tax, Litigation, and Intellectual Property. These service areas include, but are not limited to, Oil & Gas (Upstream/Midstream/Downstream), Power & Utilities (including thermal/nuclear and renewable), Data Centers & Digital Infrastructure, Energy & Oilfield Services, LNG, Clean Fuels, Carbon Capture & Sequestration, Critical Minerals and Metals (Mining).

This Coordinator will join our high-functioning Client Development team known for their collegiality and business acumen. This is a full-time, non-exempt position with excellent benefits that will reside in our Houston office.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support the Client Development Manager with managing the firm’s portfolio of energy sub-sectors, including organizing routine cross-practice meetings, organizing meeting agenda/content, and supporting follow-up of action items.
  • Prepare business development and marketing deliverables including pitch materials, RFPs, brochures, thought leadership pieces, invitations, website content and other bespoke marketing materials.
  • Assist with the organization and logistical handling of speaking opportunities and event/conference sponsorships and act as a liaison between internal and external stakeholders, managing with minimum oversight all details through post-event wrap-up.
    • Includes liaising with external vendors (ex: branded products, printers, event coordinators) to execute marketing and event projects efficiently and on budget.
  • Coordinate internal communications related to marketing initiatives to ensure attorneys and staff are informed, engaged, and collaborating. (ex: event announcements, internal presentations, etc.).
  • Prepare survey/award submission responses and compile client references for publications such as Chambers, Legal 500 and Law 360.
  • Track transactional experience to leverage for various marketing and business development purposes.
  • Support CRM data management and list building.
  • Collaborate with attorneys and practice leaders to identify marketing opportunities that reflect the Firm’s needs and goals.
  • Maintain, update, and monitor digital marketing channels, including the firm’s internal website, event email marketing campaigns, ensuring content is engaging, accurate, and timely.
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of marketing collateral libraries (e.g., presentations, bios, practice descriptions, case studies, templates), ensuring content is current, consistently formatted, and consistent with brand standards.
  • Collaborate with competitive intelligence team on the production, analysis and dissemination of detailed client and industry research reports related to initiatives and client meetings.
  • Assist with regular reporting of ongoing transactional practice metrics and aid in budget management.
  • Support other business development initiatives and special projects as directed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business administration or a related field;
  • Interest in the energy industry;
  • Three or more years of professional experience;
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with competing demands;
  • Very strong attention to detail, organizational, and prioritization skills;
  • Strong technical proficiency in MS Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Word;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact with lawyers comfortably; possess diplomacy, enthusiasm, perseverance and a sense of humor;
  • Flexibility to work occasional overtime or travel for events/conferences.

Preferred

  • Energy sector experience and/or energy industry relationships;
  • Experience in business development/marketing for a law firm or professional services firm;
  • Competency leveraging artificial intelligence tools (e.g., CoPilot, OpenAI - ChatGPT, Anthropic – Claude, etc.);
  • Experience with CRMs and knowledge of web-based legal and business resources;
  • Experience with DataCloud, Vuture and Foundation.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

Success in this role means becoming a dependable, proactive, and detail-oriented driver of execution for the Energy Client Development team. The strongest performers will bring curiosity about the energy industry, excellent follow-through, sound judgment, and a service-oriented approach that helps lawyers and colleagues move faster, stay organized, and present the firm at its best.

Within 3 months, the Coordinator will be expected to:

  • Build a working understanding of the firm’s Energy practices, key lawyers, priority sub-sectors, and recurring Client Development workflows.
  • Become familiar with the team’s core tools, templates, collateral, CRM processes, event procedures, and internal communication channels.
  • Reliably execute assigned tasks with strong attention to detail, clear communication, and timely follow-through.
  • Begin supporting attorney-facing initiatives, including meeting preparation, event logistics, pitch materials, list building, and internal updates.
  • Demonstrate good judgment in asking questions, flagging issues early, and keeping projects organized.

Within 6 months, the Coordinator should be able to:

  • Independently manage defined workstreams, such as routine Energy sub-sector meetings, event logistics, collateral updates, award/survey submissions, CRM/list projects, and internal communications.
  • Produce polished first drafts of basic pitches, brochures, lawyer biographies, event materials, website updates, and other marketing content with limited rework.
  • Track action items, deadlines, experience updates, and follow-ups across multiple Energy initiatives with minimal prompting.
  • Develop confidence working directly with lawyers, internal teams, and vendors in a responsive and professional manner.
  • Contribute ideas to improve organization, consistency, efficiency, and quality across recurring Client Development processes.

Within 12 months, the Coordinator should be:

  • A trusted, proactive member of the Energy Client Development team who can anticipate needs and help drive projects forward.
  • Independently facilitating recurring marketing and BD processes with limited oversight, including events, collateral maintenance, CRM/list hygiene, credential tracking, and internal communications.
  • Supporting higher-value pitch, RFP, client targeting, and strategic initiative work with stronger sector fluency and commercial awareness.
  • Helping maintain an organized and reliable foundation of Energy experience, credentials, templates, mailing lists, and market-facing materials.
  • Known by lawyers and colleagues as responsive, detail-oriented, collaborative, and dependable under competing deadlines.
  • Actively identifying ways to improve how the team supports lawyers, promotes the firm’s Energy platform, and executes against business development priorities.

HOW YOU'LL WORK

Extent of Contact

  • Extensive contact with lawyers and staff in all locations at all levels.
  • High degree of contact with the Pricing, Financial Services and Knowledge Services teams.
  • Moderate degree of contact with clients.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to work at a computer for extensive periods of time.
  • Must be able to routinely lift and carry event materials and other items up to 10 pounds.
  • Must be able to function in a standard office environment.

Working Conditions and Environment

  • Work is normally performed in a typical office environment, which includes the ability to visit face-to-face and virtually with firm lawyers, staff and external contacts.
  • Position is full-time and requires a five-day work week and standard hours as outlined in the Firm policy manual.
  • Overtime will be required on occasion, including evenings and weekends, and some limited travel may be required to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • This role may be hybrid and will require a minimum of three days per week (or at least 60%) present in the office, and up to two days per week (40%) may be performed remotely.

title: Master Thesis, 30 hp: Multi-Channel IQ Data Generation with Angle of Arrival
description:
Are you a student eager to apply your theoretical knowledge and fresh perspectives to real-world challenges? At Saab, we believe that innovation thrives on new ideas, and your master thesis project could be the spark that ignites our next technological breakthrough.

Your role

We recognize the immense value that students bring to our company. Your academic rigor, combined with your enthusiasm for cutting-edge technology, allows you to approach problems with a unique and insightful lens. At Saab, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced engineers and specialists, gaining invaluable practical experience while making a tangible contribution to our growth and development.


Description of the Thesis Project
This thesis focuses on developing a simulator for generating the channel phase deltas according to the Angle of Arrival (AoA). These phase differences will then be used to generate IQ-data with AoA information by a separate component outside the scope of this thesis. The generated IQ streams will be used for test and verification of FPGA-applications.


The simulator will take a pulse descriptor word (PDW) or similar signal description as input and generate four synchronized phase delta streams corresponding to a signal arriving from the direction specified in the PDW. By adjusting the phase between the four I/Q streams relative to a receiving antenna array with fixed element spacing, a specific angle is obtained


The work will include:

  • Modelling of signals received by multiple antennas
  • Investigating the relationship between AoA and antenna-channel phase/time differences
  • Implementation of a configurable phase delta generator
  • Verification of the generated phase deltas
  • Integration with FPGA simulation and testbench environments
  • Language: VHDL, Python, C++

The thesis combines digital signal processing, mathematical modelling and software development.

Your profile

The project is suitable for one student with an interest in signal processing, radar, communications or FPGA technology. You are in the final stage of Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering or equivalent and are about to begin a 30 hp thesis project. Experience with Python, FPGA development is beneficial

We provide the support and guidance you need to translate your theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Join us and become a driving force behind Saab's technological advancements!

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. Drive engagement among residents to increase group class participation and build a 1:1 and partner training client base. Growth is fueled by your relationship-building efforts and reinforced by referrals from FOX's skilled therapy team as patients transition out of rehabilitation.

Collaborate with a therapy team

Work alongside FOX Physical and Occupational Therapists and Speech Language Pathologists at the Senior Living Community. Build trust with clinicians who refer patients to wellness, a direct pipeline that supports your schedule growth.

Educate and connect

Confidently communicate the benefits of wellness programming to residents, family members, and power-of-attorney contacts to increase participation and program awareness.

Expand your reach

Travel to patient residences for house call sessions and expand into additional communities as your territory grows.


Why Join FOX Rehabilitation?

FOX Rehabilitation is a clinician-operated practice rooted in meaningful relationships, evidence-based care, and a mission to abolish ageism. You’ll be supported by leaders who understand client and senior living community engagement, because they’ve lived it.


Why fitness specialists love working with FOX

  • Opportunities to practice in both in-home and senior living community settings
  • Potential telehealth / virtual care components that expand flexibility and access
  • Opportunity to autonomously drive growth of FOX Wellness and be the SLC’s “go to” for all things Wellness
  • A collaborative, interdisciplinary environment (PT, OT, SLP, Fitness Specialists)
  • Work within a community-based practice that supports independence, wellness, and longevity
  • A culture that invests in your growth and values provider-driven decision-making

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Exercise Science, Kinesiology, or Exercise Physiology; OR Certified Personal Trainer through a nationally accredited organization (ACSM, NSCA, NASM, ACE, ISSA preferred); OR prior fitness training experience with willingness to obtain CPT certification
  • Experience or strong interest in working with older adults in a proactive, wellness-focused setting
  • Comfortable presenting and educating residents and families on wellness program benefits
  • Ability to travel between Senior Living Communities and patient residences as needed
  • Current CPR certification
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; responsive to email, Teams, text, and phone
  • Basic computer skills for documentation and scheduling

Physical Requirements

The physical demands below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. The strength classification for this position is medium, defined as:

  • Exerting 25–50 lbs. of force occasionally (up to 1/3 of the time)
  • Exerting 10–25 lbs. of force frequently (up to 2/3 of the time)
  • Exerting up to 10 lbs. of force constantly

Additional physical requirements include:

  • Ability to perform CPR
  • Moderate to maximum assists with patient transfers and bed mobility
  • Able to reposition a bed-bound patient independently
  • Required to stoop, sit, bend, pull, climb, reach, kneel, crouch, and climb stairs
  • Stand for extended periods of time
  • Prolonged periods of intense physical exertion including running, lifting, and stretching
  • Perform repetitive movements of the upper extremities
  • Extensive walking throughout the shift
  • Fit to drive (required for House Calls setting)
  • Regularly required to talk and hear; specific vision abilities include close vision and ability to adjust focus
  • Frequently required to stand, walk, use hands to feel, and reach with hands and arms

title: Senior Environmental Advisor
description:
As the UK transitions towards a low‑carbon energy system under the Government’s Clean Power 2030 Action Plan, resilient and flexible electricity infrastructure is critical. United Infrastructure supports this transition by delivering fully integrated power infrastructure solutions across transmission and distribution networks. As an Independent Connection Provider (ICP), we deliver end-to-end design, construction, and maintenance of electrical networks up to 400kV.

What are we looking for:

As part of our services, the Power Transmission & Distribution (UIPT&D) services are seeking a Senior Environmental Adviser to support the environmental controls and mitigations in the delivery of a significant project to our client.

Based in Alness, Scotland, the project to construct and install energy transmission infrastructure covers approximately 80km of the Scottish Highlands between Loch Buidhe to Beauly. The successful candidate, as well as receiving an industry competitive benefits package will encounter and support the environmental protection and sustainability of almost every species of Scottish flora and fauna to be found across the project landscape, forests and waterways from Eagles and Osprey, Wildcat and Badgers to Greater Crested Newts, adders and Water Voles.

About the role:

Reporting to the Environmental Lead, the role forms part of the Health, Safety, Environmental, Sustainability and Quality (HSESQ) team in providing technical support and practical guidance to the project teams.

The role provides an opportunity to be involved in all aspects of the project with consideration of the environmental controls, mitigations and responsibilities in line with the legal, company, client and other stakeholder’s requirements and responsibilities.

The successful candidate will be encouraged to develop their knowledge, skills and experience within the role and will be supported in their development to achieve career growth within the project team and wider UIPT&D HSESQ team as opportunities present themselves across the UK.

Operating and administrating from the main site office in Alness, the role splits their time between the Site Office and the project worksites monitoring and advising the worksite activities and working with other environmental technical contractors to ensure the minimal impact to the environment is always at the forefront of our operations.

Other responsibilities of the role include:

  • Support the development and implementation of UIPT&G’s environmental strategy and approach to environmental management including the implementation of UIPT&D’s environmental standards.

  • Provide technical support to facilitate the Contract Environmental Management Plan to ensure that environmental aspects are appropriately identified and managed and that UIPT&G’s HSSE policy obligations are enacted.

  • Assist in the identification, understanding and communication of the legal, industry and contractual environmental obligations placed on UIPT&D and it’s contractors.

  • Assist in the development and provision of training on key environmental aspects to facilitate greater environmental awareness across the business.

  • Work with assurance teams in developing and undertaking environmental inspections and audits as required assigned to the project.

  • Provide support on a broad range of environmental management issues e.g. Peat Management, Water Management, Species protection and other Environmental constraints.

  • Provision of technical environmental advice and support to project management and workforce to ensure that environmental obligations are effectively supported as per the Contract Environmental Management Plan.

  • Assist in the reporting and investigation of environmental incidents and subsequent monitoring to ensure any trends are identified and mitigated effectively.

  • Manage the deployment and monitoring of environmental technical (Ecology and Archaeology) contractors, collating their reports and advising of changes and solutions affecting the project programme.

  • Carrying out environmental Walkovers, ensuring the environmental aspects are identified that impact the project programme and the controls and mitigations to comply with the legal, company, client and other stakeholder’s requirements and responsibilities.

  • Review RAMS and Risk Assessments with a view of environmental aspects and impacts and the suitability of controls

  • Liaise with the Environmental Lead regarding activities at the worksite and the environmental controls, issues, alerts etc.

  • Work closely with the Environmental Lead in the development, maintenance and implementation of

Qualifications:

  • Be suitably qualified in a relevant environmentally based discipline - Degree or equivalent (desirable)

  • Be experienced in a similar role on construction projects of a similar type and scale (desirable)

  • Have a minimum of 3 years as an Environmental Clark of Works (ECoW) or Environmental Adviser

  • Professional membership of environmental body (desirable)

  • An ability to collating and interpreting environmental performance data.

  • Practical environmental monitoring skills

  • Authoring environmental management processes & procedures

  • Conversant with UK/Scottish consenting and environmental legislation

  • Undertaking environmental awareness training

  • Environmental inspection and auditing

  • Driving licence

  • Excellent communication & literacy skills

  • Proficient in all aspects of MS Office

Outline of benefits:

  • Competitive Salary with regular reviews in line with the industry sector based upon knowledge, skills and experience.

  • Car/Car Allowance Based on your location, the option of a company Car or Car Allowance (£3750/year taxable) may be included

  • Holidays 34 days annual leave (including public holidays)

  • Death in Service 4 x Annual salary

  • Contributory Pension Scheme Basic level: 3% employee / 6% employer contributions

  • Access to United Infrastructure optional benefits package private medical cover, Gym discounts, cycle to work, holiday purchase, leisure and shopping discounts; all of these and more that can be adapted to suit your own lifestyle.

  • Remote Workers Provision of worker accommodation (Where vacancy allows) or support in finding accommodation, Accommodation allowance, Meals/Food allowance, living away from home allowance (Distance based)

  • Commitment to continued professional development: development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests.

  • National connections: join experts around the UK who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession.

  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business.

If all of this sounds good to you, then forward a copy of your CV to apply and start your career journey with United Infrastructure Power Transmission & Distribution.

Join us at United Infrastructure and be part of our mission to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions to the complex infrastructure needs of the UK.

title: Staff Packaging Engineer
description:

title: Client Service Representative

We are seeking an experienced Client Service Representative to join our team.
At VCA Animal Hospitals, we take our mission statement – your pet’s health is our top priority and excellent service is our goal – very seriously. With every opportunity, we aim to exceed each pet owner’s expectations.

title: Client Service Representative
description:
JOB TITLE

Client Service Representative

SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE AND FUNCTION

The Client Service Representative (CSR) serves as the primary point of contact and the welcoming face of VCA Animal Hospitals.

This role is essential in establishing and maintaining trust and confidence with clients and their pets by delivering exceptional customer service and support.

The CSR is responsible for managing front-desk operations, including greeting visitors, handling appointment scheduling, processing payments, and providing product and service information.

Additionally, the CSR supports clinical teams by managing medical records and ensuring the hospital environment is clean, safe, and inviting.

Through effective communication and organizational skills, the CSR helps facilitate smooth hospital operations and contributes to the overall mission of prioritizing pet health and client satisfaction.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

  • Client Interaction & Customer Service

    • Greet clients and their pets upon arrival, answer telephones, and direct to exam rooms.

    • Provide a welcoming, professional, and compassionate experience.

    • Address client questions and concerns promptly and courteously.

  • Appointment Scheduling & Confirmation

    • Schedule, confirm, and coordinate appointments.

    • Manage the appointment calendar to optimize workflow.

    • Place outbound calls for appointment reminders and follow-ups.

  • Financial Transactions & Fee Presentation

    • Present and explain fees for services and products.

    • Process payments, handle billing inquiries, and maintain accurate financial records.

  • Product & Service Recommendations

    • Recommend, select, and obtain products and services, including prescriptions.

    • Educate clients on available options and their benefits.

  • Medical Records & Administrative Support

    • Manage and update medical records, charts, reports, and correspondence.

    • Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of client and patient information.

  • Facility Maintenance & Cleanliness

    • Maintain a clean, safe, and inviting hospital environment (including removal of animal waste).

    • Ensure all areas (inside and outside) meet hospital standards for cleanliness and safety.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

EDUCATION

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent is required.

TYPE & YEARS OF EXPERIENCE

Required

  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a client-facing role, preferably within a veterinary, healthcare, or customer service environment.

Preferred

  • Experience handling appointment scheduling, payment processing, and customer inquiries is highly desirable.

  • Familiarity with veterinary terminology, medical records management, and prescription handling is advantageous.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently in a fast-paced setting while maintaining professionalism and empathy.

CREDENTIAL/LICENSE/CERTIFICATION

Required

  • Additional coursework or certification in customer service, veterinary assistance, or related fields is a plus.

COMPUTER PROFICIENCY

Preferred

  • Proficiency with scheduling software, point-of-sale systems, and basic computer applications (e.g., Microsoft Office).

  • Experience with veterinary practice management software (e.g., AVImark, Cornerstone) or similar platforms to streamline scheduling, billing, and record-keeping processes.

LANGUAGE PROFICIENCY

Preferred

  • Multilingual Abilities: Ability to communicate effectively in multiple languages to better serve a diverse client base and enhance client experience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with clients, colleagues, and clinical staff.

  • Attention to detail and organizational skills to maintain accurate records and support hospital operations.

  • Compassion for animals and commitment to delivering excellent client service aligned with VCA’s mission.

  • Conflict Resolution Skills: Demonstrated capability to handle difficult situations and resolve client concerns calmly and professionally, ensuring positive outcomes.

title: Sykepleier 100 % fast stilling med kreftkontakt funksjon hjemmetjenesten i Hunndalen
description:
Vi søker etter en engasjert og selvstendig sykepleier til fast stilling i hjemmetjenesten Hunndalen.

Vi holder til i Åslundmarka bo og servicesenter sentralt i Hunndalen, med kort vei til offentlig transport og gratis parkering. Vi samarbeider med øvrige virksomheter i senteret som består av bokollektiv, omsorgsboliger og dagsentre.

Om stillingen:

Som sykepleier i hjemmetjenesten får du en variert og selvstendig arbeidshverdag, hvor du får brukt hele bredden av din kompetanse. Du vil bidra til å sikre god omsorg, trygghet og oppfølging til våre brukere. 20 % av stillingen er som kreftkontakt i virksomheten, og det er satt av en fast dag i uka til dette arbeidet. Du vil være en del av kommunens nettverk med kreftkontakter som ledes av kreftsykepleier

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Helhetlig sykepleie til brukere i eget hjem.
  • Kliniske observasjoner, vurderinger, dokumentasjon og rapportering.
  • Medikamenthåndtering, injeksjoner, infusjoner og oppflging av vedtak og behandlingsplaner.
  • Forebygge forverring av tilstand, spesielt hos kronisk syke og sårbare brukere.
  • Akutt oppfølging og tiltak ved endring i brukers tilstand.
  • Samarbeide tett med sykepleiere, fastleger, spesialisthelsetjenesten og øvrig personell.
  • Bidra til et rygt og rolig miljø for brukerne.
  • Oppfølging av brukere med kreftdiagnoser.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier.
  • Førerkort klasse B.
  • Godkjent politiattest.
  • Erfaring fra hjemmetjenesten er en fordel.
  • Du er trygg, selvstendig og trives med ansvar.
  • Gode norsk kunnskaper, skriftlig og muntlig.
  • Evne til å takle varierte og uforutsette situasjoner på en rolig måte.
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter.
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med brukergruppa.
  • Ønskelig med relevant videreutdanning.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En variert og spennede arbeidshverdag.
  • God opplæring og støtte fra erfarne kollegaer.
  • Et trivelig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.
  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling.
  • Gode pensjons-,bank- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP.
  • Turnus med arbeid hver 3. helg.

Unntatt offentlighet må begrunnes:

Gjøvik kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet, jfr. offentleglova § 11.

Dette betyr at alle søkere oppføres på offentlig søkerliste. Det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak jfr. offentleglova § 25.

Søknad:

Alle søknader skal sendes elektronisk via vårt søkesystem.

Vi ønsker et mangfoldig arbeidsmiljø og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, etnisk bakgrunn, religion, funksjonsevne og alder.

title: Hospital Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Veterinary Client Service professional to join our leadership team as Hospital Manager.
The role demands a leader with the interpersonal and organizational skills to continue achieving our goals of delivering excellent patient care and customer service to both our clients and referring veterinarians.

The successful candidate will have experience in Human Resource and personnel management, Marketing, and Business development. Your strong financial and operational acumen will be put to good use!

The Hospital Manager—under the guidance of the Regional Management team and in partnership with the Medical Director—performs a wide range of administrative activities related to the practice. This includes: mentoring the staff and overseeing the business operations and maintenance of the facility; ensuring the business growth and profitability of the practice; and supporting the hospital’s mission of delivering high quality patient care and exceptional client service.


Skills and Qualifications
• 2 to 3 years of customer service and financial budget management experience.
• Knowledge of sales and marketing techniques.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially to a diverse range of audiences and settings.
• The ability to make decisions, delegate responsibility and achieve results with hospital team members.
• Professional comportment and appearance, with excellent interpersonal skills and a friendly, positive attitude.
• Respect for and willingness to work with clients and their pets.
• Must be able to handle multiple tasks and deal with an environment of changing priorities.

Job Responsibilities
• Direct and develop the veterinary, technical and administrative staff towards the goal of quality patient care and excellent client service; assist in the formulation of objectives and policies to ensure efficient and profitable hospital operations.
• Oversee the hiring, reviewing, disciplining and terminating of professional staff, in accordance with and with the approval of the Regional Management team.
• Review the P&L Report monthly and partner with the Hospital Medical Director to increase revenue and limit expenses; work with home office to prepare and submit the yearly budget (budget forecast, operating plan, cap-ex expenditures) and participate in the evaluation process with Regional Management team.
• Model an “owner” mentality in hospital by demonstrating a willingness to assist all employees in making the practice a success; invest the necessary amount of time to accomplish the required responsibilities and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital.
• Minimizing patient stress and discomfort; recommend referral to another VCA doctor or specialist when this is likely to significantly improve the prognosis.
• Maintain client/patient medical/surgical records and make certain all necessary logs are kept up-to-date through established protocols; assist colleagues in follow-up and future management of the patient.
• Supervise the administration and case review of client medical complaints.
• Positively represent the hospital and VCA in the professional community and to the general public.

description:

Arbeidsoppgåver
Stillinga krev god digital kompetanse og evne til å utvikle og vedlikehalde gode administrasjonsrutinar.
Arbeidsoppgåvene er knytt til sakshandsaming i datasystem for sak og arkiv, bruk av ulike dataprogram for elevregistrering, ansvar for innkjøp, utleige, lønsregistrering, betening av sentralbord og førefallande kontorarbeid.
Stillinga vil og innebere aktiv deltaking i vedlikehald av HMS-system. Kjennskap til budsjett og rekneskap er ein fordel.

I tråd med opplæringslova stiller vi krav om tilfredsstillande politiattest av den som får tilbod om stillinga.

Vi tilbyr
Faglege og personlege utfordringar i eit godt og inspirerande arbeidsmiljø.
Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar og løn etter avtale.

Bjørnafjorden kommune er ein arbeidsplass som verdset likestilling og mangfald, der alle tilsette forpliktar seg til prinsippet om likeverd og bidreg til å skapa eit inkluderande arbeidsmiljø. Vi ønskjer eit mangfald av søkjarar og oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, etnisk bakgrunn eller livssyn.

Etter utløpet av søknadsfristen vil det bli utarbeidd ei offentleg søkjarliste. Denne vil innehalda namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og dessutan bustad- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn dersom ein søkjar ber om det, men opplysningar kan likevel bli offentleggjort i samsvar med gjeldande regelverk. Dersom ei oppmoding om unntak ikkje blir teken til følgje, vil søkjaren bli varsla.

Vi vil aldri be søkjarar om å oppgi BANK-ID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen.

title: Senior Customer Insights Partner, India & SEA
description:
What You'll Do:

We are seeking a Senior Customer Insights Partner – Lead to strengthen our South APAC Performance Solutions AX team, with a primary focus on India and Southeast Asia.
This is an individual contributor role designed for an expert analyst who also acts as a functional lead: combining advanced hands-on analytics with responsibilities in guiding best practices, driving operational excellence and representing the team on complex or cross-market initiatives.
The role is ideal for someone who enjoys deep analytical work while also stepping up as a reference point for expertise, mentorship and coordination within the team.

  • Perform advanced analysis of campaign performance, detecting root causes of issues and proposing actionable solutions.
  • Build optimisation scenarios and deliver data-driven recommendations to commercial teams and clients.
  • Partner closely with commercial and technical stakeholders to shape client strategies and long-term outcomes.
  • Understand client needs and challenges. Explored innovative and concrete ideas that address these challenges and deliver value for the future growth
  • Use SQL, Python, Tableau and AI-assisted tooling to design sophisticated analyses, automation and scalable solutions.
  • Support the Senior Manager by acting as the main contact point for complex or cross-market requests.
  • Own and oversee functional aspects of team operations such as workflow monitoring, queue management and the enforcement of best practices.
  • Represent the team in cross-functional or senior stakeholder forums, ensuring visibility and alignment.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance and knowledge-sharing to junior analysts and new members, raising the overall expertise of the team.
  • Drive local rollouts of new tools, processes, and products, adapting them to SAPAC market needs.
  • Identify product gaps and provide structured, solution-oriented feedback to product and technical teams.

This is not a people management role, but a senior expert position where you will lead through expertise, influence and ownership of functional responsibilities.

Who You Are:

  • Experience: 6-12 years in analytics, consulting or performance marketing, ideally with client-facing exposure and peer mentorship responsibilities.
  • Academic background: Bachelor’s degree or higher (Master’s degree or above preferred) in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field
  • Analytics & Technical skills: Advanced SQL and Python required; Tableau, Hadoop/Hive/Vertica are a plus.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to write code, build analysis and automate workflows is required, beyond chat and summarisation.
  • Business skills: Strong client orientation, ability to translate technical findings into business recommendations and confidence in engaging with senior stakeholders.
  • Leadership qualities: You demonstrate ownership, influence and the ability to guide others acting as a senior reference for the team and a trusted partner to the Senior Manager.
  • Personality: Independent, adaptable, collaborative, and comfortable working across diverse markets.

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!​

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.
📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.
💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.
🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.
💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

title: Senior Software Systems Engineer with Java
description:
Powering the agentic revolution in travel. Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.

We are seeking a Senior Software Systems Engineer to join our global Order Management team, where innovation knows no borders. This team delivers core transaction capabilities for the Sabre Smart Retailing Engine, powering personalized offers across the modern travel ecosystem. It engineers high-scale, low-latency and high-throughput systems that differentiate Sabre in the marketplace. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Senior Software Systems Engineer, you will design, build and deploy mission-critical microservices in a cloud-native architecture. You will refactor complex codebases, advance system stability and champion engineering excellence through collaborative, sustainable ways of working. This role requires technical rigor, sound architectural judgment and practical experience applying modern engineering practices to deliver resilient distributed solutions.


What you'll do

  • Design, build and deploy high-scale, low-latency microservices using Google Cloud Platform
  • Translate user stories into robust, production-ready code with strong automated test coverage
  • Refactor complex areas of the codebase to continuously improve maintainability and performance
  • Develop and maintain clear software technical documentation to support engineering alignment
  • Partner across Agile teams to address feedback, resolve technical blockers and deliver enhancements
  • Identify and implement engineering solutions that improve application performance, resilience and stability
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot to accelerate implementation, testing and debugging

What you'll bring

Required qualifications

  • At least 5 years of hands-on Java backend development experience, including recent production experience with Java 17 or later (familiarity with Java 21 is an advantage)
  • Strong knowledge of the Java ecosystem, Spring Boot and designing and building microservices
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, including service boundaries, asynchronous messaging, consistency, failure handling, resilience and observability
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle (SDLC), from requirements and system design through implementation, testing, code review, CI/CD, deployment and production support
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks such as JUnit 5, Mockito and AssertJ
  • Practical experience working in Agile or Lean software development teams
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools effectively for code exploration, implementation, testing, documentation and debugging, including experience introducing AI-assisted engineering practices or evaluating their delivery impact
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Polish

Preferred qualifications

  • Domain knowledge in Order Management Systems (OMS) or airline and travel operations, including orders, PNRs, payments or booking servicing
  • Experience with build and dependency management using Maven and Bazel in a monorepo setup
  • Solid experience with relational databases and distributed or NoSQL data stores, with Google Cloud Spanner being especially relevant
  • Experience designing event-driven systems using Google Cloud Pub/Sub
  • Experience building and integrating APIs, particularly gRPC with Protocol Buffers and REST with JSON
  • Experience with cloud deployments and containers, with Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes/GKE preferred
  • Experience with Terraform and cloud infrastructure
  • Familiarity with application security standards, including OAuth 2.0/JWT and Okta integration, as well as Envoy and cloud-native load balancing concepts

Work arrangements

  • Hybrid working mode; 3 chosen days from the office in a week
  • Flexible working hours: Maintain your work-life balance by adjusting your working hours to your needs

Paid time off

  • Year-End-Break: enjoy additional fully paid days off during the last week of the year
  • Paid parental leave: Take up to 12 weeks off with pay after birth or adoption of a child. Sabre Global Paid Parental Leave runs concurrently with local leave policies.
  • Paid volunteer time: take up to 4 days annually to give your time to a charitable organization of your choice

Your money

  • My Benefit platform/Multisport card: enjoy the benefit cafeteria system and use popular sport card
  • Tax deduction: take the opportunity to claim deductible costs, reducing your income tax
  • Employee Capital Plans: profit from long-term saving scheme co-financed by Sabre and the State Treasury
  • Baby Bonus: benefit from one-time allowance on childbirth or adoption
  • Say Thanks program: collect points on recognition program and transfer them to wide variety of gifts and services

Health and wellness

  • Luxmed medical coverage: take care of yourself and your family with the extensive medical package with a broad range of additional services
  • Foreign travel insurance: feel safe going abroad with free Allianz insurance offered as part of our Lux Med package
  • Employee Assistance Program: find help in free, confidential program with a certified counselor
  • Mindfulness & meditation apps: take care of your mental and physical health
  • Life insurance: sign up for free, high coverage life insurance program

Career development

  • Professional development: access to e-learning platforms as well as join Sabre live learning sessions
  • Certification and tuition reimbursement
  • Our Communities: join one of our team member groups focused on sharing knowledge and best practices (Google Developers Group, Innovation Lab Community, Women in Technology, SOLVE!T and many more)

And more

  • Car and bike parking
  • Fun & Relax zone in modern office: enjoy electronic tables to work, foosball, ping pong, pool table, swings, massage chairs and terraces to admire a panoramic view of Kraków. We have parents’ rooms as well
  • No dress code
  • Innovation Lab: access Augmented Reality & Virtual Reality equipment, Robot construction kit, 3D printers and many more
  • Attractive Referral Bonus: earn $2500 USD for every hired referral

description:
Inkoopadviseur
HBO/WO | € 4520 - €6422 | Schaal 11 | Jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband | 32-36 uur

Jouw functie
  • Zelfstandig werken in een betrokken en professioneel inkoopteam
  • Begeleiden en adviseren bij Europese aanbestedingen en inkooptrajecten
  • Uitdagingen op het snijvlak van rechtmatig, doelmatig en maatschappelijk verantwoord inkopen

Breng jouw inkoopexpertise naar de ambitieuze praktijk van gemeente Haarlemmermeer
Haarlemmermeer is een gemeente met grote ambities en een organisatie die volop in beweging is. De opgaven zijn groot en divers. We zoeken professionals die kansen zien, initiatief nemen en samen resultaten willen bereiken. Je krijgt de ruimte om mee te bouwen, processen te verbeteren en de inkoopfunctie verder te professionaliseren. Ook de projecten waaraan je werkt zijn bijzonder veelzijdig. Maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen, ruimtelijke opgaven en de aanwezigheid van Schiphol leiden tot uiteenlopende inkoopvraagstukken.

Dit ga je doen
Als inkoopadviseur adviseer je de interne klant, gevraagd en ongevraagd, over de mogelijkheden en beperkingen van inkoop. Je denkt in oplossingen. Je begeleidt inkooptrajecten waaronder Europese aanbestedingen en adviseert de vakinhoudelijke collega’s van de clusters bij hun onderhandse aanbestedingen en contractmanagement.

Daarnaast ben je als klantmanager actief betrokken bij de ontwikkelingen in een van de domeinen Fysiek, Sociaal, Dienstverlening of Bedrijfsvoering. Je zit in een vroeg stadium van het proces aan tafel, zodat je tijdig en krachtig kunt adviseren en ondersteunen. Je bent vaak met meerdere projecten en opdrachten tegelijk bezig. Voorbeelden van aanbestedingen zijn ICT, jeugdzorg, schoonmaak, inhuur, een brug of een nieuw wagenpark. Het is een afwisselende baan in een dynamische omgeving. Jouw manier van werken versterkt het team en draagt eraan bij dat inkoop positief op de kaart staat!

title: Principal Reliability Engineer
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Principal Reliability Engineer

Burlington, NC or Durham, NC



Position Overview

The Principal Reliability Engineer is the organization’s highest‑level technical authority within a defined engineering discipline. This senior individual contributor sets enterprise reliability strategy, advances asset performance, and leads high‑impact capital and infrastructure initiatives across a complex global facilities portfolio. The role ensures systems are engineered, constructed, and maintained for maximum reliability, operational efficiency, and optimized lifecycle cost while partnering with senior leadership to standardize practices and strengthen a culture of reliability across all facility types.

Job Responsibilities

Reliability Engineering & Strategy

  • Define and implement enterprise reliability strategies to improve system performance and asset lifecycle outcomes.
  • Conduct advanced failure analysis and root cause investigations; implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Establish asset reliability frameworks, maintenance strategies, and performance metrics.
  • Lead efforts to reduce downtime, improve uptime, and optimize lifecycle costs.
  • Perform audits and assessments to ensure adherence to reliability standards.

Project Engineering Leadership

  • Serve as the technical lead on engineering and capital projects from concept through commissioning.
  • Manage engineering design, installation, and project execution activities to ensure delivery on time and within budget.
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, designers, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless project delivery.
  • Support a project portfolio totaling approximately $5M–$25M annually across 100 or more projects of varying complexity.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory, safety, and engineering standards.

Engineering Standards & Governance

  • Develop, implement, and maintain global engineering design standards and procedures to ensure consistency and quality.
  • Establish and harmonize project execution standards, documentation, and processes across regions.
  • Provide technical oversight and governance for design reviews and system implementations.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to engineering practices.

Subject Matter Expertise

  • Function as the enterprise subject matter expert for a specific engineering discipline (Electrical, HVAC, Mechanical, Automation & Instrumentation).
  • Provide expert guidance on design, construction, commissioning, and operational performance.
  • Support complex troubleshooting and resolution of critical system issues.
  • Influence standards, specifications, and long‑term engineering strategy within the discipline.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Partner with senior leadership in Capital, Engineering, Construction, and Facilities to plan and execute prioritized initiatives.
  • Mentor and guide engineers and technical teams to build organizational capability.
  • Serve as a liaison between internal clients and external partners to ensure alignment and execution excellence.
  • Drive a culture of reliability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related field); 5 or more years of applicable professional engineering experience may be used in lieu of degree.
  • 10 or more years of progressive experience in project engineering, reliability engineering, or facilities engineering.
  • 5 or more years of experience leading complex, multi‑site, or high‑impact facility projects.
  • 5 or more years of experience with CMMS, predictive maintenance technologies, and reliability analytics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP).
  • Project Management Professional (PMP).
  • 5 or more years of experience in asset‑intensive or regulated environments (healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing).
  • 5 or more years of experince in facilities or engineering for commercial/Industrial HVAC/Plumbing or pipe fitting

Additional Job Standards

  • Advanced technical expertise in at least one engineering discipline (Electrical, HVAC, Mechanical, Automation & Instrumentation).
  • Strong project management and execution capabilities.
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business needs into engineering solutions.
  • Advanced analytical and critical thinking skills, including root cause analysis.
  • Ability to influence without authority and operate as a principal‑level individual contributor.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Continuous improvement and standardization mindset.
  • Up to 25% travel.
  • Comfortable working in and around vivarium's

.

title: Part-Time Administrator
description:
Part-Time Administrator

Hours: 20 hours per week, spread across 4 days (5 hours per day)
Salary: Dependent on experience
Job Type: Part-Time, Permanent
Location: Remote from South Africa

About the Role

We are recruiting on behalf of an established and growing business seeking a reliable, organised and detail-oriented Part-Time Administrator to support its day-to-day administrative activities.

This is a varied position, ideally suited to someone who enjoys keeping records organised, working with spreadsheets and ensuring information is accurate and up to date.

The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining records, monitoring expenditure, updating internal systems and highlighting any discrepancies or upcoming deadlines.

The role will initially focus on vehicle administration, fuel monitoring and general record-keeping, with additional administrative responsibilities introduced over time.

Key Responsibilities

General Administration

  • Maintaining accurate and organised records using spreadsheets and internal systems.

  • Updating information and ensuring records are kept up to date.

  • Monitoring expenditure and identifying any unusual changes or discrepancies.

  • Providing regular updates to management.

  • Assisting with additional administrative tasks as required.

Vehicle & Fuel Administration

  • Recording and monitoring weekly fuel expenditure across company vehicles.

  • Identifying unusual changes in fuel consumption and reporting these to management.

  • Adding and updating vehicle information on an internal fleet management system.

  • Monitoring upcoming MOTs, servicing, road tax, and maintenance requirements.

  • Recording vehicle repairs, maintenance work and associated costs.

  • Ensuring vehicle records are accurate and easily accessible.

Equipment & Stock Records

  • Maintaining records of equipment and protective clothing issued to employees.

  • Recording dates of issue, replacements and associated costs.

  • Keeping information organised within a central record-keeping system.

  • Assisting with monitoring equipment usage and expenditure.

About You

The ideal candidate will be an organised and dependable administrator with excellent attention to detail.

Essential Requirements

  • Previous experience in an administrative role.

  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and general computer systems.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working with figures and maintaining accurate records.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies and raise concerns when necessary.

  • Good communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage daily tasks efficiently.

  • A reliable, methodical, and proactive approach to work.

Experience in fleet administration or vehicle management would be beneficial but is not essential, as training will be provided.


Additional Information

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator looking for a consistent part-time position within an established and growing business.

The role offers a varied workload, a supportive working environment, and the opportunity to take on additional administrative duties as the position develops.

To Apply

Please submit your CV outlining your relevant administrative experience.
