Job Description

Responsibilities

Programme and delivery leadership

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Agentic AP Suite implementations across one or more enterprise clients — discovery, solution design, build and configuration, integration, testing, UAT, go-live, and hypercare — on time, within budget, and to agreed quality standards.
  • Build and maintain the integrated delivery plan, RAID log, resource plan, and financial forecast; track effort, burn, and margin against the SOW and flag variances early.
  • Run the delivery cadence: sprint planning and reviews, daily stand-ups, defect triage, release readiness and go/no-go reviews, and cutover planning with tested rollback options.
  • Manage scope and change formally — assess every change request for commercial, technical, and timeline impact, and secure client and internal approvals before committing.
  • Lead cross-functional pods spanning solution architects, AI/ML and data engineers, AP process SMEs, integration and ERP consultants, QA, security, and client-side teams; hold matrixed and vendor resources to plan without direct line authority.

Agentic AI solution delivery

  • Translate client AP process requirements into a deliverable configuration of the Agentic AP Suite — agent scope and autonomy levels, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, straight-through-processing targets, and exception routing rules.
  • Drive the accuracy and benefit case: baseline current-state AP metrics (touchless rate, cost per invoice, cycle time, first-pass match rate, exception mix), define acceptance thresholds, and evidence realised improvement at go-live and through hypercare.
  • Manage the realities of AI delivery — extraction accuracy on messy invoice populations, prompt and model iteration cycles, golden-dataset and regression testing, confidence thresholds, and fallback-to-human paths — and set honest client expectations about what agents will and will not decide autonomously.
  • Partner with Responsible AI, InfoSec, and Data Privacy to clear the solution through client and Genpact governance: data classification, PII handling, audit trail and explainability requirements, agent action logging, segregation of duties, and SOX and internal-control impact for AP approvals and payment release.

Integration and technical governance

  • Own delivery of the integration landscape connecting the suite to client systems of record — SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), Oracle, Workday, or equivalent ERPs, and P2P platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, or Basware — covering vendor master, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoice posting, payment blocks, and GL and tax determination.
  • Govern interface design and build across APIs, middleware and iPaaS, IDoc/BAPI/OData, RPA hand-offs, SFTP batch, and email and document intake channels; ensure environment strategy, connectivity, and credentials are secured ahead of build.
  • Drive master data and data-quality readiness — vendor and tax master hygiene, tolerance and approval matrices, chart-of-accounts and cost-object mapping, and historical data for model training and validation.
  • Chair technical design reviews and hold architectural decisions to a documented, testable baseline; escalate design debt rather than absorbing it silently into the plan.

Client and stakeholder management

  • Run governance forums with credible, evidence-based reporting: status, milestones, benefit tracking, risks with named owners and mitigation dates, and decisions required; escalate with a recommendation, not just a problem.
  • Manage expectations across a mixed audience of finance, operations, IT, and audit stakeholders, and keep internal Genpact leadership, practice, and account teams aligned to the same version of the truth.
  • Support pre-sales and account growth where required — delivery input to proposals and estimates, solution demonstrations, implementation roadmaps, and identification of expansion opportunities across the wider source-to-pay estate.

Quality, risk, and change

  • Implement quality control across the lifecycle — requirements traceability, peer and design reviews, and a test strategy spanning functional, integration, accuracy/model, regression, security, performance, and user acceptance testing — holding entry and exit criteria at each gate.
  • Identify, quantify, and actively work risks and issues; maintain contingency for the patterns that most often derail AP automation programmes: poor invoice image quality, unmapped exception scenarios, ERP release freezes, and slow client-side decision making.
  • Own change and incident management for the solution in transition — CAB submissions, release and deployment approvals, defect SLAs during hypercare, and a clean, documented handover to run-state support and the client’s AP operations team.
  • Drive adoption: role-based training, updated desktop procedures and control documentation, super-user enablement, and a communication plan that addresses the workforce impact of agentic automation directly and respectfully.

Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
  • Relevant years of total experience, including Relevant years managing enterprise technology or digital transformation programmes end to end as the accountable delivery lead.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering data, digital, automation, or AI projects in a client-facing capacity — not solely internal IT delivery.
  • Working knowledge of the accounts payable and invoice-to-pay process: invoice capture and intelligent document processing, PO and non-PO invoice handling, two- and three-way match, coding and approval workflow, exception and dispute management, supplier query handling, and payment run mechanics.
  • Hands-on delivery exposure to intelligent automation or AI-enabled solutions — OCR/IDP, machine learning, LLM- or agent-based automation — including how such solutions are tested, tuned, and governed in production.
  • Proven experience delivering ERP-integrated solutions, with practical familiarity with at least one major ERP (SAP ECC or S/4HANA, Oracle, Workday) and one P2P platform (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Basware, or similar), and with integration patterns including APIs, middleware/iPaaS, and batch interfaces.
  • Proficiency in Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall, and the judgement to run hybrid delivery where an agile build meets fixed client finance-calendar milestones.
  • Strong commercial and financial management: SOW and scope governance, estimation, effort and margin tracking, and change-order discipline.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, negotiation, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to raise a difficult conversation with a client early rather than late.

Preferred Qualifications / Skills

  • Project management certification — PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, Certified Scrum Master, or SAFe.
  • Prior delivery of AP automation, source-to-pay transformation, or finance shared-services and GBS technology programmes.
  • Understanding of AI governance and Responsible AI practice — model risk, explainability, accuracy and bias monitoring, audit trails for agent actions, and emerging regulatory expectations for autonomous systems.
  • Familiarity with finance control and compliance requirements affecting AP: SOX, segregation of duties, delegation of authority, indirect tax and e-invoicing mandates, and internal or external audit evidence needs.
  • Experience with project and delivery tooling — Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, Smartsheet, Confluence — and comfort building executive-grade reporting from it.
  • Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or process re-engineering methods applied to finance processes.
  • Experience in a consulting, BPO, or systems-integrator environment, and willingness to travel to client sites as delivery phases require.

title: PRN Counselor
description:
PRN Counselor | The Aviary Recovery Center | Eolia, Missouri

About the Job:

PURPOSE STATEMENT:

The Counselor One provides treatment and support to assist clients in their recovery from addictions, such as alcoholism, drug addiction, or mental health disorders, assists with modifying problem behaviors; may also provide counseling services to families of clients.

Roles and Responsibilities:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Conducts client assessments focused on identifying client history, current presentation, problem areas, ongoing clinical need for treatment and risk assessment.
  • Conducts ongoing assessments of chemical dependence services required by the treatment program.
  • Participates in and prepares client treatment planning and treatment plan progress reviews as assigned and documents as required.
  • Conducts assigned group counseling, individual or family sessions and implements evidence-supported treatment modalities as assigned and documents as required.
  • Provides client and family education relative to substance abuse/psychiatric problems.
  • Ensures all documentation regarding client care, treatment and incidents is completed timely and in a clear, concise manner.
  • Provides crisis intervention to clients, as needed, and seeks consultation as appropriate.
  • Plans for and completes required documentation of aftercare for assigned clients.
  • Acts as a liaison with insurance carriers, as requested.
  • Provides case management duties for clients, ensuring individualized quality care.
  • Conducts educational workshops both within the Hospital and in the community as required.
  • Serves as a liaison with self-help groups and EAP professionals.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Requires a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in social services, addiction, mental health or closely related health services field.
  • Degree must be from an accredited college or university.
  • Professional experience is not required, but experience in counseling field instruction/internship or similar practicum training is preferred.

LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Must have current and valid licensure or certification as a social worker, professional counselor, therapist or addiction counselor per state agency, including entry level licenses as issued by the state.
  • CPR certification and de-escalation training required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
  • First aid may be required based on state or facility.

WORK LOCATION:

This position is onsite and is not a remote position.

SUPERVISORY REQUIREMENTS:

This position is an Individual Contributor.

Why The Aviary Recovery Center?The Aviary Recovery Center offers a comprehensive benefit plan and a competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates should apply by submitting a resume. The Aviary Recovery Center is an EOE.

Veterans and military spouses are highly encouraged to apply. Summit BHC is dedicated to serving Veterans with specialized programming at our treatment centers across the country. We recognize and value the unique strengths of the military community in supporting our mission to serve those who have served.

title: Afdelingsleder til Haveafdelingen
description:
Har du en stærk plantefaglig profil og lyst til at bringe din viden i spil i en hverdag fyldt med planter, kunder og gode kolleger? Har du samtidig blik for salg, inspirerende varepræsentationer og gode kundeoplevelser? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som afdelingsleder til vores haveafdeling i Plantorama Viborg.

Som afdelingsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift af haveafdelingen, hvor din plantefaglige viden bliver en vigtig del af hverdagen. Du bliver faglig sparringspartner for dine kolleger og er med til at sikre en inspirerende og sæsonaktuel afdeling. I tæt samarbejde med centerchefen får du ansvar for afdelingens drift og udvikling, samtidig med at du bliver en del af centerets ledergruppe.

Du skaber gode kundeoplevelser

I Plantorama skal et besøg være mere end en indkøbstur. Med din viden om planter, pasning og pleje hjælper du kunderne med at finde de rette løsninger til haven og giver dem inspiration til at lykkes med deres planteprojekter.

Du bliver en del af et team med erfarne og engagerede kolleger, hvor plantefaglighed og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Sammen sørger I for, at afdelingen altid fremstår frodig, inspirerende og salgsklar, og at planterne får den rette pleje.

Din faglighed gør forskellen

Du trives med en hverdag tæt på planterne og kunderne, hvor du får mulighed for at bruge din faglighed aktivt. Sammen med dine kolleger er du med til at udvikle afdelingen og sikre, at sortiment og præsentationer følger sæsonerne og inspirerer kunderne.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Rådgive kunder med udgangspunkt i din plantefaglige viden
  • Sikre optimal plantepleje, kvalitet og præsentation af sortimentet
  • Skabe inspirerende vareoplæg og sæsonaktuelle kundeoplevelser
  • Bestille varer og sikre god vare- og lagerstyring
  • Følge afdelingens salg og nøgletal
  • Bidrage til den daglige planlægning og koordinering af afdelingens opgaver

En arbejdsplads, hvor du kan vokse

Hos os får du mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling. Vi prioriterer videreuddannelse og tilbyder blandt andet pension og sundhedsordning.

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har et solidt plantekendskab, gerne med en gartnerfaglig baggrund
  • Har erfaring fra havecenter, planteskole eller lignende
  • Brænder for at dele din viden og give kunderne kompetent rådgivning
  • Har blik for salg, varepræsentation og en inspirerende afdeling
  • Har forståelse for indkøb, vareflow og økonomi
  • Trives med ansvar og et tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger
  • Kan lide en sæsonpræget hverdag med skiftende tempo og kan arbejde i weekender

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart snarest efter aftale.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning gennem linket her på siden og lad os høre, hvem du er.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Vi jobber blant annet med beskrivelser, prosjektering og modellering av alt innen elektroinstallasjoner i bygninger, oppfølging av entreprenører, tilstandsvurderinger, teknisk prosjektledelse og ITB.   • Har erfaring med relevante prosjekteringsverktøy og BIM
  • Har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner

title: Toezichthouder Rechtmatigheid Wmo & Jeugdwet
description:
Zorggeld moet terechtkomen bij de mensen die het écht nodig hebben.
Zie jij snel wanneer cijfers, dossiers en geleverde zorg niet met elkaar kloppen?

Wat ga je doen?
Als Toezichthouder Rechtmatigheid Wmo & Jeugdwet onderzoek je signalen van zorgfraude, misbruik en oneigenlijk gebruik. Je analyseert dossiers, financiële en administratieve gegevens, voert gesprekken en brengt informatie uit verschillende bronnen samen.

Je bepaalt welke onderzoekslijn nodig is en legt je conclusies vast in heldere, juridisch houdbare rapportages. Op basis daarvan adviseer je gemeenten over passende maatregelen. Zie je terugkerende risico’s of patronen? Dan vertaal je die naar adviezen voor beleid, contractmanagement, management en bestuur.

Ook houd je je bezig met:
  • het bewaken van de kwaliteit en voortgang van toezichtonderzoeken;
  • het samenwerken met toezichthouders en collega’s uit onder andere financiën, data, beleid en contractmanagement;
  • het vertegenwoordigen van het toezicht in regionale samenwerkingen en het verder professionaliseren van het regionale toezicht.

Je krijgt ruimte om kennis te delen, initiatief te nemen en mee te denken over hoe het toezicht slimmer en effectiever kan.

Hoe ziet je werkdag eruit?
Je start bijvoorbeeld met een signaal over een zorgaanbieder die opvallend veel uren begeleiding declareert. Je bekijkt de gegevens en contractafspraken en bepaalt of verder onderzoek nodig is.

Later bespreek je met een collega-toezichthouder een onderzoek waarbij meerdere gemeenten betrokken zijn. Samen scherpen jullie de onderzoekslijn aan. ’s Middags overleg je met beleid en contractmanagement over patronen die je in onderzoeken ziet en wat deze betekenen voor beleid of contractafspraken.

Aan het einde van de dag werk je verder aan een onderzoeksrapportage. Jouw conclusies kunnen de basis vormen voor bijvoorbeeld terugvordering van zorggeld of een andere maatregel. Zo combineer je onderzoek, advies en samenwerking en zie je direct wat jouw werk in beweging kan zetten.

In welk team kom je terecht?
Je werkt bij de Regionale Backoffice Lekstroom (RBL) voor de gemeenten Houten, IJsselstein, Lopik, Nieuwegein en Vijfheerenlanden.

Je werkt samen met toezichthouders, financiële experts, data-analisten, contractmanagers en beleidsprofessionals en hoort bij het team data&bedrijfsvoering met 8 andere collega's waarvan 1 toezichthouder.

Het regionale toezicht wordt de komende jaren verder ontwikkeld. Dat geeft jou de ruimte om vanuit je eigen expertise mee te denken, initiatief te nemen en verbeteringen aan te dragen. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega’s, met korte lijnen en vertrouwen in elkaars vakmanschap.

Dit bieden we je
  • Een salaris van maximaal € 5.178,- bruto per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (schaal 9), volgens de cao Gemeenten per Januari 2027.
  • We hebben de intentie om met jou een langdurige samenwerking aan te gaan met een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
  • 17,05% Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB): voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen, een studievoorschot of maandelijkse uitbetaling.
  • Flexibel & hybride werken: in overleg met je team verdeel je je tijd slim tussen thuis en kantoor.
  • Toplocatie: Een centraal gelegen werkplek direct naast het station Houten, slechts 8 minuten met de trein vanaf Utrecht Centraal.
  • Ontwikkeling: Laptop, telefoon en volop opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Houten Academie.
  • Extra's: Vitaliteitsprogramma, leasefietsregeling en een volledige reiskostenvergoeding (NS Business Card mogelijk).
  • Goed geregeld: Betaald ouderschapsverlof en een uitstekende pensioenregeling via het ABP.


Wie ben jij?
Je bent een stevige professional die graag uitzoekt hoe iets écht zit. Je stelt kritische vragen, legt snel verbanden en onderbouwt je conclusies zorgvuldig. Daarbij kun je schakelen tussen een kritisch onderzoeksgesprek met een zorgaanbieder en een strategisch overleg met management of bestuur.

Je hebt:
  • hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in Rechten, Bestuurskunde of SJD;
  • ervaring binnen het sociaal domein;
  • kennis van de Wmo 2015 en/of Jeugdwet;
  • ervaring met onderzoek, toezicht of handhaving.

Daarnaast ben je:
  • analytisch sterk en heb je financieel inzicht;
  • helder en overtuigend in je communicatie, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • zorgvuldig en onafhankelijk, met gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen.

Je staat stevig in je schoenen, werkt graag samen en deelt je kennis met anderen.

Het is belangrijker dat je over de juiste competenties beschikt dan dat je al voldoet aan alle functie-eisen. Herken jij jezelf in de competenties die wij vragen? Dan ontvangen wij graag jouw sollicitatie!


Enthousiast geworden?
Klaar om de volgende stap in je carrière te zetten? Solliciteer eenvoudig via ons digitale formulier met jouw motivatiebrief en recent CV.

Het is mogelijk te reageren tot en met 22-11-2026.

Let op: We beoordelen kandidaten doorlopend en kunnen de vacature eerder sluiten bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met:
Judith Maljaars
Ontwikkelmanager Regionale Backoffice Lekstroom (RBL)
06-27358068

Voor vragen over werken bij gemeente Houten of de sollicitatieprocedure kun je contact opnemen met:
Wendy Werensteijn
Adviseur Arbeidsmarkt en Recruitment
werkenbij@houten.nl

Zijn we enthousiast over jouw profiel? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een eerste gesprek. De eerste gesprekken vinden plaats op 26 november en de tweede gesprekken op 27 november. Houd deze data daarom alvast vrij in je agenda. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten en beter te leren kennen.

title: Case Manager - FT
description:
Case Manager - FT | Palms Behavioral Health | Harlingen, Texas

About the Job:

PURPOSE STATEMENT:

The Case Manager supports the clinical services department by providing case management to the different units within the facility. Responsible for the overall discharge resource connection and aftercare planning needs and placement of the patient based on their individual needs and as directed by the treatment team. Maintains routine contact with referral sources and providers while maintaining resource file. Participates in quality care monitoring for the department.

Roles and Responsibilities:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Participates in the development of the service plan.
  • Implements appropriate activities and/or programs. Implements services to patients in accordance with their individualized service plan (ISP) and within the case manager’s scope of practice.
  • Collaborates with the patient and patient’s family or significant others to implement an effective aftercare service plan, explaining the available options to the team, including the advantages and disadvantages of each option.
  • Maintains the patient’s comprehensive clinical record, including documentation of activities performed as part of the service delivery process (e.g., assessments, provision of services, coordination of care, discharge planning). Coordinates releases and faxing records to providers.
  • Coordinates referrals and connections for patient with mental illness and/or substance use including accessing psychiatric services, therapy services, community-based services, employment, housing or other placement options.
  • Works collaboratively with the clinical team to engage, educate, communicate, and coordinate care with patient, their family, behavioral and general medical health care providers, community resources and others to ensure that all services prescribed in the individualized service plan (ISP) are implemented.
  • Ensures all appropriate referrals for identified services on the service plan are made and coordinated with service providers via contracted network providers or community resources.
  • Coordinates referral or completes the screening and assessment on all patients on caseload for financial entitlements (AHCCCS, SSI/SSD etc.); completes AHCCCS applications on all patients on caseload meeting criteria.
  • Assures that discharge planning begins at admission. Obtains collateral input from providers and supports.
  • Ensures the development and implementation of transition, discharge, and aftercare plans prior to discontinuation of behavioral health services.
  • Ensures all contact with referral source and/or other treatment providers is done within designated time frame and documented accordingly.
  • Makes arrangements for community resources to facilitate discharge. Provide all needed documentation to other providers to facilitate the continuum of care.
  • Employs appropriate crisis intervention techniques as needed.
  • Communicates appropriate patient information to the treatment team; participates in team discussion and evaluation of patient goals, objectives and motivations.
  • Schedules after care appointments for patients with PCPs, psychiatrists, next level therapy programs, living arrangements, etc.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a behavioral health area, marketing, business administration or related field preferred.
  • One or more years previous related experience in Behavioral Health preferred.
  • Previous experience in case management preferred.

LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and de-escalation and restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
  • First aid may be required based on state or facility requirements.

WORK LOCATION:

This position is onsite at the facility and is not a remote position.

SUPERVISORY REQUIREMENTS:

This position is an Individual Contributor.

title: Regional Quality Assurance Lead (Korea)
description:
Job Description

Agilent Korea. The statutory and operational responsibilities associated with the Korea Quality Manager role will be the primary responsibility of this position. Additional regional responsibilities may also be performed to provide oversight, processes, and tools to the operating companies and channel partners (importers, distributors, sellers/resellers, dealers, service providers, sales & marketing agents) who execute commercial quality activities for Agilent in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.

This role involves working with cross-functional teams to execute, improve, maintain and monitor these regional quality activities. The Manager will report directly to the International Quality Lead. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager for IVD medical devices in South Korea.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Overview

The Manager, Regional Quality Assurance (QA) will serve as the registered IVD Medical Device Quality Manager(품질책임자) for Agilent Korea. The statutory and operational responsibilities associated with the Korea Quality Manager(품질책임자) role will be the primary responsibility of this position. Additional regional responsibilities may also be performed to provide oversight, processes, and tools to the operating companies and channel partners (importers, distributors, sellers/resellers, dealers, service providers, sales & marketing agents) who execute commercial quality activities for Agilent in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.

This role involves working with cross-functional teams to execute, improve, maintain and monitor these regional quality activities. The Manager will report directly to the International Quality. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager(품질책임자) for IVD medical devices in South Korea.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Main Responsibilities (as South Korea Registered Medical Device and IVD Quality Manager(품질책임자))

  • Manage and strengthen governance and quality systems of Agilent Korea IVD Import License Model against the MFDS regulations. Current model: warehouse (storage) and testing (inspection/lab) activities are outsourced.
  • Responsible for key commercial quality activities: outsourced warehouse oversight, contractual agreement, testing review, product quality inspection, product release approval, inspection/audit readiness, deviation/CAPA management, and post market activities.
  • Maintain Korea QMS documentation and records: procedures, document change records, communication records, facility maintenance records, equipment maintenance/calibration/repair records, customer complaints, deviations, corrective/preventive actions, training records, test and inspection records, and product release records.
  • Perform and/or host audits and inspections, including MFDS Audits for various licenses, Warehouse Audits, and KGMP Audit on registered Agilent manufacturing sites.
  • Provide training to relevant Korea personnel on Commercial Quality requirements, procedures and responsibilities.
  • Receive the mandatory 8-hour training annually per MFDS requirement.
  • Prepare Medical Devices reports, including Import Annual Reports(의료기기 실적보고) and Pre-Import Reports (표준통관예정보고).

Additional Regional Responsibilities

  • Establish QMS processes and tools systems to ensure consistent execution of commercial quality activities across APAC region.
  • Negotiate quality agreements and/or the quality elements of contracts with the APAC operating companies and channel partners to ensure accountability.
  • Direct customer-reported quality signals and feedback related to commercial activities to the International Quality to coordinate the correct QMS processes for issue management and escalation.
  • Support regional audits/inspections, and internal reviews related to commercial quality processes.
  • Partner with regulatory and regional teams to identify quality activities performed by other functions and establish communication channels and community of practice.
  • Enable consistent quality execution across markets and commercial organizations in APAC through processes and training programs.
  • Assist in a risk-based approach for oversight of compliance and the health of the commercial quality processes.
  • Track APAC regional commercial quality issues, trends, and risks.


Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor of Science (BS or BSc) degree in Engineering, Science, Life Science, Medical, Clinical Laboratory Science, or another relevant technical discipline is required, or directly equivalent experience in Quality Assurance. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager (품질책임자) for IVD medical devices in South Korea. Eligibility must be verified before appointment.
  • Advanced degrees, including an MBA or a relevant professional certification in Quality Management, Engineering, Life Sciences, Medical Devices, or Regulatory Affairs are preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial Quality, including substantial hands-on experience in medical device or IVD Quality Assurance and import quality operations.
  • Prior experience serving as, or directly supporting, a registered Quality Manager (품질책임자) for a medical device or IVD manufacturer or importer in South Korea is strongly preferred.
  • Experienced in Regulated Product Environments, such as Medical Devices, In-Vitro Diagnostic Devices (IVDs), BioPharma, or other related Life Science industry, with medical device or IVD experience strongly preferred.
  • Experienced in conducting and/hosting audits and inspections, with strong knowledge of applicable Korean medical device and IVD requirements, KGMP, and relevant international standards and regulations, including US FDA CFRs, EU IVDR, MDSAP requirements, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 9001, and the application to establish a strong QMS.

Essential Skills

  • Professional proficiency in Korean and English, including the ability to read, interpret, and prepare regulatory and quality documentation.
  • Strong understanding of both International and APAC country-specific compliance considerations, including and not limited to South Korea, Japan, Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.
  • Experience working cross functionally with Marketing, Sales, Commercial Compliance, Legal Compliance, Field Service, Regulatory, and Quality teams.
  • Proven ability to manage risks and ensure consistency across regional organizations. Escalate issues promptly and concisely into the International Quality Lead.
  • Proven ability to take independent actions to initiate process improvement. Align actions accordingly with the International Quality.
  • Ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with stakeholders, including business group leaders and peers, in a matrixed environment.
  • Able to lead and manage the execution of processes, projects and programs within the APAC region.
  • Well-organized, able to multitask and prioritize competing tasks.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Basic AI knowledge to facilitate efficiencies in day-to-day responsibilities (e.g. custom reports/dashboards, visualizations in analytical tools, metrics and data presentation).

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

PURPOSE STATEMENT:

The Behavioral Health Associate I serves as an integral part of the multidisciplinary treatment team and is responsible for monitoring and reporting of client behaviors; providing continuous client care, supervision, interaction, and role modeling; assisting in client data collection, recording, and maintenance; and responding in crisis situations and medical emergencies as needed.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for patient correspondence related to Regen product fittings and support.

· Communicate and collaborate with Enovis’ internal order processing team to ensure timely and accurate processing.

· Provide ongoing administrative support to Territory Managers to assist with day-to-day operational needs.

· Manage and support VA submissions by preparing, tracking, and submitting required documentation.

· Collaborate closely with the regional team to streamline submission processes and meet critical deadlines.

· Conduct consistent follow-up ("chasing") on outstanding paperwork, approvals, and scheduling matters.

· Schedule patient appointments and coordinate documentation to ensure seamless service delivery.

· Maintain accurate records and logs of communications, orders, and support activities.

· Proactively identify and resolve delays or gaps in paperwork, order progression, or patient coordination.

Minimum Basic Qualifications:

· High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

· 1–3 years of experience in administrative support, healthcare coordination, customer service, or a related field.

· Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and basic data entry systems.

title: Libraries Adviser - Multiple Locations across City
description:
Libraries Advisor
Multiple Location across City

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850 (pro-rata for part-time)
Hours: 12 per week, 52 weeks

We are recruiting Library Advisor staff to join our library teams in a number of library locations across the city.

Posts are shift working and include Saturdays and evenings.

Our libraries are at the heart of their communities. Members of staff work with their community to help create a thriving place to live and to help reduce poverty and inequality. We support users to develop their digital skills, and we help them get the information and advice they need. Our staff encourage babies and children to develop their language and reading ability through programmes like Bookbug and Read, Write Count. We help those of all ages in the community who struggle with loneliness by providing them with a place to meet and connect. We provide a full range of books and other resources to help everyone to live, learn and work.

Young people are regular users of libraries and can range from structured activity to simply meeting up with friends. It is vital that our staff have a broad understanding of the issues faced by young people and that individually or as part of the team, you are willing to engage with and support young people and maintain a positive, safe and trusted environment. Any youth engagement experience will be welcomed.

To be a successful member of our team you must be able to show that you can deliver excellent customer service and that you can understand the needs of different parts of the community.

If you could be an effective team player in a service that puts customers first, please apply. If you are invited to interview, we will ask you your preferred hours and discuss with you the permanent and temporary positions. Whilst we recruit to teams in individual libraries, staff are expected to work in any library across the city.

The City of Edinburgh Council is committed to recruiting people who will deliver high quality public services to our diverse communities within the city of Edinburgh. As an equal opportunity employer, we recognise and value the benefits that a diverse workforce with different values, beliefs, experience, and backgrounds brings. We are committed to building an inclusive recruitment culture where all people feel valued, included and able to be at their best.

We would like to encourage conversations with people who have not previously thought about employment within a Local Authority. We warmly invite people to take this opportunity to demonstrate their ability regardless of age, disability, sex, gender, race, marital status, sexual orientation, religious or political beliefs.

This post is regulated work with children and/or protected adults under the Protection of Vulnerable Groups (Scotland) Act 2007. The preferred candidate will be required to join the PVG Scheme or undergo a PVG Scheme update check. Where an individual has spent a continuous period of 3 months or more out with the UK in the last 5 years, an Overseas Criminal Record Check will be required. You will be required to provide this check. An unconditional offer of employment and commencement in the post will be subject to the outcome of both these pre-employment checks being deemed satisfactory.

We're committed to creating a workplace culture where all our people feel valued, included and able to be their best at work, and we recognise the benefits that a diverse workforce with different values, beliefs, experience, and backgrounds brings to us as an organisation.

As part of our goal to improve our organisational culture and create a great place to work together for the people of Edinburgh, we want to make sure that we’re bringing the best people into our roles, not just in their skills and experience but also in their approach to work.

To help achieve this, we’re changing the way we interview and assess candidates by moving from a competency-based interview approach to a behavioural and technical (skills for the job) based approach. title: Group Vice President - Southern California
description:
Job Description

The Group Vice President leads a high-volume portfolio of over 100 units, holding significant multi-million-dollar P&L accountability. This role is pivotal in driving long-term business growth and actively developing internal talent and future leaders across the field organization.

By leading and mentoring a team of Regional Operations Directors, this executive builds the operational structure, talent pipeline, and accountability needed to deliver exceptional medical care, elevate Associate engagement, and ensure consistent business performance. A disciplined, data-informed Field Executive, they excel at translating complexity into decisive, high-impact leadership while leading with composure, sharp prioritization, and agility in a dynamic, rapidly evolving industry.

NOTE: This role requires candidates to reside in the region they support. Relocation is available.


This role owns and serves as a catalyst for:

  • Group P&L performance, strategic growth, and long-term value creation
  • Operational excellence at scale, including labor productivity and para-labor optimization
  • People-first leadership, advancing the Associate experience, open communication, and talent development
  • High-quality, compliant, and progressive veterinary medicine
  • This position requires a visionary and change-agile leader who inspires teams, drives alignment, and consistently delivers results in a complex, dynamic environment.
  • Managing a P&L of $500M+ and providing multi-site operational leadership across 100+ units in a high-volume, multi-location network.

The role supports our United in Care strategy execution at the Group level.

Essential Responsibility/Task:


Strategic Growth and Operational Strategy

  • Own Group P&L and KPI performance by driving strong execution through regional teams holding leaders accountable for operational results and using data, discipline, and decisive leadership to elevate hospital performance and deliver consistent, scalable outcomes.
  • Drive and reinforce disciplined execution of enterprise-designed programs (VCA and United in Care) by driving adoption, operational consistency, and alignment while minimizing stand-alone local solutions to ensure scalable, network-wide impact.
  • Contribute to the design and execute growth strategies to expand access to high quality veterinary medicine through the implementation of new client acquisition initiatives and client engagement resources.
  • Oversee Group financial and business performance, ensuring long-term health and sustainability of hospitals.
  • Lead capital planning, facility improvements, and marketing strategy to elevate hospital performance and brand experience.


People Leadership and Culture & Talent Strategy

  • Model VCA’s mission and The Five Principles of Mars, Inc., setting the cultural tone for the organization and fostering a purpose-driven, high-trust environment where teams thrive.
  • Leading and mentoring a team of Regional Operations Directors.
  • Foster an inclusive and collaborative environment that prioritizes psychological safety and open communication and cultivates shared accountability across teams.
  • Partner closely with Medical Operations, People & Organization, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Marketing, Facilities, and other support functions to drive alignment and unlock impact.
  • Break down silos and bring a United in Care mindset to day-to-day operations and key business initiatives improving cross-hospital collaboration.


Medical Quality

  • Model and support the Triad of Care model, work with Medical Affairs and Medical Operations leaders (Medical and Patient Care) to ensure consistent communication, effective resource use, and aligned medical training and Associate development programs across hospitals.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of exceptional medical care, client experience as measured by NPS, and operational excellence across all hospitals.
  • Partner with Medical Operations Leadership in attracting, hiring, onboarding, retaining, and developing veterinarians.
  • In coordination with Field and Hospital Leadership, develop and support new doctors and new grad onboarding, training and integration into hospitals.
  • Foster optimal doctor productivity by optimizing workflows, strengthening operational and development practices, delivering appropriate feedback, ensuring medical quality and outcomes remain reliable and consistent across hospitals.

* Fulfill other related duties as assigned*


Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree / MBA or DVM Preferred
  • 10+ Years Related Experience / 12+ Preferred

Computer Efficiency:

  • Advanced digital fluency with productivity platforms, including MS365, leveraging cloud-based tools to enhance communication, planning, and operational execution.

Other:

  • Ability to travel extensively within the assigned group/region (estimated 50–75% field travel, including overnight stays).
  • Ability to relocate for career pathing
  • Participation in relevant national or state associations


*All degrees will be deemed “or equivalent combination of education and experience” unless absolutely required to do the job (i.e., DVM degree for Veterinarian, Law degree for Attorney, etc.)


Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

  • Proven track record managing a substantial P&L of $500M+ and providing multi-site operational leadership across 100+ units in a high-volume, multi-location network.
  • Ability to coach, lead and develop leaders leading teams.
  • Strong proficiency in data and analytics platforms (Excel, Power BI), with the ability to interpret complex data sets, extract actionable insights, and drive data-informed decision-making across a multi-site organization.
  • Deep expertise in the veterinary, healthcare, pharmacy, high volume retail or related multi-site services industry.
  • Strong command of hospital operations, P&L ownership, pricing strategy, contract negotiation, revenue optimization, and labor management within multi-site healthcare or service environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt emerging technologies, enterprise systems, and AI-enabled tools to modernize workflows, strengthen decision quality, and elevate operational efficiency in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to analyze and utilize reports and data to affect changes in a hospital environment and establish ROI and KPIs in collaboration with Field and Medical Operations leaders.
  • Proven ability to integrate business discipline with medical priorities, ensuring operational decisions strengthen medical quality, efficiency, and overall hospital outcomes.
  • Skilled communicator with the ability to craft, organize, and deliver complex ideas in a clear and engaging way to audiences at all levels.

Additional candidate attributes for consideration:

  • Innovation & creativity
  • Ability to manage up and down / scale up and down
  • M&A experience a plus
  • Proven ability to lead at scale

Core Competencies:

  • Strategic Mindset
  • Global Perspective
  • Drives Vision & Purpose
  • Drives Engagement
  • Builds Networks
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Situational Adaptability
  • Managing Ambiguity
  • Leading and developing teams

Additional Information

Compensation is negotiable based on education, experience, and other relevant credentials. The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $204,000–$318,750. The position is also eligible for short-term and long-term incentive compensation.

Store - WINNIPEG-GARDEN CITY, MBThe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards.   • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.

Work Environment

title: Night Auditor
description:
Night Auditor

Our Culture:

We are a highly entrepreneurial company limited only by our imagination. Diversity and teamwork are major aspects of our culture. Our property associates are a highly team-focused group bringing out the uniqueness of each associate to provide great products and services. Success comes to those who continuously seek opportunities to learn and pass on new knowledge. We always strive to be better, never bored, and never complacent. Finally, giving back to the community is also vital to our culture. Our properties live by the philosophy that they are an important part of their communities and look for ways to partner in the local community to make a difference.

Job Description:

Night Auditor will be responsible for overseeing the auditing, posting and balancing of daily financial transactions. Specifically, you would be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards. This person must also provide innovative ways that align with our mission to be the best, most respected hotel company in America.

The job is simple:

Focus on ways to promote and engage in internal growth programs.

Continuously exemplify and live by our Culture.

Meet/exceed our company goals and three metrics.

  • Complete all required training
  • Be able to work independently and serve as key role for overnight hotel support
  • Adhere to all standard operating procedures and property specific brand standards
  • Perform any other duties as requested by management to aid in better operation of the hotel and service to the guests
  • Provide personalized, friendly service to every guest and associate
  • Balance the day’s business in a neat, orderly, and timely fashion
  • Be able to work all night, and also be available for other shifts at front desk when necessary

  • Check credit of guest accounts daily and follow up if action is required
  • Must have knowledge of surrounding area
  • Keep cash drawer secure and in balance throughout the shift
  • Sell and upsell rooms to walk-in guests and phone reservations
  • Have general knowledge of housekeeping

Necessary Skills:

  • Keep confidential the business functions of the company including, but not limited to, financial status, customer/guest information, employee issues, etc.
  • Must be responsible for safety and security of guests, fellow employees and hotel assets
  • Have knowledge of fire alarm system and evacuation procedures
  • Able to report to scheduled shifts
  • Able to communicate effectively in writing, verbally, and in person
  • Able to work a flexible schedule. We are a 24/7 business which may require work availability of nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Is organized, honest, and works well with others
  • Maintain a clean and attractive work area, uniform, and person
  • Able to work with people from diverse cultures and backgrounds Has the highest degree of integrity and is humble, living by the Golden Rule
  • Able to work with people from diverse cultures and backgrounds
  • Values of dedication, innovation, showing respect, being driven by excellence, being community-focused, and having a spirit of service.
  • Be able to bend, reach, kneel, push, and stretch and lift and/or carry up to 25 pounds
  • Can perform work for 8 hours and work in a restrictive space/environment
  • Must have eyesight enabling vision both near and far
  • Must be able to use/lift arms for up to 8 hours
  • Must be able to work over night independently
  • Must be able to handle pressure situations appropriately
  • Have finger dexterity for operating equipment such as computer PMS
  • Able to remember property computer systems to ensure customers can be checked in and out, make adjustments to reservations, review balances and other needed computer related items per brand training
  • Must speak in a clear, understandable voice, hear at a basic level, and understand English
  • Must be able to write effectively to communicate shift and guest needs

title: Part Time Merchandise Manager
description:
Store - MIA-HIALEAH, FLThe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards. This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.
  • Execute and maintain SISO (Store-In-Stock Optimization) routines to drive in-stock levels, replenishment accuracy, and sales readiness.
  • Oversee Planogram (POG) execution, ensuring merchandising sets are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards, including initial product placement and presentation to company expectations.
  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Type of Experience Required

  • 3+ years retail leadership experience

Work Environment

  • Ability to remain standing for long periods of time
  • Ability to move throughout the store
  • Regular bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and stretching
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise and fixtures, up to 25-50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve products.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including scanning items, stocking shelves, and operating POS equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent customer interactions.
  • Work hours include nights, weekends and early mornings

Applicants in the U.S. must satisfy federal, state, and local legal requirements of the job.

title: Hardware Project Manager
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Plans, prepares and coordinates tecchnical projects according to the Project Management (PM) standards defined, throughout all stages of the Q-gate process.

Business Title: Hardware Project Manager (North)

Location: Gurugram

POSITION SUMMARY and CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate and supervise site preparations and advise customers and contractors for the installation of SHS products, to ensure efficient and timely execution of installations according to technical and safety regulations and maximize customer satisfaction. Monitors project completion from initiation through delivery to meet revenue and cost projections.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Coordinate and supervise site preparations with customers, to ensure sites are contractually compliant for SHS products installations

• Provide coordination services by planning SHS activities and resources for installation of SHS products on prepared customer sites, to ensure installations can be carried out from start to end according to plans established and contracts agreed with customers

• Collect documents of Acceptance Test results, to ensure that all contractual conditions are met according to schedule for final handover of the installation project to the customers

• Establish and manage work programs for installation and upgrades of SHS products for all parties involved (SHS departments and 3rd party sub-contractors), in order to ensure that installations are completed according to specifications and schedule and that customers can sign the Acceptance Letters

• Interface externally with customers / 3rd party vendors / architects for the timely execution of projects to ensure that they can perform their work according to established installation project plans and that necessary actions are taken to resolve issues and problems

• Coordinate external contractors’ activities on installation sites (architects, rigging companies etc…), to ensure that they can perform their work according to established installation project plans and that necessary actions are taken to resolve issues and problems

• Record all information resulting from installation meetings and site inspections with customers, SHS installation engineers and external contractors, to provide all parties the necessary information to enable them to perform their activities according to established installation project plans

• Maintain tools such as MS project/taskray , SAP, Gantt charts, trip reports, check lists and escalation reports to ensure coordination work is correctly reported

• Interface internally with Installation Supervisors / sales organization / order processing / centralized services to provide them the necessary technical support on installations and optimize customer relations

• Develop and maintain close working relationships between SHS sales, order processing, installation teams and European local and regional service managers, to achieve a smooth processing of customer orders according to installation plans and provide regular reports on ongoing installation projects

• Monitor status of installation projects to provide feedback into the forecasting process

• Monitor installation process indicators and conduct debriefings, in order to track issues and take corrective actions to solve problems and ensure installations are carried out according to established installation project plans

• Perform other duties as assigned

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:

Educational requirements: Graduate from University in Civil / Structural / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronic engineering.

Number of years related experience: Minimum 5 years of project management in healthcare or in a capital equipment field.

Number of years SHS experience: Preferred

KNOWLEDGE

Project Management: Sound knowledge and professional experience of project management (planning and execution), particularly as it relates to working across functional interfaces in a capital equipment field

Information Technology: Knowledge of and professional experience with microcomputers / PC based systems

Customers: Thorough understanding of customers and their requirements

Contract Negotiations: Sound understanding and application of contract terms

Business Procedures: Thorough understanding and application of SHS business procedures

Business Strategy: Knowledge of SHS strategy and sound understanding of business goals, i.e. corporate strategy, product and market strategies

Technical expertise: Knowledge of processes and methods used in SHS product areas such as product specification, product developments / expansion.

Who we are: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

How we work: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

Data Privacy: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

Beware of Job Scams: Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

To all recruitment agencies: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

title: Hospital Reference Test Clerk
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.


Onsite Lab and Customer Support Clerk

Labcorp is seeking a Onsite Lab Support Clerk to join our team in Macon, GA


Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 9:00am – 6:00pm, and rotating Saturdays


Job Responsibilities:

  • Prepare laboratory specimens for analysis and testing
  • Communicate effectively with client office staff
  • Research, troubleshoot and resolve customer and specimen problems
  • Meet department activity and production goals
  • Data entry of patient information in an accurate and timely manner
  • Accurately identify and label specimens
  • Pack and ship specimens to proper testing facilities
  • Scrub requisitions to ensure samples are prepared and missing items are updated
  • Do spinning/freezing/splitting and other special services as needed based on client

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or GED or equivalent
  • 1 year or more experience in laboratory or accessioning or production or manufacturing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 years or more of medical or patient facing healthcare experience

Additional Job Standards:

  • Comfortable handling biological specimens
  • Ability to accurately identify specimens
  • Experience working in a team environment
  • Strong data entry and organizational skills
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Experience with MS Office
  • Able to lift up to 40lbs.
  • Able to pass a standardized color blindness test

Are you organized, accountable, and have always gone the extra mile to make sure things are done right? Imagine the impact those skills can have in ensuring the accuracy of millions of healthcare tests, every month. If you share our passion for strengthening physician care, please apply for this onsite Clerk position!


The Hospital Reference Test Clerk will be responsible for performing clinical specimen accessioning, sample sorting and data entry in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment located onsite with one of our client offices.


Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. Employees who are regularly scheduled to work a 7 on/7 off schedule are eligible to receive all the foregoing benefits except PTO or FTO. For more detailed information, please click here.


If you're looking for a career that offers opportunities for growth, continual development, professional challenge and the chance to make a real difference, apply today!

title: Software Installation Engineer
description:

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Executes the installation of a technical discipline at the installation site.

Software Installation Engineer (m/f/d)


Location: Milan area, Italy
Travel requirement: approximately 50% to 75%, primarily within Italy, with occasional travel across EMEA and Africa


Do you want to help create the future of healthcare?

We are looking for a Software Installation Engineer to join our software installation team in Northern Italy. Ideally based within easy reach of Milan, you will contribute to the installation and upgrade of oncology information systems and associated IT infrastructure at customer sites.

This opportunity may suit someone beginning their career in a high-tech cancer care environment, as well as an experienced professional looking to further develop their software installation and field service expertise.

Following comprehensive product and technical training, you will perform both on-site and remote assignments. You will work independently while having access to an experienced support network whenever technical advice or guidance is required.


Your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform remote and on-site software installation, upgrade and configuration activities for customer systems.
  • Install, test and hand over oncology information systems and associated IT equipment.
  • Conduct database tests, clinical database upgrades and application deployments for radiotherapy departments, including ARIA and Eclipse environments.
  • Update software licenses and configure the required applications.
  • Install complete IT infrastructure when required, including servers, server racks, power supplies, network switches, consoles, workstations and backup systems.
  • Prepare customer sites by supporting Active Directory and network configuration activities, either remotely or on site.
  • Work with customers to plan and execute technically complex clinical database upgrades.
  • Perform acceptance testing and support customers through the agreed clinical go-live.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues independently and involve the appropriate support teams when additional expertise is needed.
  • Adapt technical activities and priorities in response to unexpected events while protecting project deadlines and customer commitments.
  • Complete the required administrative activities, including time records, work orders, online training, technical reading, documentation updates, technical data maintenance and travel arrangements.
  • Travel primarily within Italy and, when required, to other locations across EMEA and Africa.
  • Carry out assignments that typically last between one and five days.

Your qualifications and experience

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a comparable field, or possess equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • You have practical knowledge of Intel-based computer architecture.
  • You have strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and Windows Server environments.
  • You understand relational database management systems and SQL tools, particularly in connection with Microsoft SQL Server.
  • You have solid knowledge of IT networking.
  • You are comfortable working hands-on with IT hardware, including mounting servers, network switches and backup systems in racks.
  • You can install systems from the ground up and replace standard computer components, such as hard drives and video cards.
  • You are fluent in Italian and English.
  • You are available to travel approximately 50% to 75% of your working time, primarily within Italy and occasionally across EMEA and Africa.

Preferred qualifications

  • Previous experience in software installation, field service or another customer-facing IT role.
  • Knowledge of VMware vSphere virtualization environments and their administration and management tools.
  • Knowledge of Citrix environment installation, configuration and management.
  • Proficiency in Italian and English.

Your attributes and skills

  • You work independently, take ownership of your assignments and apply a structured approach to problem-solving.
  • You are comfortable managing changing priorities and switching between remote and on-site activities.
  • You remain composed and solution-oriented when handling complex technical issues or time-sensitive customer situations.
  • You can work effectively towards demanding deadlines, including deadlines linked to clinical go-live activities.
  • You communicate clearly with customers and colleagues and provide a high standard of service.
  • You collaborate effectively with remote support teams and field-based colleagues.
  • You are flexible, hands-on and willing to contribute to both technical and practical installation activities.
  • You are motivated to learn and develop your expertise in a highly specialized healthcare technology environment.

Our team

You will join a collaborative software installation team supporting customers in Italy and other international markets. Although many assignments require independent work at customer sites, you will be supported by colleagues who can provide technical guidance and assistance when required.

Your work will help healthcare professionals use oncology information systems and related technologies in their daily clinical activities.

  • Performance Bonus: this role is eligible for a variable incentive plan linked to specific achievements.

We are deeply committed to your growth, providing continuous learning opportunities with a dedicated budget for both technical advancement and soft skills development.

title: Compensation Consultant
description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM


TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

About the Role
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Compensation Consultant to provide specialist advisory services on complex compensation matters. Serving as a trusted advisor to business leaders and HR Business Partners (HRBPs), you will translate market and internal data into actionable recommendations across an assigned sector portfolio.

In this role, you will tackle high-impact compensation challenges, including escalated employment offers, pay compression, organizational restructures, and major compensation analysis projects. While routine offer management remains with HRBPs, you will step in to lead exception pricing, job mapping, and merger and acquisition (M&A) compensation integration, ensuring all practices align with our overarching Center of Excellence (COE) policies.

Key Responsibilities

Escalated Offer Pricing & Advisory

  • Analyze and recommend complex, non-standard, or exception employment offers, including counter-offers, out-of-range placements, international transfers, and acquisition scenarios.
  • Review escalated offers from HRBPs involving compression risks, sign-on bonuses, or policy exceptions, ensuring proper documentation of offer rationales and audit trails.
  • Coordinate executive or equity-linked offer components seamlessly with the Equity Manager and Senior Director.
  • Provide data-driven guidance to HRBPs and Talent Acquisition teams by interpreting Comp AI Tool analytics and applying corporate pay philosophy.

Restructure & Organizational Change

  • Lead the compensation analysis workstream for organizational restructuring, reductions in force, realignments, and site consolidations.
  • Build comprehensive restructure cost models, including current vs. proposed pay levels, severance impact, retention risks, and market impact.
  • Present business cases and recommendations to leadership using rigorous data, scenario modeling, and risk assessments.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs and Legal on transition communications, severance packages, and compliance.

Sector-Wide Analysis & Projects

  • Execute large-scale compensation projects such as comprehensive market reviews, compression analysis, hot-skill pricing, and geographic differentials.
  • Develop ad-hoc financial and data analyses including cost-of-labor comparisons, new site modeling, budget impact, and headcount cost forecasting.
  • Support compensation readiness for new facilities by coordinating job structures, salary ranges, and offer guidelines with Program teams.
  • Participate actively in the annual compensation cycle, managing sector-specific calibration, exception processing, and manager support.

M&A Compensation Integration

  • Support compensation due diligence for acquisitions within your assigned sector, analyzing pay structures, offer practices, and competitive positioning.
  • Lead post-close harmonization efforts, including job mapping, pay alignment, and transition communications.

Stakeholder Partnership & Portfolio Management

  • Serve as the primary compensation resource for business leaders, site General Managers, and HRBPs across assigned portfolios.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships through proactive engagement and data-driven guidance.
  • Coach HRBPs on compensation best practices and optimal usage of the Comp AI Tool.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5 to 8 years of dedicated compensation experience, with a strong focus on market pricing, offer analysis, and internal consulting.
  • Proven experience pricing complex offers involving executive compensation, equity-linked components, international transfers, or acquisition scenarios.
  • Demonstrated experience in restructuring compensation analysis, including cost modeling, severance planning, and harmonization.
  • High proficiency with compensation benchmarking tools, market survey data, and advanced Excel/analytics (scenario modeling and data visualization).
  • Excellent advisory and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently influence business leaders.
  • Industry experience in Manufacturing, or Electronics.
  • Multi-country compensation experience within the Asia-Pacific market (specifically China, Hong Kong, and Malaysia).
  • Direct experience with M&A due diligence and post-merger integration.
  • Knowledge of DCAA or ITAR compensation governance frameworks.


Compensation and Benefits:

Applicants may be entitled to:

  • Mandatory Statutory Benefits according to the laws and legislation

  • Staff dormitory, Dining hall, Gym room, Company Shuttle, and other supportive facilities and services for those living on-site

  • Occupational health check-ups, Shuttle bus, Supplementary housing allowance (those not in dorms), Meal subsidy, etc.

  • Labor unions or other kinds of associations of interest, rich recreational activities such as company Annual Dinners, holiday gifts and greetings, team building, and various social activities.

  • Systematic training courses, Development projects, and Career paths

Export Statement:
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

Are you passionate about transforming complex data into meaningful insights that drive better decisions?

About the Business
LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Insurance vertical, we provide customers with solutions and decision tools that combine public and industry specific content with advanced technology and analytics to assist them in evaluating and predicting risk and enhancing operational efficiency. The Data Engineering Team in the UK&I features 20 individuals but sits within a global Data Engineering team of over 400+ individuals. Data Management is currently a team of 2.5 team members but is expanding as out product offerings grow within the UK.

In this role, you will analyse and interpret complex data to support business decisions and improve data quality across the insurance lifecycle.
