description:
We are seeking an experienced Radiologist to join our team at Northwest Veterinary Specialist in Clackamas, Oregon just outside of beautiful Portland!

Join our team of established radiologists and a radiation oncologist to help us grow and expand our busy service. The Diagnostic Imaging team supports our veterinary specialty and ER departments with ultrasound, CT, and MR imaging. We also just went live with a brand new Linear Accelerator.

For 21 years, the goal of VCA NWVS has been to provide exceptional patient care while creating a supportive work environment for our doctors and staff. The hospital was built in 1999 as a 10,000 square foot facility but has grown into a large campus with four buildings housing ten specialties. The 27,000 square foot space currently houses 20 exam rooms, 5 surgical suites, a 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64 slice CT, and C-arm. We are proud that our practice supports an on-site blood bank, formulation of parenteral nutrition, mechanical ventilatory support, telemetry, and towers for all types of scoping.

Of course, a state-of-the-art facility requires a high touch professional team to breathe life into the building. At VCA NWVS, the sense of teamwork and the culture of working together is no less important than the level of medical and surgical care that patients receive. The team is experienced, with tremendous longevity and prides itself on the lack of ego. At VCA NWVS it’s all about camaraderie, treating people with respect, and creating a collegial and collaborative work place. Part of this culture is our strong Internship program. Doctors at VCA NWVS work together to mentor our interns as they develop new skills and are active participants in the interns' professional growth.

A sense of community and an active participation in the neighborhood are important components of VCA NWVS core beliefs. For example, for the past 13 years the hospital has hosted the largest regional veterinary medical conference, WinterFest, that provides on-site training and lecturing. Veterinarians throughout the Northwest know our doctors as they lecture regionally, nationally and internationally and are more than happy to “pay it forward” in the local community.

Our hospital is located just a short drive from Portland, OR and offers great affordability with all the amenities of “big city” life with many more trees and not as much traffic!

As a member of the VCA family, your love for medicine and compassion for pets and people is matched with a commitment to your professional growth. Among the reasons to consider joining VCA include:

• Network of 6,000 doctors, including more than 600 specialists
• Largest provider of private practice internships and residencies in the U.S.
• WOOF University, offering abundant CE for Doctors and Staff

title: Environmental Adviser
description:
Introduction:

As the UK transitions towards a low‑carbon energy system under the Government’s Clean Power 2030 Action Plan, resilient and flexible electricity infrastructure is critical. United Infrastructure supports this transition by delivering fully integrated power infrastructure solutions across transmission and distribution networks. As an Independent Connection Provider (ICP), we deliver end-to-end design, construction, and maintenance of electrical networks up to 400kV.

What are we looking for:

As part of our services, the Power Transmission & Distribution (UIPT&D) services are seeking an Environmental Adviser to support the environmental controls and mitigations in the delivery of a significant project to our client.

Based in Alness, Scotland, the project to construct and install energy transmission infrastructure covers approximately 80km of the Scottish Highlands between Loch Buidhe to Beauly. The successful candidate, as well as receiving an industry competitive benefits package will encounter and support the environmental protection and sustainability of almost every species of Scottish flora and fauna to be found across the project landscape, forests and waterways from Eagles and Osprey, Wildcat and Badgers to Greater Crested Newts, adders and Water Voles.

About the role:

Reporting to the Environmental Lead, the role forms part of the Health, Safety, Environmental, Sustainability and Quality (HSESQ) team in providing technical support and practical guidance to the project teams.

The role provides an opportunity to be involved in all aspects of the project with consideration of the environmental controls, mitigations and responsibilities in line with the legal, company, client and other stakeholder’s requirements and responsibilities.

The successful candidate will be encouraged to develop their knowledge, skills and experience within the role and will be supported in their development to achieve career growth within the project team and wider UIPT&D HSESQ team as opportunities present themselves across the UK.

Operating and administrating from the main site office in Alness, the role spends most of their time at the project worksites monitoring and advising the worksite activities and working with other environmental technical contractors to ensure the minimal impact to the environment is always at the forefront of our operations.

Other responsibilities of the role include:

  • Support the implementation of UIPT&D’s environmental strategy and approach to environmental management including the implementation of UIPT&D’s environmental standards.
  • Provide technical support to facilitate the Construction Environmental Management Plan to ensure that environmental aspects are appropriately identified and managed and that UIPT&D’s HSSE policy obligations are enacted.
  • Assist in the identification, understanding and communication of the legal, industry and contractual environmental obligations placed on UIPT&D and its contractors.
  • Assist in the development and provision of training on key environmental aspects to facilitate greater environmental awareness across the business.
  • Work with assurance teams in developing and undertaking environmental inspections and audits as required.
  • Work closely with environmental technical (Ecology and Archaeology) contractors assigned to the project
  • Provide support on a broad range of environmental management issues e.g. Peat Management, Water Management, Species protection and other Environmental constraints.
  • Provision of technical environmental advice and support to project management and workforce to ensure that environmental obligations are effectively supported as per the Construction Environmental Management Plan.
  • Assist in the reporting and investigation of environmental incidents and subsequent monitoring to ensure any trends are identified and mitigated effectively.
  • Liaise with the Environmental Lead regarding activities at the worksite and the environmental controls, issues, alerts etc.

Qualifications:

  • Be suitably qualified in a relevant environmentally based discipline (Degree or equivalent) (desirable)
  • Be experienced in a similar role on construction projects of a similar type and scale (desirable)
  • Have a minimum of 3 years as an Ecological Clark of Works (ECoW), Environmental Clark of Works (EnvCoW) or Environmental Adviser
  • Professional membership of environmental body (desirable)
  • An ability to collating and interpreting environmental performance data.
  • Practical environmental monitoring skills
  • Authoring environmental management processes & procedures
  • Conversant with UK/Scottish consenting and environmental legislation
  • Environmental inspection and auditing
  • Driving licence
  • Excellent communication & literacy skills
  • Proficient in all aspects of MS Office

Outline of benefits:

  • Competitive Annual Salary with regular reviews in line with the industry sector based upon knowledge, skills, and experience.
  • Car/Car Allowance based on your location, the option of a company Car or Car Allowance may be included.
  • Holidays 34 days annual leave. (including 8 x public holidays)
  • Death in Service.
  • Contributory Pension Scheme
  • Access to United Infrastructure optional benefits package private medical cover, gym discounts, cycle to work, holiday purchase, leisure, and shopping discounts; all of these and more that can be adapted to suit your own lifestyle.
  • Remote Workers Provision of worker accommodation (Where vacancy allows) or support in finding accommodation, Accommodation allowance, Meals/Food allowance, living away from home allowance. (Distance based)
  • Commitment to continued professional development: development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests.
  • National connections: join experts around the UK who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession.
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business.

If all of this sounds good to you, then forward a copy of your CV to apply and start your career journey with United Infrastructure Power Transmission & Distribution.

Join us at United Infrastructure and be part of our mission to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions to the complex infrastructure needs of the UK.

title: Rådgiver / Seniorrådgiver Elektro Samferdsel
description:
Vil du være med å utvikle fremtidens samferdselsløsninger i Rogaland?

Norconsult Stavanger søker nå rådgivere innen elektro samferdsel som ønsker å bidra i noen av regionens mest spennende infrastrukturprosjekter. Vi bygger opp et sterkt lokalt fagmiljø og søker både erfarne rådgivere og fremtidens fagressurser innen samferdselselektro.


Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe tett med et av Norges sterkeste samferdselsmiljøer, samtidig som du blir en sentral del av satsingen i Stavanger. Du vil samarbeide med spesialister fra hele landet, spesielt vårt sterke fagmiljø innenfor samferdselselektro i Bergen og samferdsel i Stavanger, og få stor påvirkning på utviklingen av elektrofaget innen samferdsel i regionen.


Vi har en spennende og variert prosjektportefølje med både store nasjonale satsinger og viktige lokale samferdselsprosjekter. I Rogalandsregionen jobber vi blant annet med prosjekter som Rogfast, Bussveien, sykkelfelt langs Dusavikveien og kollektivtiltak i Ullandhaugveien. Dette gir oss muligheten til å bidra i utviklingen av fremtidens samferdselsløsninger – fra store, komplekse infrastrukturprosjekter til konkrete tiltak som forbedrer hverdagen til trafikantene.


For deg som jobber med samferdselektro, betyr dette spennende faglige utfordringer, varierte arbeidsoppgaver og muligheten til å jobbe med prosjekter som setter synlige spor i samfunnet. Du blir en del av et sterkt tverrfaglig miljø med gode muligheter til å utvikle deg videre.


Vi ønsker primært å komme i kontakt med kandidater som har erfaring innen elektroprosjektering, samferdsel eller tekniske infrastrukturanlegg. Samtidig vet vi at morgendagens fremste rådgivere må utvikles. Derfor oppfordrer vi også nyutdannede elektro- og elkraftingeniører til å søke. Hos oss får du tett oppfølging, solid faglig støtte og muligheten til å arbeide med spennende prosjekter fra første dag.


Som rådgiver innen samferdselselektro vil du delta i planlegging og prosjektering av blant annet:

  • Vei- og tunnelanlegg
  • Veg- og gatebelysning
  • Kraftforsyningsanlegg
  • Styrings- og overvåkningssystemer
  • Ladeinfrastruktur og fremtidige energiløsninger
  • ITS- og intelligente transportsystemer
  • Elektroinstallasjoner i samferdselsprosjekter

Avhengig av erfaring vil du kunne få ansvar for:

  • Prosjektering og rådgivning innen samferdselselektro
  • Fag- og disiplinansvar i tverrfaglige prosjekter
  • Utarbeidelse av konkurransegrunnlag og tekniske beskrivelser
  • Tilbuds- og markedsarbeid
  • Kundeoppfølging og rådgivning
  • Byggeplassoppfølging og befaringer
  • Bidra til videre utvikling av vårt fagmiljø innen samferdselselektro i Rogaland

Enten du er nyutdannet og ønsker en spennende start på karrieren, eller du har flere års erfaring fra rådgiver-, entreprenør- eller byggherresiden, ønsker vi å høre fra deg.

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i flere av disse punktene:

  • Utdanning fra universitet, høyskole eller teknisk fagskole innen elektro eller elkraft
  • Interesse for samferdsel, infrastruktur og bærekraftige løsninger
  • Erfaring med prosjektering eller tekniske anlegg er en fordel
  • Gode samarbeidsevner og interesse for tverrfaglig arbeid
  • Strukturert, initiativrik og løsningsorientert
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig
  • Erfaring med relevante prosjekteringsverktøy og BIM er en fordel
  • Faglig nysgjerrig og motivert for videre utvikling

For seniorstillinger er det en fordel med erfaring fra prosjektering, rådgivning eller ledelse av elektrofag i samferdselsprosjekter.


Hos oss får du:

  • Mulighet til å være med å bygge opp et regionalt fagmiljø med støtte fra et av Norges sterkeste kompetansemiljøer innen samferdsel
  • Deltakelse i store og komplekse samferdselsprosjekter
  • Gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og karrierevekst innen marked, fag, linje og oppdrag
  • Et sterkt faglig nettverk både regionalt og nasjonalt
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid og gode muligheter for å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag
  • Moderne kontorlokaler i Stavanger/Hillevåg med utsikt over Gandsfjorden
  • Fri mellom jul og nyttår, samt mellom palmesøndag og skjærtorsdag
  • Bonusordning der en del av selskapets overskudd deles blant alle ansatte
  • Aksjeprogram i Norges største tverrfaglige rådgiverselskap
  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og ansettelsesbetingelser
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø preget av høy trivsel, sterk fagkultur og korte kommunikasjonslinjer
  • Interne fagsamlinger, sosiale arrangementer og bedriftsidrettslag


Synes du dette høres interessant ut?

Ta gjerne kontakt med Sindre Idland (926 98 206) eller Bjørn Kristian Røyland (480 44 002) for en uforpliktende prat.

Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer deg til å søke så snart som mulig.

Innsendelse av søknad

Søknad med CV, vitnemål og attester sendes via vårt elektroniske søknadsskjema på vår nettside.

Norconsult

Norconsult er et ledende nordisk rådgiverselskap som kombinerer ingeniørfag, arkitektur og digital kompetanse i små og store prosjekter innen infrastruktur, energi, industri, bygg og eiendom. Med formålet «Hver dag forbedrer vi hverdagen» utvikler vi bærekraftige, effektive og samfunnsnyttige løsninger for våre kunder og samfunnet rundt oss.

Konsernet har om lag 7 200 medarbeidere fordelt på over 140 kontorer i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Island, Polen og Finland.

For Norconsult er det en grunnleggende forutsetning at alle mennesker er likeverdige. Vi ønsker et arbeidsmiljø preget av mangfold, inkludering og like muligheter, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av bakgrunn, identitet eller livssituasjon.

Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad!

About the team

As Senior Manager, Software Engineering, you'll lead the teams who build and run it — on infrastructure that is cloud-native, with AI-assisted engineering practices built into how the organization works day to day, not treated as a separate initiative.

What You'll Own

  • Own delivery across two or more teams for instant payments and high-value payments, reporting to you directly or through other managers or leads

  • Lead and grow multiple teams of 7-12 full-time engineers each: hire, onboard, run 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and create a climate where people are motivated to do their best work, not just show up. Overall span of control may extend beyond this range once contractor staff augmentation is factored in

  • Coach and develop your engineers' careers — identifying growth opportunities, giving direct feedback, and mentoring the team through technical and professional challenges

  • Own delivery and quality trends across your teams — aggregate deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and MTTR, and drive the fixes a single team can't solve alone

  • Own reliability outcomes across your teams — set the incident response and postmortem standards your managers follow, and step in personally on the most severe or cross-team incidents

  • Stay technically credible across multiple codebases or domains: participate in architecture reviews at a higher altitude, and know when to go deep versus trust your team members' judgment

  • Drive AI adoption across multiple teams — set targets, track adoption and impact, and share what's working across the teams you lead

  • Advise your senior engineers on moderately complex technical and people matters, without doing their job for them

  • Modify and execute policies that affect your area of the organization, and recommend changes that should apply more broadly

  • Communicate regularly with senior and peer leadership on matters spanning several teams, functions, or customers

  • Own budget and headcount planning for your area, balancing near-term delivery against longer-term investment

Our Tech Stack

You don't need full hands-on competency in this stack, but you should be fluent enough to review designs, make staffing calls, and comfortable enough to earn credibility with the team building on it.

  • Java / Spring for backend and Angular for frontend — enough depth to evaluate trade-offs across multiple codebases and coach your team on technical judgment

  • Gen AI / LLM tooling — fluent enough to set adoption strategy and evaluate tool or vendor choices across multiple teams

  • Low-latency systems — familiar enough to guide design decisions and set the technical bar across teams working on transaction processing or high-throughput systems

  • Microservices & APIs — solid enough grounding to review cross-team architecture decisions and API contracts

  • Containers & Kubernetes — working knowledge sufficient to evaluate infrastructure decisions across multiple teams

  • Cloud platforms — working familiarity with Azure; exposure to AWS a plus

  • CI/CD & DevOps — comfortable evaluating pipeline standards across teams, not just one

What You Bring

You don't need to check every box below to apply — if most of this resonates, we want to hear from you.

  • 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing other managers, tech leads, or multiple teams directly

  • Strong critical thinking applied across a broader, less clearly-defined set of problems — you're comfortable when principles alone don't fully apply

  • Strong systems thinking across multiple teams' systems, spotting where complexity crosses team boundaries

  • Solid grounding in SaaS and cloud-native fundamentals, applied at a multi-team level

  • Genuine curiosity that drives you to dig into problems that don't have a strategic direction yet

  • A track record of leading through other leaders — developing managers and senior ICs, not just individual engineers

  • Strong understanding of software architecture across multiple systems or domains

  • Working familiarity with major cloud platforms, container orchestration, and CI/CD at a multi-team scale

  • A track record of using AI-assisted engineering as a lever across a broader organization

  • Demonstrated ability to persuade senior stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving relationships

  • Excellent communication with executives, peers, and the teams several levels below you

Bonus Points

  • Experience in payments, financial services, or another regulated industry

  • Experience managing distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones

  • A track record of turning around an underperforming team or function

  • Experience owning a departmental budget

What We Offer

  • Lead engineering for a platform processing mission-critical payment transactions for financial institutions worldwide

  • Be part of a truly global product development organization — real centers of engineering excellence spread across multiple regions, organized around product families and technical capabilities rather than geography for its own sake, with engineers everywhere shaping our core products and technical direction

  • A cloud-native, automation-first engineering culture that treats quality, security, and developer experience as competitive advantages, not compliance checkboxes

  • Real leadership growth — ACI actively develops managers into senior engineering leaders; your trajectory here is yours to define

  • An organization that holds managers accountable for AI adoption outcomes, not just tool advocacy — you'll have real latitude to drive that

  • Hybrid model — typically 2–3 days in-office across ACI's global hub locations

  • Some domestic and international travel (10–15%) for team meetings, conferences, or cross-site collaboration

  • Flexible schedule, with occasional extended hours around critical releases or team needs

Equal Opportunity & Compliance

ACI Worldwide is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. This role requires adherence to ACI's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, and — given access to sensitive payment data — compliance with applicable security and data-protection standards (PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA). Comprehensive background screening is required. Responsibilities may evolve with business needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

• High School degree or equivalent

title: Associate Data Engineer
description:
About TaskUs: TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.

What We Offer: At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.




Associate Data Engineer


About TaskUs: TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.


TaskUs People First culture has grown the company to have approximately 65K employees worldwide. We are currently in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, including the Philippines, India, and the United States.


It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment’s notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.


What We Offer: TaskUs provides world-class benefit packages with competitive industry salaries to all its employees. With well-developed departments, such as Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity, we continuously thrive in supporting a People First culture. We are known for our inclusiveness and community impact. We also promote internal mobility and professional development at every step of an employee's career within TaskUs. Come be part of TaskUs that supports People First by applying today!

What can you expect in an Associate Data Engineer role with TaskUs:


So what does an Associate Data Engineer do? Think of yourself as someone responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines, and data warehouses for use by the analytics infrastructure, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our employees are top-notch. So come on, now we need your full concentration because it’s time to imagine what it’s like being an Associate Data Engineer.


Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: you will assist in making accurate and meaningful data available for consumption of TaskUs Business Intelligence reporting methodology. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will lead to one thing: that everything you do is to meet an enterprise’s data delivery, business analysis, and reporting needs.


Key Responsibilities:

As an Associate Data Engineer, you will:

  • Configure
    • Configures and sets up solutions based on pre-approved patterns to move data from operational and external environments to the business intelligence environment.
    • Management of data integration & ETL jobs – consolidation, aggregation, filtering, validation, data quality routines, dimension creation, etc.
    • Configure and Deploy automation of jobs based on pre-approved and reusable patterns framework.Executes production-level jobs by considering data dependencies, schedules, validation routines, data stream updates.
    • Design, develop and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.
    • Collaborate with technical users to define data requirements & establish business rules to be applied
    • Collaborate with key business stakeholders to deliver and continually enhance the BI platform to provide relevant and accurate insights through the delivery of new datasets
  • Test
    • Validate and verify the data model according to the business requirements, and continuously optimize the model.
    • Performs unit and system integration testing, on development projects.
    • Undertaking peer reviews, assisting with testing, and ensuring documentation is current.
  • Monitor
    • Monitor Error Handling and Logging tools and processes. Troubleshoot configuration and data errors.
    • Monitor Performance and raise appropriate flags.
    • Identify opportunities to optimize the ETL environment, and implement monitoring, quality, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Knowledgeable with Python, Apache Kafka, AWS Redshift, AWS Glue, AWS S3, and Pentaho Data Integration.
  • Strong knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts with understanding of traditional and MPP database designs, star and snowflake schemas with at least 2 years of data modeling.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on development experience using ETL Tools such as Pentaho, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, Fivetran or Airflow.
  • Knowledge on the architecture, design and implementation of MPP Databases such as Teradata, Snowflake or Redshift.
  • 3-year development using Cloud-based analytics solutions preferable AWS or GCP.
  • Knowledge of designing and implementing streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, or Segment.
  • Knowledgeable in Database Tuning and ETL tuning.
  • Experience of using Python in a cloud-based environment is preferred.
  • Knowledge on NoSQL DBs is preferred.
  • Knowledge, experience and exposure to AI tools is preferred but not required.
  • Someone who has the ability to work effectively across internal functional areas in ambiguous situations.
  • Someone who is a structured thinker and effective communicator.

Education / Certifications:

  • Bachelor's/College Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, Engineering (Computer/Telecommunication) or 4-8 years experience in place of a degree.

Work Location / Work Schedule / Travel:

  • Site Location: Any TaskUs IND Site (Remote)
  • Work Setup: Work from Home
  • Work Schedule: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST (can change depending on business needs)

How We Partner To Protect You: TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.

Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.

We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL .

title: Project Lead CoreMod
description:
• Lead a programme-wide coordination capability supporting the delivery of CoreMod

  • Build and develop a high-performing team, creating clarity across priorities, capacity, coverage and service delivery

  • Work closely with CoreMod leaders and workstreams to continuously improve how coordination services are delivered across the programme

About the business/role/team


The CoreMod Project Coordination (CPC) Team provides programme-wide coordination support across CoreMod, combining workstream-aligned support with specialist services spanning governance, procurement, business operations and knowledge management.


We are looking for an experienced Project Lead to lead the CPC Team and its overall service model. Unlike a traditional technical Project Lead or Project Manager role, this position is primarily focused on people leadership, service management and operational enablement, ensuring the team is effectively prioritised, appropriately resourced and consistently delivering high-quality support across the programme.


You will work closely with the CoreMod Leadership Team, workstream leads, PMO and resource coordination, governance, risk and assurance partners, and procurement partners to understand changing programme priorities and ensure the CPC Team has the capability, capacity and coverage to respond effectively.


About the role


As the CoreMod Project Lead – CPC Team, you will:

  • Lead, coach and develop the CPC Team, creating clear expectations, accountability and a supportive environment in which people can perform at their best.
  • Own and continuously improve the CPC Team service model, including workstream-aligned support, specialist services and appropriate lead and backup coverage.
  • Manage programme-wide demand, prioritisation and allocation of work, balancing competing priorities against capability, capacity and continuity requirements.
  • Establish clear and predictable team operating rhythms, including workload reviews, forward planning, team forums and individual check-ins.
  • Provide visibility of CPC demand, capacity, risks, dependencies and emerging support requirements, escalating material constraints and trade-offs early.
  • Set and maintain the quality standards for coordination outputs, governance artefacts, templates, records and stakeholder communications.
  • Partner with programme and workstream leaders to anticipate future demand and evolve team coverage and responsibilities as CoreMod progresses.
  • Build greater resilience across the team through cross-skilling, documented processes, clear backup arrangements and knowledge sharing, reducing dependency on individual team members.
  • Drive continuous improvement across the team's templates, workflows, intake mechanisms and knowledge-sharing practices.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, transitions and broader people-management activities required to maintain an effective and sustainable CPC capability.

About you


You will be an experienced people leader who can bring clarity, structure and calm leadership to a complex programme environment.


You will be comfortable balancing competing demands, making trade-offs visible and constructively challenging stakeholders when capacity or priorities need to be addressed.


To succeed in the role, you will bring:

  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, including setting direction, coaching performance and building capability and confidence.
  • A strong service-management mindset, with the ability to balance demand, capacity, priorities and stakeholder expectations across multiple workstreams.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to translate complex or ambiguous requirements into clear actions, ownership and delivery rhythms.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing capability, including the confidence to challenge constructively, negotiate trade-offs and escalate risks when required.
  • Working knowledge of project and programme delivery environments, while recognising that this position is not accountable for technical project delivery.
  • The judgement to remain close enough to delivery to identify emerging issues while empowering team members to retain ownership of outcomes.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset and a focus on building a resilient and scalable team capability, rather than service delivery being dependent on particular individuals.

Be More

Working for an organisation that truly makes a difference to the people of Australia, we can offer development and career opportunities in a collaborative environment that supports your growth, wellbeing and promotes flexibility. Your individual growth and success drives the RBA forward as an organisation. Be more means you can do more, for yourself and for Australia.

Why RBA?


The RBA makes an important contribution to the Australian economy through the pursuit of national economic policy objectives and associated activities in financial markets and banking. We also issue Australia's banknotes and operate infrastructure critical to the payments system, all of which contribute to the welfare of the Australian people.

Made up of specialists across a wide range of fields, our people, values and culture play a critical role in achieving our objectives. Striving to be Open & Dynamic, we consider and incorporate different perspectives, work across teams and are transparent with each other, whilst delivering quality together effectively and focusing on outcomes by prioritising, testing, learning and refining as we go.


Our people conduct themselves with a high degree of integrity, while striving for excellence in the work they perform and the outcomes they achieve. We encourage intelligent inquiry and we treat one another with respect while promoting the public interest through our efforts.

We know it is the growth and success of our people that drives the RBA forward. Come and make a bigger contribution while you build and develop your own skills too, because being more means you can do more, for yourself and for Australia.

The Reserve Bank of Australia is committed to equity, diversity and inclusion through key initiatives. We welcome and encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, those living with a disability and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We are committed to making the recruitment process fair and equitable for all our candidates.

Application Close :

November 18, 2026

title: Client Service Representative
description:
Client Service Representative - VCA Northwest Animal Hospital Ina

We are seeking an experienced Client Service Representative to join our team.
At VCA Animal Hospitals, we take our mission statement – your pet’s health is our top priority and excellent service is our goal – very seriously. With every opportunity, we aim to exceed each pet owner’s expectations.
We’re looking for a personable yet highly professional “service extraordinaire” to join us in delivering our mission to our clients and their pets.

Why We Need You
As the face of VCA, the Client Service Representative sets the tone for the practice as we build and maintain each customer's trust and confidence in our abilities. The CSR is the pivot around which the hospital operates and is responsible for:
• Customer service functions, including: greeting visitors, answering telephones, and guiding clients and their pets to exam rooms.
• Scheduling and confirming appointments.
• Placing outbound calls for follow-ups and reaching out to prospective clients.
• Presenting and explaining fees, including processing payments.
• Recommending, selecting, and obtaining products and services, including prescriptions.
• Answering questions regarding products and services, including educating clients on general animal husbandry and non-medical pet care (i.e., heartworm prevention, housebreaking, and flea & tick control).
• Managing medical records, charts, reports and correspondence.
• Hospital maintenance (including removal of animal waste) and ensuring that facility is neat and clean at all times—both inside and outside.

If you are a current associate, you will need to apply through our internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on the Jobs Hub app or search for Browse Jobs.

Benefits: We offer competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision and paid vacation/sick days, 401(k), generous employee pet discounts and more!

It is not designed to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of associates assigned to this job. Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. This job has primary responsibility for providing customer insights through implementing in-housed and outsourced surveys/ studies, and analyzing different source of customer data so that the findings can help internal stakeholders make better customers-related business decisions. This position also supports Head of Customer Experience in insight-leveraging activities to drive actions (i.e organize actionable workshop after obtaining research findings, facilitate product concept development/ service innovation brainstorming sections, participate in cross function projects to represent customer’s voice or lead projects to enhance customer’s experience)

(Vị trí này sẽ chịu trách nhiệm chính trong việc tìm hiểu và đưa ra các thông tin thông qua việc thực hiện các dự án nghiên cứu nội bộ hoặc các dự án được thực hiện bởi các công ty nghiên cứu thị trường bên ngoài, và phân tích các dữ liệu khách hàng từ các nguồn các nhau để tìm ra các thông tin giúp các bộ phận trong công ty đưa ra các quyết định kinh doanh liên quan đến khách hàng một cách hiệu quả hơn. Key job responsibilities assigned to this position are:

(Trách nhiệm chính của vị trí này bao gồm:)

Research projects (inhouse or outsource)

(Thực hiện các dự án nghiên cứu hoặc outsource)

  • Understand the business needs of requesters thoroughly to propose the relevant research scope and approach or evaluate the proposal from vendors to make sure the research can address properly business needs

  • Collecting internal data from different source for analyzing, questionnaire/ DG design, conduct IDI/DG, data analyzing, report writing and provide actionable recommendations for business questions that need sound decision making.

(Thu thập dữ liệu từ nhiều nguồn nội bộ để phân tích, thiết kế bảng thảo luận nhóm (DG)/ bảng câu hỏi, thực hiện phỏng vấn IDI/DG, phân tích dữ liệu, viết báo cáo và đưa ra các đưa ra kiến nghị phù hợp cho từng mục tiêu nghiên cứu/ mục tiêu kinh doanh của công ty)

Manage the quality and delivering time of research agency. (Đánh giá và hiệu chỉnh các đề xuất thiết kế nghiên cứu của các công ty nghiên cứu thị trường sao cho đem lại hiệu quả cao nhất về mặt chất lượng, ngân sách và thời gian thực hiện nghiên cứu. Quản lý chất lượng và thời gian thực hiện dự án của công ty nghiên cứu thị trường. Đưa ra các gợi ý/ hướng dẫn/ phản hồi hữu ích và có hiểu biết sâu sắc về khách hàng cho công ty nghiên cứu thị trường đang thực hiện dự án cho Prudential trong các cột mốc chính (phát triển bảng thảo luận nhóm hay thiết kế bảng câu hỏi, phản hồi/ cho ý kiến để hoành thành bản báo cáo sơ bộ, báo cáo chi tiết tốt nhất.

Drive insights to actions

(Sử dụng các thông tin từ phân tích, nghiên cứu để đưa ra các hành động)

  • Organize actionable workshop after obtaining research findings/ data findings so that the information and be shared and bring to actions by different teams

(Tổ chức workshop để chia sẻ các thông tin từ dữ liệu phân tích được hoặc từ kết quả nghiên cứu thị trường để các teams cùng nhau đưa ra các chiến lược, hành động)

  • Initiate actions to improve customer experience and lead end to end projects to deliver the initiatives improving customer experience across touchpoints.

(Có những sáng kiến để tăng trải nghiệm và có thể quản lý toàn bộ dự án để triển khai các sáng kiến tăng trải nghiệm Khách hàng ở các điểm chạm)

  • Join cross-function projects to represent voice of customers.

(Tham gia các dự án cùng các phòng ban để đại diện tiếng nói của Khách hàng)

Job Requirements / Yêu cầu

Qualifications / Bằng cấp

  • University/ College Degree with marketing/ business major

(Tốt nghiệp Cao đẳng/ Đại học với chuyên ngành marketing/ hoặc các nhóm ngành thuộc khối kinh doanh)

Experience / Kinh nghiệm

  • At least 5 years’ experience in market research (2 years' working experience for a market research agency is preferable) and minimum 1 year of working as a CI/ market research manager.

Có ít nhất 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực nghiên cứu thị trường (ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm làm việc 2 năm tại các công ty nghiên cứu thị trường) và ít nhất 1 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc ở vị trí CI manager/ Market research manager

Job capabilities & behaviors requirements: / Các năng lực và hành vi mong đợi cho vị trí này :

  • Execution excellence: take full ownership to resolve difficulties, challenges and deliver the project objectives efficiently with highest standard of quality

(Năng lực thực thi dự án xuất sắc: có trách nhiệm cao, chủ động trong việc tìm ra giải pháp khắc phục khó khăn/ thách thức trong quá trình triễn khai dự án nhằm đạt được mục tiêu của dự án một cách hiệu quả với chất lượng công việc tốt nhất)

  • Working together: work well with different types of people including external research vendors and internal stakeholders; proactively contribute thoughts, ideas in meetings, cross-functional projects

(Khả năng làm việc nhóm: Làm việc tốt với nhiều nhóm đối tượng khác nhau bao gồm đối tác – các công ty nghiên cứu thị trường cũng như đồng nghiệp trong cùng công ty, chủ động đóng góp ý kiến, đưa ra ý tưởng có giá trị trong những buổi họp, những dự án chiến lược cần nhiều phòng ban phối hợp thực hiện)

  • Strategic thinking: think a big picture and use good judgment to find HOWs to approach/ implement one issue/ challenge thoroughly and efficiently

(Khả năng tư duy chiến lược: có thể nhìn nhận vấn đề một cách tổng quan và vận dụng tốt nhận định cá nhân để tìm ra cách tiếp cận/ giải quyết vấn đề/ khó khăn một cách hiệu quả và toàn diện)

  • Great data analytic skill (i.e either qualitative or quantitative data points)

(Có khả năng phân tích số liệu/ thông tin xuất sắc cho dù là số liệu định tính hay định lượng)

  • Be a great communicator, both spoken and written English communication

title: Libraries Adviser - Multiple Locations across City
description:
Libraries Advisor
Multiple Locations across City

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850 (pro-rata for part-time)
Hours: 17.79hrs per week, 52 weeks

We are recruiting Library Advisor staff to join our library teams in a number of library locations across the city. (Advert states Waverley Court by default)

Posts are shift working and include some Saturdays and evenings.

Our libraries are at the heart of their communities. Members of staff work with their community to help create a thriving place to live and to help reduce poverty and inequality. We support users to develop their digital skills, and we help them get the information and advice they need. Our staff encourage babies and children to develop their language and reading ability through programmes like Bookbug and Read, Write Count. We help those of all ages in the community who struggle with loneliness by providing them with a place to meet and connect. We provide a full range of books and other resources to help everyone to live, learn and work.

Young people are regular users of libraries and can range from structured activity to simply meeting up with friends. It is vital that our staff have a broad understanding of the issues faced by young people and that individually or as part of the team, you are willing to engage with and support young people and maintain a positive, safe and trusted environment. Any youth engagement experience will be welcomed.

To be a successful member of our team you must be able to show that you can deliver excellent customer service and that you can understand the needs of different parts of the community.

If you could be an effective team player in a service that puts customers first, please apply. If you are invited to interview, we will ask you your preferred hours and discuss with you the permanent and temporary positions. Whilst we recruit to teams in individual libraries, staff are expected to work in any library across the city.

The City of Edinburgh Council is committed to recruiting people who will deliver high quality public services to our diverse communities within the city of Edinburgh. As an equal opportunity employer, we recognise and value the benefits that a diverse workforce with different values, beliefs, experience, and backgrounds brings. We are committed to building an inclusive recruitment culture where all people feel valued, included and able to be at their best.

We would like to encourage conversations with people who have not previously thought about employment within a Local Authority. We warmly invite people to take this opportunity to demonstrate their ability regardless of age, disability, sex, gender, race, marital status, sexual orientation, religious or political beliefs.

This post is regulated work with children and/or protected adults under the Protection of Vulnerable Groups (Scotland) Act 2007. The preferred candidate will be required to join the PVG Scheme or undergo a PVG Scheme update check. Where an individual has spent a continuous period of 3 months or more out with the UK in the last 5 years, an Overseas Criminal Record Check will be required. You will be required to provide this check. An unconditional offer of employment and commencement in the post will be subject to the outcome of both these pre-employment checks being deemed satisfactory.

We're committed to creating a workplace culture where all our people feel valued, included and able to be their best at work, and we recognise the benefits that a diverse workforce with different values, beliefs, experience, and backgrounds brings to us as an organisation.

As part of our goal to improve our organisational culture and create a great place to work together for the people of Edinburgh, we want to make sure that we’re bringing the best people into our roles, not just in their skills and experience but also in their approach to work.

To help achieve this, we’re changing the way we interview and assess candidates by moving from a competency-based interview approach to a behavioural and technical (skills for the job) based approach. This new way of interviewing will allow us to assess how you think and how you would bring Our Behaviours of Respect, Integrity and Flexibility into your ways of working.

You can find out more on Our Behaviours web page Our Behaviours – The City of Edinburgh Council

Our salary range typically reflects the initial starting salary and annually increases until it reaches the top of the range.

Happy to talk flexible working.

Follow us on X at @edincounciljobs

title: IT Support Analyst (Denver, Colorado)
description:
Armstrong Collective is the parent company of Rocky Mountaineer and Canyon Spirit, creating unforgettable rail journeys through some of the most breathtaking landscapes in Western Canada and the American Southwest. Guided by our values, Create Meaningful Moments, Be One Team, and Achieve Extraordinary Outcomes, we show up every day with pride, ownership, and a shared commitment to excellence. We work hard, support one another, embrace new possibilities, and celebrate growth, all in a respectful and inclusive environment where integrity, collaboration, and passion for the guest experience lead the way.

Role Overview

The IT Support Analyst reports to the Senior Manager, IT Service Delivery and supports the implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of technology across Canyon Spirit Onboard, Destinations, and Rail operations. Integrated with the Canadian-based IT Services team, and working closely with third-party vendors, this role delivers reliable technical support, maintains critical infrastructure, and contributes to technology initiatives that improve operational performance, as well as Guest and team member experiences. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, a customer-focused mindset, accountability for results, effective collaboration, and the ability to adapt to changing business and technology needs.

Key Responsibilities

End User Support & Service Delivery

• Provide first and second-level support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, Microsoft 365 applications, operating systems, Apple iOS devices, and business applications for teams onboard the train, across multiple physical locations, as well as , remote, telephone, and on-call support.

• Support hardware deployment, troubleshooting, upgrades, replacements, and lifecycle management for laptops, desktops, printers, and related equipment.

• Manage mobile device provisioning, administration, training, cellular services, and Microsoft Intune device management.

• Monitor, prioritize, and resolve incidents and service requests within established service levels, taking ownership of issues through to resolution while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

Endpoint, Mobility & Systems Administration

• Manage and maintain the organization’s fleet of Apple mobile devices, including provisioning, support, training, mobile device management through Microsoft Intune, and cellular contract administration.

• Configure, install, upgrade, and maintain desktops, laptops, peripherals, software packages, patches, and operating systems.

• Support the Vancouver based Rail Technology team with occasional guided support of networking, wireless services, and compute onboard the train.

• Perform user administration activities, including account creation and termination, permissions management, access provisioning, distribution lists, and group administration for network and business applications.

• Support SharePoint Online sites, Microsoft Teams environments, collaboration platforms, and business systems used throughout Canyon Spirit operations.

• Anticipate potential issues, evaluate options, and take appropriate action to minimize operational impacts.

Collaboration, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Partner with internal clients, vendors, and IT team members to resolve issues and support operational priorities.

• Create, maintain, and enhance support documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge resources to improve service delivery and knowledge sharing.

• Share expertise with peers, contribute to team learning, and actively seek feedback to strengthen technical capability and performance.

• Participate in team meetings, openly contribute ideas, and recommend process improvements that increase efficiency, service quality, and user satisfaction.

• Embrace change, adapt to evolving technologies and business requirements, and identify opportunities to leverage technology in new and innovative ways.

What You Bring

• A customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional service and creating meaningful experiences.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess situations, evaluate options, and determine effective solutions.

• Accountability for results, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate across teams.

• A commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and expanding technical expertise.

• Resilience, adaptability, and a positive approach to change, ambiguity, and evolving business needs.

• A proactive mindset that identifies opportunities for improvement and contributes innovative ideas that enhance team and business outcomes.

Experience & Qualifications

• Diploma in Information Technology or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Professional certifications such as HDI CSS, CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent.

• Microsoft 365 Modern Desktop Administrator (MD-102) certification is considered an asset.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in an IT support or Service Desk environment providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support.

• Experience supporting Apple mobile devices, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, Active Directory, endpoint management technologies, and telecommunications providers.

Work Environment

• Denver-based position supporting Canyon Spirit operations across multiple office and guest facing locations in both Colorado and Utah.

• Frequent computer-based work with travel required to support remote operating locations.

• Flexibility to support operational requirements outside standard business hours when required.

Compensation

  • The base salary offered for this role is $65,000 - $75,000 per annum and can vary based on job-related expertise, qualifications, experience and internal equity.
  • Eligible for Armstrong Collective’s Bonus Program.

Perks & Benefits
Armstrong Collective supports the health and well-being of its team members through a comprehensive benefits program. Eligible employees may also enjoy 401(K) matching, travel benefits, and additional company perks.

This job description is not exhaustive of all duties and will encompass additional duties assigned. Responsibilities, title, reporting structure, and duties may be changed in response to business requirements.

title: Finance Administrator - Fixed Term Contract
description:
We provide meaningful careers that connect people with purpose.

We are united by a common purpose of providing the best and safest care; and by our shared values of Care, Truth, Participation, Compassion and Dignity.

Netcare invites you to be part of our journey.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Hospital Finance Administrator will assist the Hospital Financial Accountant with various financial transactions. A key function will include performing the banking functions and ensuring compliance to key banking controls in order to maintain a high level of financial integrity. This individual will also assume responsibility for the hospital debtors, creditors and accounting functions.

This Hospital Finance Administrator will adhere to other required financial administrative functions and will work in consultation with all the relevant stakeholders to maintain good working relationships and fulfil work requests. This individual will further assist the Hospital Financial Accountant in the achievement of divisional goals and maintaining compliance with the required financial standards.

KEY WORK OUTPUT AND ACCOUNTABILITIES

DISRUPTIVE INNOVATION

Finance and Treasury administration

  • Provide support to Netcare Hospitals with respect to Treasury Administration within the Hospital Division. This includes, but not limited to, facilitating user access administration (new user, user termination, changes in user access rights, re-set of passwords).
  • Assist in the maintenance and revision of policies and procedures to ensure general compliance to treasury and fidelity requirements of the business.

Compliance management

  • Maintain an effective compliance communication program for the division including promoting heightened awareness of Standards of Conduct and understanding of new and existing compliance issues and related policies and procedures.
  • Periodically review and assist in the update Standards of Conduct to ensure continuing currency and relevance in providing guidance to management and employees in the Hospital division.
  • Collaborate with all departments (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Human resources etc.) to direct compliance issues to appropriate existing channels for investigation and resolution.
  • Respond to alleged violations of rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and Standards of Conduct by evaluating or recommending the initiation of investigative procedures.
  • Assist in monitoring compliance activities of other departments to remain abreast of the status of all compliance activities and to identify trends.
  • Ensure personal awareness and compliance with pertinent policies / legislation.
  • Participate in internal & external audit reviews and recommend implementation as per management instructions within the delegation of authority framework.
  • Conduct Control Self-Assessment (CSA) Compliance Audits within the Hospital Division to ensure CSA Compliance.
  • Provide CSA guidance and support to the Hospital Division.
  • Periodically review and update Hospital Division CSAs to ensure they remain relevant to the control environment.
  • Assist in the maintenance and revision of policies and procedures to ensure general compliance to maintain legal, ethical and proper conduct.

Tax accounting

  • Facilitate the completion of the Hospital Division IT14SDs.
  • Provide support and guidance to the Hospital Division on the preparation of tax reporting packs to support Income Tax Returns.
  • Provide support and guidance to the Hospital Division on the preparation of VAT reconciliations to support VAT returns.
  • Provide support to the Hospital Division in resolution of all tax related queries.
  • Promote the validity, accuracy and completeness of tax accounting principles applied in the business.

Risk management

  • Identify, record, quantify and manage the division’s exposure to tax and other financial risks.
  • Assist with training, preparation of manuals, update of policy documents and implementation of procedures to comply with the Group requirements.

Reporting / Legislation

  • Review and interpret current and proposed legislation and documents that impact on regulatory reporting or taxation requirements for Hospital Division.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of statutes to contribute to ensuring all financial information meets the necessary statutory and regulatory compliance standards, including liaising with tax consultants and auditors.
  • Communicate technical advice and provide assistance to the Accounting team in relation to financial reporting, treasury and taxation issues.
  • Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to management.

Projects

  • Participate in various treasury, accounting, taxation and finance information system projects.
  • Support and work closely with the finance team to ensure the appropriate tools, processes and reporting are developed and implemented to continuously improve processes, data integrity and reporting particularly in relation to tax and reporting obligations.

Training

  • Assist with training activities, prepare manuals, update policy documents and implement procedures to comply with the Group requirements.

TRANSFORMATION OF OUR SOCIETY

Transformation targets

  • Embrace the transformation goals as set out by the transformation committee by fostering a culture of inclusivity in work and relationships.

Teamwork

  • Actively participate as a member of the team to achieve goals.

Personal and professional development

  • Assume responsibility for own personal and professional development.
  • Ensure that managerial behaviours are modelled and aligned to the Netcare values.
  • Keep up to date with Netcare’s evolving policies and procedures.

SKILLS PROFILE

EDUCATION

Required

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Accounting / Finance or equivalent NQF 7 level qualification.

KNOWLEDGE

Required

  • Attention to detail and quality of deliverables.
  • Accounting knowledge (IFRS and equivalent standards).
  • Workable knowledge of key elements of the VAT Act, Income Tax Act and Companies Act and other relevant legislation.
  • Advanced computer literacy (Excel, Word and PowerPoint) - High proficiency in Excel and spreadsheets and reconciliations.
  • Report writing.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • In the event of any physical or psychological limitation that may impair the employee’s ability to perform the required job function, the employee must consult the employer for reasonable accommodation.

SKILLS

Customer Focus and Service Delivery

  • The capacity to identify and respond to the needs of *internal and external customers.

Personal Work Ethic

  • Capacity to instil an ethic of quality and consistency in self and others.

Building Relationships

  • Capacity to establish constructive and effective relationships.

Communication

  • The capacity to clearly present information, either written or verbal.

Teamwork

  • Capacity to cooperate with others to work towards a common goal.

Technical Knowledge

  • The capacity to perform a technical function to required standards.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Professional flexibility in working hours while supporting daily business operations which may include weekends and night shifts where applicable.
  • Will interact with internal and external customers through several different means.

NETCARE VALUES AND BEHAVIOURS

Netcare Values
At Netcare, our core value is care. We care about the dignity of our patients and all members of the Netcare family. We care about the participation of our people and our partners in everything we do. We care about truth in all our actions. We are passionate about quality care and professional excellence.

  • At Netcare, our core value is care.
  • We care about the dignity of our patients and all members of the Netcare family.
  • We care about the participation of our people and our healthcare partners in everything that we do.
  • We care about the truth in all our actions.
  • We listen with empathy and respond with acts of compassion in all interactions with our patients and their families.


The Netcare Way

Netcare is committed to providing quality care. Our basic service standard holds us accountable for the below seven behaviours which you will be accountable to uphold:

  • Respect - I always greet everyone to show my respect.
  • Identity - I always wear my name badge to show my identity.
  • Dignity - I always treat others with consideration and humility to uphold dignity
  • Care - I always act in the best interest of Netcare and others to show I care
  • Compassion - I always listen with empathy and respond with kind action to show my compassion
  • Appreciation - I always say thank you to show my appreciation.
  • Diversity- I always embrace diversity to strengthen inclusivity and belonging.

Join the team committed to providing the best and safest health and care.

title: Supervisor, Restaurant
location: Hard Rock Cafe London United Kingdom
description:
Our team members are the key to our company’s success, and their health and well-being, as well as that of their families, is very important to us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that allows our team members stay healthy, plan for their future and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Benefits may vary with employment status. To see our fill list of Team Member Benefits please visit our career site:

Job Description:

The Cafe Supervisor is responsible for assisting the management team with the day-to-day operations of the Cafe, ensuring Guest satisfaction, while supporting all Departments, including the Line, Prep, Dish, Receiving, Inside Expo, Outside Expo, Bar, Servers, Hosts, Bussers, Retail and Sales/Banquets. The Cafe Supervisor communicates with the Managers on a daily basis, reviews the daily functions and events, validates the execution of Hard Rock recipes, validates the execution of steps of service and ensures ticket times are adhered to, while coaching the overall delivery of an amplified experience in order to create Raving Fans of our Guests.


Basic Key Performance Indicators of a Cafe Supervisor:

PEOPLE:

  • Continuously provides Employees with verbal recognition, direction and support
  • Communicates with Employees to keep them informed of Cafe, Regional and Corporate procedures
  • Communicates with Managers to evaluate work procedures, review standards, identify methods for increasing efficiency or effectiveness and respond proactively to any needs that have arisen
  • Mentors new Employees by presenting them with information about their job and the company
  • Trains and empowers Employees to exercise good judgment to make decisions regarding service, food quality and Guest satisfaction by adhering to company training standards
  • Ensure Employees follow safety, sanitation and security procedures
  • Listens to comments, criticisms, and feedback from Guests, Employees and other Managers to gain an understanding of areas of strength and opportunity to improve personal/Cafe/Retail performance
  • Greets Employees as they begin their shift to promote an atmosphere
  • Communicates with Managers to ensure that departmental opening, swing, closing and cleaning duties were completed up-to-standard
  • Performs Employees’ tasks such as preparing Menu items, bussing tables and serving food to help Employees and ensure the quality of the Guest experience
  • Prepares Cafe and Employees for shift and ensures the place is ready to open according to standards

GUEST EXPERIENCE:

  • Performs 100% table visits to ensure guest satisfaction
  • Greets all guests and models the use of 10-5-First and Last
  • Resolves guest complaints with MOD
  • Listen’s to guests requests and needs and communicates to the Management team
  • Understands SMG, Mystery Shop and Review Pro and uses analytics to improve the guest experience
  • Observes Employees’ while they work to ensure adherence to policy and positive guest experience
  • Performs Employees’ tasks such as helping in the Rock Shop, preparing menu items, bussing tables, running drinks and serving food to ensure the quality of the guest experience

SALES:

  • Builds business/market share by thinking of new ways to promote Company and new programs that will bring in business, and by participating in local events to increase sales and profits
  • Inspects product levels and storage areas to determine if enough product is on hand and to maintain proper storage, rotation, freshness of product and sanitation conditions
  • Monitors sales (F&B, Alcohol and Retail) by the hour and reports information to team

PROFITS:

  • Monitors food, beverage and labor costs using established methods to meet goals, reports findings to Manager
  • Observes food prep by watching Employees’ portion, cook, and heat items to ensure correctness of recipe, temperature and quality
  • Inspects, tastes and touches food to ensure freshness, proper temperature, and recipe adherence during Line Checks
  • Validates all Comps and Discounts through inspection via table visit (only Managers are allowed to complete a Comp)
  • Expedites food preparation by checking lead times and monitoring ticket times to ensure that food is prepared and served timely

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Top performer and Certified Trainer within Department
  • Full time employee
  • Proficiency communicating (speaking, reading, and writing) in English, bilingual preferred
  • Proficiency in relevant technology (POS, KDS, FreshTxt/Open Table, Rock Wall®, Hard Rock Rewards®, etc.)
  • Proficiency in and can demonstrate Menu/Beverage/Retail knowledge
  • Food/Alcohol Certifications up to date
  • College coursework preferred; high school diploma or equivalency required
  • Minimum of 1-2 year hospitality industry experience preferred

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Employees are expected to be able to perform the job functions with reasonable accommodation

title: Merchandise Manager
description:
Store - WILKES BARRE, PAThe Merchandise Manager drives merchandising and operational execution, including truck processing, inventory routines, planogram sets, and visual standards. This role ensures accurate pricing, timely promotional execution, and a customer-ready store environment through strong workload planning and inventory management.

Major Activities

  • Assist Store Manager in leading and managing adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Company programs to ensure compliance with applicable laws and requirements.
  • Ensure execution of Company policies and standards, holding team accountable for store conditions and results.
  • Provide Manager-on-Duty (MOD) coverage, maintaining floor leadership, service standards, and operational continuity.
  • Lead truck execution processes, ensuring timely unloading, accurate sorting, and efficient flow of merchandise to the sales floor.
  • Own workload planning and daily task prioritization, partnering with store leadership to align staffing and execution to business needs.
  • Execute and maintain SISO (Store-In-Stock Optimization) routines to drive in-stock levels, replenishment accuracy, and sales readiness.
  • Oversee Planogram (POG) execution, ensuring merchandising sets are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Establish and maintain visual merchandising standards, including initial product placement and presentation to company expectations.
  • Support a clean, organized, and customer-ready store environment, including backroom organization and sales floor recovery.
  • Manage key aspects of inventory control, ensuring product accuracy, integrity, and efficient stock movement.
  • Execute ad sets, ensuring promotional signage and product placement are compliant and customer focused.
  • Complete price changes accurately and on time, maintaining pricing integrity across the sales floor and systems.
  • Oversee Ship from Store fulfillment, ensuring orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently and accurately.
  • Process RTVs (Return to Vendor) and ASN receiving, ensuring compliance, documentation accuracy, and proper inventory adjustments.
  • Manage store damages procedures, ensuring proper handling, reporting, and shrink reduction
  • Train, coach, and develop team members through structured TM onboarding and ongoing skill-building across assigned departments.
  • Partner in maintaining strong Asset Protection practices, reducing shrink through awareness, compliance, and safe operations.

Other duties as assigned

Minimum Type of Experience Required

  • 3+ years retail leadership experience

Work Environment

  • Ability to remain standing for long periods of time
  • Ability to move throughout the store
  • Regular bending, lifting, carrying, reaching, and stretching
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull merchandise and fixtures, up to 25-50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to climb ladders or step stools to stock and retrieve products.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions, including scanning items, stocking shelves, and operating POS equipment.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequent customer interactions.
  • Work hours include nights, weekends and early mornings

Applicants in the U.S. must satisfy federal, state, and local legal requirements of the job.

title: Country Leasing Manager - Central Europe
description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Lindex in Central Europe? As our Leasing Manager, you will play a key role in creating a strong and attractive store portfolio, building valuable partnerships, and supporting our continued growth across the region.

Your role in our team

As Country Leasing Manager, you will play a key role in shaping and developing our store portfolio across Central Europe. Together with colleagues and stakeholders, you will identify growth opportunities, lead lease negotiations, and support store development projects that strengthen our business and customer experience. As a member of the Country Leadership Team, you will contribute to broader business decisions and the future development of the market. As part of our global Store Portfolio & Global Leasing function, you will also bring local market insights into our long-term leasing strategy.

  • Lead and develop leasing and store portfolio activities in Central Europe.
  • Drive lease negotiations, renewals, relocations, closures, and expansion projects.
  • Identify and evaluate new store opportunities and attractive retail locations.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with landlords, developers, and external partners.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of the market's store portfolio strategy.
  • Lead and support store development projects from planning through execution.
  • Collaborate closely with local and global stakeholders across multiple functions.

Is this you?

You’re a commercially driven and relationship-oriented professional who combines strategic thinking with a hands-on approach. You enjoy identifying opportunities, building strong partnerships, and turning ideas into actions that create long-term value. Working across teams, markets, and cultures energizes you, and you know how to bring people together around a common goal.

You are confident in negotiating, influencing stakeholders, and balancing commercial opportunities with business needs. You welcome new perspectives, take ownership of your development, and thrive in a dynamic, fast-changing environment. Leading yourself, being active in your own development and always staying on your toes to find the best solution are all things you know well. This also sounds like you:

  • Several years of experience within retail leasing, real estate, expansion, portfolio management, or a similar field.
  • Solid knowledge of the Central European retail property market and a strong professional network across the region.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional projects forward.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Good understanding of the commercial and financial drivers behind store performance.
  • Relevant education within business, real estate, retail management, or a related field.
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English, both spoken and written.
  • Bonus: experience from an international retail or matrix organization.

Who we are

We’re a growing global fashion company from Sweden, driven by a higher purpose: to drive meaningful change for women. Our commitment to women, sustainability, and customers guides everything we do as we build a brand-driven, sustainable company with a digital-first mindset. At Lindex, we’re all about doing things together – collaborating, sharing ideas, and supporting one another. Because together, we achieve more than we ever could alone.

Got a good feeling? We’d love to hear from you.

Apply today – we’re excited to get to know you! We review applications continuously, so don’t wait too long.

We like to keep things simple, so please apply online.
