title: Allround medewerker Burgerzaken
description:
Pak de ruimte in Maashorst als Allround medewerker Burgerzaken

Uden | 24-28 uren | Schaal 8

Dit ga je doen?
Als Allround Medeweker Burgerzaken ben je de expert die ervoor zorgt dat inwoners kunnen vertrouwen op de gegevens die wij registreren. Je werk is afwisselend en vraagt regelmatig om speurwerk, inzicht en een scherp oog voor detail.

Als allround medewerker Burgerzaken houd je je bezig met uiteenlopende inhoudelijke werkzaamheden binnen de Basisregistratie Personen (BRP) en de burgerlijke stand. Je zorgt ervoor dat persoonsgegevens correct en actueel zijn en dat aanvragen en dossiers zorgvuldig worden behandeld.

Daarnaast ben je een belangrijke vraagbaak voor je collega's. Wanneer zij vastlopen in een ingewikkelde casus, weten ze jou te vinden. Je deelt je kennis, denkt mee over oplossingen en draagt bij aan een hoge kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
  • Adresonderzoeken: je voert adresonderzoeken uit bij twijfel over de juistheid van een adresregistratie. Je verzamelt en beoordeelt informatie, onderhoudt contact met inwoners en betrokken instanties en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige administratieve afhandeling.
  • Briefadressen: je beoordeelt aanvragen voor een briefadres, onderzoekt of aan de voorwaarden wordt voldaan en begeleidt het proces van aanvraag tot besluitvorming.
  • Burgerlijke stand: je behandelt aanvragen en verzoeken op het gebied van de burgerlijke stand, zoals het opmaken en beoordelen van akten en het verwerken van wijzigingen in de persoonlijke staat. Je controleert documenten en beoordeelt of deze voldoen aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving. Je voltrekt kosteloze en administratieve huwelijken en registreerde partnerschappen en registreert deze.
  • Kwaliteit van de BRP: je signaleert onjuistheden en denkt mee over het verbeteren van de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van de persoonsgegevens.
  • Informatieverstrekkingen: je verzorgt de informatieverstrekking met overheidsinstanties, ondernemers en inwoners.
  • Contact en samenwerking: je hebt contact met inwoners, collega's en externe organisaties om informatie te verzamelen, vragen te beantwoorden en dossiers zorgvuldig af te handelen.
  • Balie: je werkt in rooster aan de balie

Kortom: een functie waarin je jouw vakkennis volop kunt inzetten, samenwerkt met betrokken collega's en elke dag weer andere vraagstukken tegenkomt.

Je doet het samen met…..

Je werkt in een vast rooster samen in een team (met vier collega’s) waarbij Dienstverlening aan onze inwoners hoog in het vaandel staat!

Dit zijn wij
Even voorstellen. Wij zijn Maashorst. Een jonge gemeente die volop in beweging is. Bij ons vind je het beste van twee werelden: de levendigheid van Uden en de karaktervolle charme van onze kleinere kernen, elk met een eigen actief dorpsleven. Omgeven en geïnspireerd door natuur zoals je die nergens anders tegenkomt, pakken wij de ruimte om het anders te doen. Als gemeente weten we precies waar we heen willen. Maar eerlijk is eerlijk: we hebben nog wat stappen te zetten voordat we daar zijn. Boeiend? Zeker weten! Want er liggen bij ons volop kansen. En dat geeft jou de ruimte om vanaf dag één je mouwen op te stropen en echt impact te maken.

Over impact gesproken: Maashorst barst van de ambities! Met lef en daadkracht bouwen we aan het ‘goei leven’ voor iedereen in Maashorst. Om een van onze ambities te noemen: de groenste gemeente van Nederland worden. Deze en andere plannen verwezenlijken we graag met een stel vrijzinnige pioniers, die zin hebben in een oer-Brabants avontuur. Met jou aan boord willen wij een gemeente zijn die durft én doet, en ook ingewikkelde problemen vol vertrouwen aanpakt. Zie jij het al voor je? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Je bent van harte welkom in ons gemeentehuis in het levendige hart van Uden. Tot snel!

En dit helpt jou om ruimte te pakken
  • Een individueel keuzebudget (17,05% van je salaris) waarmee jij de keuzes maakt die bij jou passen. Laat bijvoorbeeld een deel van je maandinkomen uitbetalen of zet dit om in extra verlof of een fietsvergoeding.
  • Zicht op een vast contract.
  • Duurzaam reizen wordt beloond, ontvang een bonus tot maximaal €500 per jaar.
  • 28 vakantiedagen bij een 36-urige werkweek
  • Blijf fit met een korting op je sportabonnement, je ontvangt tot €20 per maand.
  • Je bouwt pensioen op bij het ABP, met een werkgeversbijdrage van 70%.
  • Veel vrijheid om werk en privé te combineren.
  • Betrokken collega’s en veel gezelligheid (onder meer door de actieve personeelsvereniging).
  • Kansen om je te ontwikkelen, op zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk gebied

Passen we bij elkaar?
Werken in Maashorst past bij jou als je het leuk vindt om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van onze jonge gemeente en ertegen kunt dat dit soms gepaard gaat met wat turbulentie. Het belangrijkste? Dat je eigenaarschap toont en energie toevoegt aan ons team. Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie breng je daarnaast het volgende mee:
  • MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau
  • Een afgeronde opleiding richting Burgerzaken (bijvoorbeeld NVVB-modules), vakgerichte opleiding(en)
  • Relevante werkervaring binnen Burgerzaken bij een gemeente
  • Actuele kennis van de relevant wet- en regelgeving
  • Ervaring met gemeentelijke applicaties
  • Je bent ambtenaar van de Burgerlijke Stand (is een pré)
  • Kun je informatie goed analyseren, beoordelen en vastleggen
  • Ervaring met ondersteunende werkzaamheden bij het organiseren van Verkiezingen
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (Engels)
  • Communiceer je duidelijk en klantgericht, ook wanneer een situatie ingewikkeld of gevoelig is;
  • Werk je zelfstandig, zorgvuldig en resultaatgericht.
  • Bereidheid om een avondopenstelling te doen

Competenties
Wij zoeken iemand die:
  • Integer en betrouwbaar handelt
  • Nauwkeurig, analytisch en kwaliteitsgericht werkt
  • Analytisch sterk is
  • Stressbestendig blijft onder druk
  • Goed kan samenwerken èn zelfstandig beslissingen durft te nemen

Kies jij voor Maashorst?
We zijn benieuwd naar jou! Upload je motivatie en cv via het sollicitatieformulier hieronder. Je hoort na de sluitingsdatum zo snel mogelijk of je wordt uitgenodigd.

title: Helsefagarbeider
description:
Et overordnet perspektiv på kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester er at flere skal kunne bo hjemme og få nødvendig helsehjelp der de bor. Er du helsefagarbeider med ønske om å videreutvikle tjenesten i tråd med morgendagens omsorg, ønsker vi at du søker jobb hos oss. Vi har nå ledig 100 % fast stilling som fagarbeider i hjemmetjenesten.

Som helsefagarbeider i hjemmetjenesten er det viktig at du kan identifisere deg med Tysvær kommune sine medarbeiderverdier ROMA; raus, open, modig og ansvarlig. Tysvær er i en spennende endring og hjemmetjenesten skal til neste år flytte over i kommunens hittil største prosjekt - Helsekvartalet.

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver

  • Ansvarlig for observasjoner, tiltak og oppfølging av pasienten etter vedtak
  • Medisinhåndtering
  • En-til-en oppfølging av brukere etter behov
  • Besvare/ håndtere trygghetsalarmer
  • Følge opp brukere med velferdsteknologiske løsninger og behandle varsler i tråd med gjeldende rutiner
  • Delta i praktiske hjemmehjelpsoppgaver
  • Ivareta rollen som primærkontakt etter gjeldene rutiner
  • Bidra til at brukermedvirkning blir ivaretatt og legge til rette for godt samarbeid med pårørende og tilby nødvendig pårørendestøtte
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid med fastlege og andre kommunale instanser
  • Ansvarlig for veiledning av lærlinger, elever og kollegaer

Er du den vi ser etter?

Du har:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig
  • Gode IKT-kunnskaper

Det er ønskelig at du har:

  • Erfaring fra arbeid i hjemmetjenesten
  • Relevant videreutdanning på fagskolenivå

Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet. I tillegg til å ha gode samarbeidsevner og være en positiv bidragsyter til arbeidsmiljøet, ser vi etter deg som har disse egenskapene:

  • Positiv, fleksibel, trygg og løsningsorientert
  • Arbeider selvstendig og trives med et høyt arbeidstempo
  • Har evnen til å håndtere og strukturere varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ser og forstår betydningen av et godt tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Har evnen til å gi bruker god og individuell omsorg
  • Har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter

Før ansettelse må du kunne legge fram godkjent politiattest som ikke er eldre enn tre måneder.

Dette får du hos oss

  • En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag – der du gjør en forskjell!
  • Godt faglig arbeidsmiljø med fokus på arbeidsnærvær.
  • Både langvakter og ordinære vakter i turnus.
  • Lønn etter gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk.
  • Gratis parkering.
  • Velferdsordninger for ansatte i kommunen.
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon gjennom KLP. Som KLP-medlem får du livsvarig pensjon, inkludert uføre- og etterlattepensjon – og gode medlemsfordeler i bank og forsikring.

Vil du bli en del av laget?

Søknad sendes elektronisk ved å klikke på «Søk her». Du kan laste opp relevante vitnemål og attester sammen med søknaden. Dersom du ikke har mulighet til å laste dem opp, kan du ta dem med til et eventuelt intervju.

Når søknadsfristen er utløpt, vil det utarbeides en offentlig søkerliste. Denne inneholder navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bostedskommune for alle søkere. Det følger av offentlighetsloven at opplysninger om deg som søker kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. I så fall vil du bli varslet før offentliggjøring.

title: Sr. Lead Biostatistician - Oncology Evidence Generation
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Senior Lead Biostatistician – Oncology Evidence Generation to join our team in Raleigh/Durham, NC.

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, First Shift

Job Summary:

Labcorp is seeking a Senior Lead Biostatistician to join our cross-functional Evidence Generation team, supporting a growing portfolio of oncology research initiatives, with a focus on observational clinical validity studies in minimal residual disease (MRD), alongside investigator-initiated studies, registries, and real-world evidence programs. This role will serve as the statistical lead across multiple studies, driving study design, analytical strategy, and execution to ensure high-quality, scientifically rigorous outputs.

The Senior Lead Biostatistician will act as a central statistical leader, partnering closely with clinical development, scientific, data, and operational teams, as well as external investigators and collaborators. This individual will ensure studies are appropriately designed, powered, and analyzed while delivering high-quality statistical outputs that support evidence generation, publication, and clinical adoption. The role plays a critical part in translating complex data into meaningful insights and advancing Labcorp’s precision oncology evidence strategy.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to and shape the design of MRD-focused studies, including clinical validity studies, registries, and real-world evidence programs, defining endpoints, analysis strategies, and overall statistical approach across multiple concurrent programs
  • Perform sample size and power calculations, support endpoint justification, and draft statistical sections of study protocols
  • Independently perform statistical analyses across diverse datasets (clinical, assay/validation, and real-world/registry data) using appropriate methods (e.g., regression, survival analysis, validation approaches), ensuring accuracy, reproducibility, and appropriate documentation
  • Serve as the statistical point of contact for assigned studies; partner with clinical, translational, and data teams, as well as external collaborators, to support study execution and communicate statistical concepts, methods, and results clearly to non-statistical stakeholders
  • Identify study risks and provide data-driven recommendations to support study integrity and decision-making
  • Develop, manage, and maintain statistical deliverables (analysis summaries, tables/listings/figures, study reports) and lead or contribute to the development of Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs)
  • Contribute to abstracts, manuscripts, and scientific presentations supporting evidence generation and publication strategy
  • Manage statistical deliverables across multiple concurrent studies, ensuring timelines, quality, and consistency of outputs
  • Lead or contribute to development of statistical templates, tools, and workflows, while building subject matter expertise in MRD and oncology study methodologies

Minimum Requirements:

  • MS in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • 6 or more years of experience in clinical biostatistics within biotechnology, diagnostics, CRO, or related healthcare environments
  • 5 or more years of experience in statistical programming (R, SAS or equivalent acceptable)
  • 3 or more years of experience supporting clinical research studies, including observational studies, registries, and/or assay validation efforts
  • 3 or more years of experience independently managing statistical analyses and deliverables across multiple concurrent studies

Preferred Requirements:

  • PhD in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • 3 or more years of experience in oncology research, biomarker-driven studies, or precision oncology
  • 3 or more years of experience with real-world data, registry-based research, or observational study designs
  • 3 or more years of experience contributing to scientific publications, including abstracts, manuscripts, or conference presentations
  • 1 or more years of experience with MRD, ctDNA, genomics/NGS-based assays, or molecular diagnostics
  • 1 or more years of experience with clinical study documentation and regulatory standards (e.g., protocols, SAPs, GCP principles)

Additional Job Standards:

  • Strong foundation in clinical study design and applied statistical leadership, including sample size estimation, power calculations, and endpoint evaluation
  • Experience applying statistical methods to clinical, real-world, and/or assay validation datasets, including regression and survival/time-to-event analysis
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to clearly convey complex statistical concepts to diverse scientific and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with high attention to detail and commitment to data quality and scientific rigor
  • Experience working in collaborative research environments involving academic or external investigator partnerships
  • Occasional travel for internal meetings or external collaborator engagement, as needed (≤10–15%)

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. title: Senior Product Manager Disruption Management
description:
Powering the agentic revolution in travel. Sabre is an AI-native technology leader, backed by one of the world’s largest travel data clouds. Built on an open, modular, cloud-native architecture, Sabre serves as the backbone for both established leaders and bold, new disruptors, guiding them to the next age of travel retailing through intelligent, connected, and personalized experiences. With AI at its core and operating at unparalleled scale, Sabre transforms insights into innovation, empowering airlines, hoteliers, agencies and other partners to retail, distribute and fulfill travel worldwide.


Role Overview


This role will own the product vision for simplifying and automating how schedule changes are identified, evaluated, communicated, and resolved, helping airlines reduce manual servicing while delivering a better traveller experience.

The Senior Product Manager will work across airline operations, reservations, servicing, reaccommodation, notifications, digital channels, and partner ecosystems to build scalable capabilities that support airlines with different business models, workflows, and levels of automation.


Key Responsibilities


Product Strategy & Ownership


Define how the product evolves from manual and rules-based servicing towards increasingly automated, intelligent, and self-service schedule change management.

  • Translate airline operational challenges and traveller needs into clear product requirements, features, and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritise investments based on customer value, operational impact, strategic alignment, and technical feasibility.

Schedule Change & Airline Servicing Expertise

  • Develop solutions covering the end-to-end schedule change lifecycle, including: Detection and classification of itinerary changes.Assessment of impacted passengers and itineraries.Airline policies and reaccommodation rules.Identification and presentation of alternative flights.Automated and agent-assisted reaccommodation.Traveller notification and acceptance.Digital self-service.Ticketing and servicing considerations.Handling of ancillary products and associated services.Interline and partner-airline scenarios.Exceptions requiring manual intervention.
  • Ensure solutions can support different airline policies, thresholds, workflows, and customer servicing strategies.
  • Partner with adjacent product areas such as DCS, reservations, disruption management/IROPs, retailing, customer servicing, notifications, and airport solutions.

Customer & Market Leadership

  • Engage directly with airline customers to understand current workflows, pain points, requirements, and desired business outcomes.
  • Serve as a product subject-matter expert in customer discussions, workshops, demonstrations, and roadmap reviews.
  • Monitor airline industry trends and evolving expectations around automated servicing and traveller self-service.
  • Balance individual airline requirements with the development of scalable product capabilities.

Execution & Delivery

  • Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, operations, and other product teams to translate strategy into executable product increments.
  • Develop clear epics, requirements, acceptance criteria, and business priorities.
  • Make product trade-offs across customer demand, technical complexity, operational risk, and strategic value.
  • Manage dependencies with upstream and downstream airline systems and product teams.
  • Partner with delivery teams throughout development, testing, rollout, and adoption.

Commercial & Business Outcomes

  • Build business cases for product investment and clearly articulate expected customer and business value.
  • Define and track product success measures such as: Schedule changes resolved automatically.Reduction in manual servicing.Traveller self-service adoption.Time to resolution.Contact-centre/agent workload reduction.Customer adoption and satisfaction.
  • Support commercial teams with product positioning, customer proposals, and strategic opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant product management experience, preferably within airline technology, travel technology, reservations, passenger servicing, disruption management, or airline operations.
  • Strong understanding of airline passenger servicing and itinerary management.
  • Experience defining product strategy and managing complex, cross-functional roadmaps.
  • Ability to translate complicated airline workflows and business rules into scalable technology solutions.
  • Experience working with engineering and architecture teams on highly integrated enterprise products.
  • Strong customer-facing skills, including discovery, workshops, requirements discussions, and executive presentations.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise competing customer, commercial, operational, and technology requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to use data and customer insights to guide product decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with airline reservations/PSS, schedule change, reaccommodation, IROPs, ticketing, or passenger servicing.
  • Knowledge of airline distribution and servicing concepts, including PNRs, segments, ticketing and EMDs.
  • Understanding of interline and codeshare servicing scenarios.
  • Familiarity with modern airline retailing concepts, including Offers and Orders, would be beneficial.
  • Experience building highly automated or rules-driven airline servicing products.
  • Experience with airline digital self-service and customer notification journeys.
  • Experience managing products operating at significant transaction scale and requiring high availability.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will make Schedule Change progressively simpler, more automated, and more customer-friendly.

They will help move airlines away from labour-intensive servicing towards capabilities that can intelligently identify impacted travellers, apply airline policies, offer appropriate alternatives, automate routine scenarios, enable traveller self-service, and direct agents towards the exceptions that genuinely require human intervention.

Ultimately, the role will deliver measurable value across three dimensions: better traveller experiences, lower airline servicing costs, and greater operational efficiency.

Ideal Candidate

This person combines airline domain expertise, strong product leadership, and customer empathy. They are comfortable moving from a detailed conversation about servicing rules or reaccommodation logic to an executive discussion about automation, customer experience, revenue protection, and operating cost.

They don't simply manage a backlog. They understand the problem, define where the product should go, and bring customers, technology teams, and business stakeholders together to get there.

We will give careful consideration to your application and review your details against the position criteria. You will receive separate notification as your application progresses.

Please note that only candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role will proceed in the selection process.

title: Actuarial Manager (Quản lý Định phí bảo hiểm)
description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed.

Job Purpose / Mục tiêu vị trí
• Manage end-to-end delivery of assigned actuarial transformation initiatives for Prudential Vietnam, ensuring agreed scope, timeline, quality, controls and business outcomes are achieved.
Quản lý triển khai end-to-end các sáng kiến chuyển đổi Actuarial được phân công cho Prudential Việt Nam, đảm bảo đạt phạm vi, thời hạn, chất lượng, kiểm soát và kết quả kinh doanh đã thống nhất.

• Translate business requirements into practical delivery plans across data, automation, reporting, workflow and process improvement initiatives, working closely with Actuarial SMEs, Technology, vendors and business users.
Chuyển yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thành kế hoạch triển khai thực tế cho các sáng kiến dữ liệu, tự động hóa, báo cáo, workflow và cải tiến quy trình, phối hợp chặt chẽ với chuyên gia Actuarial, Technology, nhà cung cấp và người dùng nghiệp vụ.

• Support sustainable actuarial capability building by ensuring delivered solutions are tested, documented, adopted by users and transitioned effectively into BAU ownership.
Hỗ trợ xây dựng năng lực Actuarial bền vững bằng cách đảm bảo giải pháp được kiểm tra, tài liệu hóa, người dùng áp dụng và chuyển giao hiệu quả sang chủ sở hữu BAU.

Job Accountability / Trách nhiệm chính

  • Manage end-to-end delivery of assigned actuarial transformation initiatives for Prudential Vietnam, ensuring agreed scope, timeline, quality, controls and business outcomes are achieved.
  • Translate business requirements into practical delivery plans across data, automation, reporting, workflow and process improvement initiatives, working closely with Actuarial SMEs, Technology, vendors and business users.
  • Support sustainable actuarial capability building by ensuring delivered solutions are tested, documented, adopted by users and transitioned effectively into BAU ownership.
  • Lead day-to-day delivery of assigned initiatives from scoping, planning and design through build, testing, deployment, handover and BAU transition.
  • Work with Actuarial leads, users and initiative owners to clarify requirements, define deliverables, confirm acceptance criteria and secure business sign-off.
  • Coordinate internal teams, Technology, vendors and shared-service resources to manage dependencies, resolve issues and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, milestones, actions, risks, issues and decisions, and provide regular status updates to the Senior Manager or relevant governance forum.
  • Support solution design review to ensure outputs are practical, controlled, scalable and aligned with actuarial business needs and technology standards.
  • Prepare users for adoption through training, user guides, testing support and hypercare, ensuring solutions are embedded into BAU ways of working.

Job Requirements / Yêu cầu


  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial, finance, mathematics, data science, computer science or related discipline.
    Tốt nghiệp đại học chuyên ngành Actuarial, tài chính, toán học, khoa học dữ liệu, khoa học máy tính hoặc ngành liên quan.
  • Good actuarial exam progress; Associate designation or relevant professional qualification is preferred.
    Có tiến độ tốt trong các kỳ thi Actuarial; ưu tiên cấp Associate hoặc chứng chỉ chuyên môn liên quan.
  • At least 5 years of life insurance actuarial, finance transformation, data, reporting or project delivery experience.
    Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong Actuarial bảo hiểm nhân thọ, chuyển đổi tài chính, dữ liệu, báo cáo hoặc triển khai dự án.
  • Experience managing project plans, requirements, testing, implementation, risks/issues, dependencies and stakeholder updates.
    Có kinh nghiệm quản lý kế hoạch dự án, yêu cầu, kiểm thử, triển khai, rủi ro/vấn đề, phụ thuộc và cập nhật stakeholder.
  • Experience in actuarial data, reporting automation, reconciliation, modelling outputs, workflow solutions or process improvement is preferred.
    Ưu tiên kinh nghiệm về dữ liệu Actuarial, tự động hóa báo cáo, đối soát, kết quả mô hình, giải pháp workflow hoặc cải tiến quy trình.
  • Able to coordinate across Actuarial, Technology, vendors and shared-service teams, with strong problem-solving and follow-through.
    Có khả năng điều phối giữa Actuarial, Technology, nhà cung cấp và shared-service, với năng lực giải quyết vấn đề và theo dõi đến cùng.
  • Good communication, writing and presentation skills; fluent English.
    Kỹ năng giao tiếp, viết và trình bày tốt; tiếng Anh thành thạo.

title: Technician Assistant Overnight
description:
VCA Shoreline Veterinary Referral and Emergency Center is hiring a full time Technician Assistant to join our team! We are seeking an individual who is positive, energetic, eager to learn, and works well on a team.


About Us

VCA Shoreline is a state-of-the-art medical facility providing a range of specialty, critical care and emergency services exclusively for dogs and cats. We deliver the best medical care for pets and the best experience for pet owners.


Located in Shelton, our veterinary specialists, technicians and pet-friendly support staff are trained to the highest standards. Their thorough knowledge of the latest procedures and medicines ensures that our patients receive the best in preventive and healing care.


Check out our website here:


Potential Schedule: Full time, Overnight Sun-Wed 10pm-8am or Sun-Tues



Compensation: $19.00 - $20.00 / hr based on skill set and experience.



Technician Assistant duties include:

  • Restraining animals for doctor and technician
  • Administering medications under the supervision of the technician
  • Assisting with obtaining lab samples
  • Running labs on our in-house machines (including learning how to troubleshoot machines)
  • Cleaning kennels and replacing bedding for hospitalized patients
  • Offering food and water to hospitalized patients under the supervision of the technician
  • Walking hospitalized patients under the supervision of the technician
  • Assisting with sedated or anesthetized procedures as needed (set up and break down, cleaning, moving patients in and out of O/R, etc.)
  • General cleaning duties inside and outside the hospital, including laundry, sweeping/mopping, restocking medical supplies, maintaining medical equipment
  • Other duties as assigned



The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, both written and oral, and be able to effectively communicate with others in a fast-paced environment.

  • Growth & leadership opportunities
  • Medical, Dental & Vision
  • Career development programs
  • Veterinary Technician education tuition support and scholarships
  • Generous hospital discounts and product discounts
  • Employer-paid life, long- and short-term disability insurance
  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • 401(k)
  • Free mental health resources and wellness subscriptions (Headspace)
  • Referral bonuses
  • Infertility benefits
  • Competitive wage



Please take a moment to view our brief video on life as a veterinary technician with VCA from a technician’s point of view.

We create and support an inclusive work environment where you can focus on your career, your happiness, and the patients you serve.

title: Sykepleier
description:
Et overordnet perspektiv på kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester er at flere skal kunne bo hjemme og få nødvendig helsehjelp der de bor. Er du sykepleier med ønske om å videreutvikle tjenesten i tråd med morgendagens omsorg, ønsker vi at du søker jobb hos oss. Vi har nå ledig 100 % fast stilling som sykepleier i hjemmetjenesten.

Som sykepleier i hjemmetjenesten er det viktig at du kan identifisere deg med Tysvær kommune sine medarbeiderverdier ROMA; raus, open, modig og ansvarlig. Tysvær er i en spennende endring og hjemmetjenesten skal til neste år flytte over i kommunens hittil største prosjekt - Helsekvartalet.

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver

  • Ansvarlig for sykepleiefaglige observasjoner, tiltak og oppfølging av pasienter etter vedtak
  • Anvende avansert sykepleie i pasientens hjem
  • Medisinhåndtering
  • Bidra til å sikre forsvarlig pleie og omsorgstjenester i tråd med kvalitetskrav og lovverk
  • Sørge for at nødvendige sykepleiefaglige prosedyrer og rutiner er utarbeidet
  • Bidra til at brukermedvirkning blir ivaretatt og legge til rette for godt samarbeid med pårørende og tilby nødvendig pårørendestøtte
  • Tett tverrfaglig samarbeid med spesialisthelsetjenesten, fastlegen og andre kommunale instanser
  • Ansvarlig for veiledning av studenter og kollegaer
  • Sykepleiefaglig ansvarlig på vakt etter delegasjon

Er du den vi ser etter?

Du har:

  • Offentlig godkjent utdanning som sykepleier/vernepleier
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig
  • Gode IKT-kunnskaper

Sykepleiere med relevant videreutdanning, og 3. års studenter oppfordres til å søke.

Vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet. I tillegg til å ha gode samarbeidsevner og være en positiv bidragsyter til arbeidsmiljøet, ser vi etter deg som har disse egenskapene:

  • Positiv, fleksibel, trygg og løsningsorientert
  • Arbeider effektivt og selvstendig, samt kunne jobbe i team
  • Har evne til å håndtere og strukturere varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ha god arbeidskapasitet og trives med et høyt arbeidstempo
  • Ha evne til å identifisere den enkelte brukers egne ressurser, og kunne gi bruker god og individuell omsorg
  • Ha gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsferdigheter, samt evne til å danne relasjoner med både bruker, pårørende og kollegaer

Før ansettelse må du kunne legge fram godkjent politiattest som ikke er eldre enn tre måneder.

Dette får du hos oss

  • En variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag – der du gjør en forskjell!
  • Godt faglig arbeidsmiljø med fokus på arbeidsnærvær
  • Internundervisning og mulighet for veiledning i små grupper
  • Mulighet for langvaktsordning
  • Gratis parkering
  • Lønn etter gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon gjennom KLP. Som KLP-medlem får du livsvarig pensjon, inkludert uføre- og etterlattepensjon – og gode medlemsfordeler i bank og forsikring.

Vil du bli en del av laget?

Søknad sendes elektronisk ved å klikke på «Søk her». Du kan laste opp relevante vitnemål og attester sammen med søknaden. Dersom du ikke har mulighet til å laste dem opp, kan du ta dem med til et eventuelt intervju.

Når søknadsfristen er utløpt, vil det utarbeides en offentlig søkerliste. Denne inneholder navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bostedskommune for alle søkere. Det følger av offentlighetsloven at opplysninger om deg som søker kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. I så fall vil du bli varslet før offentliggjøring.

title: Libraries Adviser - Multiple Locations across City
description:
Libraries Advisor
Multiple Locations across City

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850 (pro-rata for part-time positions)
Hours: 36 per week, 52 weeks

We are recruiting Library Advisor staff to join our library teams in a number of library locations across the city. (Advert states Waverley Court by default)

Posts are shift working and include some Saturdays and evenings.

Our libraries are at the heart of their communities. Members of staff work with their community to help create a thriving place to live and to help reduce poverty and inequality. We support users to develop their digital skills, and we help them get the information and advice they need. Our staff encourage babies and children to develop their language and reading ability through programmes like Bookbug and Read, Write Count. We help those of all ages in the community who struggle with loneliness by providing them with a place to meet and connect. We provide a full range of books and other resources to help everyone to live, learn and work.

Young people are regular users of libraries and can range from structured activity to simply meeting up with friends. It is vital that our staff have a broad understanding of the issues faced by young people and that individually or as part of the team, you are willing to engage with and support young people and maintain a positive, safe and trusted environment. Any youth engagement experience will be welcomed.

To be a successful member of our team you must be able to show that you can deliver excellent customer service and that you can understand the needs of different parts of the community.

If you could be an effective team player in a service that puts customers first, please apply. If you are invited to interview, we will ask you your preferred hours and discuss with you the permanent and temporary positions. Whilst we recruit to teams in individual libraries, staff are expected to work in any library across the city.

The City of Edinburgh Council is committed to recruiting people who will deliver high quality public services to our diverse communities within the city of Edinburgh. As an equal opportunity employer, we recognise and value the benefits that a diverse workforce with different values, beliefs, experience, and backgrounds brings. We are committed to building an inclusive recruitment culture where all people feel valued, included and able to be at their best.

We would like to encourage conversations with people who have not previously thought about employment within a Local Authority. We warmly invite people to take this opportunity to demonstrate their ability regardless of age, disability, sex, gender, race, marital status, sexual orientation, religious or political beliefs.

This post is regulated work with children and/or protected adults under the Protection of Vulnerable Groups (Scotland) Act 2007. The preferred candidate will be required to join the PVG Scheme or undergo a PVG Scheme update check. Where an individual has spent a continuous period of 3 months or more out with the UK in the last 5 years, an Overseas Criminal Record Check will be required. You will be required to provide this check. An unconditional offer of employment and commencement in the post will be subject to the outcome of both these pre-employment checks being deemed satisfactory.

We're committed to creating a workplace culture where all our people feel valued, included and able to be their best at work, and we recognise the benefits that a diverse workforce with different values, beliefs, experience, and backgrounds brings to us as an organisation.

As part of our goal to improve our organisational culture and create a great place to work together for the people of Edinburgh, we want to make sure that we’re bringing the best people into our roles, not just in their skills and experience but also in their approach to work.

To help achieve this, we’re changing the way we interview and assess candidates by moving from a competency-based interview approach to a behavioural and technical (skills for the job) based approach. This new way of interviewing will allow us to assess how you think and how you would bring Our Behaviours of Respect, Integrity and Flexibility into your ways of working.

You can find out more on Our Behaviours web page Our Behaviours – The City of Edinburgh Council

Our salary range typically reflects the initial starting salary and annually increases until it reaches the top of the range.

Happy to talk flexible working.

Follow us on X at @edincounciljobs

title: Medewerker Customer Desk ES
location: Chubb Fire & Security B.V. Papendorpseweg 83, 3528 BJ Utrecht, Netherlands Chubb
description:
Vacature - Medewerker Customer Desk bij Chubb - Utrecht

Ben jij een klantgerichte duizendpoot met een passie voor service en administratie?

Heb jij uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en ben je in staat om klantvragen snel en adequaat te beantwoorden? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen als Medewerker Customer Desk:
Als Medewerker Customer Desk ben je, samen met je collega’s, verantwoordelijk voor een optimale servicedienstverlening aan onze klanten binnen de Business Unit Security. De Customer Desk omvat verschillende disciplines, waaronder servicedesk, planning, facturatie en werkvoorbereiding.

Wat ga je doen? In deze rol ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten die vragen hebben over het onderhoud en storingen van beveiligingssystemen. Je verwerkt binnenkomende opdrachten. Door het stellen van de juiste vragen zorg je ervoor dat werkorders correct en volledig in onze systemen worden ingevoerd, zodat de planners en monteurs direct aan de slag kunnen.

Dit past goed als je graag het volgende doet:

  • Het verwerken van servicewerkbonnen en het opmaken van facturen;
  • Beantwoorden van klantvragen over facturen en klantafspraken;
  • Verwerken en beheren van servicecontracten en gegeven;
  • Opstellen van offertes en verwerken van orders;
  • Aanmaken van werkbonnen en service orders;, incl. het vastleggen van alle benodigde informatie voor de planning;
  • Controleren van onderhoudsrapportages op volledigheid en juistheid;
  • Registreren en (waar mogelijk) oplossen van klachten over facturatie, leveringen, producten of diensten;
  • Uitvoeren van aanvullende administratieve werkzaamheden ter ondersteuning van een efficiënt serviceproces.
  • Klantenservice: jij bent het gezicht van Chubb bij het aannemen van storingen;
  • Registreren en verwerken van storingsmeldingen via telefoon en e-mail;
  • Aanmaken van werkorders met correcte en volledige informatie;
  • Samenwerken met de planner en collega’s van de Customer Desk om klantvragen optimaal op te lossen.

Wat breng jij mee als onze toekomstige Medewerker Customer Desk:
Om de functie te kunnen vervullen is het noodzakelijk dat je jezelf in onderstaande zaken herkent:

  • MBO werk- en denkniveau en affiniteit met klantenservice en administratie.
  • Je vindt het leuk om klanten telefonisch te woord te staan en bent communicatief sterk.
  • Administratief vaardig en accuraat in je werk.
  • Klantgericht en een echte teamspeler.
  • Nieuwsgierig en geïnteresseerd in onze diensten en producten.
  • Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en houdt het overzicht in een dynamische omgeving.

Wij willen ervoor zorgen dat jij een tevreden Medewerker Customer Desk bent, daarom bieden wij:
De kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen in deze functie. Wij zijn een groeiende organisatie waar kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid de drijvende krachten zijn. Ondernemerschap en veiligheid zit in ons DNA en daarom blijven we groeien en innoveren en bieden we volop kansen. Je hoeft ze alleen maar te grijpen.

Wij bieden je:

  • CAO Metaal en Techniek / Technisch installatiebedrijf is van toepassing;
  • Een uitstekend arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, afgestemd op jouw ervaring en opleidingsniveau;
  • 8% vakantiegeld en pensioenregeling;
  • 25 vakantiedagen en de keuze uit 13 ADV-dagen per jaar of een hogere bruto maandloon;
  • Ruime mogelijkheid om opleidingen te volgen en jezelf te ontwikkelen;
  • Ruime doorgroeimogelijkheden.

Heb jij de juiste ervaring en vaardigheden of bijna?
We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

Heb je meer informatie nodig?
Heb je nog vragen over de functie of over werken bij Chubb? Neem dan contact op met Nadine Alberts en stuur een whatsapp bericht.

Disclaimer voor werving- en selectiebureaus:
Chubb Fire & Security doet er alles aan om je privacy te waarborgen. In het privacy statement op onze website lichten wij toe hoe wij omgaan met jouw persoonlijke gegevens. title: Actuarial Manager (Quản lý Định phí bảo hiểm)
description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed.

Job Purpose / Mục tiêu vị trí
• Manage end-to-end delivery of assigned actuarial transformation initiatives for Prudential Vietnam, ensuring agreed scope, timeline, quality, controls and business outcomes are achieved.
Quản lý triển khai end-to-end các sáng kiến chuyển đổi Actuarial được phân công cho Prudential Việt Nam, đảm bảo đạt phạm vi, thời hạn, chất lượng, kiểm soát và kết quả kinh doanh đã thống nhất.

• Translate business requirements into practical delivery plans across data, automation, reporting, workflow and process improvement initiatives, working closely with Actuarial SMEs, Technology, vendors and business users.
Chuyển yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thành kế hoạch triển khai thực tế cho các sáng kiến dữ liệu, tự động hóa, báo cáo, workflow và cải tiến quy trình, phối hợp chặt chẽ với chuyên gia Actuarial, Technology, nhà cung cấp và người dùng nghiệp vụ.

• Support sustainable actuarial capability building by ensuring delivered solutions are tested, documented, adopted by users and transitioned effectively into BAU ownership.
Hỗ trợ xây dựng năng lực Actuarial bền vững bằng cách đảm bảo giải pháp được kiểm tra, tài liệu hóa, người dùng áp dụng và chuyển giao hiệu quả sang chủ sở hữu BAU.

Job Responsibilities / Phạm vi công việc

  • Manage end-to-end delivery of assigned actuarial transformation initiatives for Prudential Vietnam, ensuring agreed scope, timeline, quality, controls and business outcomes are achieved.
  • Translate business requirements into practical delivery plans across data, automation, reporting, workflow and process improvement initiatives, working closely with Actuarial SMEs, Technology, vendors and business users.
  • Support sustainable actuarial capability building by ensuring delivered solutions are tested, documented, adopted by users and transitioned effectively into BAU ownership.
  • Lead day-to-day delivery of assigned initiatives from scoping, planning and design through build, testing, deployment, handover and BAU transition.
  • Work with Actuarial leads, users and initiative owners to clarify requirements, define deliverables, confirm acceptance criteria and secure business sign-off.
  • Coordinate internal teams, Technology, vendors and shared-service resources to manage dependencies, resolve issues and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, milestones, actions, risks, issues and decisions, and provide regular status updates to the Senior Manager or relevant governance forum.
  • Support solution design review to ensure outputs are practical, controlled, scalable and aligned with actuarial business needs and technology standards.
  • Prepare users for adoption through training, user guides, testing support and hypercare, ensuring solutions are embedded into BAU ways of working.

Job Requirements / Yêu cầu


  • Bachelor’s degree in actuarial, finance, mathematics, data science, computer science or related discipline.
    Tốt nghiệp đại học chuyên ngành Actuarial, tài chính, toán học, khoa học dữ liệu, khoa học máy tính hoặc ngành liên quan.
  • Good actuarial exam progress; Associate designation or relevant professional qualification is preferred.
    Có tiến độ tốt trong các kỳ thi Actuarial; ưu tiên cấp Associate hoặc chứng chỉ chuyên môn liên quan.
  • At least 5 years of life insurance actuarial, finance transformation, data, reporting or project delivery experience.
    Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong Actuarial bảo hiểm nhân thọ, chuyển đổi tài chính, dữ liệu, báo cáo hoặc triển khai dự án.
  • Experience managing project plans, requirements, testing, implementation, risks/issues, dependencies and stakeholder updates.
    Có kinh nghiệm quản lý kế hoạch dự án, yêu cầu, kiểm thử, triển khai, rủi ro/vấn đề, phụ thuộc và cập nhật stakeholder.
  • Experience in actuarial data, reporting automation, reconciliation, modelling outputs, workflow solutions or process improvement is preferred.
    Ưu tiên kinh nghiệm về dữ liệu Actuarial, tự động hóa báo cáo, đối soát, kết quả mô hình, giải pháp workflow hoặc cải tiến quy trình.
  • Able to coordinate across Actuarial, Technology, vendors and shared-service teams, with strong problem-solving and follow-through.
    Có khả năng điều phối giữa Actuarial, Technology, nhà cung cấp và shared-service, với năng lực giải quyết vấn đề và theo dõi đến cùng.
  • Good communication, writing and presentation skills; fluent English.
    Kỹ năng giao tiếp, viết và trình bày tốt; tiếng Anh thành thạo.

title: Vi har ledig vikariat for helsefagarbeider / assistent med relevant erfaring
description:
Avdelingen yter tjenester til personer med diagnoser innen psykisk og fysisk utviklingshemming som er hjemlet i Lov om kommunale omsorg og helsetjenester med det formål at den enkelte får mulighet til å ha en aktiv og meningsfylt hverdag og motta nødvendig praktisk bistand og veiledning i dagliglivet.

Toranesgata 69 er en omsorgsbolig hvor det bor 6 personer med ulike bistandsbehov

Er du engasjert og omsorgsfull i tillegg til å ha de kvalifikasjonene vi etterspør, så er du kanskje akkurat den rette til å bli en del av vårt supre team i Toranesgata.

Hos oss er det nå ledig:

  • 1 svangerskapsvikariat på 23, 06% i perioden 18.01.27 til 13.12.27 som helsefagarbeider eller assistent med relevant erfaring. Arbeidstid på helg men med muligheter for ekstravakter på tilkalling i ukedager

Arbeidsområde / arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Praktisk bistand, veiledning og motivasjonsarbeid i forhold til mennesker med utviklingshemming
  • Være en del av et team som jobber med å utvikle og opprettholde et meningsfult tjenestetilbud til mennesker med sammensatte og ulike behov
  • Pårørendesamarbeid / tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Nettverksarbeid / bidra til en aktiv og meningsfull fritid

Kvalifikasjonskrav:

  • Førerkort kl B
  • norsk autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider eller assistent med erfaring fra arbeid med personer med psykisk utviklingshemming
  • Du må kunne bruke data som verktøy.
  • Gyldig politiattest ved tiltredelse, jf. Helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4
  • Må beherske norsk muntlig og skriftlig tilstrekkelig til å utøve yrket forsvarlig

Personlig egnethet / personlige egenskaper:

  • Du må ha evnen til å jobbe selvstendig og samtidig kunne være en bidragsyter i et team.
  • Du må ha gode kommunikasjon- og samhandlingsferdigheter med tjenestemottaker og andre samarbeidspartnere
  • Du må være nytenkende og reflekterende
  • Du må ha evnen til å skape gode relasjoner.
  • Du må ha interesse for målrettet miljøarbeid.
  • Du må ha evnen til å utvikle et godt pårørendesamarbeid.

personlig egnethet vil bli særlig vektlagt.

Vi kan tilby:

  • Faglig opplæring og utvikling
  • Et godt og spennende tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø
  • muligheten til å ta ekstravakter som tilkallingsvikar i tillegg til stillingsprosenten

Arbeidstid: Turnus med arbeid annenhver helg med dag og aftenvakter.

De to siste referanser må oppgis. Aktuelle søkere blir innkalt til intervju.

Stillingskode og lønn fastsettes på grunnlag av utdanning, lønnsansiennitet og intern lønnsstruktur. Lønnsansiennitet beregnes ut fra vitnemål og attester, som legges ved søknaden. Det gis tillegg for relevant tilleggs-/videreutdanning.

Fortrinnsrett for interne søkere vil bli tatt hensyn til ved ansettelsen.

Attester må legges ved i søknaden.

Politiattest skal fremskaffes først når søkeren har fått tilbud om stilling. Stillingen tilbys under forutsetning av at attesten ikke viser anmerkninger som enten fører til utelukkelse fra ansettelse, eller at søker finnes uegnet etter Rana kommunes vurderinger.

Rana kommune praktiserer mer offentlighet. I henhold til Offentlighetsloven §25 kan opplysninger om søker bli offentliggjort selv om søker ber om anonymitet.

Spørsmål knyttet til stillingen og ansettelsesprosessen kan rettes til

Rigmor Tveråli, tlf.: 95962770 eller epost: rigmor.tverali@rana.kommune.no

Søknad skal sendes via elektronisk søknadsskjema, se link på denne side.

title: Libraries Adviser - Multiple Locations across City
description:
Libraries Advisor
Multiple Locations across City

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850 (pro-rata for part-time)
Hours: 9 per week, 52 weeks

We are recruiting Library Advisor staff to join our library teams in a number of library locations across the city.

Posts are shift working and include Saturdays and evenings.

Our libraries are at the heart of their communities. Members of staff work with their community to help create a thriving place to live and to help reduce poverty and inequality. We support users to develop their digital skills, and we help them get the information and advice they need. Our staff encourage babies and children to develop their language and reading ability through programmes like Bookbug and Read, Write Count. We help those of all ages in the community who struggle with loneliness by providing them with a place to meet and connect. We provide a full range of books and other resources to help everyone to live, learn and work.

Young people are regular users of libraries and can range from structured activity to simply meeting up with friends. It is vital that our staff have a broad understanding of the issues faced by young people and that individually or as part of the team, you are willing to engage with and support young people and maintain a positive, safe and trusted environment. Any youth engagement experience will be welcomed.

To be a successful member of our team you must be able to show that you can deliver excellent customer service and that you can understand the needs of different parts of the community.

If you could be an effective team player in a service that puts customers first, please apply. If you are invited to interview, we will ask you your preferred hours and discuss with you the permanent and temporary positions. Whilst we recruit to teams in individual libraries, staff are expected to work in any library across the city.

description:
About us

BeOne is a global oncology company that is discovering and developing innovative treatments that are more affordable and accessible to cancer patients worldwide. With a broad portfolio, we are expediting development of our diverse pipeline of novel therapeutics through our internal capabilities and collaborations. We are committed to radically improving access to medicines for far more patients who need them. Our growing global team of more than 10,000 colleagues spans five continents, with administrative offices in Basel, Beijing, and Cambridge, U.S. To learn more about BeOne, please visit and follow us on LinkedIn and X (formerly known as Twitter).

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

Job Description:

General Description:

BeOne is seeking a compliance professional to help lead the Healthcare Compliance programs in Japan (and potentially other markets in region). Reporting to Head of Compliance, APAC, this is an excellent opportunity to serve as the primary interface for Japan commercial organizations to support the launch of new BeOne therapies while at the same time contributing to the Company’s geographic expansion in those markets. The position will contribute to the development and implementation of organizational strategies, policies and practices, and work with the Japan Leadership team to integrate appropriate healthcare, corporate and other compliance controls to guide the Company’s operations. The position will be based in Japan.

title: Bestuursadviseurs
description:
Functietitel: Bestuursadviseurs
Aantal uren: 32 tot 36 uur per week
Werk- en denkniveau: hbo/ wo

Wil jij werken in het hart van het lokaal bestuur en een directe bijdrage leveren aan de samenwerking tussen bestuur en organisatie? Als bestuursadviseur ondersteun je twee wethouders en help je mee om bestuurlijke processen soepel, zorgvuldig en integraal te laten verlopen.
Ben jij bestuurlijk sensitief, organisatorisch sterk en voel je je thuis in een dynamische omgeving? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren.

Deze rol is nieuw binnen onze gemeente. Wij zoeken twee bestuursadviseurs.

Wat je gaat doen voor Middelburg
Als bestuursadviseur werk je voor twee wethouders. Je bent hun klankbord, zorgt voor een goede afstemming en opvolging van afspraken en bewaakt de integraliteit van besluitvormingsprocessen.

Je maakt deel uit van het cluster Algemeen Bestuur. Een professioneel en betrokken team dat naast jou en je collega-bestuursadviseur, bestaat uit twee politiek-bestuurlijk strategisch adviseurs en een algemeen bestuursadviseur. Samen zorgen jullie voor een sterke verbinding tussen bestuur, organisatie en samenleving.

In deze veelzijdige functie:

  • ondersteun je de wethouders bij portefeuillehoudersoverleggen en interne en externe overleggen;
  • leg je afspraken vast en bewaak je de voortgang en opvolging daarvan;
  • adviseer je over politiek-bestuurlijke besluitvormingsprocessen en heb je oog voor de belangen van interne en externe stakeholders;
  • bereid je commissie- en raadsvergaderingen voor en ben je hierbij, wanneer nodig, aanwezig;
  • bewaak je de samenhang tussen verschillende dossiers en portefeuilles en zorg je dat relevante collega's tijdig zijn aangehaakt;
  • toets je college- en raadsvoorstellen op kwaliteit, opbouw, externe oriëntatie en de juiste toepassing van participatie, geheimhouding en inspraak;
  • organiseer je trainingen en kennissessies om de kwaliteit van bestuurlijke stukken verder te versterken;
  • bouw je aan een waardevol netwerk en zet je dit in ter ondersteuning van de wethouders, een zorgvuldige besluitvorming en een sterke positionering van het college.


Kortom: een afwisselende functie waarin je dicht op het bestuur werkt, veel schakelt binnen de organisatie en een zichtbare bijdrage levert aan de kwaliteit van het lokaal bestuur in Middelburg.

Waarmee jij Middelburg versterkt

  • Afgeronde hbo- of wo opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van Bestuurskunde, Politicologie of een vergelijkbare studie;

  • Ervaring in een politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving, bij voorkeur als adviseur, bestuursondersteuner of in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Kennis van ambtelijke, bestuurlijke en politieke processen;

  • Goed ontwikkeld gevoel voor politiek bestuurlijke verhoudingen.

  • Organisatorisch sterk, goed kunnen plannen, prioriteren en overzicht kunnen houden in een dynamische omgeving waarin snel geschakeld moet worden.

  • Goede netwerkvaardigheden en het op een natuurlijke wijze met elkaar weten te verbinden van mensen, belangen en perspectieven.

Daar staat tegenover

  • Een brutosalaris van maximaal € 5.624 p/m op basis van een fulltime dienstverband en een indicatieve inschaling in schaal 10.
  • De mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een maximum brutosalaris van € 6.422 p/m op basis van een fulltime dienstverband en een indicatieve inschaling in uitloopschaal 11.
  • Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 17,05% bovenop je brutosalaris. Dit bedrag kun je flexibel inzetten voor extra verlof, fietsproject, verduurzamingsproducten, sport en vitaliteit, aanvulling op het salaris, et cetera.
  • Een open en informele werkomgeving.
  • Goed bereikbaar stadskantoor op een mooie locatie aan het kanaal.
  • Flexibele werktijden waarin hybride werken wordt gefaciliteerd met een thuiswerkvergoeding, inrichting thuiswerkplek en een smartphone en laptop. En een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.
  • Een ontwikkelgerichte organisatie met ruimte voor opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen.
  • Een jaarlijkse tegemoetkoming in de premie voor je ziektekostenverzekering.
  • (Deels) doorbetaald ouderschapsverlof voor ouders met jonge kinderen.

Meer weten en solliciteren
Voor meer informatie over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met Sabine Bierens, afdelingshoofd Wijk en Bestuur, tel. (0118) 67 53 24.

title: Principal Network DevOps Engineer
description:
• Hybrid work environment in Sydney CBD
  • 18mth Fixed Term Contract opportunity supporting a major vulnerability management and network security uplift
  • Lead the technical evolution of enterprise networking through automation, secure engineering and Network DevOps practices

About the business/role/team

The Reserve Bank of Australia’s Network Services team is responsible for engineering and supporting the Bank’s enterprise network infrastructure and associated network services.


We are seeking an experienced Principal Network DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership to a team of Network DevOps Engineers supporting a significant Vulnerability Management and Hardening uplift. The role will work closely with the Network Engineering Team Lead and collaborate across Cyber Security, Architecture, Operations, project teams and technology vendors.

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who can bring together deep enterprise networking expertise with DevOps, automation and modern engineering practices, while providing technical direction, mentoring engineers and helping establish sustainable engineering capabilities.

About the role

As Principal Network DevOps Engineer, you will:

  • Provide technical leadership and direction to Network DevOps Engineers across network engineering, automation and security uplift activities.
  • Lead architecture and engineering decisions across complex enterprise network environments, including routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, data centre, firewalls, F5 and network security.
  • Establish and promote Network as Code and DevOps engineering practices, including Git, CI/CD, peer review, automated testing and controlled deployment.
  • Lead and enable network automation using technologies such as Python, Ansible, APIs and platform-native automation capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership for network vulnerability remediation, patching, hardening and configuration compliance.
  • Help establish repeatable and, where appropriate, automated pre-change and post-patch validation to protect network availability and resilience.
  • Provide technical oversight of network management and patching capabilities across technologies such as Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco FMC and F5 tooling.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable automation patterns, design principles and technical governance.
  • Lead technical assessment of automation and orchestration opportunities, including proofs of concept where appropriate.
  • Work closely with Cyber Security, Architecture and operational teams to manage technical risk, vulnerabilities, exceptions and remediation dependencies.
  • Provide technical leadership during complex incidents and critical or zero-day vulnerability responses.
  • Mentor and develop engineers, improve engineering capability and reduce key-person dependencies.
  • Ensure new engineering capabilities are supportable and can transition effectively into BAU operations.

About you:

You will bring:

  • Extensive experience designing, engineering and supporting large-scale enterprise network environments.
  • Strong technical expertise across network technologies such as routing and switching, BGP, WAN/SD-WAN, data centre networking, firewalls, load balancing and network security.
  • Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership to senior engineers and engineering teams.
  • Strong experience in network automation and Network DevOps, using technologies such as Python, Ansible, REST APIs and infrastructure/network-as-code approaches.
  • Practical experience with Git and CI/CD practices, including peer review, automated testing, deployment controls and rollback.
  • Experience with network management, security or automation platforms such as Cisco Catalyst Center, Cisco FMC and F5 BIG-IQ or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with vulnerability remediation, security patching, infrastructure hardening and configuration compliance.
  • Strong architecture and solution design capability, including the ability to assess technical options, risks, dependencies and operational impacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, technical governance and design assurance.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capability across complex production environments.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and building sustainable engineering capability.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear recommendations and decisions.
  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively across Network Services, Cyber Security, Architecture, Operations, projects and external vendors.

Be More

Working for an organisation that truly makes a difference to the people of Australia, we can offer development and career opportunities in a collaborative environment that supports your growth, wellbeing and promotes flexibility. Your individual growth and success drives the RBA forward as an organisation. Be more means you can do more, for yourself and for Australia.


Why RBA?


The RBA makes an important contribution to the Australian economy through the pursuit of national economic policy objectives and associated activities in financial markets and banking. We also issue Australia's banknotes and operate infrastructure critical to the payments system, all of which contribute to the welfare of the Australian people.


Made up of specialists across a wide range of fields, our people, values, and culture play a critical role in achieving our objectives. Striving to be Open & Dynamic, we consider and incorporate different perspectives, work across teams and are transparent with each other, whilst delivering quality together effectively and focusing on outcomes by prioritising, testing, learning, and refining as we go.


Our people conduct themselves with a high degree of integrity, while striving for excellence in the work they perform and the outcomes they achieve. We encourage intelligent inquiry and treat one another with respect while promoting the public interest through our efforts.

We know it is the growth and success of our people that drives the RBA forward. Come and make a bigger contribution while you build and develop your own skills too, because being more means you can do more, for yourself and for Australia.


The Reserve Bank of Australia is committed to equity, diversity and inclusion through key initiatives. We welcome and encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, those living with a disability and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We are committed to making the recruitment process fair and equitable for all candidates.

title: Brukerstyrt personlig assistent - 42% fast stilling
description:
Personlig assistanse er et serviceyrke og din oppgave er å yte service og god praktisk assistanse etter instruks, slik at arbeidsleder kan leve sitt liv på den måten den ønsker og har behov for. Det er arbeidsleder, som din nærmeste overordnede, som definerer hva din stilling skal inneholde og hvilke arbeidsoppgaver du til enhver tid skal utføre.

Brukerstyrt personlig assistent i 42% fast stilling ønskes til mann i 30-årene. Trenger bistand til alle dagligdagse gjøremål, være tilstede for å gi trygghet og stabilitet. Noe bistand til oppgaver i hjemmet som å bære ved, ta ut/inn av oppvaskmaskin, skifte på seng osv. Ønskes en person med forståelse for og innsikt i brukers behov. Opplæring vil bli gitt, men det er viktig at du som assistent har evnen til å tilpasse deg.

Arbeidstid vil fortrinnsvis være dag/kveld i ukedager, men kan også være aktuelt med vakt på helg ved behov. Arbeidsplan settes sammen med deg da det er rom for fleksibilitet.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Førerkort kl. B
  • Trygg og stabil

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr:

Årslønn i 100 % stilling: stillingstittel, Assistent off. stkode: 6572. Fra kr 418 600,- til kr 515 800,-.

Gode pensjonsordninger.

Annet:

Det er ønskelig at det stilles bil til disposisjon i tjenesten ved særlige behov. Bruk av egen bil i tjenesten vil bli kompensert i henhold til reiseregulativet (SGS 1001, §4).

Attester og vitnemål lastes inn som vedlegg til søknaden.

I henhold til offentleglova § 25, kan opplysninger om søker unntas i offentlig søkerliste dersom søkeren selv ber om det. Det gjøres oppmerksom på at en søknad kan bli gjort offentlig selv om søkeren har bedt om å ikke bli ført opp søkerlista. Søkeren vil i tilfellet bli varslet om dette.

title: FDV Liaison Officer
description:
· Permanent Full Time Contract

· Location: Ngarluma (Karratha) WA 6714

· Salary: $94,472 + super + NFP salary packaging benefits

· Make a meaningful difference to the lives of Australians in need

Life at Mission Australia

When you join the team at Mission Australia, you become part of a community who are determined to end homelessness and ensure people in need can thrive. United by our Christian purpose and values, we advocate for a fairer Australia, to meet the growing needs of people across the country. Together we’re building hope and possibility for all.

Find out more about us and our purpose.

Your Opportunity

For someone experiencing family and domestic violence, the hours after police attendance can be overwhelming. Fear, uncertainty and concern for their children often remain long after the immediate crisis has passed.

As a Family and Domestic Violence Liaison Officer, you will be the person who helps bring clarity, safety and support during some of life's most difficult moments.

Working as part of the Pilbara Family & Domestic Violence Coordinated Response Service (CRS), you will partner closely with WA Police, Child Protection and other community agencies to identify and support people at high risk of harm. Based in Karratha, this is an on-site position where you will provide trauma informed assessments, safety planning, advocacy, referrals and case coordination to help individuals and families build safer futures.

This is more than a case management role. It is an opportunity to empower people, strengthen community connections and ensure victim survivors receive the timely support they need to move forward with confidence.

This is a 7-day-a-week service, requiring weekend coverage as part of a rotating roster.

Your Key Responsibilities:

· Conduct assessment and triage of domestic violence incident reports in collaboration with WA Police and Child Protective Services, ensuring timely and accurate documentation.

· Undertake comprehensive risk assessments and develop safety plans using the Common Risk Assessment and Risk Management Framework.

· Respond promptly to urgent client safety needs, providing crisis‑focused intervention and support.

· Deliver home visits, community outreach, advocacy, and case coordination for victims and their children, usually over a 6–12‑month case period.

· Build strong working relationships with key stakeholders including police, courts, child protection, women’s refuges, and specialist FDV services.

· Participate in interagency meetings, steering committees, and forums to share information, contribute to best practice, and advocate for the needs of families affected by violence.

· Adhere to all internal and external policy and procedural requirements, including confidentiality, duty of care, OH&S, and statutory compliance.

Requirements for Success

· Relevant tertiary qualifications and/or demonstrated experience in the Family and Domestic Violence, child, youth, or family services sectors.

· At least 1 year of experience working within FDV services, with confidence in case management and trauma‑informed assessment processes.

· Strong local knowledge of, and respect for, ATSI communities, peoples, and cultural protocols.

· Demonstrated ability to quickly assess client needs and apply sound judgement in high‑risk situations.

· Excellent communication, time management, networking, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to adapt to different audiences.

· Capability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative multi‑agency team.

· Ability to work weekends and public holidays as required as part of a rotating roster.

· First Aid certificate is desired but not mandatory.

· Full driver licence with no restrictions.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check, qualifications, and referee checks, and have a clearance to work with children/vulnerable people.

Your Benefits

To ensure our employees feel valued, empowered, and celebrated, we provide a range of employee benefits including:

· Rewarding work – every day you know you’re making a real difference

· Not-for-profit salary packaging, reducing your tax (details via AccessPay)

· Free external, confidential counselling and access to chaplaincy support.

· Volunteering opportunities

· Extra leave available including an additional public holiday, additional annual leave day on your work anniversary and the opportunity to purchase further annual leave.

· Pilbara Remote Benefits include:

o Additional $1,000 each year to assist with cost of living in a remote area

o 5 weeks Annual leave

o Access to up to 5 additional days Personal/Carers leave each year

o Rental Assistance of up to $200 per week

o Relocation allowance of $1,500 to assist in moving to the area

Our Culture

Our innovative and inclusive culture will ensure you feel valued at Mission Australia as you help Australians in need and develop in your career.

We prioritise the safety and wellbeing of everyone, both within our team and the individuals we serve.

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive working environment. We actively support and encourage people of all backgrounds; gender, age, ethnicity, race, cultural background, disability, religion, and sexual orientation to submit an application and aim to ensure that the recruitment and employee experience is as accessible and inclusive as possible. So, whoever you are, if you’re skilled and actively support our purpose and values, you would be welcome at Mission Australia.

If you live with disability and require support to submit your application, please email talentattraction@missionaustralia.com.au or visit our Careers page for additional contact details.

We strongly encourage applications from people who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander. For culturally safe support or assistance with your application, please contact us at Deadlycareers@missionaustralia.com.au

Find out more about a career with Mission Australia.

How to apply

Click ‘Apply’ and send your application today!

As a committed Circle Back Initiative employer, we will respond to your application.

Applications for this role are shortlisted as received and we are interviewing through the advertising period. Please apply as soon as possible to be considered. Thank you.

title: Outpatient Manager (FT, on site)
description:
Outpatient Manager (FT, on site) | Peak View Behavioral Health | Colorado Springs, Colorado

About the Job:

PURPOSE STATEMENT:

The Clinical Services Manager is responsible for assisting the clinical department Director with management and oversight of the day-to-day operations of the clinical department, planning, implementation, and evaluation of clinical care systems and for client health outcomes attributable to clinical practice. The Clinical Services Manager serves as the Clinical Department lead, in the event of the Director’s absence. At the direction of the Director, provides direct supervision to clinical staff and indirect guidance to other staff regarding clinical programming and treatment expectations to ensure effective & safe therapeutic practices are being provided. Leads assigned aspects of the counseling programs including compliance with standards for completion Psychosocial Assessments, discharge planning, conducting groups, facilitating family therapies and individual therapies, and developing, implementing, and reviewing Treatment Plans. Assists in overseeing the clinical programs, monitoring the multidisciplinary treatment team process.

Pay Range: $85,000-94,000 annually

Roles and Responsibilities:

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • At the direction of the Director, reviews the progress, quality, and effectiveness of all clinical programs via live observations and chart audits.
  • Implements and monitors the clinical unit program schedule.
  • Provides support and instruction as needed to direct care staff to ensure they adequately understand the treatment program and service delivery expectations to clients based on the clients’ individual treatment plans and clinical needs.
  • Identifies and prioritizes issues of importance, including those priority issues as set for by leadership. Collaborates with department leaders and corporate leaders, as needed.
  • Communicates instructions, expectations and timelines clearly and concisely.
  • Assists in monitoring that all clinical programming, staffing, and documentation is in accordance with regulatory agencies and standards of care.
  • Coaches a team of highly engaged members through hiring, orientation, performance assessment and employee engagement to meet department goals and ensure effective and efficient department operation. Ensures appropriate communication with department Director and Human Resources for any pertinent staff issue or concern.
  • Manages staff scheduling and maintains an updated plan for contingency staffing.
  • Maintains accountability expectations for self and staff in all areas of job performance.
  • Assists with ensuring staff educational and supervision needs are addressed with education and supervision programs that are attended by staff.
  • Holds staff accountable for non-compliance and client safety concerns, as well as attendance, following policies, behavior, and adherence to code of conduct.
  • Provides clinical consultation, guidance and supervision.
  • Serves as subject matter expert and resource related to documentation standards for clinical services provided.
  • Responsible for a limited caseload as needed.
  • Maintains an awareness of community and market-related activities which includes knowledge of the activities of other providers, needs of local payors and the political climate related to mental health.
  • Provides direct care services when needed.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Master's Degree in Social Work, Counseling or Psychology required.
  • Three or more years of experience as a licensed social worker, counselor or therapist required.

LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Current and valid State issued licensure for professional mental health therapist or counselor required. Requirement for licensure level that allows for independent practice without need for structured supervision agreement per state licensure agency.
  • CPR and de-escalation and restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
  • First aid may be required based on state or facility.

WORK LOCATION:

This position is onsite and is not a remote position.

SUPERVISORY REQUIREMENTS:

One or more years’ supervisory/management experience required, preferably in social/clinical services.
