title: Barnehagelærar 100 % fast stilling
description:
Vil du bli med på laget i Hjelmelandsbarnehagen? Som eit ledd i å auke andelen barnehagelærare i tråd med nasjonale mål, har me ledig fast stilling i 100 % frå januar 2027.

Hjelmeland barnehage er under utbygging og me skal i løpet av januar "fusjonera" frå to til eitt bygg. Utbyggingsdelen vert den nye administrasjonsavdelinga, der det vert gode fasiliteter for tilsette, med blant anna felleskontor for barnehagelærare.

I Hjelmeland kommune er det tre kommunale barnehagar fordelt på bygdene Hjelmeland, Årdal og Fister. Alle tilsette i barnehagane våre har fokus på vår felles visjon «Det beste for barnet». Gjennom våre felles verdiar «Respekt, Omsorg og Tryggleik» er det eit viktig mål å gje barn gode og trygge opplevingar, ut i frå deira eigne føresetnadar og eiga utvikling. Me arbeidar heile tida for å vera i fagleg utvikling.

Me søkjer ein barnehagelærar som gjennom sitt engasjement og faglege grunnlag er med på å skapa ein meiningsfull, spennande og utviklande kvardag for barn. Som barnehagelærar vil du vera med å ha ansvar for den faglege tilrettelegginga i arbeidet. Stillinga inneber ikkje personalansvar.

Ansvar og arbeidsoppgåver
- delta aktivt i det daglege arbeidet med barna
- vera ein tydeleg rollemodell ovanfor barn og vaksne
- leggja til rette for leik, læring og utvikling
- sikra gode rutinar for det einskilde barnet sin trivnad og utvikling
- leggja til rette for og bidra til eit godt psykososialt miljø i barnehagen
- planleggja, gjennomføra, vurdera og dokumentera det pedagogiske arbeidet
- skapa eit nært samarbeid mellom heim og barnehage
- bidra til å planleggja og evt. gjennomføra foreldresamtalar
- bidra til eit godt samarbeid med andre tenester
- bidra til å rettleia og støtta medarbeidarar i det pedagogiske/metodiske arbeidet
- vera oppdatert og vidareutvikla fagleg kompetanse

Kvalifikasjonar og vilkår
- godkjent barnehagelærarutdanning eller annan likeverdig utdanning, jamfør barnehagelova §25
- gode norskspråklege kunnskapar både skriftleg og munnleg, jamfør barnehagelova §28

Me søkjer etter ein person som
- er varm og tydeleg, med evne til å skapa gode relasjonar til barn, føresette og kollegaer
- har eit medmenneskeleg og pedagogisk engasjement, der barna er i fokus
- har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
- bidreg til å skapa eit inkluderande miljø for omsorg, leik, læring og danning
- er utviklingsorientert og villig til å ta initiativ
- er løysingsorientert og fleksibel
- er fagleg engasjert, og interessert i å tileigna seg ny kunnskap

Me tilbyr
- løn etter gjeldande avtaleverk
- pensjon og forsikringsordning etter tariffavtale
- barnehagar som er engasjert i pedagogisk utviklingsarbeid
- gode kollegaer og godt arbeidsmiljø
- kompetanseutvikling for alle tilsette
- rettleiing av nyutdanna barnehagelærarar

description:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Reliable, punctual, and well-organised
  • Able to prioritise, multitask, and adapt to changing deadlines

Desirable qualifications but not essential:

  • Health & Safety Awareness
  • First Aid qualification

Why work with us? Here are some of the brilliant benefits you could get as a Resident Liaison Officer:

  • 23 days of holiday per year, excluding Bank Holidays (+ get more days with length of service)

With over 20 years of success behind us, PiLON began an exciting new chapter in 2024 as part of the United Infrastructure Group. This growth means more opportunity, broader expertise, and long-term stability for our teams - and a stronger platform for people to build lasting careers.

description:

Reception / Administrator

Bupa Health Centre, Milton Keynes (Blackberry Court, Walnut Tree, MK7 7PB)

Permanent

£16,740.00 per annum

Part Time 24 hours per week

Every Saturday - 7.30-16.00 or 07.45-16.15

Every Tuesday - 8.5 hours between 07.30-20.15

We make health happen


At Bupa, our purpose is simple, helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world.


As a Reception and Administrator at our Milton Keynes Health Centre, you'll be the face of Bupa, providing a warm welcome and outstanding support to every customer who visits the clinic. You'll play a vital role in ensuring the smooth day to day operation of the centre, delivering exceptional customer service while providing efficient administrative support to our clinical teams.


This is a fast-paced and varied role where no two days are the same. You'll manage reception duties, coordinate appointments, support customer journeys from arrival through to departure, handle administration tasks and help ensure the highest standards of service are maintained throughout the centre.


If you're highly organised, customer-focused and thrive in a busy environment, we'd love to hear from you.


You'll help us make health happen by:


  • Greeting and welcoming customers, ensuring they receive a professional and positive experience throughout their visit.
  • Managing customer enquiries via telephone, email and in person, providing timely and accurate information.
  • Supporting the booking, amendment and rescheduling of appointments using internal systems.
  • Preparing customer documentation, appointment packs and consent forms where required.
  • Processing payments, invoices, credit notes and other financial administration accurately.
  • Managing customer records and ensuring information is maintained to a high standard.
  • Supporting the administration of customer reports and results within agreed service levels.
  • Monitoring stock levels and ordering supplies when needed.
  • Working closely with clinical and operational colleagues to ensure outstanding customer service is delivered at every stage of the customer journey.
  • Supporting operational compliance, quality standards, clinical governance requirements and audit activity.

Key Skills / Qualifications needed for this role:


  • Previous administrative experience, ideally within a healthcare, medical or customer-focused environment.
  • Strong customer service experience with a genuine passion for helping people.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organisational and time management abilities, with the capability to prioritise workload effectively.
  • Good IT skills, including experience using Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Flexible and adaptable approach to changing priorities.
  • GCSE level education or equivalent.

Benefits


Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva is our global wellbeing programme and includes all aspects of our health, from mental and physical, to financial, social and environmental wellbeing.


Joining Bupa in this role, you'll receive:


  • Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind.
  • Enhanced pension plan and life insurance.
  • Access to our wellbeing and employee support programmes.
  • A supportive team environment with opportunities to learn and develop.

Why Bupa?


We're a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus.


Our people are all driven by the same purpose: helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do.


We encourage all our people to "Be You at Bupa". We champion diversity and understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That's why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences.


As a Disability Confident employer, we offer a guaranteed interview to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We'll make sure you're treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone who needs them.

Houseperson

Our Culture:

We are a highly entrepreneurial company limited only by our imagination. Diversity and teamwork are major aspects of our culture. Our property associates are a highly team-focused group bringing out the uniqueness of each associate to provide great products and services. Success comes to those who continuously seek opportunities to learn and pass on new knowledge. We always strive to be better, never bored, and never complacent. Our teams thrive on hard work, inclusivity, and producing outstanding experiences. We endeavor to make our fellow associates feel comfortable and entrepreneurial so that they can engage unhindered. Finally, giving back to the community is also vital to our culture. Our properties live by the philosophy that they are an important part of their communities and look for ways to partner in the local community to make a difference.

Job Description:

A houseperson will be responsible for cleaning and maintaining the commercial and common areas of the hotel; such as the lobby, lobby restrooms, banquet rooms, game room, elevators, hallways, entries, crossovers, stairwells, bar, cart rooms, guest and laundry area. The person in this position must be able to roll their sleeves up and assist our teams when needed, living our “ONE TEAM. ONE VISION.” philosophy. This person must also provide innovative ways that align with our mission to be the best, most respected hotel company in America.

The job is simple:

Focus on ways to promote and engage in internal growth programs.

Continuously exemplify and live by our Culture.

Meet/exceed our company goals and three metrics.

  • Complete all required training
  • Adhere to all standard operating procedures and property specific brand standards
  • Perform any other duties as requested by management to aid in better operation of the hotel and service to the guests
  • Provide personalized, friendly service to every guest and associate
  • Clean designated areas including, but not limited to, restrooms, public areas, offices and banquet/meeting/conference rooms
  • Perform tasks including, but not limited to, dusting and polishing furniture and fixtures, vacuuming, mopping, sweeping, shampooing carpets, washing windows, cleaning/waxing floors, removing and disposing of trash and emptying ashtrays

title: Sykepleier natt
description:
Et overordnet perspektiv på kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester er at flere skal kunne bo hjemme og få nødvendig helsehjelp der de bor. Er du sykepleier med ønske om å videreutvikle tjenesten i tråd med morgendagens omsorg, ønsker vi at du søker jobb hos oss. Vi har nå ledig 75 % fast stilling på natt.

Som sykepleier i hjemmetjenesten er det viktig at du kan identifisere deg med Tysvær kommune sine medarbeiderverdier ROMA; raus, open, modig og ansvarlig. Tysvær er i en spennende endring og hjemmetjenesten skal neste år flytte over i kommunens hittil største prosjekt - Helsekvartalet.

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver

  • Ansvarlig for sykepleiefaglige observasjoner, tiltak og oppfølging av pasienter etter vedtak
  • Anvende avansert sykepleie i pasientens hjem
  • Medisinhåndtering
  • Bidra til å sikre forsvarlig pleie og omsorgstjenester i tråd med kvalitetskrav og lovverk
  • Sørge for at nødvendige sykepleiefaglige prosedyrer og rutiner er utarbeidet
  • Bidra til at brukermedvirkning blir ivaretatt og legge til rette for godt samarbeid med pårørende og tilby nødvendig pårørendestøtte
  • Tett tverrfaglig samarbeid med spesialisthelsetjenesten, fastlegen og andre kommunale instanser
  • Ansvarlig for veiledning av studenter og kollegaer
  • Sykepleiefaglig ansvarlig på vakt etter delegasjon

Krav til kompetanse

  • Sykepleier med offentlig godkjent utdanning
  • Førerkort kl B
  • Gode norskkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig
  • Gode IKT kunnskaper
  • Sykepleiere med relevant videreutdanning oppfordres til å søke
  • 3.års sykepleierstudenter kan vurderes med forbehold om innvilget autorisasjon i juni 2027

Personlige egenskaper

  • Positiv, fleksibel, trygg og løsningsorientert
  • Arbeider selvstendig og trives med et høyt arbeidstempo
  • Har evnen til å håndtere og strukturere varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Ser og forstår betydningen av et godt tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Har evnen til å gi bruker god og individuell omsorg
  • Har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsferdigheter

Dette får du hos oss

  • Godt faglig arbeidsmiljø med fokus på arbeidsnærvær
  • Internundervisning og mulighet for veiledning i små grupper
  • Gratis parkering
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Lønn etter gjeldene lov- og avtaleverk
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon gjennom KLP. Som KLP-medlem får du livsvarig pensjon, inkludert uføre- og etterlattepensjon – og gode medlemsfordeler i bank og forsikring.

Godkjent politiattest som ikke er eldre enn tre måneder må legges frem ved ansettelse, og senest før du begynner i stillingen ihht gjeldende lovverk. Det blir tatt forbehold om at merknader på politiattesten kan føre til endring i tilbudet om stilling.

Vil du bli en del av laget?

Søknad sendes elektronisk ved å klikke på «Søk her». Du kan laste opp relevante vitnemål og attester sammen med søknaden. Dersom du ikke har mulighet til å laste dem opp, kan du ta dem med til et eventuelt intervju.

Når søknadsfristen er utløpt, vil det utarbeides en offentlig søkerliste. Denne inneholder navn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bostedskommune for alle søkere. Det følger av offentlighetsloven at opplysninger om deg som søker kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. I så fall vil du bli varslet før offentliggjøring.

title: Produktionschef- kretskortstillverkning
description:
Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.


Din roll

I din roll som produktionschef på Saab kommer du ha det övergripande ansvaret för att leda och utveckla ett team som kommer att bestå av 15-20 montörer och operatörer som jobbar skift eller ständig kväll. Tjänsten kommer huvudsakligen bestå av personalansvar, kompetensutveckling, budgetansvar samt att ständigt jobba mot förbättringar inom produktionen.


Du kommer ha ett nära samarbete med övriga delar av tillverkningen och ha leveransansvar för ditt område. Du kommer också vara en viktig del i kravställandet mot stödfunktioner för att säkerhetsställa att tillverkningspersonalen har rätt förutsättningar för att kunna göra sitt arbete på bästa möjliga sätt under kvällstid.


Dina arbetsuppgifter kan delas in i:

  • Ledarskap och medarbetarutveckling; som innebär att du driver teamet framåt genom tydliga riktlinjer och konkreta mål. Du kommer att vara en mentor och stödja dina medarbetare i deras utveckling och framtida karriärvägar.
  • Strategi och planering; där du tillsammans med ditt team utvecklar och implementerar strategier för att öka effektiviteten och lönsamheten i våra åtaganden.
  • Kvalitetskontroll och processförbättring; att verka för en ständig förbättring av våra tillverkningsprocesser och kvalitetssäkringssystem. Du kommer att tillsammans med din grupp utvärdera och ge förslag på förbättringar samt vid behov vara med och införa nya processer för att säkerställa effektivitet och höga krav på kvalitet.
  • Ansvar för sektionens ekonomiska resultat.

Du kommer att ansvara för en produktionsgrupp som arbetar i tvåskift eller ständig kväll. Rollen är operativt nära verksamheten, vilket innebär att du förväntas arbeta i någon av dessa skiftformer.

Din profil

För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du har en teknisk bakgrund, gärna inom produktion. Du har även en akademisk utbildning inom teknik eller motsvarande. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att leda operationell verksamhet, där snabba åtgärder krävs antingen med tidigare personalansvar eller roll i ledande befattning av team eller projekt. I kombination med det operationella arbetet trivs du med att arbeta strategiskt mot mer långsiktiga mål.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet inom/av:

  • Kretskortstillverkning
  • El-montering eller kabeltillverkning.
  • Försvarsindustrin

Som person tror vi att du är en lösningsorienterad och driven lagspelare med styrka att involvera, motivera och inspirera dina medarbetare och kollegor. Du är stark i förändringsarbetet, nyfiken, strukturerad och har lätt att sätta dig in i nya områden. Genom god analytisk kompetens har du förmåga att planera, implementera och lyckas med strategiska initiativ. Då rollen har många gränssnitt internt både inom produktion men också mellan affärsområden tror vi att du för att lyckas har mycket goda förmågor vad gäller samarbete och kommunikation på både svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.


Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.


Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.


Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

Vill du lära känna vår verksamhet och personal lite bättre? Här kan du hitta berättelser från några av våra anställda.

title: Property Claims Manager - HO3 and Condo
description:
We are looking for a dynamic Property Claims Manager who is energized by a challenge and brings both deep technical expertise and a passion for developing people. You will lead a team of property claims adjusters, strengthening their skills in homeowners and condo claims, coverage interpretation, estimating, and customer communication. You will also help the team adapt as our claims tools, processes, and ways of working continue to evolve.


If you enjoy coaching people, solving problems, improving the customer experience, and building better ways of working, this could be a great opportunity for you.


Why you will enjoy this role

  • Develop people: Help adjusters build confidence, strengthen technical skills, and grow in their careers.
  • Shape what is next: Contribute to an evolving claims organization and help improve how work gets done.
  • Take on the challenge: Bring your experience and technical skill to a role where you will help build how we train and develop adjusters going forward.
  • Make an impact: Use your expertise to improve claim quality, customer responsiveness, and team performance.
  • Lead with insight: Use claims data and operational trends to focus coaching where it matters most.

What you will do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of property claims adjusters.
  • Coach on homeowners and condo coverage, estimate writing, claim quality, and customer communication.
  • Support sound coverage decisions and review escalated or complex claim matters.
  • Use performance and quality data to identify trends and coaching opportunities.
  • Help build and deliver structured training that strengthens adjusters’ technical skills, contributing your expertise as we stand up new training programs.
  • Help the team successfully navigate new tools, workflows, and business priorities.
  • Partner with claims leaders and other teams to improve training, processes, and customer outcomes.

What you will bring

  • P&C Adjuster's License
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of property claims experience
  • 2+ years of people management/leadership experience
  • Strong homeowners property claims knowledge, including coverage interpretation
  • Experience using Xactimate to review or write property or contents estimates
  • Experience with XactContents, ClaimXperience, Guidewire Live Boards, or similar claims tools
  • Experience contributing to or delivering formal training programs for claims adjusters
  • Ability to lead through change while keeping teams engaged, accountable, and customer-focused

Pay Range:

$88,000.00 - $147,000.00

If you are driven to keep roadways and bridges safe and effective, accelerate your career by being part of the team that keeps Maine moving! Join MaineDOT as a Transportation Worker for a rewarding career full of advancement opportunities, career development, competitive pay, generous paid time off, terrific benefits including a robust wellness program, and much more!


From road repair to culvert replacement in the summer to plowing in the winter, Transportation Workers are an essential part of the MaineDOT team getting Mainers from point A to point B safely. Transportation workers are on the front lines of roadwork, putting in long hours in all types of weather to make sure Mainers and their families are safe on our state’s roads, bridges, and highways.


A day in the life of a Transportation Worker changes with the seasons, meaning employees learn new skills and no two days are exactly the same. MaineDOT offers paid Commercial Driving License training and Snowfighter training, and over time, the more you learn, the more you earn with automatic promotional opportunities.

  • Must be 18 years of age, have a high school diploma or equivalent
  • Required to work at a higher class as necessary and in accordance with required licenses and/or certification

    • a drug test
    • Department’s Respirator fit test
  • Class C State of Maine license by first day of employment.
  • Shall obtain and retain a valid Class B State of Maine license during the initial six-month probationary period.
  • Ability to become a certified snow fighter within 12 months.
  • Ability to obtain flagger certification within a specified amount of time.

Under federal law, only U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, or H-2A, H-2B, or E-2 visa holders will be eligible for new or renewed CDLs

Telephone: 207-624-8201 Email: Melissa.labbe@maine.gov

Why join our team?

No matter where you work across Maine state government, you find employees who embody our state motto—"Dirigo" or "I lead"—as they provide essential services to Mainers every day. We believe in supporting our workforce's health and wellbeing with a valuable total compensation package, including:

  • Work-Life Fit – Rest is essential. Take time for yourself using 13 paid holidays, and 3+ weeks of vacation leave annually. Vacation leave accrual increases with years of service, and overtime-exempt employees receive personal leave.
  • Wellness – We care about you and your family’s wellbeing, offering 12 days of sick leave annually to help you stay healthy.
  • Health Insurance Coverage – The State of Maine pays 85%-95% of employee-only premiums ($12,213.60-$13,650.48 annual value), depending on salary. Use this chart to find the premium costs for you and your family, including the percentage of dependent coverage paid by the State.

  • Retirement Plan – The State contributes the equivalent of 14.06% of the employee's pay towards the Maine Public Employees Retirement System (MainePERS).

State employees are eligible for an extensive and highly competitive benefits package, covering many aspects of wellness. Learn about additional wellness benefits for State employees from the Office of Employee Health and Wellness.

title: Hospital Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Veterinary Client Service professional to join our leadership team as Hospital Manager.
The role demands a leader with the interpersonal and organizational skills to continue achieving our goals of delivering excellent patient care and customer service to both our clients and referring veterinarians.

The successful candidate will have experience in Human Resource and personnel management, Marketing, and Business development. Your strong financial and operational acumen will be put to good use!

The Hospital Manager—under the guidance of the Regional Management team and in partnership with the Medical Director—performs a wide range of administrative activities related to the practice. This includes: mentoring the team and overseeing the business operations and maintenance of the facility; ensuring the business growth and profitability of the practice; and supporting the hospital’s mission of delivering high quality patient care and exceptional client service.


Skills and Qualifications
• 2 to 3 years of customer service and financial budget management experience.
• Knowledge of sales and marketing techniques.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially to a diverse range of audiences and settings.
• The ability to make decisions, delegate responsibility and achieve results with hospital team members.
• Professional comportment and appearance, with excellent interpersonal skills and a friendly, positive attitude.
• Respect for and willingness to work with clients and their pets.
• Must be able to handle multiple tasks and deal with an environment of changing priorities.

• Direct and develop the veterinary, technical and administrative staff towards the goal of quality patient care and excellent client service; assist in the formulation of objectives and policies to ensure efficient and profitable hospital operations.
• Oversee the hiring, reviewing, disciplining and terminating of professional staff, in accordance with and with the approval of the Regional Management team.
• Review the P&L Report monthly and partner with the Hospital Medical Director to increase revenue and limit expenses; work with home office to prepare and submit the yearly budget (budget forecast, operating plan, cap-ex expenditures) and participate in the evaluation process with Regional Management team.
• Model an “owner” mentality in hospital by demonstrating a willingness to assist all employees in making the practice a success; invest the necessary amount of time to accomplish the required responsibilities and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital.
• Minimizing patient stress and discomfort; recommend referral to another VCA doctor or specialist when this is likely to significantly improve the prognosis.
• Maintain client/patient medical/surgical records and make certain all necessary logs are kept up-to-date through established protocols; assist colleagues in follow-up and future management of the patient.

• Positively represent the hospital and VCA in the professional community and to the general public.

title: Corporate Identity Apprentice (Security & IAM)
description:
What You'll Do:

Criteo's Corporate Identity team manages who can access what, across the company. We cover the identity lifecycle of our workforce (employees, contractors, third parties), access to corporate applications, and authentication (SSO, MFA). We use modern IAM and IGA platforms (Microsoft Entra ID and SailPoint ISC), automate as much as we can, and and AI is playing an increasingly significant role in our daily lives.
You will join a small, friendly team, work with a mentor, and share your ideas from day one. Your two main missions:

  • Support the team's daily activities: access requests, tickets and incidents, data quality checks, and documentation.
  • Take part in the team's projects: improving and automating identity and authentication processes, strengthening access governance, and experimenting with AI to make identity operations faster and smarter.

Depending on your interests, you may work on topics such as:

  • Identity governance (joiner, mover, leaver, access reviews, roles)
  • Authentication and access (SSO, MFA, conditional access)
  • Automation and AI use cases (scripts, workflows, assistants and agents that answer access questions)
  • Reporting and dashboards on access, accounts and compliance (SOX regulation)

You will learn how security, IT and the business work together. You will see how an identity platform is designed, run and improved at scale.

Who You Are:

  • You are in the 4th or 5th year of a Master's program in cybersecurity, information security, IAM, or a related field. Your school can provide a work-study contract.
  • You are dynamic, curious and you take initiatives. You like to understand how things work and desire to be autonomous.
  • You are rigorous and careful with details. You know that in security, small mistakes matter.
  • You are attracted by AI and want to see how it can improve security and IT operations.
  • You have a basic knowledge of security and access management concepts (authentication, authorization, directories, SSO, MFA). Hands-on experience is a plus, but not required.
  • You have an experience with scripting (for example Python or PowerShell) or willing to learn.
  • You are a team player.
  • Good communication skills in English.

We know that many candidates do not match every point. If your profile looks a little different but you think you can bring value, we would love to hear from you.

We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!​

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.
📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship & career development programs.
💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks & mental health support.
🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.
💸 Fair pay & perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

title: SAP ILM / ARCHIVING CONSULTANT
description:
SAP ILM / ARCHIVING CONSULTANT


Summary

We are seeking an experienced professional to lead strategic initiatives in Information Lifecycle Management (ILM) and data archiving within the IT Services sector. In this pivotal role, the successful candidate will oversee the full spectrum of data retention strategies, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards while optimizing storage efficiency for complex enterprise environments. This position demands a deep understanding of SAP ecosystems and cloud storage solutions to drive seamless data migration, retention policy enforcement, and system modernization efforts, ultimately safeguarding organizational data integrity and operational continuity.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and execute comprehensive ILM strategies utilizing cloud storage platforms such as AWS S3 and Azure Blob to manage long-term data retention.
  • Deploy and configure enterprise-grade archive solutions, including OpenText, IBM, and KGS, to handle massive data volumes efficiently.
  • Facilitate the collection of business requirements and maintain robust communication channels with key stakeholders to align technical solutions with organizational goals.
  • Lead the end-to-end testing, deployment, and cutover phases for archiving projects to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Implement GDPR-compliant ILM snapshots and establish secure retention warehouses to meet strict data privacy and legal obligations.
  • Manage the complete lifecycle of SAP archiving and ILM processes, ensuring alignment with current SAP standards and best practices.
  • Oversee retention management protocols and execute system decommissioning activities in a controlled and secure manner.
  • Drive the implementation of end-to-end SAP archiving solutions across both ECC and S/4HANA landscapes.

Requirements

Requirements:
  • Possess 8 to 15 years of professional experience within the IT Services industry, with a specialized focus on SAP data management.
  • Demonstrate proven expertise in managing data storage within AWS S3 and Azure Blob environments.
  • Show hands-on proficiency with major archive solutions including OpenText, IBM, and KGS.
  • Exhibit strong capabilities in gathering business requirements and managing stakeholder relationships effectively.
  • Have a track record of successfully leading archiving testing, deployment, and cutover activities.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of GDPR regulations regarding ILM snapshots and retention warehousing.
  • Possess deep technical knowledge of SAP Archiving and SAP ILM modules.
  • Be skilled in ILM retention management and the execution of system decommissioning projects.
  • Have extensive experience in delivering end-to-end SAP archiving implementations.
  • Demonstrate familiarity with archiving processes specific to SAP ECC and S/4HANA systems.

title: Hospital Administrator - VCA West Los Angeles
description:
Join our Team at VCA West Los Angeles Animal Hospital!

Are you an experienced Hospital Administrator looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity? VCA West Los Angeles Animal Hospital, an AAHA-accredited, 24-Hour Emergency, Specialty, and General Practice Hospital, is seeking a highly skilled individual to join our leadership team.

About VCA West Los Angeles Animal Hospital:

Our hospital, located in the heart of Los Angeles, California, boasts a sprawling 42,000 square feet and operates as a referral center, primary care facility, and teaching hospital with round-the-clock emergency services. With a dedicated team of 39 veterinarians, 6 residents, and 15 interns, we offer specialized expertise in internal medicine, surgery, neurology, cardiology, oncology, radiation oncology, radiology, behavior, and integrative medicine. VCA West Los Angeles Animal Hospital is not only one of the largest facilities in the country but also one of the most aesthetically stunning, nestled within a beautiful setting.

Our state-of-the-art hospital features nine surgery suites, including specialized suites for neurology, orthopedic, and minimally invasive procedures. Additional amenities include 19 examination rooms, 2 medical procedure rooms, MRI and CT facilities, a medical oncology suite, and a radiation oncology suite equipped with a cutting-edge linear accelerator for IMRT. Furthermore, VCA West LA has earned recognition as one of the nine Veterinary Trauma Centers in the United States, actively collaborating to elevate standards of care and enhance trauma patient management. As a hospital deeply committed to education, we take pride in our thriving internship and residency program and anticipate any specialist joining our team to play a vital role in nurturing the next generation of veterinary professionals.

Position Summary:

As a Hospital Administrator at VCA West Los Angeles Animal Hospital, you will work closely with our Regional Management team and collaborate with Medical Directors to oversee various administrative aspects of our practice. We prioritize a collaborative, team-oriented approach to management, valuing the insights of staff and co-managers to cultivate a culture centered on exceptional client service and top-notch patient care.

Key responsibilities include mentoring staff, supervising facility operations and maintenance, ensuring practice growth and profitability, and aligning with our hospital's mission of delivering high-quality patient care and exceptional client service. Candidates should possess strong financial acumen, including proficiency in financial statement analysis, and must demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of HR compliance regulations. We are seeking a hands-on leader who can adapt to evolving hospital dynamics, staff expectations, and client needs. Above all, our Hospital Administrator is dedicated to working in tandem with the management team and Doctors to uphold the highest standards of medical care for our patients while fostering an environment that encourages employee growth.

Job Responsibilities

  • Direct and develop the veterinary, technical and administrative staff towards the goal of quality patient care and excellent client service; assist in the formulation of objectives and policies to ensure efficient and profitable hospital operations.
  • Oversee the hiring and evaluation of professional staff, with the approval of the Regional Management team.
  • Review the P&L Report monthly and partner with the Hospital Medical Director to increase revenue and limit expenses; work with home office to prepare and submit the yearly budget (budget forecast, operating plan, cap-ex expenditures) and participate in the evaluation process with Regional Management team.
  • Model an “owner” mentality in hospital by demonstrating a willingness to assist all employees in making the practice a success; invest the necessary amount of time to accomplish the required responsibilities and ensure the smooth operation of the hospital.
  • Minimizing patient stress and discomfort; recommend referral to another VCA doctor or specialist when this is likely to significantly improve the prognosis.
  • Maintain client/patient medical/surgical records and make certain all necessary logs are kept up to date through established protocols; assist colleagues in follow-up and future management of the patient.
  • Supervise the administration and case review of client medical complaints.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

Qualifications:

  • At least 5 years of progressive leadership experience including leading multi-site or multi-specialty operations.
  • At least 5 years of financial budget management experience.
  • College Degree, MBA preferred. Veterinary industry management experience preferred. CVPM a plus or interest in obtaining.
  • Knowledge of sales and marketing techniques.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially to a diverse range of audiences and settings.
  • The ability to make decisions, delegate responsibility and achieve results with hospital team members.
  • Professional comportment and appearance, with excellent interpersonal skills and a friendly, positive attitude.
  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks and deal with an environment of changing priorities.

title: Formann Lærlinger
description:
Vil du være med å forme framtidens fagarbeidere? Bli vår neste leder for lærlingeavdelingen!


I Framo Services AS er vi stolte av å være fageksperter – og enda stoltere av å lære det videre til neste generasjon.


Nå ser vi etter en tydelig og engasjert leder som vil være med å utvikle lærlingene våre og gi dem en solid start i arbeidslivet.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Du får ansvaret for lærlingeavdelingen vår, med lærlinger innen industrimekanikerfaget, CNC, industrirørlegging, automasjon og logistikk. Det betyr at du blir en nøkkelperson i å planlegge, lede og utvikle avdelingen, slik at vi når både læringsmål og produksjonsmål.


Du får også personalansvar for lærlingene og skal sørge for at de får god oppfølging, tydelige forventninger og trygge rammer for å utvikle seg i faget.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som brenner for fagopplæring, liker å jobbe tett på folk i verksted- og lagermiljøet, og har gode kommunikasjonsevner og naturlige pedagogiske egenskaper.


Du er strukturert, har gode IT-kunnskaper og vet hvordan man lager en plan som sikrer at både mennesker, kompetanse og verktøy er på plass.


Du må trives med tett samarbeid på tvers, og du ser verdien av et nært samspill med administrativt ansvarlig, formenn/fagledere og instruktører.

Du vil trives hos oss hvis du:

  • Liker å jobbe med ungdom og unge voksne
  • Har en naturlig evne til å motivere og inspirere
  • Trives med å lede andre
  • Er en pådriver for Lean og kontinuerlig forbedring
  • Setter arbeidsmiljø og trivsel høyt
  • Ønsker å være en del av et engasjert og støttende team
  • Har erfaring med ledelse, planlegging og personalansvar – eller ønsker å tvikle deg i den retningen

Hva tilbyr vi?

Hos oss får du ikke bare en jobb – du får muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell.


Vi gir deg opplæringen og støtten du trenger for å lykkes, og du vil møte motiverte kolleger i et miljø med høy fagkompetanse og stolthet for det vi lager og leverer.

Fagbrev innen relevant fagområde er ønskelig, og relevant yrkeserfaring vil bli vektlagt.

Klar for å bli med på laget og være med å utvikle framtidens fagarbeidere? Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Spørsmål om rollen? Da kan du kontakte Workshop Manager Leon Kolstad, telefon 90 78 90 98

title: Coördinator Welzijn (Midden-Inn, Heerjansdam)
description:
Jouw uitdaging: Bouwen, coachen en aanpakken met je team!
Midden-Inn moet dé plek worden waar heel Heerjansdam samenkomt. In deze rol combineer je het coördineren en coachen van onze onmisbare vrijwilligers met een gezonde dosis hands-on mentaliteit. Je bent een netwerker pur sang: je weet als geen ander hoe je contacten legt, partijen samenbrengt en een lokaal netwerk warm houdt. Samen met je enthousiaste collega's van de dagbesteding stroop je de mouwen op om van Midden-Inn een levendige, warme ontmoetingsplek te maken.

Wat ga je doen?
● Netwerken & Verbinden: Je trekt actief de wijk en het dorp in om contacten te leggen met buurtbewoners, lokale verenigingen en samenwerkingspartners. Je bouwt aan een sterk extern netwerk en onderhoudt dit met plezier.
● Coachen van vrijwilligers: Onze vrijwilligers zijn goud waard. Jij coacht, begeleidt en motiveert hen bij het uitvoeren van de activiteiten.
● Handen uit de mouwen: Je denkt niet alleen na over welzijn, je brengt het ook in de praktijk. Je zorgt voor een laagdrempelige omgeving waarin (buurt)bewoners zich direct welkom voelen en elkaar makkelijk ontmoeten.
● Welzijn & Activering: Je ontwikkelt en begeleidt kwalitatieve welzijnsactiviteiten en grotere dorpsactiviteiten (zoals themabijeenkomsten) die naadloos aansluiten bij de behoeften van de inwoners.
● Kwaliteit & Beleid: Je signaleert kansen in het dorp, adviseert de welzijnsregisseur en helpt mee met de uitvoering van gebiedsplannen en verkregen subsidies om het welzijnsaanbod te stimuleren.
● Samenwerking & Flexibiliteit: Je trekt intensief op met je directe collega's van de dagbesteding. Jullie vormen samen de motor achter het welzijnsaanbod en waar nodig val je flexibel voor elkaar in om de continuïteit te waarborgen.

Wie zoeken wij?
We zoeken een daadkrachtige, flexibele en empathische netwerker. Je stapt makkelijk op mensen af, denkt in kansen en weet met jouw enthousiasme zowel vrijwilligers, dorpsgenoten als partners te verbinden.

Jouw bagage:
● Een afgerond relevant mbo-4 diploma, bijvoorbeeld SPW (activiteitenbegeleiding) of MZ (maatschappelijke zorg);
● Aantoonbare ervaring met het opbouwen, onderhouden en uitbreiden van een (lokaal) netwerk;
● Een motiverende en coachende stijl van begeleiden (ervaring met het coachen van vrijwilligers is een grote pre);
● Uitstekende communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden;
● Een gezonde dosis organisatievermogen, flexibiliteit en een echte hands-on mentaliteit;
● Goede computerervaring (bij voorkeur met Google Workspace).

Wat biedt Aafje jou?
Werken in het welzijn betekent dat je écht iets betekent voor de lokale gemeenschap. Je krijgt er veel voldoening, waardering en een fijne werksfeer voor terug. Daarnaast geeft Aafje jou graag de ruimte voor jouw ideeën en persoonlijke groei.
● Een salaris conform de CAO VVT, ingeschaald in FWG 40 (op basis van de rompfunctie Dagbestedingscoach, afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring);
● Ruime mogelijkheden om door te leren of door te groeien;
● Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.


Solliciteren of meer weten?
Direct enthousiast? Is deze veelzijdige functie jou op het lijf geschreven? Stuur dan je motivatiebrief en cv onder vermelding van "Vacature Coördinator Welzijn Midden-Inn" naar
Aafje, afdeling Werving & Selectie via werkenbij@aafje.nl.
Eerst nog een vraag? Wil je meer informatie over deze rol? Neem dan gerust contact op met Renske van Gelderen via telefoonnummer 0612795319.

Bij Aafje draait alles om de juiste klik. Daarom is een referentiecheck een vast onderdeel van onze sollicitatieprocedure. Zo weten we zeker dat jij en je nieuwe team een goede match zijn.

Ben jij die veelzijdige, energieke professional die het verschil maakt in het leven van ouderen én de spil wil zijn in de dorpsgemeenschap? Stroop je graag de mouwen op en bloei je op in een omgeving waar jouw expertise gewaardeerd wordt? Dan is Aafje op zoek naar jou voor onze locatie Midden-Inn in Heerjansdam!

title: Client Service Representative
description:

Located in the heart of San Carlos, CA, VCA San Carlos Animal Hospital has proudly served the San Francisco Peninsula for over 40 years. Now operating from our new state-of-the-art facility, we provide advanced veterinary care using the latest technology to ensure pets receive the highest quality treatment.

We're proud to be part of San Carlos' rich history—from its railroad origins to its growth as a hub of innovation and compassion. Our dedicated team is committed to delivering exceptional care, fostering collaboration, and advancing

veterinary medicine.


At VCA, we foster a culture of collaboration and respect, where each team member's unique talents and personalities
enrich our collective mission. Whether administering compassionate care or pioneering new advancements in
veterinary medicine, our diverse team stands at the forefront of excellence.
Join us as we continue to uphold our legacy of professionalism and passion at VCA San Carlos Animal Hospital. Let's
embark on a journey where every pet receives the utmost care and attention they deserve.

Why We Need You
As the face of VCA, the Client Service Representative sets the tone for the practice as we build and maintain each customer's trust and confidence in our abilities. The CSR is the pivot around which the hospital operates and is responsible for:

• Customer service functions, including: greeting visitors, answering telephones, and guiding clients and their pets to exam rooms.

• Scheduling and confirming appointments.

• Placing outbound calls for follow-ups and reaching out to prospective clients.

• Presenting and explaining fees, including processing payments.

• Recommending, selecting, and obtaining products and services, including prescriptions.

• Answering questions regarding products and services, including educating clients on general animal husbandry and non-medical pet care (i.e., heartworm prevention, housebreaking, and flea & tick control).

• Managing medical records, charts, reports and correspondence.

• Hospital maintenance (including removal of animal waste) and ensuring that facility is neat and clean at all times—both inside and outside.

Essential Functions

• Customer service functions, including: greeting visitors, answering telephones, and guiding clients and their pets to exam rooms.

• Scheduling and confirming appointments.

• Placing outbound calls for follow-ups and reaching out to prospective clients.

• Presenting and explaining fees, including processing payments.

• Recommending, selecting, and obtaining products and services, including prescriptions.

• Answering questions regarding products and services, including educating clients on general animal husbandry and non-medical pet care (i.e., heartworm prevention, housebreaking, and flea & tick control).

• Managing medical records, charts, reports and correspondence.

Qualifications

• At least one year of proven past experience helping customers.

• High School Diploma/GED or equivalent.

• Excellent listening and communication skills.

• Compassion for pets and people—as well as awareness and understanding of others’ reactions.

• Proven decision-making skills to choose the most appropriate course of action.

• The ability to integrate new information into problem-solving.

description:
V Skupini Triglav z našimi sodelavci, strankami in poslovnimi partnerji že več kot 125 let tkemo trdne vezi. Skupaj si prizadevamo za varno prihodnost, v kateri bomo zanesljivo, odzivno in enostavno premagovali življenjske izzive. Pridružite se naši ekipi in z nami odprite naslednje poglavje naše skupne zgodbe.

Opis delovnega mesta

  • opravljanje del in nalog v okviru organizacijske enote oziroma področja dela;
  • izvajanje zahtevnejših strokovnih nalog s področja dela;
  • operativna podpora pri pripravi in izvedbi strategije in planov s področja dela;
  • priprava gradiv, odgovorov, sklepov, odločb, pogodb in druge dokumentacije glede na zahteve in pooblastila s področja dela;
  • zbiranje in kontrola pravilnosti podatkov, vodenje in urejanje baz podatkov, evidenc in registrov v IT podpori področja;
  • sodelovanje pri pripravi in priprava raznovrstnih poročil in analiz s področja dela;
  • priprava in posredovanje različnih podatkov zunanjim in notranjim strankam;
  • nudenje pomoči področjem, ki so vključena v skupne procese in postopke dela;
  • sodelovanje v procesu nabave v skladu s podeljenimi pooblastili;
  • sodelovanje v internih postopkih s področja dela;
  • sodelovanje pri revizijskih pregledih in ostalih inšpekcijskih pregledih;
  • sodelovanje pri razvoju znotraj področja dela in v okviru tega izvajanje naslednjih nalog: izvajanje operativnih nalog pri razvoju, prenos znanja in dobre prakse in sodelovanje pri izvajanju usposabljanj v okviru področja dela;
  • spremljanje in izvajanje postopkov dela skladno s predpisi, navodili, okrožnicami in drugimi notranjimi akti družbe;
  • sodelovanje s strokovnimi področji in službami v matični družbi in sodelovanje z zunanjimi institucijami in organizacijami v skladu s podeljenimi pooblastili.

Ponujamo

  • delo v stabilnem, uglednem in družini prijaznem podjetju,
  • napredovanje in karierni razvoj v mednarodnem okolju,
  • različna strokovna izobraževanja in usposabljanja.
  • Delovno razmerje z izbranima kandidatoma bomo sklenili za nedoločen čas, s polnim delovnim časom in šestmesečnim poskusnim delom.

title: Kasseassistent til Servicelinjen, Plantorama Aalborg
description:
Elsker du at arbejde med mennesker og har du lysten til at skabe gode oplevelser? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! Vi søger en smilende og serviceminded kasseassistent til vores team i Plantorama Aalborg.

Du skaber gode kundeoplevelser

Et besøg i Plantorama, er ikke kun en indkøbstur - det er en oplevelse. Vores passion for planter, haver og dyr kommer til udtryk i vores inspirerende centre, fyldt med liv. Som medarbejder spiller du en central rolle i at levere denne oplevelse gennem kompetent og faglig vejledning. Dit engagement og din viden skaber den personlige service, der gør hvert besøg særligt.

Som kasseassistent vil din primære opgave være kassebetjening, hvor du møder kunderne med et smil og sørger for, at deres oplevelse ved kassen er behagelig og effektiv. Udover kassebetjeningen vil du også hjælpe med udpakning og opfyldning af varer samt sikre, at kasseområdet altid fremstår pænt og ryddeligt.

En arbejdsplads, hvor du kan vokse

Vi lægger vægt på, at du udvikler dig hos os. Derfor prioriterer vi videreuddannelse og sundhedsinitiativer højt, så du får ideelle muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. Du får også både pension og en fantastisk sundhedsordning, så du kan have det godt gennem hele livet. Og så kvitterer vi selvfølgelig også med et personalekort, der giver rabat i alle vores centre.

Vi forstiller os, at du:

  • Er udadvendt og elsker at møde nye mennesker.
  • Har erfaring fra detailbranchen – erfaring med kassebetjening er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Er fleksibel og kan arbejde i weekender.
  • Brænder for at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse.
  • Har en positiv attitude og gode kommunikationsevner.

Stillingen er en deltidsstilling på 34 timer/uge med opstart efter aftale. Arbejdstiden ligger primært i hverdagene mellem 8.45 og 16.00.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning gennem linket her på siden og lad os høre hvem du er.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Project and Supplier Planner
company: Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace - Defence Systems - Advanced Solutions
description:
I Aviation Programs i KONGSBERG utvikler og leverer vi avanserte løsninger til kunder med høye krav til kvalitet, presisjon og leveringssikkerhet. Vår prosjektportefølje er i vekst, og vi søker nå en Project and Supplier Planner som vil få en sentral rolle i å sikre god prosjektgjennomføring gjennom helhetlig planlegging og effektiv leverandøroppfølging.

Dette er en spennende kombinasjonsrolle hvor du får ansvar både for prosjekt- og ressursplanlegging på tvers av programmer og prosjekter, samt koordinering og oppfølging av aktiviteter mot leverandører og Supply Chain. Rollen gir stor påvirkningskraft og en unik mulighet til å bidra til at våre leveranser gjennomføres effektivt og forutsigbart.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver

Som en sentral del av prosjektteamet vil du sikre helhetlig planlegging og koordinering på tvers av prosjekter, ressurser, Supply Chain og leverandører. Du vil blant annet:

  • Etablere og følge opp planer som sikrer effektiv gjennomføring av programmer og prosjekter

  • Koordinere aktiviteter og prioriteringer på tvers av Aviation Programs

  • Sikre god ressursutnyttelse og nødvendig kapasitet gjennom hele prosjektløpet

  • Integrere leverandørarbeidet som en naturlig del av prosjektgjennomføringen

  • Samarbeide med Supply Chain om planlegging og oppfølging av eksterne leveranser

  • Følge opp fremdrift og bidra til at leveranser skjer i henhold til plan

  • Identifisere forhold som kan påvirke prosjektgjennomføringen og bidra til nødvendige tiltak

  • Være et bindeledd mellom prosjekter, Supply Chain og leverandører

  • Bidra til å videreutvikle planleggings- og prosjektstyringsarbeidet i organisasjonen

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som kombinerer struktur og analytiske ferdigheter med evne til å bygge gode relasjoner og drive koordinering på tvers av organisasjonen.

Vi tror du har:

  • Høyere utdanning innen teknologi, logistikk, økonomi, prosjektledelse eller tilsvarende
  • Erfaring fra prosjektplanlegging, prosjektledelse eller prosjektkoordinering
  • Erfaring med planleggingsverktøy som Microsoft Project eller tilsvarende
  • Interesse for eller erfaring med leverandørstyring, Supply Chain eller kontraktsoppfølging
  • God forretningsforståelse og evne til å se sammenhenger på tvers av organisasjonen
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk

Det er en fordel dersom du har erfaring fra prosjektbasert virksomhet, industri eller høyteknologiske miljøer.

Personlige egenskaper

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

  • Er strukturert og systematisk
  • Tar initiativ og arbeider selvstendig
  • Trives med å koordinere aktiviteter og skape fremdrift
  • Bygger tillit og gode samarbeidsrelasjoner
  • Evner å balansere detaljer og helhetsperspektiv
  • Er proaktiv og løsningsorientert

Hvorfor KONGSBERG?

Hos oss blir du en del av et internasjonalt teknologimiljø som utvikler løsninger for noen av verdens mest krevende kunder. Du får arbeide sammen med dyktige kolleger i et selskap med lange tradisjoner, høye ambisjoner og et sterkt fokus på innovasjon og samarbeid.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Utfordrende og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Et inkluderende og kompetent arbeidsmiljø
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Fleksible arbeidsordninger

Om Aviation Programs

Aviation Programs er ansvarlig for utvikling og leveranse av KONGSBERGs Digital Tower-løsninger, som digitaliserer og moderniserer flytårntjenester. Ved hjelp av avanserte sensorer, kameraer og programvare muliggjør vi sikker fjernstyring av flyplasser og bidrar til økt effektivitet og fleksibilitet i lufttrafikktjenesten.

Kandidater som søker på stillingen, vil i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprosessen bli gjenstand for bakgrunnssjekk og vurdering av denne vil bli lagt til grunn ved valg av kandidat.For å være aktuell kandidat til stillingen må du være kvalifisert for å bli sikkerhetsklarert, jfr. Sikkerhetsloven.

title: Client Service Representative
description:
VCA North Atlanta Animal Hospital is expanding our Patient Care Team and seeking a full-time Veterinary Assistant / Client Service Representative to join our team!


About Our Hospital

VCA North Atlanta Animal Hospital is a 2-doctor practice dedicated to providing high-quality veterinary care, including preventive medicine, surgery, dentistry, diagnostics, and client education. We pride ourselves on fostering a supportive team culture where experienced professionals are valued, encouraged to share their knowledge, and empowered to continue growing in their careers.


The Opportunity

This unique split-position is ideal for someone who enjoys both hands-on patient care and connecting with clients. You’ll have the opportunity to support our medical team as a Veterinary Assistant while also helping create a positive experience for pets and their families as a Client Service Representative.


What You’ll Do

  • Safely handle and restrain pets for exams and treatments
  • Prepare exam rooms and treatment areas
  • Assist doctors and technicians with appointments and procedures
  • Collect patient histories and assist with client communication
  • Feed, walk, and monitor hospitalized patients
  • Assist with laboratory samples, diagnostics, and surgical preparation
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization throughout the hospital
  • Provide compassionate care to patients throughout their visit
  • Welcome clients and their pets with a warm, friendly approach
  • Answer phones, schedule appointments, and assist with client questions
  • Check clients in and out and process payments
  • Maintain accurate client and patient information
  • Communicate with clients regarding appointments, services, and follow-up care
  • Help create a positive, welcoming experience for every client

As a VCA Associate, eligible full-time employees receive a comprehensive benefits package which may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

title: Relief/On Call LVT
description:
Locum Relief CVT: Work When You Want, Where You're Needed


VCA Animal Emergency Critical Care in Leesburg, VA is looking for a Locum Relief CVT to jump in when and where the team needs an extra set of skilled hands. No long-term commitment required, just bring your experience and your A-game.


If you like variety, hate being bored, and want the freedom to build a schedule around your life instead of the other way around, this is your kind of gig. You'll get the full ER/critical care experience. The fast pace, the real cases, the good kind of chaos without being locked into a fixed schedule..


The pay: $35-37 Based on experience and licensure, competitive with our full-time CVT compensation. Currently offering shift differential and shift bonus if called in, all in addition to hourly pay.


The schedule: Flexible / as-needed. Pick up shifts that work for you, including swing and overnight coverage.


What you'll actually be doing:

  • Jumping into physical exams, patient histories, and vitals like you've been here all along
  • Administering vaccines, meds, and treatments with accurate dosing and documentation
  • Medications, CRIs, transfusions, and treatments, dosed right and documented right
  • IV catheters, venipuncture, fluid therapy, high flow oxygen
  • Anesthesia inducing, monitoring, and keeping patients stable through procedures
  • Running radiography and in-house diagnostics
  • Talking clients through preventive care, meds, and at-home instructions
  • Keeping records tight and communication clear, even when you're new to the room
  • Handling everything from routine visits to full-blown emergencies without missing a beat

Who we're looking for: A CVT who can walk into a new environment, read the room fast, and get to work. Positive, adaptable, and comfortable being the "new face" on a shift. If you thrive on variety and want ER-level cases without ER-level commitment, we want to meet you.


Why VCA

VCA is one of the largest networks of animal hospitals in the country — but you'd never know it from the way we operate. Every hospital keeps its own identity, its own team, and its own culture, while giving you access to the resources, mentorship, and career opportunities of a national organization behind you. You get the best of both: the tight-knit feel of a local practice and the backing, benefits, and growth potential of an industry leader.


We're genuinely invested in your career — not just your job. From continuing education to credential support to nationwide transfer opportunities if life takes you somewhere new, we build the kind of support system that helps technicians build real, lasting careers, not just punch a clock. This is a place where your work is seen, your growth is prioritized, and your future in this field actually matters to us.


Interested in this opportunity?


Apply!


We look forward to hearing from you.

title: baker
description:
Brand:

Einstein Bros. Bagels

Breakfast with us, and dinner with your loved ones! At Einstein Bros. Bagels, we believe in the bagel, and we’ve been baking bagels fresh daily since 1995. We believe that our bakeries do more than just make the best breakfast in the neighborhood. We guarantee two things: First, to spread a little more joy and happiness in the world. To laugh, smile, and enjoy each other’s company that much more. And to us, there’s no better way to do that than with the bagel. Second: we are committed to work-life balance for our team. Our stores close at 2pm! You will never miss that dance recital or once in a lifetime concert. Join our team!

We are looking for a Baker!

We wouldn’t be much if we didn’t have our bagels, and a bagel is only as good as the person who bakes it! The baker is first in our hearts and the first ones in our bakeries. Our Bakers arrive early (as early as 3AM) turn on a podcast or their favorite band and take care of what makes us who we are – bagels!

What’s a day in the life of a Baker?

Our Bakers ensure quality product is available each shift by stocking the bagel wall and pastry case. We work as a team to provide excellent guest service by helping with order taking, sandwich making, etc. Our teams take pride in ensuring the quality of the food and beverages we serve; and by keeping a safe and clean store environment. Why would you want to work anywhere else? If this sounds like a place where you would enjoy coming to work, making people’s mornings, and continuing to grow in your career so you can rise like one of our bagels, we’d love to hear from you.

What’s in it for you:

  • You will never have to work past 3PM (Yep, you read that right! NO EVENINGS & NO NIGHTS!)
  • Competitive pay, plus cash and credit card tips*
  • Paid time off**
  • Employee Assistance Program – FREE therapy, financial advising, legal advice, etc.
  • Learn To Live – FREE online life coaching, webinars, to help with stress, anxiety, and more
  • 401K with company match!

  • Must be at least 18 years or older
  • Must be able to multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Must be able to work varied hours/days as business dictates including early hours (as early as 3am depending on the restaurant) and weekends
  • Must be able to pass background check as applicable with local, state, and federal law

*Tip eligibility subject to state regulations.

**Additional benefits eligibility is subject to position guidelines at time of hire.

$14.57 - $21.86 per hour
